The results also show that neither hybridization with synthetic data nor augmentation produced a better final deployment choice. These findings suggest that, for embedded UAV wildfire detection, dataset realism and domain alignment are more valuable than increasing training set size through synthetic expansion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了数据集构成对嵌入式无人机实时野火检测的影响，使用紧凑YOLO模型作为验证框架。通过比较四种训练配置（真实非增强、真实增强、混合非增强、混合增强），发现真实非增强数据集取得最佳性能，合成数据混合和图像增强均未带来更好的部署效果。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉的无人机野火检测系统受限于多样化真实世界训练图像的稀缺性，需要探究数据集构成对检测性能的实际影响。
AI.method: 以紧凑YOLO模型为受控验证框架，评估四种训练配置：真实非增强、真实增强、混合非增强（真实+AI生成）和混合增强，在资源受限部署条件下对比检测性能。
AI.result: 真实非增强数据集在召回率与平均精度均值之间取得最佳平衡，合成数据混合与图像增强均未产生更优的最终部署选择。
AI.conclusion: 对于嵌入式无人机野火检测，数据集的真实性和领域对齐比通过合成扩展增加训练集规模更具价值。

title: NL2SHACL-Bench: A Benchmark Suite for Natural Language to SHACL Translation
summary: SHACL is a core technology for validating the conformance of RDF knowledge graphs (KGs). Yet, authoring SHACL shapes requires technical expertise that most domain experts lack. Translating natural language requirements into SHACL (NL2SHACL) would lower this barrier. However, there is no dedicated benchmark for NL2SHACL, and evaluating generated shapes requires methods beyond string comparison, as semantically equivalent shapes can differ in serialisation and structure. To tackle these challenges, we present NL2SHACL-Bench, a benchmark suite for natural language to SHACL translation. Using NL2SHACL-Bench, we evaluate four state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) for this task. Our results show that current LLMs are highly capable of generating syntactically valid SHACL, but still struggle to produce semantically equivalent constraints for complex logical and structural patterns. This indicates that NL2SHACL-Bench provides a meaningful basis for measuring advances in the NL2SHACL state of the art.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了NL2SHACL-Bench，一个用于评估从自然语言到SHACL翻译任务的基准测试套件，并评估了四个先进大语言模型的性能，发现它们能生成语法有效的SHACL但在复杂逻辑和结构模式的语义等价性上仍有困难。
AI.motivation: SHACL是验证RDF知识图谱一致性的核心技术，但编写SHACL形状需要领域专家通常不具备的技术专长。将自然语言需求翻译为SHACL（NL2SHACL）可以降低这一门槛。然而，目前缺乏专门的NL2SHACL基准，且评估生成的形状需要超越字符串比较的方法，因为语义等价的形状可能在序列化和结构上有所不同。因此需要建立一个专门的基准来推动该领域的发展。
AI.method: 构建了NL2SHACL-Bench基准测试套件，用于自然语言到SHACL翻译任务的评估。该基准考虑了语义等价性评估，而不仅仅是字符串比较。利用该基准评估了四个最先进的大语言模型（LLMs）在NL2SHACL任务上的表现，涵盖语法有效性和语义等价性两个维度的分析。
AI.result: 评估结果表明，当前的大语言模型在生成语法有效的SHACL方面表现出高度能力，但在为复杂逻辑和结构模式生成语义等价的约束时仍然存在困难。
AI.conclusion: NL2SHACL-Bench为衡量NL2SHACL领域的进展提供了一个有意义的基础，当前LLMs在该任务上仍有提升空间，特别是在复杂语义约束的生成方面。

title: SparsePilot: Belief-Guided Network Planning under Sparse Wireless Measurements
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have emerged as a promising solution for on-demand wireless coverage planning in urban environments. Existing learning-based UAV control methods, however, typically rely on continuous access to dense user-level received signal strength (RSS) measurements. Such full-observation assumptions are difficult to satisfy in real-world deployments due to the high cost and limited availability of dense wireless feedback. Sparse-feedback decision making under severe observation constraints therefore represents a fundamental challenge. To fill this gap, we propose SparsePilot, a measurement-efficient sensing-control framework that couples active wireless probing with belief-guided network control. SparsePilot formulates spatial probing as a multi-armed bandit problem over grid cells, uses upper confidence bound probing to select informative regions, and aggregates sparse RSS measurements into a coverage belief map. A deep reinforcement learning controller then uses this belief state to generate continuous UAV mobility actions, while the full wireless state remains hidden from the policy. We further provide a theoretical analysis connecting sparse probing, belief estimation error, and the sparse-feedback performance gap. Experiments across seven urban digital twins show that SparsePilot achieves superior coverage restoration performance while using only about 3.1% of the full-observation measurement budget and demonstrates strong cross-scene generalization to unseen urban-scale wireless environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SparsePilot，一种面向无人机无线覆盖规划的测量高效感知-控制框架。该框架将空间探测建模为多臂老虎机问题，使用上置信界探测选择信息丰富的区域，将稀疏RSS测量聚合成覆盖置信图，再由深度强化学习控制器基于置信状态生成连续无人机移动动作。实验表明仅需约3.1%的测量预算即可实现优越的覆盖恢复性能，并具备跨场景泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的无人机控制方法依赖持续获取密集的用户级RSS测量，这种全观测假设在实际部署中因高成本和有限的无线反馈而难以满足。稀疏反馈下做出决策是根本性挑战，亟需测量高效的解决方案。
AI.method: SparsePilot将空间探测公式化为网格单元上的多臂老虎机问题，通过上置信界探测选择信息丰富的区域；将稀疏RSS测量聚合为覆盖置信图；深度强化学习控制器利用该置信状态生成连续无人机移动动作，而完整无线状态对策略隐藏。同时提供理论分析连接稀疏探测、置信估计误差与稀疏反馈性能差距。
AI.result: 在七个城市数字孪生上的实验表明，SparsePilot在覆盖恢复性能上优于现有方法，仅使用全观测测量预算的约3.1%，并展示了到未见城市规模无线环境的强大跨场景泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: SparsePilot通过主动无线探测与置信引导的深度强化学习控制相结合，有效解决了稀疏反馈下的无人机覆盖规划问题，大幅降低测量成本的同时保持优越性能，为实际部署提供了可行方案。

title: Ouroboros: A Self-Developing Frontier Coding Agent with Reviewed Core Evolution
summary:
We present Ouroboros, a self-developing agent harness whose tools, prompts, context assembly, and core implementation improve through reviewed commits that become the runtime for later work. Core evolution proceeds in two modes. In recursive free evolution, improvement is itself a task, and completing one evolution cycle can schedule the next. In experience-driven core evolution, ordinary work and social interaction expose bugs, rough edges, and inefficient context construction that lead to reviewed structural changes.
  On Terminal-Bench 2.1, an Opus 5 run scores 86.74%, the best result reported on the benchmark. On OSWorld-Verified, an Opus 5 run reaches 90.69%, exceeding the best previously reported score. A five-rollout CL-Bench campaign achieves a normalized reward of 0.2301, setting a new state of the art.
  Hope is the longest-running publicly documented Ouroboros deployment. It is a 161-day living agent experiment in free evolution under governed human communication across seven surfaces. Human interaction surfaces faults and generates proposals, but the agent decides which changes to pursue. Because a self-developing agent may rewrite its own code and select new model APIs, operational safety becomes a primary design problem: guardrails must remain authoritative under evolutionary and public social pressure. Benchmark campaigns use frozen system snapshots, while Hope continues live evolution on a separate lineage.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Ouroboros，一个自我发展的代理框架，其工具、提示词、上下文组装和核心实现通过审查后的提交来改进，这些提交成为后续工作的运行时。在Terminal-Bench 2.1和OSWorld-Verified上取得最佳成绩，并有161天的实时演化部署实验"Hope"。
AI.motivation: 现有AI代理系统缺乏自我改进能力，无法通过自身经验持续演化。作者希望构建一个能够从自身工作和社会交互中学习、演化并改进自身核心实现的代理框架，同时解决自我改写代码带来的操作安全问题。
AI.method: Ouroboros采用两种演化模式：1)递归自由演化——改进本身作为任务，完成一个演化周期可安排下一个；2)经验驱动的核心演化——普通工作和社会交互暴露出的bug、粗糙边缘和低效上下文构建导致审查后的结构变更。同时引入"Hope"作为长期实时演化的部署实验，基准测试使用冻结系统快照，而Hope在独立谱系上持续演化。
AI.result: 在Terminal-Bench 2.1上Opus 5运行达到86.74%的最高分；在OSWorld-Verified上达到90.69%超过此前最好成绩；在CL-Bench上以五次rollout获得0.2301的归一化奖励，创造新的SOTA。Hope是运行161天的实时演化部署，跨越七个平台在治理化人类通信下进行自由演化。
AI.conclusion: Ouroboros证明了自我发展的代理框架可以在多种基准上达到SOTA性能，并能在长期实时部署中持续演化。由于自我发展的代理可以重写自身代码和选择新的模型API，操作安全成为主要设计问题——护栏必须在演化和公共社会压力下保持权威性。

authors: Venkata Naga Sai Vishnu Rohit Pulipaka
title: Evaluating Dedicated Monolingual and Joint Multilingual Causal Models for Dravidian Languages
summary: Dravidian languages, mainly Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam make up only a small part of the data used to train multilingual language models, so it's not clear how much per-language ability these models actually keep. I have trained five GPT-2 architecture models from scratch to compare four monolingual models (one each for Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam, each with its own 32K-vocabulary subword tokenizer) against one multilingual model sharing a 64K-vocabulary subword tokenizer across all four languages. All the 5 models are trained on cleaned CC-100, Wikipedia, and Samanantar data. I have tested the models on perplexity, bits-per-byte, tokenizer efficiency, and fine-tuning results which are compared against mGPT. The monolingual models outperform mGPT on sentiment classification and named entity recognition, and their tokenizers proved more efficient than the shared multilingual model across all the languages tested.

AI.tldr: 本文从头训练了五个GPT-2架构模型（四个单语模型分别对应泰米尔语、泰卢固语、卡纳达语和马拉雅拉姆语，以及一个共享64K词表的跨语言模型），通过困惑度、字节/比特、分词器效率和微调结果等多维度评估，发现单语模型在情感分类和命名实体识别上优于mGPT，且分词器效率高于共享多语言模型。
AI.motivation: 达罗毗荼语系语言（泰米尔语、泰卢固语、卡纳达语、马拉雅拉姆语）在训练多语言模型时占比很小，因此这些模型对每种语言的实际能力并不明确。作者希望通过系统性对比单语与多语言模型的性能，填补这一认知空白。
AI.method: 训练五个GPT-2架构模型：四个单语模型（各自使用32K词表的子词分词器）加一个跨四种语言的多语言模型（共享64K词表分词器）。所有模型使用经过清洗的CC-100、Wikipedia和Samanantar数据训练。评估指标包括困惑度、每字节比特数、分词器效率以及微调后的下游任务表现，与mGPT进行对比。
AI.result: 单语模型在情感分类和命名实体识别任务上优于mGPT；所有测试语言中，单语模型的分词器效率均高于共享的多语言模型。
AI.conclusion: 对于低资源语言的达罗毗荼语系，从头训练单语模型比依赖通用多语言模型（如mGPT）更具优势，无论是在分词效率还是下游任务性能方面。

title: MVMD: A Multi-View Approach for Enhanced Mirror Detection
comment: This work has already published at WACV 2025, just want more accessibility
summary:
In 3D reconstruction, mirrors introduce significant challenges by creating distorted and fragmented spaces, resulting in inaccurate and unreliable 3D models. As 3D reconstruction typically relies on multi-view images to capture different perspectives of a scene, detecting and labeling mirrors in multi-view images before reconstruction can effectively address this issue. However, existing methods focus solely on single-image detection, overlooking the rich information provided by multi-view setups. To overcome this limitation, we propose MVMD, a novel Multi-View Mirror Detection method, along with the first database specifically designed for mirror detection in multi-view scenes.
  The design of MVMD is grounded in the inherent associations between objects seen from different views and those reflected inside and outside of mirrors. These relationships are learned through cross- and self-attention mechanisms. MVMD consists of three key blocks: the Inter-Views Block tracks the shifts of objects within mirrors caused by changes in viewpoint; the Intra-View Block detects object reflections inside mirrors; and the Refinement Block sharpens mirror boundaries and enhances detected details.
  Experimental results show that our method improves accuracy by up to 2.6% and IoU by up to 11.1%, compared to single-image mirror detection techniques. This substantial improvement makes MVMD particularly effective for computer vision tasks, especially in enhancing the accuracy of 3D reconstruction in mirror-dense environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MVMD，一种多视图镜子检测方法，利用多视图图像间的关联信息来检测镜子，解决了单图检测忽略多视图丰富信息的问题。实验表明相比单图方法，准确率提升2.6%，IoU提升11.1%，可显著改善3D重建在镜子密集环境中的精度。
AI.motivation: 3D重建中镜子会引入畸变和碎片化的空间，导致3D模型不准确不可靠。在重建前检测多视图图像中的镜子可以有效解决此问题，但现有方法仅聚焦于单图检测，忽略了多视图设置提供的丰富信息。
AI.method: MVMD基于不同视角下物体与其镜内外反射之间的内在关联，通过交叉注意力和自注意力机制学习这些关系。模型由三个关键模块组成：Inter-Views Block追踪视角变化引起的镜内物体位移；Intra-View Block检测镜内物体反射；Refinement Block锐化镜子边界并增强检测细节。同时构建了第一个多视图镜子检测数据库。
AI.result: 相比单图镜子检测方法，MVMD准确率提升高达2.6%，IoU提升高达11.1%。该方法在计算机视觉任务中特别有效，能显著提高镜子密集环境下3D重建的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 多视图信息对镜子检测具有重要价值，MVMD通过多视图关联学习有效提升了镜子检测性能，并可大幅改善3D重建在镜子密集环境中的精度。

title: Dynamic Coalition Formation and Communication Pricing in Skill-Based Agentic AI Systems
summary: Modern agentic AI systems combine multiple large language model agents with heterogeneous skills, yet most architectures either fix communication in advance or allow full broadcast. Both can be inefficient because token cost, latency, redundancy, and error propagation increase with the number of active agents and communication links. We model agent selection and communication as a cooperative game with task-conditioned net utility $U(C\mid x)=V(C\mid x)-\sum_{i\in C}c_i$, separating coalition-level costs from agent activation costs. We propose a marginal-value activation rule and greedy router, extend the model to optimize communication edges with per-edge costs, and use estimated Shapley values to predict which agents are worth contacting before and during execution. We connect the problem to submodular maximization and prove two limited guarantees: a curvature-refined bound for a monotone, cardinality-constrained special case, and a tight $1/2$-approximation, with a correction for signed objectives, for an unconstrained non-monotone case via double greedy. Neither guarantee applies directly to the main router, which remains a heuristic. We also prove a Shapley-submodularity sandwich bound linking the error of marginal-value routing to a per-agent diminishing-returns quantity. In synthetic experiments, greedy routing achieves $99.5%$ of brute-force-optimal utility while activating $1.96$ of $8$ agents on average, compared with $38.8%$ for full broadcast. Performance is robust to activation cost and redundancy weight but falls to $66%$ under strong violations of submodularity or noisy value estimates. We distinguish the framework from Shapley pricing, hedonic coalition formation, and communication-graph pruning, and propose evaluation on real multi-agent LLM benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将智能体选择与通信建模为带任务条件净效用的合作博弈，通过边际价值激活规则和贪心路由器动态选择智能体及通信边，在合成实验中达到贪心最优效用的99.5%，同时仅激活8个智能体中的1.96个，相比全广播的38.8%显著更优。
AI.motivation: 现代多智能体AI系统要么预先固定通信架构，要么允许全广播通信，二者都因活跃智能体数量和通信链路增加而导致token成本、延迟、冗余和错误传播效率低下，缺乏动态、自适应的智能体选择与通信优化机制。
AI.method: 将智能体选择和通信建模为合作博弈，定义任务条件净效用U(C|x)=V(C|x)-Σc_i，分离联盟级成本与激活成本；提出边际价值激活规则和贪心路由器；扩展到带边成本的通信边优化；使用估计Shapley值在运行前和运行中预测值得联系的智能体；将问题关联到子模最大化并证明两个有限保证（曲率精化界和tight 1/2近似）。
AI.result: 合成实验中贪心路由达到暴力最优效用的99.5%，平均激活8个中的1.96个智能体，而全广播仅达38.8%；对激活成本和冗余权重鲁棒，但在子模性严重违反或价值估计有噪声时降至66%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架区别于Shapley定价、享乐群联盟形成和通信图剪枝等方法，提出在真实多智能体LLM基准上的评估方向，为主路由器提供了实用启发式方案，尽管其理论保证尚未直接覆盖。

title: Automated Synthesis of Deterministic Cross-Domain Interfaces
summary: Deterministic networking spans heterogeneous domains. At each boundary, two domains must agree on an assume--guarantee contract: what traffic the client may inject, and the QoS the carrier will hold for it. Composing such contracts into an end-to-end guarantee is standardized, but deriving each domain's contract is not. Today they are hand-crafted, static, and over-provisioned. The difficulty rises when traffic changes and the contract must become dynamic. We present a framework that automatically synthesizes the per-domain contract for both static and dynamic classes, along with the registration the dynamic one rests on. Two reasoning modules implemented with large language models (LLMs) drive it: an agent takes the client's traffic declaration and searches the carrier's configuration mechanisms, and a handler builds the network model from a typed disclosure of the substrate. The handler calls a network-calculus kernel for the model's hard terms, and an independent oracle---a faithful simulator, testbed, or live network---which verifies each candidate and discovers what lacks an a-priori algebraic form: when a reconfiguration is safe, and the instant to apply it. We synthesized a dynamic contract for uplink 5G fronthaul over a TDM-PON, grounded against a packet-level simulator. Across six draws from two LLM families, every synthesis produced a feasible, verified contract tight to ${\sim}1.2\,μ$s, holding a $100$-$μ$s deadline that reactive scheduling cannot meet, at up to $3.5$ times the bandwidth efficiency of static over-provisioning. Tasked instead with computing the worst-case delay directly, the LLMs were unsound in five of six attempts---evidence for the division of labor: LLMs construct the model, formal tools hold numeric authority. The same framework, unchanged, synthesized a static 5G--TSN bridge contract on a second substrate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个自动合成跨域确定性网络每域契约（assume-guarantee contract）的框架，支持静态与动态两类契约。框架由两个基于LLM的推理模块驱动：智能体搜索载体的配置机制，处理器构建网络模型并调用网络微积分内核与独立验证器（模拟器/测试台/实网）。在TDM-PON上综合5G前传动态契约，验证可行且紧致至~1.2μs，带宽效率较静态超配高3.5倍；直接让LLM计算最坏情况时延在六次尝试中五次不健全，证明"LLM建模型、形式工具管数值"的职责分工。
AI.motivation: 确定性网络跨异构域，每个域边界需要手动、静态且过度配置的assume-guarantee契约，缺乏自动化推导方法；当流量变化需要动态契约时难度更大。现有标准化只管契约组合，不管契约推导。
AI.method: 框架由两个LLM驱动的模块组成：(1) 智能体（agent）根据客户端流量声明搜索载体配置机制；(2) 处理器（handler）依据底层网络类型化披露构建网络模型，调用网络微积分内核处理硬项，并调用独立验证器（仿真器、测试台或实网）验证每个候选方案，发现缺乏先验代数形式的安全重配置时刻与适用时机。
AI.result: 在TDM-PON上为5G上行前传综合出动态契约，经包级仿真器验证：两个LLM家族六次抽取均产生可行验证契约，紧致至~1.2μs，满足100μs截止期（反应式调度无法做到），带宽效率较静态超配高3.5倍。若直接让LLM计算最坏情况时延，六次中五次不健全。同一框架未改动即在第二载体上综合出静态5G-TSN桥接契约。
AI.conclusion: LLM适合构建网络模型和搜索配置空间，但数值计算必须交给形式化工具（网络微积分内核与独立验证器）。这种职责分工能在跨域确定性网络场景中自动、可靠地综合出动态契约，且框架具备泛化能力。

title: Do Stack Overflow Answer Edits Occur Beyond Java? A Replication on Python and JavaScript
summary: Stack Overflow answers are continually revised by the community, and the edits made to their code snippets are a potential source of improvements for code that has been reused in open-source projects. A recent empirical study established this for Java, reporting that 16.11% of accepted Java answers are edited and that the resulting recommendations concentrate in highly popular GitHub projects. Whether that behaviour is a property of Stack Overflow or a property of the Java community has remained an open question. We replicate the study on Python and JavaScript, the two most widely used languages alongside Java, applying the same SOTorrent-based extraction pipeline, the same clone search tool, Siamese+, and the same project popularity criteria. Analysing 840,132 accepted Python answers and 1,144,185 accepted JavaScript answers, we find that 41.25% and 39.10% respectively have been edited at least once, roughly two and a half times the Java rate, while the number of revisions per edited answer is almost invariant across the three languages at 2.78, 2.68 and 2.82. Searching 100 GitHub projects per language, we find that the number of matched answer edits increases monotonically from low- to medium- to high-popularity projects in both languages, from 80 to 156 to 977 for Python and from 32 to 71 to 353 for JavaScript. The difference is statistically significant for Python but not for JavaScript. The central findings of the original study therefore generalise beyond Java, with the supply of candidate improvements considerably larger in both replication languages than in the original.

AI.tldr: 本研究在Python和JavaScript上复现了先前关于Stack Overflow答案编辑对开源项目代码改进影响的研究（原研究针对Java）。发现Python和JavaScript的接受答案编辑率（41.25%和39.10%）约为Java（16.11%）的2.5倍，但每个被编辑答案的修订次数在三种语言中几乎一致（约2.7-2.8次）。在GitHub项目中的匹配编辑数量随项目流行度单调递增，Python差异显著而JavaScript不显著。核心发现可泛化到Java之外。
AI.motivation: 原研究仅针对Java，发现16.11%的被接受Java答案被编辑，且改进建议集中在高人气GitHub项目中。但这一行为究竟是Stack Overflow的普遍属性还是Java社区特有的现象仍属未知，因此需要在其他主流语言上进行复现验证。
AI.method: 使用与原研究相同的SOTorrent提取管线、相同的克隆搜索工具Siamese+以及相同的项目流行度标准，在Python（840,132个被接受答案）和JavaScript（1,144,185个被接受答案）上进行复现。每种语言搜索100个GitHub项目，按低、中、高流行度分组比较匹配的答案编辑数量。
AI.result: Python和JavaScript的被接受答案编辑率分别为41.25%和39.10%，约为Java的2.5倍；每个被编辑答案的修订次数三种语言几乎不变（2.78、2.68、2.82）。匹配编辑数量从低到高流行度项目单调递增：Python为80→156→977，JavaScript为32→71→353。Python差异统计显著，JavaScript不显著。
AI.conclusion: 原研究的核心发现可泛化到Java之外的编程语言，且Python和JavaScript中候选改进的供给量比Java大得多，说明该现象是Stack Overflow平台属性的体现而非Java社区特性。

title: The No-Meaning Falsity: The Structural Impossibility of the Arbitrary Sign in Classical Arabic
summary: This paper investigates whether the postmodern claim of unrestricted semantic indeterminacy, and its foundational Saussurean axiom of the arbitrary sign, are compatible with the structural architecture of Classical Arabic. We develop a formal mathematical model of Arabic non concatenative morphology in which lexical meaning is determined by the interaction between an invariant root and a morphosyntactic pattern. Within this framework, we establish a Morphological Correspondence Theorem, demonstrating that every lexical item is uniquely generated by a root pattern pair, and a Semantic Localization Theorem, proving that lexical meaning is determined at the derivational level prior to surface realization. To address Saussurean weaker notion of relative arbitrariness, we formalize it via conditional Kolmogorov complexity, defining arbitrariness algorithmically as the no rule property. We prove that general relative arbitrariness is formally undecidable, while Arabic relative arbitrariness is decidable and provably less than 1 for its motivated signifiers (Levels W and M), establishing a strict system complexity asymmetry over Indo-European languages.

AI.tldr: 本文通过形式化数学模型论证古典阿拉伯语的非连接形态学与索绪尔任意符号原则不相容，证明阿拉伯语中词汇意义由不变词根与形态句法模式的确定性交互生成，并用条件Kolmogorov复杂度形式化相对任意性，证明阿拉伯语动机符号的相对任意性可判定且小于1，与印欧语言形成严格系统性复杂度不对称。
AI.motivation: 检验后现代主义关于无限制语义不确定性的主张及其索绪尔任意符号公理是否与古典阿拉伯语的结构架构兼容，试图从形式数学角度挑战语言任意性的普遍性论断。
AI.method: 构建阿拉伯语非连接形态学的正式数学模型，将词汇意义刻画为不变词根与形态句法模式的交互；建立形态对应定理和语义定位定理；用条件Kolmogorov复杂度将索绪尔的相对任意性形式化为"无规则"算法属性，并通过可判定性与复杂度比较加以证明。
AI.result: 证明了每个词汇项由词根-模式对唯一生成；词汇意义在派生层（表层实现之前）已确定；一般相对任意性形式不可判定，而阿拉伯语相对任意性可判定且对动机符号严格小于1，确立了对印欧语言的系统复杂度不对称。
AI.conclusion: 阿拉伯语的结构架构在形式上不支持后现代主义所主张的无限制语义不确定性，其非连接形态学中的动机符号体系与索绪尔任意符号公理在严格意义上不相容，至少在相对任意性的较弱版本下仍与印欧语言存在本质性结构差异。

title: XEns-CKD: An Explainable Ensemble-Based Approach for Chronic Kidney Disease Stage Detection
summary: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is a silent disease. Its progression may not significantly hamper a person's daily routine. Human kidney function can be classified as normal or as one of the five stages of CKD. Early detection of the CKD stage can help patients understand the functional status of their kidneys and follow medical advice to slow CKD progression. In this paper, we propose XEns-CKD, a novel ensemble vision transformer-based scheme for CKD stage classification using ultrasound images. Three ViTs were trained on a private ultrasound image dataset using different training parameters. The performance of each ViT was evaluated using macro sensitivity, macro specificity, macro precision, macro F1-score, macro Youden index, the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC), and macro balanced accuracy. The ensemble model achieved an overall classification accuracy of 86.36%. This work also emphasizes identifying and interpreting kidney regions affected by CKD progression. Explainable artificial intelligence techniques, including LIME, LRP, Attention-Min, and Attention-Max, were used to improve model transparency and clinical trust. An attention map combining the Attention-Min and Attention-Max results effectively identified and interpreted kidney regions affected during CKD progression from one stage to another. The attention map also highlighted the effects of CKD progression in these regions. Compared with existing methods, the proposed method classified the five CKD stages and normal kidney status with a 4% improvement in accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出XEns-CKD，一种基于集成视觉Transformer（ViT）的方案，用于利用超声图像对慢性肾病（CKD）进行分类，将肾功能分为正常及五个CKD阶段，整体分类准确率达86.36%，并采用可解释人工智能（XAI）技术（LIME、LRP、Attention-Min/Attention-Max）提高模型透明度和临床可信度。
AI.motivation: CKD是一种"无声"疾病，进展可能不会显著影响日常活动，但早期检测CKD阶段能帮助患者了解肾功能状态并遵循医嘱以减缓疾病进展。因此需要一种有效的自动分类方法来早期识别CKD分期。
AI.method: 提出XEns-CKD集成方案：使用三个ViT在私有超声图像数据集上以不同训练参数分别训练，集成模型综合各ViT的预测结果；同时使用XAI技术（LIME、LRP、Attention-Min、Attention-Max）识别和解释肾脏受影响区域，并将Attention-Min与Attention-Max结果结合生成注意力图以可视化CKD进展。
AI.result: 集成模型整体分类准确率为86.36%；与现有方法相比，在五阶段CKD和正常肾脏状态分类上准确率提升4%。注意力图能有效识别并解释CKD从一个阶段进展到另一个阶段时受影响的肾脏区域。
AI.conclusion: XEns-CKD通过集成ViT和可解释AI技术，在CKD分期分类上获得优于现有方法的准确率，同时提升了模型透明度和临床可信度，有助于早期检测和了解CKD进展。

title: MetaSpace: Metamorphic Testing for Spatial Cognition in Embodied Agents
comment: 30 pages, 17 figures. Published in Proceedings of the ACM on Programming Languages (OOPSLA1)
summary:
An embodied agent is an intelligent entity that interacts with its environment through a physical body. Currently, the evaluation of embodied agents primarily relies on two paradigms: (1) manually annotated Visual Question Answering (VQA) pairs and (2) high-level task completion metrics, such as success in navigation or manipulation. The former is labor-intensive and subject to variability in annotation quality. The latter may obscure critical vulnerabilities, allowing agents to complete tasks through suboptimal means or safety violations, thereby concealing safety risks and inefficiencies. Given that spatial cognition is the cornerstone for executing embodied tasks, there is a pressing need to assess whether embodied agents possess robust spatial cognition during task execution.
  Inspired by metamorphic testing principles in software engineering, we propose MetaSpace, a novel framework designed to evaluate the spatial cognition of agents. By leveraging spatiotemporal multimodal states derived from real execution trajectories, MetaSpace automatically generates test cases based on predefined metamorphic relations (MRs) grounded in logical rules and physical laws. Crucially, we encode these MRs as executable rules in a logic programming language (Prolog). Violations of these relations indicate failures in spatial cognition. Our empirical evaluation across three embodied scenarios demonstrates that MetaSpace successfully detects 90,422 spatial cognition errors in state-of-the-art (SOTA) MLLM-driven agents. We introduce the Spatial Cognition (SC) score to quantify performance. Results indicate that all SOTA agents achieve average scores between 0.44 and 0.52, significantly lower than the human benchmark of 0.96.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MetaSpace框架，基于蜕变测试原理评估具身智能体的空间认知能力。通过将物理规律和逻辑规则编码为Prolog可执行规则，自动生成测试用例，在三个具身场景中检测出90,422个空间认知错误，所有SOTA智能体得分仅0.44-0.52，远低于人类基准0.96。
AI.motivation: 现有具身智能体评估主要依赖人工标注的VQA对和高层任务完成指标，前者成本高且质量不稳定，后者可能掩盖安全风险和效率问题。由于空间认知是执行具身任务的基石，亟需一种能够评估智能体在执行任务过程中是否具备稳健空间认知能力的方法。
AI.method: 借鉴软件工程中的蜕变测试原理，提出MetaSpace框架。利用真实执行轨迹中的时空多模态状态，基于逻辑规则和物理定律预定义蜕变关系（MRs），并将MRs编码为Prolog语言中的可执行规则。通过检测这些关系的违反来判断空间认知失败。
AI.result: 在三个具身场景中对SOTA MLLM驱动的智能体进行实证评估，MetaSpace成功检测出90,422个空间认知错误。引入空间认知（SC）评分量化性能，所有SOTA智能体平均得分在0.44-0.52之间，显著低于人类基准的0.96。
AI.conclusion: 当前最先进的具身智能体在空间认知方面与人类仍存在巨大差距，MetaSpace提供了一种自动化、可扩展的评估框架，能够有效揭示传统评估指标所掩盖的空间认知缺陷，为该领域的发展提供了新的评估视角。

title: Enabling Beyond-Visual-Line-of-Sight Drones Operation over Open RAN 5G Networks with Slicing
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Published in IEEE Network
summary: Among the foretold claims of the transition from 5G to 6G, Beyond-Visual-Line-of-Sight (BVLoS) drone operation has emerged as a prominent Internet-of-Robots enabler. However, safety concerns have been raised since BVLoS imposes strict requirements on performance and dependability on the technology, and requires robust regulatory frameworks. While current 5G technologies promise to meet the performance requirements in terms of throughput and latency, there is a lack of studies regarding how to achieve full reliability in practice. To address this challenge, the research community is actively working on open-source projects that allow for experimental validation in the field. Fortunately, new Open RAN (O-RAN) standards are paving the way for such approaches in an integrated, native manner. In this work, we deploy a state-of-the-art 5G O-RAN open-source BVLoS operational system, report current limitations, and address them via advanced capabilities natively available in O-RAN: Slicing. Our proposed deployment minimizes trajectory errors due to 5G link congestion and keeps latency well below the 3GPP limits defined for BVLoS operation. Finally, we discuss on the challenges ahead and the opportunities that 5G O-RAN-enabled networks may bring to BVLoS drone operation.

AI.tldr: 本文部署了一个基于5G O-RAN开源平台的超视距（BVLoS）无人机操作系统，利用O-RAN原生的网络切片能力解决链路拥塞导致的轨迹误差问题，并将延迟保持在3GPP定义的BVLoS作业限制之内。
AI.motivation: BVLoS无人机作业是5G向6G过渡的重要应用场景，但5G技术虽然在吞吐量和延迟方面满足性能要求，却缺乏如何在实际中实现完全可靠性的研究。现有研究缺少现场实验验证的实践方案。
AI.method: 部署一个基于最新5G O-RAN开源平台的BVLoS实际操作系统，报告现有局限性，并利用O-RAN原生支持的网络切片（Slicing）高级功能来解决这些问题。
AI.result: 所提出的部署方案能够最小化因5G链路拥塞导致的轨迹误差，并将延迟保持在3GPP为BVLoS作业所定义的极限值以下。
AI.conclusion: 总结了未来面临的挑战以及5G O-RAN网络为BVLoS无人机作业可能带来的机遇。

title: Tangent: An Empirical Study of Testing Practices for LLM-Based Agent Applications
summary: Agents built on large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to build applications that perform complex, multi-step tasks involving reasoning, tool use, and interaction with external environments. Despite rapid progress in benchmarking LLM-based agents, very few studies have attempted to understand how such systems are tested in practice. In particular, testing levels, objectives, data patterns, test complexity, and validation strategies for agent applications remain underexplored. In this paper, we present an empirical study of testing practices in LLM-based agent applications using a large corpus of mined open-source projects. We construct a large-scale dataset of agent applications, tools, and tests, and manually label 2,572 test methods from 240 modules. From this analysis, we derive a taxonomy of 23 testing patterns across test fixtures, data, objectives, and assertions, and characterize tests by level (unit, module, integration). We complement this with structured interviews of 10 senior industry practitioners building agentic systems. Our results show that testing of LLM-based agent applications is dominated by narrowly scoped unit tests, with limited coverage of complex interactions, realistic scenarios, and non-functional requirements. Tests frequently rely on simplistic inputs, heavy mocking, and shallow validation, and agent-related tests exhibit low structural complexity. While industry practice places greater emphasis on non-functional testing than open-source projects, both reveal common gaps, including the lack of formal testing foundations, unclear test objectives, and challenges in generating high-quality test data. Based on these findings, we outline research directions toward more systematic and rigorous testing of agent applications, including foundations for agent testability, formalized test objectives, and fault-based testing techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文通过挖掘大规模开源项目语料库并手工标注2,572个测试方法，结合对10位资深行业从业者的结构化访谈，首次对LLM智能体应用的测试实践进行了实证研究，提出了包含23种测试模式的分类体系，发现当前测试以窄范围的单元测试为主，缺乏对复杂交互、真实场景和非功能需求的覆盖。
AI.motivation: 尽管基于LLM的智能体应用发展迅速，但很少有研究系统地理解这类系统在实际中如何被测试。测试层级、目标、数据模式、测试复杂度和验证策略等关键问题仍未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 构建大规模智能体应用、工具和测试数据集；手工标注来自240个模块的2,572个测试方法；推导出覆盖测试固件、数据、目标和断言的23种测试模式分类体系；按单元/模块/集成层级表征测试；并对10位高级行业从业者进行结构化访谈。
AI.result: 测试以窄范围的单元测试为主，对复杂交互、真实场景和非功能需求覆盖有限；测试常依赖简化输入、重度模拟和浅层验证；智能体相关测试结构复杂度低；行业实践比开源项目更重视非功能测试，但两者都缺少正式测试基础、测试目标不清晰、高质量测试数据生成困难。
AI.conclusion: 基于研究发现，提出了更系统、更严谨的智能体应用测试研究方向，包括智能体可测试性基础、形式化测试目标以及基于故障的测试技术。

title: Jako Tako or Fluent? Presenting PoVisLE: A Polish Vision-Language Evaluation
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance on tasks such as image captioning, visual question answering, and image-to-text generation. However, they are predominantly trained on English-centric data, which limits their ability to handle culturally grounded visual understanding and leads to failures in interpreting region-specific meanings, symbolic content, and context-dependent visual cues. Existing benchmarks for cultural competence are often template-driven and focused on surface-level recognition, making them insufficient for evaluating deeper linguistic and pragmatic understanding in culturally situated settings. We introduce PoVisLE, a monocultural vision-language benchmark for Polish designed to evaluate culturally grounded multimodal understanding under a grounded evaluation paradigm, where language is interpreted in interaction with visual context. The dataset contains 1,117 images and 2,366 manually annotated VQA pairs. Overall, our dataset provides a controlled and challenging resource for assessing culturally grounded vision-language understanding beyond surface-level recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PoVisLE，一个面向波兰语的单一文化视觉语言基准数据集，包含1,117张图像和2,366个手工标注的VQA问答对，采用"接地评估"范式评估模型在文化情境中的多模态理解能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型主要基于英语中心数据训练，缺乏对文化特定视觉内容（如区域符号、情境依赖线索）的深层理解能力。已有文化能力基准多为模板驱动、只关注表层识别，无法评估深层语言语用理解。
AI.method: 构建PoVisLE数据集，采用接地评估范式（语言需结合视觉情境进行解读），包含1,117幅波兰文化图像和2,366个手工标注的VQA问答对，区分于表层识别任务，强调文化与语境的交互理解。
AI.result: 产出一个受控且具有挑战性的波兰文化多模态理解基准资源，可用于评估VLM在超越表层识别的文化接地视觉语言理解能力。
AI.conclusion: PoVisLE为评估视觉语言模型在文化特定情境中的深层理解能力提供了新资源，弥补了现有基准在文化深度评估方面的不足。

title: Mechanistic Interpretability-Guided Selective Fine-Tuning of Vision-Language Models for Centimeter-Level Flood Depth Estimation
comment: This Paper is accepted in International Conference on Machine Learning and Application (ICMLA) 2026
summary: Urban flooding poses an escalating threat to transportation infrastructure, yet no operational system provides real-time, street-level flood-depth estimates at centimeter resolution. This paper presents three vision-language models fine-tuned for continuous flood-depth estimation from street-level imagery: FloodLlama-Dense, a fully fine-tuned QLoRA baseline, and FloodLlama-MI5 and FloodLlama-MI6, interpretability-guided sparse variants that fine-tune only the top five and six causally relevant cross-attention layers identified through mechanistic interpretability analysis, respectively. Training uses an approximately 610,000-image subset of a 2.81-million-image synthetic corpus generated in Unreal Engine 5. The dataset combines single-vehicle subsets with 5 cm depth increments and mixed-vehicle subsets with 1 cm depth increments, spanning seven vehicle types, four weather conditions, and flood depths from 0 to 40 cm. FloodLlama-Dense achieves an MAE of 0.40 cm, an RMSE of 1.97 cm, and an Acc@5cm of 97.59%. Mechanistic interpretability analysis combining linear probing, logit lens, centered kernel alignment (CKA), and cross-attention entropy reveals a two-stage adaptation pattern: layers L13-L22 restructure visual representations, while depth first becomes linearly decodable at layer L23. FloodLlama-MI5 and FloodLlama-MI6 leverage this insight by fine-tuning only five or six of the eight cross-attention layers, achieving an 86-88% reduction in trainable parameters (6.55-7.86 million versus 54.4 million) with minimal accuracy loss. On a real-world benchmark, FloodLlama-MI6 achieves 98.62% accuracy, compared with 86.61% for the published STURM-FloodDepth baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了三个用于街景图像连续洪水深度估计的视觉-语言模型（FloodLlama-Dense、FloodLlama-MI5、FloodLlama-MI6），在Unreal Engine 5生成的约281万张合成图像子集上训练。全微调模型MAE仅0.40 cm，而基于机制可解释性分析仅微调少量交叉注意力层的稀疏变体可将可训练参数减少86-88%且几乎无精度损失，在真实基准上显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 城市洪水对交通基础设施构成日益严重的威胁，但目前尚无操作性系统能够以厘米级分辨率提供实时、街道级别的洪水深度估计。现有方法缺乏实时性和精度，需要一种能从街景图像中连续估计洪水深度的新方法。
AI.method: （1）使用Unreal Engine 5生成约281万张合成图像语料，涵盖7种车辆类型、4种天气条件和0-40 cm洪水深度；（2）微调三个视觉-语言模型：全微调的FloodLlama-Dense（QLoRA基线），以及基于机制可解释性分析（线性探针、logit lens、CKA、交叉注意力熵）识别因果相关层后仅微调少量交叉注意力层的FloodLlama-MI5和MI6；（3）在真实世界基准上评估。
AI.result: FloodLlama-Dense达到MAE 0.40 cm、RMSE 1.97 cm、Acc@5cm 97.59%。机制可解释性分析揭示两阶段适应模式：L13-L22层重构视觉表征，深度在L23层首次可线性解码。MI5和MI6仅微调5-6个交叉注意力层，可训练参数从54.4M降至6.55-7.86M（减少86-88%），精度损失极小。真实基准上MI6达98.62%准确率，远超STURM-FloodDepth基线的86.61%。
AI.conclusion: 机制可解释性分析可以有效识别最关键的模型层进行稀疏微调，在大幅降低计算成本的同时保持高精度。该方法证明了合成数据用于训练厘米级洪水深度估计模型的可行性，并为模型可解释性与高效微调的结合提供了有力示范。

title: When LLM Agents Negotiate: Private Information and Dynamic Bargaining in Supply Chains
summary: As LLM agents move from decision support to autonomous procurement, firms need to know whether delegated negotiators create value, divide it predictably, and avoid money-losing contracts. We study this in a canonical supply chain bargaining problem: a buyer with private demand information negotiates a quantity-payment contract with an uninformed seller. We benchmark nine LLMs from OpenAI, Google, and Alibaba against a validated Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium across 9,840 LLM-to-LLM negotiations. First, capability governs value creation. Agents agree in 98.9% of negotiations and capture 95.4% of first-best surplus undiscounted, but average 2.98 rounds against the benchmark's 1.25, and this delay erodes 21-34% of surplus. Capability also governs reliability: baseline models accept individually irrational contracts in 19.2% of cases, versus 0.0-0.6% at mid-tier and flagship, making automated profit verification the binding guardrail below that threshold. Second, surplus capture is relational. Provider identity predicts who captures surplus better than capability rank: self-play buyer shares average 40% for OpenAI, 50% for Google, and 70% for Alibaba's Qwen, an ordering that survives restricted communication and no discounting. Reversing which provider sells moves the division by 7-18 percentage points, and the capable Qwen flagship is the weakest cross-family seller: vendor choice is a first-order distributional decision. Third, the prompt is a strategic lever. Delegation separates the principal's economic patience from the agent's prompted strategic patience, a free deployment choice that is the single strongest driver of surplus division (90% of explained variance). Together these establish an equilibrium-referenced audit of AI agents along three dimensions: discounted efficiency, distributional profile, and operational reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM代理在供应链讨价还价中的表现，通过9,840次LLM对LLM的谈判实验，评估了九种主流LLM在价值创造、剩余分配和可靠性三个维度上的能力。发现模型能力决定价值创造与可靠性，剩余分配受提供者身份和提示策略影响，并建立了以均衡为基准的AI代理审计框架。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM代理从决策支持转向自主采购，企业需要了解被委托的谈判代理是否能创造价值、可预测地分配价值，并避免亏损合同。这是一个尚未被系统研究的关键问题。
AI.method: 在经典的供应链讨价还价环境中（买方拥有私有需求信息，与不知情的卖方谈判数量-付款合同），对OpenAI、Google和Alibaba的九种LLM进行基准测试，与已验证的完美贝叶斯均衡（PBE）对比，共进行了9,840次LLM到LLM的谈判。
AI.result: 1) 能力决定价值创造：谈判达成率98.9%，捕获95.4%的一阶最优剩余，但平均2.98轮vs基准1.25轮，延迟侵蚀21-34%的剩余；基线模型19.2%接受非理性合同，而中高端模型仅0-0.6%。2) 剩余捕获与关系有关：提供者身份比能力排名更能预测剩余分配（OpenAI 40%、Google 50%、Qwen 70%），反转卖方身份改变分配7-18个百分点。3) 提示是战略杠杆：委托分离了委托人的经济耐心与代理人的提示战略耐心，这是剩余分配最强的驱动因素（占解释方差的90%）。
AI.conclusion: 建立了沿三个维度（折现效率、分配特征、操作可靠性）的均衡参考AI代理审计框架，为企业在自主采购中使用LLM代理提供了系统性评估依据。

title: A Semantic Communication Approach to Fiducial Marker Processing in 5G-Enabled Edge SLAM
summary: Autonomous robots increasingly rely on edge computing to offload computationally intensive perception tasks while maintaining real-time operation over 5G networks. However, conventional fiducial marker detection pipelines provide limited opportunities for efficient task partitioning, making them poorly suited for communication-aware edge deployment. This paper proposes a semantic split inference framework for fiducial marker processing in 5G-enabled Edge SLAM. A DeepTag-inspired convolutional neural network is partitioned between the robot and the edge server, where intermediate feature representations serve as task-oriented semantic information transmitted over the wireless link. The framework is integrated into a ROS2-based robotic architecture and characterized over a real 5G communication testbed. Experimental results demonstrate accurate keypoint estimation, illustrate the impact on downstream pose estimation, and quantify the communication--computation trade-offs associated with different split points, providing practical insights for communication-aware deployment of deep visual perception in connected robotic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于5G边缘SLAM中基准标记（fiducial marker）处理的语义分割推理框架。该框架将DeepTag启发的CNN网络在机器人与边缘服务器之间进行分割，中间特征表示作为面向任务的语义信息通过无线链路传输，并在真实5G测试平台上进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 自主机器人在5G网络上依赖边缘计算卸载计算密集的感知任务，但传统基准标记检测管线缺乏高效的任务划分机会，难以适应通信感知的边缘部署需求。
AI.method: 提出语义分割推理框架：将DeepTag启发的卷积神经网络在机器人与边缘服务器之间进行划分，中间特征表示作为语义信息在无线链路上传输；集成到ROS2机器人架构中，并在真实5G通信测试平台上进行表征。
AI.result: 实验结果展示了准确的角点估计，阐明了其对下游位姿估计的影响，并量化了不同分割点对应的通信-计算权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为连接式机器人系统中深度视觉感知的通信感知部署提供了实用见解。

title: Generics-Aware Fuzz Target Generation for Rust Libraries via Structured API Analysis
summary: Fuzzing Rust library APIs requires constructing well-typed, compilable call sequences that satisfy ownership rules, generic parameters, and trait bounds; existing tools ignore these constraints or use shallow heuristics, yielding low coverage. We present GRAFT, which extracts structured API information from Rust documentation, builds an API dependency graph via recursive generics-aware type matching, and uses topology-guided traversal plus LLM synthesis with compiler-error feedback to produce compilable fuzz targets. On 13 crates from crates.io, GRAFT achieves 80.75% macro-average API coverage at 96.19% compilation success, outperforming RULF and RPG by 4.76x and 2.43x, and reaching 1.41x the average API coverage of deepSURF on crates with unsafe-reaching APIs.

AI.tldr: GRAFT是一个针对Rust库API的模糊测试工具，通过从文档中提取结构化API信息、构建API依赖图，并结合拓扑遍历、LLM综合与编译器错误反馈，生成可编译的模糊测试目标。在13个crate上实现80.75%的API覆盖率和96.19%的编译成功率，显著优于现有工具。
AI.motivation: Rust库API模糊测试需要构造类型正确、可编译且满足所有权规则、泛型参数和trait约束的调用序列，现有工具要么忽略这些约束，要么使用浅层启发式方法，导致覆盖率低。
AI.method: 1) 从Rust文档中提取结构化API信息；2) 通过递归的泛型感知类型匹配构建API依赖图；3) 使用拓扑引导遍历并结合LLM综合与编译器错误反馈来生成可编译的模糊测试目标。
AI.result: 在13个crates.io的crate上，GRAFT达到80.75%的宏平均API覆盖率和96.19%的编译成功率。与RULF和RPG相比分别提升4.76倍和2.43倍；在含有unsafe相关API的crate上，平均API覆盖率是deepSURF的1.41倍。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT证明了结合文档驱动的API信息提取、图引导的遍历策略以及LLM与编译器反馈闭环的方法，能够有效解决Rust API模糊测试中类型系统和所有权约束的难题，显著提升API覆盖率和编译成功率。

title: On the use of foundation models in cognitive science
summary: A host of recent studies have evaluated the cognitive and developmental alignment of Foundation Models (FMs). These investigations include evaluations of their correspondence to adult performance across a range of cognitive domains, as well as whether aspects of model training track children's cognitive development. However, using FMs as candidate cognitive models poses significant methodological and conceptual challenges. A key question underlies this effort: under what conditions does behavioral alignment justify treating FMs as explanatory models of cognition? In this paper, we articulate a four-stage inferential framework for evaluating FMs as cognitive and developmental models: adapting human experimental tasks to model-compatible formats, specifying linking hypotheses that map model outputs to human measures, evaluating behavioral correspondence, and comparing across candidate models or manipulations. We clarify the role of linking hypotheses in mapping model outputs to human behavioral measures, identify challenges that constrain alignment claims, and propose principles for theory-driven and comparative evaluation. Throughout, we argue that behavioral fit alone is insufficient. Alignment becomes scientifically meaningful only when embedded within explicit theoretical commitments, theory-diagnostic tasks, and systematic contrastive evaluation across candidate models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个四阶段推理框架来评估基础模型（FMs）作为认知和发展模型的科学性，强调行为对齐本身不足，必须嵌入明确的理论承诺、理论诊断性任务和系统对比评估。
AI.motivation: 近年大量研究评估基础模型在认知和发展层面的对齐性，但使用FMs作为候选认知模型存在方法论和概念上的重大挑战。核心问题在于：行为对齐在何种条件下才能证明将FMs视为认知解释模型的合理性？
AI.method: 提出一个四阶段推理框架：（1）将人类实验任务改编为模型兼容格式；（2）明确链接假设（linking hypotheses），将模型输出映射到人类测量指标；（3）评估行为对应性；（4）在候选模型或操作之间进行对比。同时阐明链接假设的角色，识别限制对齐主张的挑战，并提出理论驱动和比较评估的原则。
AI.result: 本文提出并论证了行为拟合不足以支撑科学结论。对齐只有在嵌入明确的理论承诺、使用理论诊断性任务、以及进行系统性的候选模型对比评估时，才具有科学意义。
AI.conclusion: 单纯的行为对齐不能使FMs成为有效的认知或发展模型；只有当对齐研究建立在明确的理论框架和系统的对比评估之上，才能产生科学的解释价值。

title: What to Edit Next: Visually Aligned Image-Editing Follow-Up Suggestions in Conversational Systems
summary: Conversational assistants increasingly recommend follow-up edits to help users continue a task. Existing systems primarily target text-only interactions, leaving image-creation conversations underexplored. In image-creation tasks, useful follow-up edit suggestions must reflect user preferences, offer diverse directions, and remain executable on the current image. We collected 100,000 real multi-turn image-creation conversation samples from Qwen App and found that 80.1% are image-dependent, underscoring the need for multimodal recommendation. We address this setting with a three-stage framework. In Stage 1, we use real online data to build a human-reviewed table of appropriate follow-up editing intents, then create SFT targets and fine-tune a multimodal policy. In Stage 2, to align rule-guided SFT suggestions with actual user choices, we use user click feedback to optimize the policy through multi-objective reinforcement learning. In Stage 3, to reduce visual inconsistencies between suggested edits and the current image, we introduce a visual verifier as additional training supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms baselines on both automatic and human evaluations. In a live user-randomized A/B test with millions of users, our final framework reduces visual inconsistency from 3.7% to 0.9%. Furthermore, it significantly improves recommendation CTR by 32.70%, image take-away rate by 16.32%, and average conversation turns per user by 39.90% (all p<0.05).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个三阶段框架，用于多模态对话助手在图像创作任务中推荐后续编辑建议。框架结合真实数据构建编辑意图表、多目标强化学习对齐用户点击反馈、以及视觉验证器减少视觉不一致性。实验表明该方法显著优于基线，在实际A/B测试中将视觉不一致率从3.7%降至0.9%，并大幅提升CTR、图片采用率和对话轮数。
AI.motivation: 现有对话系统主要针对纯文本交互推荐后续编辑，图像创作场景中的后续编辑推荐尚未被充分探索。图像创作中好的后续编辑建议需要反映用户偏好、提供多样化方向、并且能在当前图片上执行，因此需要多模态推荐方案。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：Stage 1利用真实在线数据构建人工审核的编辑意图表，生成SFT目标并微调多模态策略；Stage 2使用用户点击反馈通过多目标强化学习优化策略，使规则引导的SFT建议与真实用户选择对齐；Stage 3引入视觉验证器作为额外训练监督，减少建议编辑与当前图像之间的视觉不一致性。
AI.result: 在自动和人工评估上均显著优于基线。大规模在线A/B测试（数百万用户）中，视觉不一致率从3.7%降至0.9%；推荐CTR提升32.70%，图片采用率提升16.32%，用户平均对话轮数提升39.90%（均p<0.05）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效解决了图像创作场景中后续编辑推荐的多模态挑战，通过真实数据驱动、用户反馈对齐和视觉一致性验证，实现了显著的在线性能提升，验证了多模态推荐在图像创作对话中的价值。

title: TREAT: Evaluating Access to Formal Knowledge across Equivalent Mathematical Representations
comment: Accepted at 28th International Symposium on Symbolic and Numeric Algorithms for Scientific Computing (SYNASC 2026)
summary: AI systems increasingly operate between flexible input representations and formal objects used by downstream tools. A key challenge is recognizing when an unfamiliar formulation denotes a known formal object. We study this challenge through theorem recognition: given an equivalence-preserving transformation of a theorem condition, a model must recover the theorem identity associated with the standard statement. We introduce TREAT, a benchmark for evaluating whether large language models can recover known theorem identities from equivalence-preserving formula-level transformations. Rather than paraphrasing theorem text, TREAT changes the mathematical form of theorem conditions themselves, expressing known results through residual equations, witness statements, optimization identities, set relations, operator forms, and proof-intermediate characterizations. Starting from scraped theorem pages, we filter for entries with usable mathematical expression forms, extract canonical theorem conditions, and generate transformed variants with recorded assumptions and inverse mappings. The final corpus contains 737 theorem identities and 29,480 transformed rows. On a test panel, the best model retrieves the correct theorem identity in only 60.73% of cases. Other systems reveal different failure modes, including abstention, wrong detection, and malformed outputs. These suggest that theorem knowledge can be fragile under equivalent changes in representation. TREAT therefore provides a controlled testbed for evaluating representation-robust access to formal knowledge, with broader relevance to domains that require stable target objects, explicit equivalence relations, validation procedures, and auditable scoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TREAT基准，用于评估大语言模型在等价保持的公式变换下能否识别已知定理身份。基准包含737个定理身份和29,480个变换样本，最佳模型仅达到60.73%的准确率，表明模型对等价表示变换下的定理知识具有脆弱性。
AI.motivation: AI系统需要在灵活输入表示与下游工具的形式化对象之间运行，但当前模型难以识别不同但等价的数学公式表述是否指向同一已知定理。这一能力对可靠的形式化知识访问至关重要。
AI.method: 从定理页面抓取数据，筛选具有可用的数学表达形式的条目，提取规范定理条件，并通过残差方程、存在性陈述、优化恒等式、集合关系、算子形式和证明中间特征等方式生成等价变换变体，同时记录假设和逆映射。
AI.result: 构建了包含737个定理身份和29,480个变换行的语料库。测试面板上最佳模型仅以60.73%的准确率正确检索定理身份，其他系统表现出弃权、错误检测和格式错误等不同失败模式。
AI.conclusion: TREAT揭示了模型在等价表示变化下访问定理知识的脆弱性，为评估表示稳健的形式化知识访问提供了受控测试平台，并适用于需要稳定目标对象、显式等价关系、验证程序和可审计评分的更广泛领域。

title: Abstractions for Network Intelligence: A Reference Architecture for AI at the Wireless Edge
summary: Networks are increasingly adopting AI as are AI applications leveraging networks. Awareness sharing between networks and AI applications promises to unlock higher levels of network utilization and application performance, but is inadequately supported in the current architecture of the Internet. In this paper, we describe a reference architecture that abstractly enables the synergistic interaction of intelligent applications and the intelligent network, via an information waist, and also supports the network intelligence services in the emerging intelligence plane in networks. We discuss the rationale for our AI-EDGE architecture, its functional requirements, and the core abstractions. We present a reference component-level design of the core abstractions to support experimentation and development on existing platforms for wireless networking (i.e., based on O-RAN cellular networks) and edge computing (i.e., based on 3GPP Edge App and ETSI MEC). Moreover, we provide representative use cases from the perspective of different types of users that demonstrate the benefits of the architecture in contexts of awareness sharing, portability, prototyping, and validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为AI-EDGE的参考架构，通过"信息腰部"（information waist）实现智能应用与智能网络之间的协同交互，并支持网络中的智能平面服务。该架构设计了核心抽象，并基于O-RAN蜂窝网络和3GPP Edge App/ETSI MEC提供了组件级参考设计，以支持在无线网络和边缘计算平台上进行实验和开发。
AI.motivation: 当前互联网架构对网络与AI应用之间的感知共享支持不足，无法充分发挥网络利用率和应用性能的潜力。网络越来越多地采用AI，AI应用也在利用网络，因此需要在架构层面支持两者之间的协同交互。
AI.method: 提出AI-EDGE参考架构，通过信息腰部抽象实现智能应用与智能网络的协同交互，支持网络智能平面中的智能服务。设计了功能需求和核心抽象，并提供了基于O-RAN和3GPP/ETSI MEC平台的组件级参考设计。
AI.result: 提供了代表性用例，从不同用户类型角度展示了架构在感知共享、可移植性、原型设计和验证方面的优势。
AI.conclusion: AI-EDGE架构为智能网络与AI应用的协同提供了系统化的参考架构和实现路径，为在现有无线网络和边缘计算平台上进行实验验证奠定了基础。

title: Fusing UI Structure & Semantics for Feature-Oriented App Screen Retrieval & Clustering
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at the 42nd IEEE International Conference on Software Maintenance and Evolution (ICSME 2026), Benevento, Italy
summary:
User Interface (UI) programming is challenging due to the complex abstraction gap between code and graphical software representations. To bridge this gap, UI programming tools often rely on screen retrieval and clustering, which require accurate similarity measures based on overlapping features. However, computing feature-oriented similarity is difficult because screens with similar functionality often exhibit design variations.
  To address this, we propose FRAME (ReinForced UseR InterfAce Screen EMbedding with Graphical Structural ComprEhension), a multi-modal, neuro-symbolic embedding technique. FRAME constructs symbolic, graph-based representations of UI components to encode salient relationships and capture feature patterns across different screens. It leverages large vision-language models for visual and lexical encoding, alongside a novel UI-specific computational geometry algorithm that enables weighted embedding propagation. Across three benchmarks, FRAME outperforms strong baselines by up to 13% MRR in search and 7.6 percentage points in clustering accuracy. A comprehensive ablation study further confirms the benefit of each component, demonstrating FRAME's potential for enhancing automated UI design and testing tools.

AI.tldr: 提出FRAME，一种多模态、神经符号的UI屏幕嵌入技术，通过图形化结构理解和计算几何算法，在UI搜索和聚类任务上分别提升高达13% MRR和7.6%聚类准确率。
AI.motivation: UI编程面临代码与图形界面表示之间的抽象鸿沟，现有工具依赖屏幕检索和聚类，但基于重叠特征的相似度度量难以处理功能相似但设计风格各异的屏幕。
AI.method: FRAME构建UI组件的符号化图表示以编码关键关系，利用大型视觉-语言模型进行视觉和词汇编码，并提出新颖的UI特定计算几何算法实现加权嵌入传播。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试中，FRAME在搜索任务上比强基线提升高达13% MRR，在聚类准确率上提升7.6个百分点；消融实验验证了各组件贡献。
AI.conclusion: FRAME展示了增强自动化UI设计和测试工具的潜力，其每个组件均被证明有效。

title: "Many Are My Names": The Anatomy of the Assistant and Its Personas via Sparse Autoencoders
summary: How a language model internally represents who is speaking, the Assistant, an assigned roleplay persona, or a narrated story character, remains underexplored. We study speaker representations using a dataset of user-expressed emotional text and corresponding model responses. We decompose three generation settings (Assistant, Roleplay, and Story) into sparse autoencoder features extracted at turn-boundary and pronoun-token positions and selected through a filtering pipeline for different depths. We characterize each surviving feature through its steering effects and activation distribution. Our main finding is that the Assistant and roleplay personas are not independent alternatives: personas retain the Assistant-associated feature core while progressively differentiating from it across layers, starting from operational machinery towards behavioral and stylistic features. Meanwhile, generated story characters lack the Assistant-associated core. Both Story and Roleplay can be distinguished from the Assistant with Immersive Simulation Mode. However, the Assistant can sometimes enter or slowly drift into it even in the default setting.

AI.tldr: 本文通过稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征分析，研究语言模型内部如何表征说话者（Assistant、Roleplay人设、故事角色）。核心发现是：Assistant和Roleplay人设并非独立替代关系——人设保留Assistant核心特征但逐层分化；而故事角色缺乏Assistant核心。三种设定可通过"沉浸式模拟模式"区分，但Assistant在默认设置下有时也会进入或漂移进该模式。
AI.motivation: 语言模型如何内部表征"谁在说话"（助手、角色扮演人设、叙述故事角色）仍未被充分探索，本文旨在填补这一可解释性研究空白。
AI.method: 使用用户情感表达文本及对应模型响应的数据集，在三种生成设定（Assistant、Roleplay、Story）下，从回合边界和代词token位置提取稀疏自编码器特征，并通过过滤管线按不同深度筛选特征，再通过引导效应（steering effects）和激活分布对存留特征进行刻画。
AI.result: 1) Assistant与Roleplay人设共享Assistant特征核心，但人设随层深逐渐分化，从操作机制到行为与风格特征；2) 故事角色缺乏Assistant核心特征；3) Story和Roleplay可通过"沉浸式模拟模式"（Immersive Simulation Mode）与Assistant区分；4) Assistant在默认设置下也可能进入或逐渐漂移进该模式。
AI.conclusion: 说话者表征在语言模型内部并非简单的独立类别区分，而是存在共享核心与逐层分化结构；"沉浸式模拟模式"是区分不同说话者设定的关键内部机制，且该模式并非严格由外部设定控制。

title: Temporal Generalization in fNIRS-Based Autism Classification: A Cross-Time-Window Transfer Benchmark
summary: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) is a promising modality for autism spectrum disorder (ASD) classification, yet existing approaches assume temporally aligned evaluation. In practice, the optimal observation window varies across subjects due to differences in hemodynamic delay and neurovascular coupling, creating a temporal distribution shift that degrades performance. We formalize this as a \textit{cross-time-window transfer problem}, introducing a protocol that varies window length (2.5--10\,s) and offset within biological motion trials. Using topographic map representations of fNIRS recordings, we benchmark three vision architectures under two zero-shot baselines and eight adaptation strategies under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation ($N{=}124$). Key findings: (1) zero-shot cross-window accuracy is near chance (54--69\%); (2) ${\approx}5\%$ subject-specific fine-tuning recovers 90--96\%, while a subject-specific upper bound reaches 97--100\%, identifying inter-subject variability as the dominant barrier; (3) domain-adversarial and self-supervised strategies achieve 78--90\% without target-subject data; and (4) discriminative information is recoverable from windows as short as 2.5\,s. These findings provide a practical roadmap for deploying fNIRS-based ASD classifiers under realistic temporal variability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了功能近红外光谱（fNIRS）在自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）分类中的跨时间窗迁移问题。由于个体间血流动力学延迟和神经血管耦合差异导致最佳观测窗口各异，作者形式化了"跨时间窗迁移问题"，并基于124名受试者的数据，系统比较了三种视觉架构在两个零样本基线和八种自适应策略下的表现。关键发现包括：零样本跨窗口准确率接近随机水平（54-69%）；约5%的受试者微调数据即可恢复90-96%的准确率；域对抗和自监督策略在无目标数据下达到78-90%；2.5秒的短窗口仍包含判别信息。
AI.motivation: 现有fNIRS用于ASD分类的方法都假设时间对齐评估，但实际应用中因个体血流动力学延迟和神经血管耦合差异，最佳观测窗口因人而异，造成时间分布偏移并降低性能。作者希望形式化并解决这一被忽视的实际问题。
AI.method: 作者将问题形式化为跨时间窗迁移问题，提出改变窗口长度（2.5-10秒）和偏移量的实验协议。使用fNIRS记录的地形图表示，采用留一受试者交叉验证（N=124），基准测试三种视觉架构、两种零样本基线和八种自适应策略（包括域对抗和自监督方法）。
AI.result: (1) 零样本跨窗口准确率接近随机水平（54-69%）；(2) 约5%的受试者微调数据可恢复90-96%准确率，受试者上限达97-100%，表明个体间变异性是主要障碍；(3) 域对抗和自监督策略无目标数据下达到78-90%；(4) 2.5秒短窗口仍包含可恢复的判别信息。
AI.conclusion: 作者为部署fNIRS-based ASD分类器在现实时间变异条件下提供了实用路线图，揭示了受试者个体间变异性是性能瓶颈的主要来源，并指出了无需目标受试者数据的域自适应策略作为可行路径。

title: An AI Scientist that Doesn't Drift: Taste, Structure, and Falsifiable Findings in a Quadruped Navigation Research Loop
summary: Autonomous research loops driven by large language models can run machine-learning experiments at scale but tend to drift toward local refinements of whichever metric they optimise rather than testing the hypotheses that motivate the experiments. We address this structurally and present an AI Scientist for studying generalisation in quadruped robot navigation policies in simulation. Building on the autoresearch paradigm of Karpathy, our loop adds three components: an immutable experiment card that pairs each iteration's prediction with its outcome under a fixed schema, so a falsified hypothesis cannot be retconned; specialised subagents restricted to mechanical roles; and kkanbu, a preference oracle that holds the user's research taste as a typed knowledge graph and is the only component permitted to make subjective judgements. To isolate the oracle we run the identical loop twice across eleven research streams, with and without kkanbu. Neither arm drifts: both falsify roughly three quarters of their own hypotheses, and the best trained policy comes from the oracle-less arm. What the oracle changes is direction, not score: it alone explores test-time adaptation, it authored the winning designs where its arm led, and it carried lessons across streams that the other arm repeatedly re-derived. The scaffold keeps the loop honest; kkanbu decides where it looks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于四足机器人导航策略泛化研究的AI科学家系统。该系统在Karpathy的自动研究范式基础上增加了三个组件：不可变的实验卡片（防止假设被事后篡改）、分工明确的专业子代理、以及一个名为kkanbu的偏好预言机（以类型化知识图谱形式保存用户研究品味，是唯一可做主观判断的组件）。通过对11个研究流进行有无kkanbu的对照实验，发现两个分支都不会漂移（都能证伪约四分之三的自身假设），但kkanbu改变的是研究方向而非分数——它能探索测试时适应、在领先时创造获胜设计、并能跨流传递经验。
AI.motivation: 大规模语言模型驱动的自主研究循环在大规模运行机器学习实验时，容易倾向于局部优化某个指标，而非测试驱动实验的假设。作者希望从结构上解决这一漂移问题，确保研究循环保持对假设的忠实检验。
AI.method: 在Karpathy的自动研究范式基础上，增加了三个组件：(1)不可变的实验卡片——以固定模式将每次迭代的预测与结果配对，使被证伪的假设无法被追溯改写；(2)限于机械角色的专业子代理；(3)kkanbu——一个以类型化知识图谱保存用户研究品味的偏好预言机，是唯一被允许做主观判断的组件。实验设计为在11个研究流上运行完全相同的循环，分为有kkanbu和无kkanbu两组进行隔离对照。
AI.result: 两个分支都不漂移，均能证伪约四分之三的自身假设；最佳训练策略来自无kkanbu的分支。kkanbu改变的是方向而非分数：它独自探索了测试时适应，在它领先的流中创作了获胜设计，并跨流传递了另一分支反复重新推导的经验。
AI.conclusion: 该脚手架结构保证了研究循环的诚实性（假设不被篡改），而kkanbu决定了研究的方向（往哪里看）。两者角色分离：结构负责防止漂移，偏好预言机负责引导探索方向。

title: Adaptive Two-Level Allocation of a Conserved Capacity Budget Across Locations and Service Classes
summary: We study how to share a single conserved capacity budget across many locations and two service classes when demand is uneven, time-varying, and can exceed supply. The shape recurs: an origin's request-rate cap split across its edge locations, a licensed throughput cap across premium and standard tenants, or an egress budget between latency-critical and batch workloads. We present a two-level algorithm. The first level redistributes capacity within a class across locations by proportional deficit and excess redistribution; the second lends capacity elastically between classes when one has surplus and the other deficit. We prove it conserves the budget exactly, preserves non-negativity, and reaches a stable allocation in one iteration under stationary demand because it carries no per-cycle state, at O(KN) cost per cycle for K classes and N locations. We evaluate it defending a CDN's per-domain budget under volumetric attack, where the classes are confirmed-legitimate and not-yet-cleared traffic; across 8 contention scenarios on a 22-location topology it serves 66-93% of high-priority demand, competitive with a single-class linear-programming optimum, while never leaving capacity idle or over-committing whenever aggregate demand meets or exceeds the budget (the contention regime these scenarios evaluate). Two findings carry beyond the application. First, a throughput-maximizing objective is wrong under contention: a two-class LP maximizing total served load serves less high-priority load than our demand-proportional, reservation-respecting allocator in most scenarios, because it cannot tell that some load it serves is the contention. Second, inter-class borrowing earns its complexity under bursty load, improving high-priority service by 1.5 points (isolated by ablation), and is neutral under stationary demand. A 5-location prototype with real HTTP traffic validates the pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何在多个位置和两个服务类别之间共享单一守恒容量预算的问题，提出了一种两级分配算法：第一级在类别内跨位置按比例赤字/过剩再分配容量，第二级在类别间弹性借贷容量。算法无需每周期状态即可在平稳需求下一次迭代达到稳定分配，计算成本为O(KN)。在CDN域名级预算防御场景下，该算法在22个位置的拓扑和8种争用场景中优先服务66-93%的高优先级需求，与单类线性规划最优解相当，且永不闲置容量或过度承诺。
AI.motivation: 许多真实系统面临相似的问题形态：一个源头的请求速率上限分散到多个边缘位置，许可吞吐量上限分配给高级租户和标准租户，或出口带宽预算分配给延迟关键型与批处理工作负载。这些问题都需要在需求不均匀、随时间变化且可能超过供给的情况下，在多个位置和两个服务类别之间公平有效地共享守恒容量预算。
AI.method: 提出两级分配算法。第一级在类别内部跨位置进行按比例的赤字与过剩再分配；第二级在类别之间进行弹性容量借贷（当一类有盈余而另一类有赤字时）。算法不携带跨周期状态，因此在平稳需求下一次迭代即可达到稳定分配，计算复杂度为O(KN)，其中K为类别数，N为位置数。
AI.result: 在CDN域名级预算对抗容量型攻击的防御场景中，以确认合法流量和未清除流量为两个类别，在22个位置拓扑和8种争用场景下，该算法服务于66-93%的高优先级需求，与单类线性规划最优解相当，且从不闲置容量或过度承诺。消融实验表明跨类别借贷在突发负载下将高优先级服务提升1.5个百分点，在平稳需求下表现中性。5位置真实HTTP流量原型验证了完整管线。
AI.conclusion: 两个超越应用的发现：第一，在争用场景下以吞吐量最大化为目标的目标函数是错误的——最大化总服务负载的两类LP在多数场景中服务的高优先级负载少于按需求比例且尊重预留的分配器，因为它无法区分所服务的负载中哪些是争用流量。第二，跨类别借贷在突发负载下值得其复杂度代价，而在平稳需求下则无增益。算法在数学上保证了预算精确守恒、非负性和稳定收敛。

title: Biomedical Knowledge Composition: A Software Engineering Perspective
summary: Biomedical research has accumulated vast molecular, clinical, and population data, yet translating this wealth into actionable knowledge remains constrained by technical and organizational difficulties. This article presents a unified treatment of two perspectives on biomedical knowledge infrastructure. The first introduces the biomedical domain to software engineers: it explains why knowledge graphs (KGs) are the central integrative data structure in modern biomedicine, characterizes five data harmonization challenges (identifier mapping, entity resolution, schema alignment, evidence integration, and provenance tracking), surveys application domains from drug discovery to digital twins, and profiles six representative KG systems with contrasting choices. The second perspective asks why engineering biomedical knowledge infrastructure remains so difficult. We argue that a contributing root cause is limited adoption of software tooling and practices that make development in other mature domains - particularly web engineering - reliably composable and reproducible: package management, typed namespaces, canonical interchange formats, service composition protocols, reproducible pipelines, and lifecycle governance. Against this backdrop, eight open engineering challenges for biomedical data integration are catalogued, each with partial solutions but no universally adopted stack. Crucially, the article shifts emphasis from describing deployed KG instances toward the reproducible process of assembling them: reusable build pipelines, versioned dependencies, and engineering practices that let others compile and customize a KG from source rather than consuming a static artifact. Together, the two perspectives provide domain grounding for newcomers and a research agenda for software engineers seeking to make transformative contributions to biomedical knowledge infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文整合了关于生物医学知识基础设施的两个视角：一是向软件工程师介绍生物医学领域知识图谱（KG）的核心作用、数据协调挑战及应用场景；二是剖析为何构建生物医学知识基础设施如此困难，指出软件工具和实践（如包管理、类型化命名空间、可复现流水线等）采用不足是根本原因，并列出八个开放工程挑战，强调从静态制品转向可复现的构建流程。
AI.motivation: 生物医学研究积累了海量分子、临床和人群数据，但将这些数据转化为可操作的知识仍面临技术与组织层面的困难。作者希望通过统一两个视角，为新手提供领域基础，同时为软件工程师指明在该领域做出变革性贡献的研究方向。
AI.method: 文章采用综述与论证相结合的方式：首先系统性地向软件工程师介绍生物医学KG作为核心整合数据结构的作用，归纳五大数据协调挑战（标识符映射、实体消解、模式对齐、证据整合、溯源追踪），调研应用领域并剖析六个代表性KG系统；然后从软件工程实践角度论证根因是缺乏成熟领域（如Web工程）中已有的工具和实践，并编目八个开放工程挑战。
AI.result: 本文识别了五个数据协调挑战、六个代表性KG系统、八个开放工程挑战，并提出了一个关键观点转变：应从描述已部署的KG实例转向关注可复现的组装过程，即通过可复用构建流水线、版本化依赖和工程实践，让其他人能够从源码编译和定制KG而非消费静态制品。
AI.conclusion: 生物医学知识基础设施的构建困难主要源于软件工具和实践采用不足。作者呼吁将工程重点从已部署的KG实例转移到可复现的构建过程上，为生物医学领域的新手提供入门指南，同时为软件工程师提供具体的研究议程。

title: SurakshaEval: An Indic Safety Benchmark for Multilingual LLMs
summary: Existing safety evaluation datasets for large language models (LLMs) predominantly focus on English and Western contexts, often overlooking the linguistic diversity and culturally grounded safety risks present in other languages. To address this gap, we introduce SurakshaEval, a novel safety benchmark composed of human-written prompts spanning real-world scenarios, explicitly designed for ten major Indian languages - Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Punjabi, Tamil, and Telugu, along with English. SurakshaEval includes both generic prompts common across India and region- and language-specific prompts that capture localized sociocultural sensitivities. We benchmark a broad range of state-of-the-art LLMs on SurakshaEval, establish baseline safety performance, and identify recurring failure modes, including over-refusal, missed detection of implicit bias, and insufficient contextual awareness in regionally sensitive settings. Our results show that even strong multilingual LLMs struggle to reliably meet nuanced safety requirements when operating in Indic languages, particularly in native scripts. These findings highlight the urgent need for safety evaluation frameworks that incorporate region-specific data and structured assessment protocols, enabling the development and deployment of AI systems that operate securely, ethically, and in alignment with diverse societal values. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/debobanerjee/SurakshaEval. Warning: This paper contains text that may be offensive or unsafe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SurakshaEval，一个面向十种主要印度语言（阿萨姆语、孟加拉语、古吉拉特语、印地语、卡纳达语、马拉雅拉姆语、马拉地语、旁遮普语、泰米尔语、泰卢固语）及英语的新型安全评估基准，包含人工撰写的真实场景提示词，并识别了多语言LLM在印度语言中的常见失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全评估数据集主要聚焦英语和西方语境，忽视了其他语言中存在的语言多样性和文化背景相关的安全风险，需要填补印度语言安全评估的空白。
AI.method: 构建SurakshaEval基准，包含跨印度通用的提示词和针对地区及语言特有的提示词，捕捉本地化的社会文化敏感性，并对一系列最先进的LLM进行基准测试。
AI.result: 即使强大的多语言LLM在使用印度语言（特别是本土文字）时，也难以可靠满足细微的安全要求；识别出过度拒绝、隐性偏见漏检和区域敏感场景下上下文意识不足等反复出现的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 迫切需要纳入区域特定数据和结构化评估协议的安全评估框架，以支持AI系统在多样社会价值观中安全、道德地开发和部署。

title: Latent-Frequency Validity: Fast Spectral Editing with Screened Video-VAE Transfer Operators
summary: Direct spectral editing in video-VAE latents can control noise, flicker, smoothness, and frequency content without a decode--filter--reencode pass. However, video VAEs may redistribute pixel-space frequency bands across latent channels, and latent edits can disrupt VAE round-trip dynamics. We introduce \emph{latent-frequency validity} (LFV), which learns a compact VAE-specific spectral response and deploys it only when it improves decoded-target fidelity without worsening round-trip drift. LFV follows a validation-selected path from a diagonal per-frequency calibrator (C1) to full channel mixing (CM), making cross-channel capacity a controllable per-edit resource. Across 544 VAE--edit cells spanning six spectral families, LFV emits 423 cheap operators: 277 are handled by C1, while 146 (34.5\% of emitted operators) require channel mixing. On the primary 120-cell radial sweep, 99/100 emitted operators pass source-video-grouped held-out evaluation. Across five additional filter families, all 323 emitted operators pass held-out evaluation. Fully frozen OpenVid-fitted operators, including the validation-selected path coefficient, pass all 20 tested CogVideoX and HunyuanVideo generated-domain cells without adaptation. The selected response matches direct latent-filter latency and is about $3\times$ faster than pixel filter--reencode. The resulting maps reveal distinct VAE regimes, including strongly channel-coupled CogVideoX responses and a sharp Open-Sora high-band stability frontier.

AI.tldr: 本文提出潜伏频率有效性（LFV）方法，用于在视频VAE潜伏空间中实现直接光谱编辑，无需解码-滤波-再编码流程。LFV学习紧凑的VAE特定光谱响应，并通过验证选择路径（从对角逐频率校准C1到全通道混合CM）控制噪声、闪烁、平滑度和频率内容。实验跨越544个VAE-编辑单元，其中423个廉价算子通过LFV处理，所有通过验证的算子均通过留出评估，且性能比像素滤波-再编码快约3倍。
AI.motivation: 视频VAE可能将像素空间频带重新分配到潜在通道中，导致直接潜在编辑可能破坏VAE往返动态。现有方法需要解码-滤波-再编码的额外流程，效率低且无法充分利用潜在空间的编辑能力。
AI.method: LFV学习一个紧凑的VAE特定光谱响应，仅在能改善解码目标保真度且不恶化往返漂移时部署。采用验证选择的路径：从对角逐频率校准器C1到全通道混合CM，将跨通道能力作为可控的逐编辑资源。
AI.result: 在544个VAE-编辑单元中，LFV产生423个廉价算子（277个由C1处理，146个需要通道混合）。主径向扫描99/100算子通过留出评估，五个额外滤波器族全部323个算子通过评估。OpenVid拟合的冻结算子通过所有20个CogVideoX和HunyuanVideo域测试。延迟匹配直接潜在滤波，比像素滤波-再编码快约3倍。
AI.conclusion: LFV揭示了不同的VAE机制，包括强通道耦合的CogVideoX响应和Open-Sora高带宽稳定边界。该方法提供了一种高效、灵活且可迁移的潜在空间光谱编辑框架，无需解码-再编码步骤。

title: The Field Knows: Cross-Dimensional Geometry from Navigation to Black Holes
summary: We introduce a continuous metric field framework trained by a single causal contrastive loss. The framework encodes a scene into coefficients of a fixed symmetric matrix basis, assembles them into a Lie algebra element, and exponentiates the result to a Riemannian or Lorentzian metric. Across dimensions, this field discovers the full spectrum of geometric structures: from obstacle-avoiding geodesics in robot navigation across planar and manipulator configuration spaces, to event horizons of black holes in Lorentzian spacetime. Extensive zero-shot generalization studies demonstrate that the field captures transferable geometric structure rather than memorizing specific configurations. In the black hole setting, the causal loss spontaneously evolves genuine black-hole-like structures with the correct Lorentzian signature. The same loss, the same architecture, and the same training protocol produce the full range of geometric phenomena across dimensions. The field knows geometry, and geometry knows physics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种连续度量场框架，通过单一因果对比损失训练，将场景编码为对称矩阵基系数，组装成李代数元素并指数化为黎曼或洛伦兹度量。该框架在不同维度下发现完整几何结构谱系：从机器人导航中的避障测地线到黑洞视界，并展现出强大的零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 探索是否能用统一的因果对比学习范式，在不同维度空间中自发涌现出丰富的几何结构（如测地线避障、黑洞事件视界），而非针对特定任务手工设计几何模型，从而验证"几何知道物理"的核心假设。
AI.method: 构建连续度量场框架：将场景编码为固定对称矩阵基的系数，组装为李代数元素，再通过矩阵指数映射得到黎曼或洛伦兹度量。使用单一因果对比损失进行训练，同一架构与训练协议适用于不同维度与场景。
AI.result: 在平面与机械臂构型空间中实现了机器人避障测地线导航；在洛伦兹时空中自发演化出具有正确洛伦兹符号的黑洞类结构。零样本泛化实验表明模型捕捉的是可迁移的几何结构而非记忆特定配置。同一损失、架构与协议在不同维度产生完整几何现象谱系。
AI.conclusion: 该框架证明了统一的因果对比学习能够在不同维度下自发涌现出从经典机器人导航到广义相对论黑洞的完整几何结构，说明几何结构可以从单一学习原则中涌现，而无需针对特定物理或机器人问题手工设计。

title: White paper: A perspective on civilian-to-defence research transfer to SDD
summary:
Military capability is increasingly determined by software. Yet defence platforms are procured on decade-long timescales, while the software and AI models they carry must evolve in days or hours. This paper calls this mismatch the lifecycle paradox, and argues it is the central problem Software-Defined Defence (SDD) must solve.
  SDD rests on three dimensions: software and systems engineering (design, procurement, certification), AI engineering (sovereignty and trust of learned components), and connectivity and infrastructure engineering (timely exchange of information among sensors, AI, and operators). The proposed path to resilient SDD starts from civilian technologies, addressed through a continuous, DevOps-style loop: model-based systems engineering and simulation-based testing front-load design and verification; tactical connectivity and low-power edge execution carry that design into contested operation; continuous compliance, assurance, and variability management run as cross-cutting concerns. This loop is sustainable given capabilities already proven in automotive, manufacturing, space, and energy. The next step is validating them under adversarial or defence-certified conditions, with short-, medium-, and long-term paths to closing gaps.
  Closing the SDD gap while preserving civic benefits is a distributed responsibility: researchers must redirect methods toward adversarial conditions; industry must expose tooling to operational needs; policymakers must shape regulatory instruments; and defence agencies must validate results with operators. Recommendations span three horizons: a short-term baseline of adversarial testing and connectivity pilots; a medium-term pipeline of incremental certification; and a long-term validation closing the loop under operational conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"生命周期悖论"（lifecycle paradox）这一核心问题：国防平台的采办周期长达数十年，而其搭载的软件和AI模型却需在数天或数小时内演进。论文主张软件定义防御（SDD）必须解决这一错配，提出基于民用技术的持续DevOps式闭环路径，并给出了短、中、长期三阶段建议。
AI.motivation: 军事能力日益由软件决定，但国防平台的采办流程依然基于十年尺度的传统周期，与软件/AI快速迭代的现实严重脱节。这一时间尺度上的根本错配（即"生命周期悖论"）是软件定义防御面临的核心挑战，亟需系统性解决方案。
AI.method: 论文提出SDD的三维框架：（1）软件与系统工程（设计、采办、认证）；（2）AI工程（主权与可信组件）；（3）连通性与基础设施工程（传感器-AI-操作员间的信息交换）。在此基础上构建一个持续的DevOps式闭环，包含模型基系统工程的仿真测试前置设计验证、战术连接与低功耗边缘执行、贯穿式的持续合规/保证/可变性管理，主张从民用技术（汽车、制造、航天、能源）迁移已验证能力，并在对抗性或国防认证条件下加以验证。
AI.result: 本文为弥合SDD差距提出分布式责任框架：研究人员转向对抗条件、工业界暴露工具于作战需求、政策制定者塑造监管工具、国防机构与操作员联合验证。并给出三阶段路线图：短期基线（对抗测试与连通性试点）、中期管道（增量认证）、长期验证（在作战条件下闭环）。
AI.conclusion: SDD的可行路径已由民用技术积累的能力所支撑，下一步关键是将这些能力置于对抗性或国防认证条件下验证。成功取决于多主体协同责任，而非单一机构的努力，需要在保持民用利益的同时系统性弥合国防软件的时间尺度鸿沟。

title: Independent Patch Verification for Coding Agents with a Bidirectional Reconstruct-and-Verify Framework
summary: Autonomous coding agents powered by large language models can now generate code patches directly from bug reports, but a fundamental gap remains: once a patch is produced, no mechanism independently verifies whether it truly resolves the reported problem. Prior work has sought to address this through iterative self-refinement and inference-time scaling, but these approaches either review the patch under the same interpretation that produced it or broaden candidate generation without verifying individual patches, and neither provides an explicit verification signal for assessing patch correctness. We propose RETRACE, a training-free post-generation verification framework that derives such a signal through bidirectional reconstruction and reconciliation. When a coding agent generates a candidate patch for an issue, RETRACE performs forward reconstruction to build an explicit repair rationale from the issue and the agent's trajectory; backward reconstruction then independently infers, from the patch and its trajectory alone and without access to the original issue, a description of the problem the patch appears to address, and compares this reconstruction against the original issue to produce an alignment verdict; a reconciliation stage then checks the consistency between the forward rationale and the patch, diagnoses the source of any misalignment, and either submits the patch or produces targeted revision guidance. Evaluated on SWE-bench Verified with two backbones (GPT-5-mini and MiniMax-2.5), RETRACE lifts Pass@1 by 7.0% and 3.6% respectively on the mini-SWE-agent scaffold, and delivers comparable gains on OpenHands without modification. Ablation experiments show that both the forward and backward stages contribute to the overall improvement and that adding reconciliation yields further gains.

AI.tldr: RETRACE是一个无需训练的补丁后生成验证框架，通过双向重构与统筹（forward reconstruction构建修复理由，backward reconstruction独立推断补丁针对的问题并与原始issue比对，reconciliation检查一致性并生成修订指导）来提供显式的补丁正确性验证信号。在SWE-bench Verified上，配合GPT-5-mini和MiniMax-2.5分别将Pass@1提升7.0%和3.6%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型驱动的自主编码代理能从bug报告中生成代码补丁，但缺乏独立验证补丁是否真正解决问题的机制。现有工作要么在产生补丁的同一解释下审查补丁（存在自我确认偏差），要么扩大候选生成范围而不验证单个补丁，均未提供显式的验证信号来评估补丁正确性。
AI.method: RETRACE包含三个阶段：1) 前向重构（Forward Reconstruction）：从issue和代理轨迹构建显式修复理由；2) 后向重构（Backward Reconstruction）：仅从补丁和轨迹独立推断补丁所针对的问题描述，并与原始issue比对产生对齐判定；3) 统筹阶段（Reconciliation）：检查前向理由与补丁的一致性，诊断错位来源，提交补丁或生成针对性修订指导。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified基准上，使用两种骨干模型（GPT-5-mini和MiniMax-2.5），RETRACE在mini-SWE-agent脚手架上分别将Pass@1提升7.0%和3.6%，在OpenHands上无需修改也能获得相当增益。消融实验表明前向和后向阶段均有贡献，加入统筹阶段进一步提升了效果。
AI.conclusion: RETRACE通过双向重构与统筹机制为补丁正确性提供了显式验证信号，是一种训练免费且与现有编码代理兼容的验证框架，能够有效提升补丁通过率，且各组件均有实质贡献。

title: Detection of Self-Introductions in Legislative Testimony
comment: Presented at AAIRC-AI4 conference, Las Vegas, NV, USA August 2026 https://ai4.io/aairc-ai4/
summary: Self-introductions are common in legislative committee testimonies. Successfully detecting them and extracting the speaker's name is enormously helpful in the task of speaker identification in the context of government meetings. In this paper, we present a pipeline for detection of self-introductions in legislative committee testimony using machine learning. We construct a training dataset from 1.54 million utterances spanning five state legislative sessions, apply a name-matching heuristic to generate automatic labels, and train three classifiers: a decision tree, random forest, and XGBoost to find self-introductions and extract the speaker's name. We construct a feature set combining bag-of-words, positional context, structural signals, introductory phrase indicators, and discourse context features. Among the three classifiers, XGBoost achieves the best performance with an F1 score of 0.9747 and the fewest total errors; adding fine-tuned BERT probability features improves this further. As an extension, we score the full candidate dataset with a fine-tuned BERT classifier and add BERT probability outputs as features. This BERT-augmented XGBoost model improves F1 from 0.9747 to 0.9782 and reduces total test errors from 241 to 207. The primary gain over the decision tree baseline (F1 0.9323) is driven by discourse context features and the boosting ensemble strategy; BERT provides a modest complementary signal. Analysis of false positives reveals that a minority are genuine self-introductions mislabeled due to name inconsistencies in the source data, indicating that measured metrics modestly understate true performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于机器学习的流水线，用于检测立法委员会证词中的自我介绍并提取发言者姓名。利用154万条话语构建训练数据集，通过姓名匹配启发式自动标注，训练决策树、随机森林和XGBoost三种分类器。XGBoost达到最佳F1分数0.9747，加入微调BERT概率特征后进一步提升至0.9782。
AI.motivation: 自我介绍在立法委员会证词中十分常见，成功检测并提取发言者姓名对政府会议场景下的说话人识别任务有极大帮助，但目前缺乏针对该任务的自动化检测方法。
AI.method: 构建涵盖五个州立法会议共154万条话语的训练数据集，应用姓名匹配启发式生成自动标签；构建结合词袋、位置上下文、结构信号、介绍性短语指示符和话语上下文特征的组合特征集，训练三种分类器（决策树、随机森林、XGBoost）；作为扩展，用微调BERT分类器对全候选数据集打分并将BERT概率输出作为额外特征。
AI.result: XGBoost表现最佳，F1分数达0.9747且总错误数最少；加入BERT概率特征后F1从0.9747提升至0.9782，测试错误从241降至207。与决策树基线（F1 0.9323）的主要差距来自话语上下文特征和Boosting集成策略，BERT提供适度的补充信号。假阳性分析显示少数误报实为真自我介绍但因源数据姓名不一致被误标，说明实测指标略低估了真实性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明结合传统机器学习特征工程与预训练语言模型概率特征的混合方案，能有效检测立法委员会证词中的自我介绍并提取发言者姓名。XGBoost配合BERT概率特征的组合达到最优性能，且任务的核心贡献来自话语上下文特征和Boosting集成策略。

title: COMEX: A Composition-Grounded Benchmark and Learning Framework for Explainable Aesthetic Image Cropping
summary: Explainable aesthetic image cropping requires not only localizing a visually pleasing crop but also explaining why it is preferred. Existing crop-and-explain methods largely treat explanation as post-hoc text generation and overlook composition, a key aesthetic factor that links crop decisions with interpretable reasoning. In this paper, we reformulate explainable aesthetic image cropping as a structured crop-composition-explanation problem. To support this setting, we introduce COMEX, a new benchmark built through image expansion and an IO-reversal pipeline. COMEX contains 33,161 quadruples, each consisting of an expanded image, a crop box, a composition category, and a composition-grounded explanation, enabling joint learning of crop localization, composition understanding, and explanation generation. We further propose a two-stage SFT+GRPO framework, where supervised fine-tuning establishes the structured output protocol and basic cropping ability, and GRPO further improves crop quality, composition prediction, and explanation faithfulness. We benchmark 15 large vision-language models and existing cropping methods on COMEX, establishing a comprehensive testbed for composition-grounded explainable aesthetic cropping. Experiments on both COMEX and prior benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and transferability of our framework, with strong performance across evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文重新定义了可解释的美学图像裁剪问题，将其建模为"裁剪-构图-解释"的结构化任务。作者提出了COMEX基准数据集（包含33,161个四元组）和两阶段SFT+GRPO训练框架，在15个大视觉语言模型上建立了全面的测试基准，实验证明其方法在裁剪质量、构图预测和解释忠实度上均表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有的裁剪-解释方法将解释视为事后文本生成，忽略了构图这一连接裁剪决策与可解释推理的关键美学因素，缺乏结构化的联合建模。
AI.method: 1) 提出COMEX基准，通过图像扩展和IO反转流水线构建33,161个四元组（扩展图像+裁剪框+构图类别+构图驱动解释）；2) 提出两阶段SFT+GRPO框架：SFT建立结构化输出协议和基础裁剪能力，GRPO进一步优化裁剪质量、构图预测和解释忠实度。
AI.result: 在COMEX和先前基准上，该方法在裁剪质量、构图预测和解释忠实度等评价指标上均取得强性能，验证了框架的有效性和可迁移性；并建立了15个大视觉语言模型的综合测试平台。
AI.conclusion: 将可解释美学裁剪重构为结构化的裁剪-构图-解释联合任务能够显著提升解释的忠实度与裁剪质量，为可解释图像裁剪提供了新的范式。

title: TeXFix-Bench: An Empirically Grounded Multi-Format Benchmark for LLM-Based Document Source Repair
summary: Scientific and technical writing depends on markup sources that must compile: LaTeX, Typst, and Markdown pipelines fail on missing delimiters, mismatched environments, broken imports, or package conflicts. Existing document-repair evaluations inject faults with ad-hoc edits that lack an empirical fault model. We present TeXFix-Bench, a multi-format benchmark for LLM-based full-source document repair grounded in a mined fault taxonomy. A Grounded-Theory study of localized hard-crash LaTeX faults from TeX Stack Exchange, GitHub commits, and package documentation (168 verified faults, dual open coding at $κ$=0.34) yields an 18-category taxonomy instantiated as DocMut: 48 AST-aware operators across three formats.
