Beyond the results presented in this paper, Taboo provides a novel primitive for generating diverse synthetic datasets, stress-testing runtime safety guardrails, and auditing model reliability prior to real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Decoding-Level Taboo，一种零提示（zero-prompt）诊断压力测试方法，通过在运行时直接干预logit空间、动态屏蔽词边界处的主要候选token，强制语言模型偏离其"名义路径"（nominal path），从而揭示模型在真实部署条件下（如复杂系统提示、安全护栏、结构约束）与基准测试分数之间的能力差距。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型评估通常仅在名义条件下进行，忽略了真实部署中模型被迫偏离最优生成路径的情况（如系统提示、安全护栏、结构约束等），导致基准分数与部署性能之间存在严重偏差，产生"能力幻觉"。
AI.method: 提出Decoding-Level Taboo，一种零提示压力测试方法。该方法在运行时直接干预logit空间，在词边界处动态屏蔽主要候选token，强制模型进行"迂回表达"（circumlocution），从而将模型逼出其名义生成路径。
AI.result: 在多个开源模型家族上的评估表明，离路径（off-path）鲁棒性受参数规模和后训练指令对齐的显著影响，鲁棒性通常随模型规模和指令对齐程度的提升而改善。
AI.conclusion: Taboo不仅是一种诊断工具，还可作为生成多样化合成数据集、压力测试运行时安全护栏以及在实际部署前审计模型可靠性的新型原语（primitive）。

title: eBIRD: Event-based Intensity Image Reconstruction Using Controllable Diffusion Models
summary: Intensity-image reconstruction from event streams remains a challenging problem due to the binary, sparse, and asynchronous nature of event data. This work proposes eBIRD, an event-guided reconstruction framework that combines a DDPM with ControlNet-based conditioning. We analyze generic and specialized diffusion learning strategies for handwritten digit (N-MNIST) and face (RGBE-Gaze) reconstruction using 33ms event windows. On N-MNIST, the general model achieves the best reconstruction quality (MSE 0.0052, SSIM 0.8982, PSNR 23.34dB), whereas the specialized model performs best on RGBE-Gaze (MSE 0.0161, SSIM 0.7605, PSNR 19.08dB). These preliminary results suggest that controllable diffusion models are a promising approach for event-guided intensity-image reconstruction, while highlighting that the preferred learning strategy depends on the reconstruction domain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出eBIRD框架，结合扩散概率模型（DDPM）与ControlNet条件控制，用于从事件流重建强度图像。实验在N-MNIST（手写数字）和RGBE-Gaze（人脸）两个数据集上进行，采用33ms事件窗口。结果表明：N-MNIST上通用模型表现最佳（MSE 0.0052, SSIM 0.8982, PSNR 23.34dB），而RGBE-Gaze上专用模型最佳（MSE 0.0161, SSIM 0.7605, PSNR 19.08dB）。初步结论认为可控扩散模型是事件引导强度图像重建的有前景方法，但最优学习策略取决于具体重建领域。
AI.motivation: 事件流数据具有二进制、稀疏和异步的特性，从中重建强度图像具有挑战性。现有方法在该任务上仍存在性能瓶颈，需要探索更有效的事件引导重建框架。
AI.method: 提出eBIRD框架，将去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）与基于ControlNet的条件控制相结合，实现事件引导的强度图像重建。比较了通用扩散学习策略与专用扩散学习策略在不同数据集上的表现。
AI.result: 在N-MNIST上通用模型最优（MSE 0.0052, SSIM 0.8982, PSNR 23.34dB）；在RGBE-Gaze上专用模型最优（MSE 0.0161, SSIM 0.7605, PSNR 19.08dB）。两个数据集上不同策略各有优势。
AI.conclusion: 可控扩散模型是事件引导强度图像重建的有前景方案，但最优学习策略依赖于具体重建领域，需要根据任务特点选择通用或专用模型。

title: Yesterday's Shield, Today's Spear: A Self-Evolving Safety Guardrail in Production
summary: Deployed LLM safety guardrails are predominantly static: trained once and frozen at release, while new jailbreak techniques and previously un-addressed harmful categories emerge within days, leaving the defense perpetually a step behind. We present SESG (Self-Evolving Safety Guardrails), a multi-agent system running in production. SESG monitors the live traffic behind a deployed guardrail and surfaces two classes of failure: jailbreaks novel in form and harmful categories novel in content. Once a failure is confirmed, a generation agent synthesizes paired training data targeted at it; a validation agent rebalances the batch toward the direction in which the deployed model errs, so that the model's own mistakes steer its training set; and a routing agent matches the training action to the diagnosed gap and returns the next version to production. Over six rounds of live evolution (V0 to V6), a 1.7B guardrail adapts to a new threat in 16-24 hours, with about 2 hours of human effort, versus the 40-90 hours of the manual process it replaces. On six emerging threats, it outperforms static guardrails from 0.6B to 9B and an adaptive baseline while preserving its general screening competence. Since April 2026, SESG has been the primary update pipeline of Sangfor's guardrail, autonomously closing 14 of 15 new threat scenarios in two months. We release 9 test sets for the 6 new threats at https://github.com/Trams1017/SESG. Warning: This paper contains examples that may be harmful or offensive.

AI.tldr: SESG（自进化安全护栏）是一个部署在生产环境中的多代理系统，通过监控实时流量识别新型越狱攻击和有害类别，自动生成针对性训练数据并持续更新护栏模型。在六轮在线演化中，1.7B护栏模型可在16-24小时内适应新威胁（仅需约2小时人工），显著优于传统手动流程（40-90小时），并在六个新兴威胁上超越静态护栏和自适应基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM安全护栏是静态的（训练一次后冻结），而新的越狱技术和新的有害类别在数天内就会出现，导致防御永远落后一步。需要一种能够持续自我演化的安全防护机制。
AI.method: 提出SESG多代理系统：1）监控代理监测真实流量并识别两类失败——新型越狱（形式新颖）和新型有害类别（内容新颖）；2）生成代理合成针对性的成对训练数据；3）验证代理根据部署模型自身的错误方向重新平衡训练批次；4）路由代理将训练动作匹配到诊断出的差距，并部署新版本到生产环境。
AI.result: 在六轮在线演化中（V0到V6），1.7B护栏模型16-24小时内适应新威胁（约2小时人工），传统手动流程需40-90小时。在六个新兴威胁上超越0.6B到9B的静态护栏和自适应基线，同时保持一般筛查能力。自2026年4月起，SESG已成为Sangfor护栏的主要更新流水线，两个月内自主关闭14/15个新威胁场景。
AI.conclusion: SESG证明了安全护栏可以从静态防御转变为生产环境中的自进化系统，通过自我纠错机制让模型自身的错误引导训练方向，大幅缩短从威胁出现到防御部署的时间周期，并已在实际生产环境中验证其有效性。

title: From Values to Benchmarks: Evaluating Large Language Models for Governmental Use in Dutch
summary: Large language models are increasingly being deployed in governmental settings, yet few existing evaluation frameworks jointly reflect the values of public administration and the linguistic requirements of non-English contexts. We present the "Grip on LLMs" framework, a systematic evaluation suite for Dutch governmental use developed in collaboration with domain experts from a major Dutch municipal organisation. Through an advisory board process, user research, and a survey of the users of a civil-servant chatbot, we identify six evaluation dimensions (factuality, honesty, social bias, energy consumption, cost, and training data transparency) and operationalise them into a benchmark suite covering more than 30 multilingual and Dutch-specific models. Our results reveal that no single model excels across all dimensions, and that trade-offs are unavoidable: higher quality consistently comes at greater environmental impact and financial cost, while bias remains largely independent of both. We further find that factuality (whether a model answers correctly) and honesty (whether a model acknowledges what it does not know) are governed by distinct properties, with high factuality not implying high honesty. To make these findings actionable for non-technical audiences, we release a publicly accessible, user-friendly model overview designed for the full range of stakeholders involved in governmental LLM selection, from engineers to policymakers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"Grip on LLMs"框架，这是一个专为荷兰政府用途设计的系统化大语言模型评估套件，涵盖六个评估维度（事实性、诚实性、社会偏见、能耗、成本和训练数据透明度），覆盖30多个多语言及荷兰语专用模型，并发布了对非技术受众友好的公开模型概览工具。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型正越来越多地被部署到政府环境中，但现有评估框架很少同时兼顾公共行政的价值观与非英语环境下的语言要求，缺乏针对政府场景的系统化评估工具。
AI.method: 与荷兰某大型市政组织的领域专家合作，通过顾问委员会流程、用户研究和对公务员聊天机器人用户的调查，确定六个评估维度并将其操作化为基准测试套件，评估30多个多语言和荷兰语专用模型。
AI.result: 没有任何单一模型在所有维度上表现优异，维度间存在不可避免的权衡：更高质量总是伴随更大的环境影响和财务成本，而偏见与两者基本独立；事实性（回答正确）与诚实性（承认未知）由不同属性支配，高事实性并不意味着高诚实性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果需要通过非技术方式呈现给政府LLM选型的各类利益相关者（从工程师到政策制定者），因此发布了公开、易用的模型概览工具，使研究成果对非技术受众具有可操作性。

title: A Combined Feature-Based Framework for Disguise and Spoofing Detection in Face Recognition Systems
summary: Face recognition systems face two distinct, commonly-separated failure modes: spoofing, where an impostor presents a photograph or video of an authorized user, and disguise, where a legitimate user is rejected because their appearance differs from their enrolled template due to accessories, facial hair, illumination, or pose. This paper proposes and compares five combined feature-extraction and classification pipelines that address both problems within a single framework: PM (PCA and Minimum Euclidean Distance, MED), LPM (Local Binary Patterns with PCA and MED), HPM (Histogram of Oriented Gradients with PCA and MED), SM (Speeded-Up Robust Features with MED), and HM (Harris corner features with MED). Each pipeline follows a common two-phase process comprising pre-processing, feature extraction, feature filtering, and classification. The methods were trained on 115 subjects drawn from the FEI, Disguised Faces Database, and NUAA databases and evaluated on six test conditions covering mixed appearances, frontal faces, dark illumination, left- and right-turned poses, and photo-spoofing attempts. The HOG-based pipeline (HPM) achieved the most consistent performance across conditions, with 94.59% accuracy on mixed-appearance disguise, 81.5-93.2% across pose and illumination variants, and 91.67% on spoofing, while the LBP-based pipeline (LPM) achieved the highest spoofing-detection accuracy (93.2%) but weaker robustness to pose change. These results reveal a measurable trade-off between spoof sensitivity and disguise robustness among classical feature representations, motivating the deep-learning and cross-database extensions discussed in the concluding sections.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并比较了五种结合特征提取与分类的流水线方法，在统一框架内同时解决人脸识别的两个失败模式：欺骗攻击（spoofing）和伪装（disguise）。实验表明HOG-based流水线（HPM）整体表现最稳定，而LBP-based流水线（LPM）在欺骗检测上准确率最高，揭示了两者之间存在可测量的权衡。
AI.motivation: 人脸识别系统存在两个通常被分开处理的失败模式：欺骗攻击（冒名顶替者使用照片或视频）和伪装（合法用户因配饰、胡须、光照或姿势变化而被拒绝）。这两种问题通常在独立的研究框架中被处理，缺乏统一解决两者的方法，需要探索一个能同时应对两种挑战的单一框架。
AI.method: 提出并比较五种特征提取与分类流水线：PM（PCA+最小欧氏距离MED）、LPM（局部二值模式LBP+PCA+MED）、HPM（方向梯度直方图HOG+PCA+MED）、SM（SURF+MED）、HM（Harris角点特征+MED）。每条流水线遵循两阶段过程：预处理、特征提取、特征过滤和分类。在115个受试者（来自FEI、Disguised Faces Database和NUAA数据库）上训练，并在六种测试条件下评估。
AI.result: HPM在混合外观伪装下达到94.59%准确率，在姿态和光照变体中达到81.5-93.2%，欺骗检测达91.67%。LPM在欺骗检测上达到最高的93.2%准确率，但对姿态变化的鲁棒性较弱。
AI.conclusion: 经典特征表示在欺骗敏感性和伪装鲁棒性之间存在可测量的权衡。该发现激励了深度学习和跨数据库扩展方向，将在论文后续章节中讨论。

title: HoloAegis: Frozen Representation, Topological Inference: Minimally Parametric Safety Manifolds for Zero-Shot LLM Guardrails
summary: Current LLM safety guardrails face a fundamental tension: fine-tuning distorts pre-trained representations while generative judges incur prohibitive inference costs. We challenge the prevailing paradigm by asking: can safety be achieved through pure geometric reasoning over frozen semantic representations? We present HoloAegis, a minimally parametric topological inference framework that decouples representation from reasoning. We term our approach minimally parametric because the only free parameters are the anchor count K and the temperature tau, both fixed after construction and requiring no gradient-based training. An un-fine-tuned encoder maps text to a unit sphere, after which all decisions are purely geometric. We formalize safety evaluation as a Gibbs-Boltzmann Free Energy computation over a pre-computed System Topology Anchor Bank, and we introduce Dual Time-Scale Exponential Moving Averages to detect progressive multi-turn semantic drift. Our key theoretical insight is a Topological Boundary Stability Conjecture: we provide theoretical motivation and strong empirical evidence that sparse anchor centroids stabilize the decision boundary against high-frequency lexical perturbations far better than full vector space methods. Evaluated across 8 benchmarks, HoloAegis achieves state-of-the-art accuracy (1.0000 AUC on AuthenHallu, 0.9802 on HarmBench) with sub-millisecond latency, zero cold-start data, and cross-lingual transfer (0.9758 AUC on Chinese CHIFRAUD).

AI.tldr: HoloAegis是一个极小参数拓扑推理框架，通过冻结语义表示上的纯几何推理实现LLM安全防护，无需微调或生成式评判器，在8个基准上达到SOTA精度且延迟低于毫秒级。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全护栏存在根本性矛盾：微调会扭曲预训练表示，而生成式评判器推理成本过高。作者挑战主流范式，探索是否可以不经过任何梯度训练，仅通过冻结的语义表示进行纯几何推理来实现安全检测。
AI.method: 使用未微调的编码器将文本映射到单位球面，将安全评估形式化为基于预计算系统拓扑锚点库的Gibbs-Boltzmann自由能计算；引入双时间尺度指数移动平均检测多轮对话语义漂移；仅有两个固定超参数（锚点数量K和温度tau），无需梯度训练。
AI.result: 在8个基准上取得SOTA精度：AuthenHallu上AUC达1.0000，HarmBench上0.9802，中文CHIFRAUD上跨语言迁移AUC达0.9758；亚毫秒级延迟，零冷启动数据需求。
AI.conclusion: 通过拓扑边界稳定性猜想及实证验证，稀疏锚点质心相比全向量空间方法能更稳定地抵御高频词法扰动，证明纯几何推理足以实现高效、低成本的LLM安全防护。

title: ERF-GS: Reconstructing Fast Motion from Disjoint Event-RGB Viewpoints
summary: Deep learning-driven representations such as neural radiance fields (NeRFs) and 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) have revolutionized the field of dynamic 3D scene reconstruction with improved visual precision and scalability. However, the reconstruction of fast-moving objects remains a challenge; existing methods based on conventional frame-based videos often struggle in scenarios such as sports events and animal videography. We propose an event-RGB fusion Gaussian splatting (ERF-GS) framework that integrates event information into both optimization and densification stages of the Gaussian splatting pipeline, taking advantage of novel event sensors with high frame-rate. Unlike many other event-assisted scene reconstruction methods, ERF-GS was developed using realistic simulation settings and realizes event-based learning detached from RGB inputs. This design enables its application beyond straightforward synthetic data into the realm of natural video with complex layout, low frame rates and severe motion blur. Our experiments show that ERF-GS outperforms both the 4DGS baseline and the concurrent E-D3DGS on different variants of the Neu3D and Nvidia datasets which include blurry RGB frames and disjoint RGB-event viewpoints. Our code is available at https://github.com/andrewbxy/ERF-GS.

AI.tldr: ERF-GS是一个事件-RGB融合的高斯泼溅框架，将事件信息集成到高斯泼溅的优化和稠密化阶段，利用事件传感器的高帧率优势，在无需依赖RGB输入的事件学习中实现了对快速运动物体的动态三维场景重建，在Neu3D和Nvidia数据集上优于4DGS和E-D3DGS基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于传统帧式视频的动态三维场景重建方法在处理快速运动物体（如体育赛事、动物摄影）时效果不佳，难以应对运动模糊和低帧率问题。作者希望利用事件传感器的高时间分辨率优势来解决这一挑战。
AI.method: 提出ERF-GS框架，将事件信息同时集成到高斯泼溅管道的优化和稠密化两个阶段。区别于其他事件辅助方法，ERF-GS采用真实模拟设置，实现脱离RGB输入的事件学习，使其能够应用于具有复杂布局、低帧率和严重运动模糊的自然视频。
AI.result: 实验表明，ERF-GS在Neu3D和Nvidia数据集的不同变体上（包含模糊RGB帧和不相交的RGB-事件视角）均优于4DGS基线和并行的E-D3DGS方法，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: ERF-GS证明了事件-RGB融合策略在高斯泼溅框架中的有效性，为快速运动场景的动态三维重建提供了一种新的解决方案，并且其脱离RGB输入的设计使其具备更强的实际应用泛化能力。

title: TrustRoboReward: Preference-Ordered Isotonic Score Editing for Multi-Paradigm Robot Reward Models
summary: Reward models are a bottleneck for reinforcement learning in embodied AI. Long-horizon robotic manipulation requires scalable vision feedback beyond handcrafted rewards or task-specific annotations. Existing open-source VLM reward judges like RoboReward adopt simple 1--5 trajectory progress scoring, lacking pairwise preferences for RLHF, DPO and Bradley-Terry frameworks, while failing to optimize video scene understanding. Augmenting RoboReward with pairwise comparison and video-QA supervision causes inconsistency between pairwise preferences and pointwise scores, introducing training noise and hurting downstream performance---an issue aggregation methods such as TrustJudge cannot resolve. To address this, we propose TrustRoboReward, a multi-paradigm reward modeling framework equipped with Preference-Ordered Isotonic Score Editing (POISE). We construct a unified four-paradigm dataset with trajectory progress scoring (Score-A), video-QA answer quality scoring (Score-B), and their pairwise counterparts (Pair-A, Pair-B). Pairwise labels align better with human judgment than pointwise scores, inspiring us to calibrate pointwise scores to avoid score-pair reversals against pairwise preferences. POISE rectifies pointwise scores and eliminates cross-paradigm reversal conflicts unresolved by TrustJudge. Theoretically, POISE reduces score-pair reversal conflicts from 20.15% to 0%, whereas TrustJudge retains 20.46% conflicts on the same corpus. Evaluated on our benchmark, Qwen3-VL-4B trained with POISE achieves an overall reward score of 77.96%, nearly matching GPT-5-mini (78.09%, gap 0.13%) and outperforming the strongest RoboReward-4B baseline by 10.13%. It also lifts test-time score-pair consistency to 71.90%, exceeding RoboReward-4B (57.26%) and GPT-5-mini (68.09%). Integrating TrustJudge aggregation during inference boosts the overall score to 78.57%, surpassing the GPT-5-mini teacher model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TrustRoboReward，一个多范式奖励建模框架，通过Preference-Ordered Isotonic Score Editing (POISE)技术校准点式分数，消除与成对偏好之间的冲突，提升长时程机器人操作任务的视觉反馈奖励模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有开源VLM奖励评判器（如RoboReward）仅采用1-5轨迹进度评分，缺乏成对偏好支持RLHF/DPO/Bradley-Terry框架，且未优化视频场景理解。简单地在RoboReward上增加成对比较和视频QA监督会导致点式分数与成对偏好不一致，引入训练噪声并损害下游性能，TrustJudge等聚合方法也无法根本解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出TrustRoboReward框架，核心是POISE（Preference-Ordered Isotonic Score Editing）技术。构建统一四范式数据集：轨迹进度评分（Score-A）、视频QA答案质量评分（Score-B）及其成对变体（Pair-A、Pair-B）。利用成对标签与人类判断更一致的特性，通过等渗回归校准点式分数，消除分数与成对偏好之间的反转冲突。
AI.result: POISE将分数-成对反转冲突从20.15%降至0%，而TrustJudge仍保留20.46%冲突。Qwen3-VL-4B在基准上达到77.96%总体奖励分数，接近GPT-5-mini（78.09%），比最强的RoboReward-4B基线高10.13%；测试时分数-成对一致性达71.90%，超过RoboReward-4B（57.26%）和GPT-5-mini（68.09%）。推理时集成TrustJudge聚合进一步提升至78.57%，超越GPT-5-mini教师模型。
AI.conclusion: 成对偏好与点式分数的系统性校准是提升机器人操作任务中VLM奖励模型的关键，POISE成功消除跨范式反转冲突，使小型模型在奖励评判上接近甚至超越大型教师模型，验证了范式间一致性校准的有效性。

title: Rethinking Attention Locality in Spiking Transformers
summary: Spiking Transformers provide a promising paradigm for efficient visual processing with spike-driven computation, yet their Softmax-free Spiking Self-Attention (SSA) struggles to establish spatially localized token interactions. Although existing locality-enhanced SSA methods improve accuracy, it remains unclear whether they consistently induce spatial locality across layers and different Spiking Transformer architectures. Through Mean Attention Distance (MAD) analysis, we reveal that computational locality does not necessarily translate into spatial locality and show that uniformly applying the same locality enhancement overlooks architecture-dependent deployment requirements. Motivated by these observations, we propose Spatially Contiguous Local Attention with Boundary Continuity Pathway (SCLA-BCP). SCLA computes attention within non-overlapping regions of spatially adjacent tokens, while BCP facilitates cross-boundary information exchange through a lightweight convolutional pathway. Furthermore, we develop a hierarchical locality deployment strategy to effectively apply SCLA-BCP across the two major Spiking Transformer architectures. Extensive experiments on seven static and neuromorphic datasets covering classification, detection, and segmentation demonstrate consistent improvements with limited parameter and energy overhead. Notably, our approach improves mAP@50 by up to 9.50% on COCO 2017 and mIoU by up to 3.42% on ADE20K. Visualizations, MAD analysis, and ablation studies further validate its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCLA-BCP方法，通过空间连续局部注意力（SCLA）和边界连续性通路（BCP）解决脉冲Transformer中注意力缺乏空间局部性的问题，并在两大主流脉冲Transformer架构上提出了层级式局部性部署策略，在7个静态和神经形态数据集上（涵盖分类、检测、分割任务）取得了显著改进。
AI.motivation: 脉冲Transformer中的无Softmax脉冲自注意力（SSA）难以建立空间局部化的token交互。现有的局部性增强方法虽然提升了精度，但通过平均注意力距离（MAD）分析发现：计算局部性并不一定转化为空间局部性，且统一应用相同局部性增强会忽略架构相关的部署需求。
AI.method: 1) SCLA：在空间相邻token的非重叠区域内计算注意力；2) BCP：通过轻量卷积通路实现跨边界信息交换；3) 提出层级式局部性部署策略，将SCLA-BCP有效应用于两大主流脉冲Transformer架构。
AI.result: 在COCO 2017上mAP@50提升最高9.50%，在ADE20K上mIoU提升最高3.42%，且参数和能量开销有限。分类、检测、分割任务的实验均显示一致改进，可视化、MAD分析和消融研究验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SCLA-BCP能有效为脉冲Transformer建立真正的空间局部性，层级式部署策略可根据架构特点自适应应用局部性增强，在保持低开销的同时实现性能提升。

title: MathShikkha: A Controlled Study of Answer-Only and Chain-of-Thought Supervision for Bangla Mathematical Reasoning in Small Language Models
summary: Mathematical reasoning remains challenging in low-resource languages such as Bangla. We study whether teacher-generated Bangla Chain-of-Thought (CoT) supervision provides benefits beyond ordinary supervised fine-tuning. We construct \textsc{MathShikkha}, a Bangla mathematical reasoning dataset with GPT-5.4-generated rationales, and fine-tune four 4B--7B student models under a matched protocol in which answer-only and CoT conditions share data splits, response-only loss masking, decoding, and scoring, differing only in the training target. In-domain, CoT provides no significant improvement over answer-only fine-tuning for three stronger backbones (paired bootstrap 95\% CIs include zero; exact McNemar $p \geq 0.17$), despite generating 15--52$\times$ more tokens, but significantly improves the weaker 4B model by 18.56 points ($p < 0.0001$). On the larger, contamination-audited BanglaMATH benchmark, this pattern reverses: CoT significantly outperforms answer-only supervision for all four models by 20.1--28.1 points (all $p < 0.0001$). Answer-only fine-tuning also reduces out-of-domain accuracy below the base model for three models, whereas CoT preserves or improves it for all four. A human study with two co-author annotators, external-expert adjudication, and Cohen's $κ= 0.76$--$1.00$ finds no significant CoT improvement over the base model on reasoning-content criteria; instead, its measurable effect is target-language adherence and producing inspectable reasoning. Overall, rationale supervision's value depends on backbone capability and distribution shift: in this setting, its main benefits are Bangla adherence, auditable reasoning, and out-of-domain robustness rather than improved in-domain reasoning validity.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨孟加拉语（低资源语言）数学推理中，教师生成的思维链（CoT）监督是否优于普通监督微调。作者构建了MathShikkha数据集，在匹配协议下微调四个4B-7B学生模型。结果显示：在领域内，CoT对三个较强骨干模型无显著提升，但显著改善较弱模型；在更大基准上，CoT对所有模型均显著优于仅答案监督；CoT的主要价值在于目标语言遵循性、可审计推理和领域外鲁棒性，而非领域内推理有效性。
AI.motivation: 数学推理在孟加拉语等低资源语言中仍具挑战性，现有研究缺乏对CoT监督在此类语言中价值的严格评估。作者希望通过匹配协议设计，厘清CoT监督相对于普通仅答案微调的真实增益。
AI.method: 构建MathShikkha孟加拉语数学推理数据集（GPT-5.4生成逐步推理），在匹配协议下对四个4B-7B学生模型进行微调，仅答案与CoT条件共享数据划分、损失掩码、解码和评分，仅训练目标不同。采用配对bootstrap置信区间、McNemar检验及人工评测（含外部专家裁决、Cohen's κ）进行多维度评估。
AI.result: 领域内：CoT对三个较强骨干无显著提升（95%CI含零，p≥0.17），但对4B较弱模型显著提升18.56分（p<0.0001）；在BanglaMATH基准上，CoT对全部四个模型显著优于仅答案监督（20.1-28.1分，p<0.0001）；仅答案微调使三个模型领域外准确率低于基座模型，而CoT保持或提升所有模型的领域外表现；人工研究无证据显示CoT在推理内容标准上显著优于基座模型。
AI.conclusion: 推理监督的价值取决于骨干模型能力和分布偏移：在本场景中，CoT的主要收益是孟加拉语遵循性、可审计推理和领域外鲁棒性，而非改善领域内推理有效性。

title: MotionCraft: Latent World Modeling with Sparse Attention for Visual Upscaling
summary: Video super-resolution (VSR) aims to recover high-fidelity high-resolution videos from low-resolution inputs and is central to applications ranging from mobile capture to streaming and archival restoration. Existing approaches trade off among local-detail fidelity, long-range spatio-temporal modeling, perceptual realism, and efficiency: convolutional alignment techniques preserve local structure but suffer when motion is large or degradations are complex; transformer-based methods capture long-range dependencies yet require architectural or algorithmic adaptations to remain computationally feasible; and recent latent or diffusion-based generators synthesize rich texture but require specialized temporal constraints to maintain coherence. We present MotionCraft, a controllable VSR framework that formulates restoration as motion-aware latent state prediction inspired by world models and integrates adaptive sparse attention with an explicit user-accessible control interface. MotionCraft combines robust motion fusion, a Latent World Transformer that balances locality and targeted non-local interactions, and a compact conditional decoder to deliver temporally consistent, high-quality reconstructions under streaming constraints. Empirical evaluations show that MotionCraft achieves strong reconstruction and perceptual performance while enabling predictable trade-offs between temporal smoothness and reconstruction fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出了MotionCraft，一个将视频超分辨率重建视为运动感知潜在状态预测的可控框架，结合自适应稀疏注意力与显式用户控制接口，在流式约束下实现高质量、时间一致的重建。
AI.motivation: 现有VSR方法存在权衡问题：卷积对齐方法保局部结构但在大运动或复杂退化下表现不佳；Transformer方法能建模长程依赖但计算开销大；潜在/扩散生成器能合成丰富纹理但需要专门的时间约束来保持连贯性。需要一个能同时兼顾细节保真、长程时空建模、感知真实性和效率的统一框架。
AI.method: MotionCraft包含三个核心组件：鲁棒运动融合（robust motion fusion）、潜在世界Transformer（Latent World Transformer）以及紧凑条件解码器。该方法受世界模型启发，将视频恢复形式化为运动感知的潜在状态预测，并集成自适应稀疏注意力以平衡局部性和目标化非局部交互，同时提供显式的用户可访问控制接口。
AI.result: 实证评估显示MotionCraft在重建质量和感知性能方面均表现优异，同时能够在时间平滑度和重建保真度之间实现可预测的权衡。
AI.conclusion: MotionCraft证明将视频超分辨率重构为运动感知的潜在状态预测是可行的，它能够在流式约束下同时实现强重建性能、高感知质量以及用户可控的时间一致性权衡。

title: Understanding Calibration and Truncation Error Propagation in Training-Free Low-Rank Compression for LLMs
summary: Training-free low-rank compression frameworks have been gaining prominence for LLM compression given their effectiveness in reducing model parameter count while maintaining task-level accuracy. However, existing SOTA frameworks share two key limitations: (1) residual errors in calibration data activations accumulate across layers during compression, causing misalignment between representations simulated at compression time and those experienced at inference; (2) the assumption that layer importance distribution is preserved post-compression does not hold. Together, these two effects introduce misalignment in the compression process in relation to the deployed model. We study these effects and propose a simple, training-free methodology compatible with existing frameworks to mitigate them, comprising: (1) Layer-by-Layer Compression with Calibration Correction; (2) Iterative Compression with Rank Allocation Correction. Implemented atop an existing SOTA decomposition framework, and evaluated on Llama and Qwen3 models across various benchmarks and compression rates, our approach demonstrates up to ~1-2.5 accuracy point improvements over per-weight and joint decomposition baselines on zero-shot tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对免训练低秩压缩框架提出两种校准方法：逐层压缩时修正校准数据激活残差，以及迭代压缩中修正秩分配偏差，在Llama和Qwen3模型上实现1-2.5个准确率点的提升。
AI.motivation: 现有SOTA免训练低秩压缩框架存在两个关键局限：(1)校准数据激活的残差误差在逐层压缩中累积，导致压缩时模拟的表征与推理时实际经历的表征不一致；(2)压缩后各层层重要性分布保持不变的假设不成立。这两种效应共同导致了压缩过程与部署模型之间的失配问题。
AI.method: 提出两种免训练、与现有框架兼容的修正方法：(1)逐层压缩中的校准修正（Layer-by-Layer Compression with Calibration Correction），解决激活残差累积问题；(2)迭代压缩中的秩分配修正（Iterative Compression with Rank Allocation Correction），解决层重要性分布变化问题。方法实现于现有SOTA分解框架之上。
AI.result: 在Llama和Qwen3模型上，于多种基准和压缩率下进行评测，与逐权重分解和联合分解基线相比，零样本任务上实现了约1-2.5个准确率点的提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对压缩过程中两大系统性失配源提出简单有效的免训练修正方案，显著提升了现有低秩压缩框架在部署场景下的实际表现，且无需额外训练开销。

title: SC-Diff: Semantically Calibrated Diffusion for Visible-to-Infrared Image Translation
summary: Visible-to-infrared image translation provides a practical way to expand infrared training data using abundant visible images. Diffusion models are promising for this task because of their strong generative performance. However, existing diffusion-based methods typically use semantic priors only as external conditions, without explicitly regulating token interactions within the denoising network. Consequently, they struggle to preserve object locations, shapes, and semantic layouts required for reliable annotation reuse. We propose SC-Diff, a semantically calibrated latent diffusion framework that uses semantic priors for both conditional guidance and internal self-attention calibration. A pretrained SAM3 model with predefined text prompts first extracts category-specific semantic masks from visible images. These masks are merged into a semantic map and fused with the visible image as the input condition. The same map is converted into token-level semantic labels to calibrate self-attention in the denoising network. Based on these labels, we introduce Semantic-Guided Self-Attention Calibration (SGSC), which adaptively applies positive biases to query-key pairs of the same category. The query-wise calibration strength depends on the dispersion of attention across semantic categories and the attention assigned to the query's own category. The original attention scores further modulate the bias, giving greater calibration to same-category keys with stronger responses. This soft calibration reduces cross-category interference while retaining global contextual interactions, thereby improving semantic consistency in generated infrared images. Extensive experiments show that SC-Diff improves perceptual quality and produces more effective synthetic training data for downstream infrared object detection.

AI.tldr: SC-Diff是一种语义校准的潜在扩散框架，用于可见光到红外图像翻译。它利用SAM3提取语义掩码作为条件输入，并将语义标签用于自注意力校准（SGSC），通过按查询自适应地增强同类token间的注意力权重，减少跨类别干扰，从而生成语义一致的红外图像，并有效提升下游红外目标检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的可见光到红外图像翻译方法仅将语义先验作为外部条件，未显式调控去噪网络内部的token交互，导致生成图像难以保持物体的位置、形状和语义布局，无法为下游任务提供可靠的标注复用。
AI.method: 1) 使用预训练SAM3和文本提示从可见光图像提取类别特定的语义掩码，合并为语义图并与可见光图像融合作为条件输入。2) 将同一语义图转换为token级语义标签。3) 提出语义引导的自注意力校准（SGSC），根据注意力在语义类别间的离散程度和查询自身类别的注意力分配自适应地调节校准强度，对同类别query-key对施加正向偏置，且偏置强度由原始注意力分数调制。4) 采用软校准方式，减少跨类别干扰的同时保留全局上下文交互。
AI.result: 大量实验表明SC-Diff在感知质量上优于现有方法，且生成的合成红外数据能显著提升下游红外目标检测模型的训练效果。
AI.conclusion: SC-Diff通过将语义先验同时用于条件引导和内部自注意力校准，实现了更可靠的语义一致性红外图像生成，为红外数据扩充和目标检测提供了有效方案。

title: Time Present and Time Past: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Temporally Evolving Document Understanding
summary: Evolving documents, such as laws, tax codes, and software documentation, are amended, replaced, and sometimes reverted over time, so a question has different correct answers at different dates. In contrast to encyclopedic knowledge, where an old fact is simply overwritten, an amendment is itself an official text that states what it replaces and when it takes effect, and the earlier version stays correct for its validity period. The central challenge is therefore version resolution, that is, identifying the version in force on the queried date. Existing temporal QA datasets treat time only as an annotation, so version resolution stays untested. We present TIDE, an expert-verified benchmark of 3,050 QA pairs over 644 official customs instruments issued between 1969 and 2025 by the Government of Bangladesh, covering eight task types over deeply code-mixed documents that are heterogeneous in layout and dated in two calendars. In addition, we evaluate nine recent LLMs under a single protocol across parametric, gold-context, and retrieval access, scored by a three-judge LLM council with a hard date gate separating correct meaning from correct time. The best macro-averaged accuracy is only 68.5%. Resolving a version from an implicit date reaches 59.7%, and detecting that the supplied version does not govern the query reaches only 26.7%. Models are more likely to find correct versions than to reject incorrect ones, and they tend to follow a confident parametric answer over the supplied authoritative text. All code and data are available at https://github.com/icsetepa44/TIDE

AI.tldr: TIDE是一个专家验证的基准数据集，包含3,050个问答对，覆盖1969至2025年间孟加拉国政府发布的644份官方海关文书，用于测试大语言模型在时间演化文档（如法律、税收法规）上的版本解析能力。评测9个LLM，最佳宏平均准确率仅68.5%，验证了现有模型在版本解析任务上的显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有时间敏感的问答数据集仅将时间视为标注，未真正测试版本解析能力——即在查询日期上识别在效版本的关键挑战。法律、税收法规等文档会随时间修订、替换甚至回滚，同一问题在不同日期有不同的正确答案，而现有方法未能针对这一核心难题进行系统评测。
AI.method: 构建TIDE基准数据集（3,050问答对、644份海关文书、1969-2025年、八种任务类型），覆盖深度代码混合文档（版式异构、双历法记日）；设计统一评测协议，在参数记忆、黄金上下文、检索访问三种模式下评估9个最新LLM；采用三位裁判LLM评委会打分，并设置硬性日期门控以区分正确语义与正确时间。
AI.result: 最佳模型宏平均准确率仅68.5%；从隐式日期解析版本准确率59.7%；检测所提供版本不适用于查询的准确率仅26.7%。模型更擅长找到正确版本而非拒绝错误版本，且倾向于跟随自信的参数化答案而忽略提供的权威文本。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在时间演化文档的版本解析任务上表现不足，尤其在版本拒绝判定方面存在严重短板，且过度依赖参数记忆而非权威来源。TIDE数据集为评测和推动该领域发展提供了基准。代码和数据已公开。

title: On-Device Multi-Species Malaria Detection with Uncertainty-Calibrated Slide-Level Aggregation
comment: Accepted at The Fifth Workshop on Applications of Medical AI (AMAI) 2026, a satellite event at MICCAI 2026. To appear in Springer Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNCS)
summary: Malaria remains a leading cause of mortality in resource-limited settings, where expert microscopists are scarce. Automated diagnosis based on microscopy images thus has strong potential to improve care delivery. But for an algorithm to deploy, a necessary requirement is that it meet a suite of non-obvious (from a machine learning (ML) perspective) clinical constraints. Therefore, in close consultation with a national health center we developed a malaria diagnosis pipeline which addresses key requirements listed by the health care center but typically ignored in the ML malaria literature. In particular, it includes: (i) stopping criteria (to reduce image acquisition and time-to-result); (ii) human-in-the-loop functionality (for review and accountability); (iii) multi-species discrimination (since treatment varies by species); (iv) thick film detection (standard for microscopy); (v) computationally-efficient uncertainty calculations (to aid clinician review); and (vi) an edge device platform (since internet can be spotty in this catchment area). The mobile system performs all inference on-device using YOLOv13n deployed via TensorFlow Lite. It detects four species and white blood cells from Giemsa-stained thick blood smear images, aggregating per-image detections into slide-level parasitemia with World Health Organization (WHO)-standard quantification. This paper highlights these various clinical constraints and offers methods to address them. Evaluated on 2,739 annotated images across all four species, the system achieves mAP@0.5 of 0.863, per-image parasite count correlation of r = 0.812, slide-level r = 0.951 (soft counting, 10 images/slide), and runs entirely offline with a pipeline time of 10.27 +- 1.65 s per image.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套面向资源有限环境（如疟疾高发但专家稀缺地区）的疟疾自动诊断流水线系统，在临床约束（停止准则、人在回路、多物种识别、厚血膜检测、不确定性计算、边缘设备部署）指导下，基于YOLOv13n和TensorFlow Lite在边缘设备上实现全离线推理，检测四种疟原虫物种及白细胞，并生成符合WHO标准的载虫率评估，在2,739张标注图像上达到mAP@0.5为0.863、幻灯片级相关系数0.951的良好性能。
AI.motivation: 疟疾在资源有限环境中仍是主要致死原因，而专业显微镜检验人员稀缺。尽管自动化诊断潜力巨大，现有ML文献大多忽视部署时所必须满足的临床约束（如停止准则、人在回路、多物种鉴别、厚涂片检测、计算高效的不确定性、离线边缘部署等）。本文旨在弥合学术研究与实际临床部署需求之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 与国家级卫生中心密切合作，开发了满足六项关键临床要求的疟疾诊断流水线：(i)停止准则减少图像采集和时间；(ii)人在回路供审查与问责；(iii)多物种鉴别（因治疗因物种而异）；(iv)厚血膜检测（显微镜标准做法）；(v)计算高效的不确定性计算辅助临床审查；(vi)边缘设备平台（因网路不稳定）。系统使用YOLOv13n模型经TensorFlow Lite部署，在设备端完成全部推理，从Giemsa染色的厚血膜图像中检测四种物种和白细胞，并将逐图检测聚合为幻灯片级载虫量，采用WHO标准定量方法。
AI.result: 在涵盖全部四种物种的2,739张标注图像上评估：mAP@0.5达0.863；逐图寄生虫计数相关性r=0.812；幻灯片级（软计数，每片10张图像）相关性r=0.951；系统完全离线运行，流水线处理时间为每张图像10.27±1.65秒。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，在满足真实临床约束的前提下，边缘设备上的疟疾自动诊断是可行且有效的。本文强调ML研究中常被忽略的临床需求，并展示了如何通过系统设计将这些约束纳入实际部署方案，为资源有限环境中的疟疾检测提供了可落地的技术路径。

title: Reproducing and Stress-Testing Two Approaches to LLM Reasoning Reliability: Test-Time Probability Aggregation and Logic-Representation Editing
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Code, data, and experiment logs: https://github.com/rabqatab/llm-reasoning-reliability-reproduction
summary: We independently reproduce two recent methods for making large language model (LLM) reasoning more reliable, and stress-test them across domains and models (RPC across four new task domains with Qwen3-8B, LCF across four 7-8B models). The first, RPC, aggregates token probabilities and self-consistency at inference; the second, LCF, trains projectors that split hidden states into "content" and "logic" and edits the logic part toward a valid region. Validating such reliability claims matters because the original evaluations are run by each method's own authors and were never independently reproduced or stress-tested across models and domains, and LCF shipped no public code. We re-run RPC's published-path aggregation and re-implement LCF's projector, contrastive, and intervention pipeline, then extend both to text-to-SQL, legal extraction, fallacy identification, and precedent grading, and probe LCF's representation directly. RPC reproduces the original grid exactly on the authors' released reasoning paths; on four new domains its edge over self-consistency is never significant (ties or small mixed differences, paired p >= 0.28), and on BIRD, the one domain where we vary the budget, the edge grows with K as predicted but its largest gap (+2.5 accuracy at K=32, p=0.16) reverses to -0.25 when we enlarge the sample to n=200. LCF's logic-validity direction is real but weak (0.82 separability at the single best sub-layer versus 0.95 for a semantic-attribute control); its one positive effect (Qwen3 $Δ$Prob) is not significant (p=0.56), while it significantly reduces $Δ$Prob on two of the other three models.

AI.tldr: 本文独立复现并压力测试了两种提升LLM推理可靠性的方法（RPC和LCF），跨领域跨模型验证后发现：RPC在原始数据上精确复现，但在新领域相对self-consistency无显著优势；LCF的逻辑有效性方向真实但微弱，且对部分模型产生负面影响。
AI.motivation: 原方法的评估均由作者自己完成，从未被独立复现或跨模型、跨领域压力测试；LCF未公开代码，可复现性存疑。验证这些可靠性声明十分重要。
AI.method: 1) 重跑RPC已发布的路径聚合；2) 重新实现LCF的projector、contrastive和intervention流程；3) 将两种方法扩展到text-to-SQL、法律抽取、谬误识别、先例分级四个新领域（RPC用Qwen3-8B，LCF用4个7-8B模型）；4) 直接探测LCF的表征。
AI.result: RPC在作者发布的推理路径上精确复现原始结果；但在四个新领域上与self-consistency无显著差异（p>=0.28）；在BIRD上随K增大优势增长，但扩大样本后最大优势从+2.5反转为-0.25。LCF的逻辑有效性方向真实但弱（0.82可分性 vs 对照0.95），对Qwen3的正效应不显著（p=0.56），且在另外两个模型上显著降低ΔProb。
AI.conclusion: 两种方法的原始可靠性声明过度乐观。RPC的优势仅限于作者特定设置，无法泛化到新领域；LCF的逻辑编辑效应微弱，甚至有害。独立复现和压力测试是验证AI可靠性声明不可或缺的环节。

title: CDGC-Net: 3D Medical Image Segmentation with Cooperative Dual-Scale Self-Attention and Grouped Channel Modeling
summary: Accurate 3D medical image segmentation requires the integration of long-range anatomical context with fine boundary detail. Existing methods often model global and local features in separate modules or feature levels and perform channel recalibration independently. This may cause semantic mismatch between global context and local boundaries, insufficient channel relationship modeling, weak spatial-channel interaction, and redundant representations. We propose CDGC-Net, a 3D medical image segmentation network that combines cooperative dual-scale spatial attention with grouped hierarchical channel modeling. With-in each CDGC block, Cooperative Dual-Scale Self-Attention (CDSA) assigns attention heads to parallel local-window and global-sparse branches. The two branches capture fine spatial details and long-range anatomical context at the same feature level. Their outputs are concatenated into an $N\times C$ spatial representation and directly passed to Grouped Hierarchical Channel Attention (GHCA). GHCA organizes the channels into $r$ groups and models both within-group and cross-group dependencies. CDSA and GHCA reuse a shared key projection to maintain a consistent feature reference. Residual feature alignment subsequently integrates the refined features with the original representation. On the Synapse, ACDC, BraTS, and LA datasets, CDGC-Net achieved mean DSC values of 86.96\%, 92.91\%, 82.56\%, and 93.52\%, respectively, exceeding the next-highest reported values by 0.39, 0.47, 0.17, and 0.32 percentage points. CDGC-Net contains 25.83M parameters and 28.62G FLOPs for an input size of $64\times128\times128$, reducing these quantities by 39.87\% and 40.30\%, respectively, relative to UNETR++. These results indicate a favorable trade-off between segmentation accuracy and computational complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CDGC-Net，一种结合协同双尺度空间注意力与分组层次通道建模的3D医学图像分割网络。通过在同一特征层级并行捕获局部细节与全局解剖上下文，并共享键投影以保持特征一致性，在Synapse、ACDC、BraTS和LA数据集上取得了优于现有方法的性能，同时显著降低了参数量和计算量。
AI.motivation: 现有3D医学图像分割方法通常将全局与局部特征建模在分离的模块或特征层级中，并独立进行通道重校准，这可能导致全局上下文与局部边界之间的语义不匹配、通道关系建模不足、空间-通道交互薄弱以及表征冗余等问题。
AI.method: CDGC-Net的核心是CDGC块，包含两部分：(1) 协同双尺度自注意力（CDSA），将注意力头分配到并行的局部窗口分支和全局稀疏分支，在同一特征层级捕获细粒度空间细节与长距离解剖上下文；(2) 分组层次通道注意力（GHCA），将通道组织成r个组，同时建模组内与跨组依赖。CDSA与GHCA共享键投影以维持一致的特征参考，并通过残差特征对齐将精炼特征与原始表征融合。
AI.result: 在Synapse、ACDC、BraTS和LA数据集上，CDGC-Net的平均Dice系数分别达到86.96%、92.91%、82.56%和93.52%，超过次优方法0.39、0.47、0.17和0.32个百分点。模型参数量为25.83M，FLOPs为28.62G（输入64×128×128），相比UNETR++分别减少了39.87%和40.30%。
AI.conclusion: CDGC-Net在分割精度与计算复杂度之间取得了良好的平衡，证明了协同双尺度空间注意力与分组层次通道建模策略在3D医学图像分割中的有效性。

title: Discovering Diverse Planning Policies for Multimodal Embodied Agents with Quality-Diversity Optimization
summary: Multimodal embodied agents are increasingly required to solve long-horizon tasks by integrating visual observations, textual goals, and interaction history into closed-loop decision making. However, state-of-the-art large-model-based planners often rely on a single dominant planning style during execution. Once this execution mode becomes ineffective, the agent may remain stalled for many steps, repeatedly interacting with the environment without making meaningful progress. We address this limitation by proposing a Quality-Diversity (QD) framework for discovering diverse planning policies for multimodal embodied agents. The proposed method treats planning-policy templates as evolvable individuals and organizes them into a behavior-indexed archive rather than collapsing search to a single prompt style. In the offline stage, rollout trajectories are summarized into structured success and failure experiences, which guide policy variation through recombination and experience-guided mutation. The resulting policies are mapped into a behavior space defined by interaction intensity and goal-directedness, and the highest-quality policy in each niche is retained in the archive. In the online stage, the agent executes one policy at a time while monitoring task progress. When persistent stall is detected, the system rolls back to the latest checkpoint and switches to a behaviorally distinct archive policy to resume execution. Experiments on the ThreeDWorld transport benchmark show that the proposed framework improves both task success and interaction efficiency over representative baseline planners. These results suggest that discovering diverse policy repertoires is an effective way to support adaptive multimodal planning and online failure recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个质量-多样性（QD）框架，用于为多模态具身智能体发现多样化的规划策略。通过将规划策略模板视为可进化个体并组织成语义行为索引的档案库，在离线阶段通过重组和经验引导突变生成多样化策略，在线阶段检测到持续停滞时回滚并切换到行为不同的策略继续执行。在ThreeDWorld基准上验证了该方法能提升任务成功率和交互效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的大模型规划器在长时程多模态任务中往往依赖单一主导规划风格，一旦该执行模式失效，智能体会在环境中反复交互却无法取得实质进展，导致长时间停滞。现有方法缺乏规划策略的多样性，无法在失败时灵活切换策略。
AI.method: 1) 将规划策略模板视为可进化的个体，组织成语义行为索引的档案库（而非坍缩为单一提示风格）；2) 离线阶段：将rollout轨迹总结为结构化的成功/失败经验，指导策略变异（通过重组和经验引导突变）；3) 将策略映射到由交互强度和目标导向性定义的行为空间，每个niche保留最高质量策略；4) 在线阶段：逐策略执行并监控任务进度，检测到持续停滞时回滚到最近检查点并切换到行为上不同的档案策略继续执行。
AI.result: 在ThreeDWorld传输基准上的实验表明，所提出的框架相比代表性基线规划器，同时提升了任务成功率和交互效率，验证了发现多样化策略库对多模态自适应规划和在线故障恢复的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 发现多样化的策略库是支持自适应多模态规划和在线失败恢复的有效途径。该方法为长时程多模态具身任务提供了可进化的策略多样性支持，有助于克服单一规划风格导致的执行停滞问题。

title: Where Is the Bee? Detecting Tiny Pollinators with a Single Collaborative-Head Transformer
comment: The 1st rank method's paper at CVPPA@ECCV 2026 BuzzSpot Challenge
summary: The CVPPA@ECCV 2026 BuzzSpot Challenge asks us to detect bees, bumblebees, hoverflies, and moths in 1920x1080 field keyframes. Its annotations carry 2 difficulties: the median box occupies 0.16% of a frame, and bees account for 80% of the labels. To cope with the small boxes, we compare 10 recorded detector configurations on held-out keyframes; plain Co-DINO with a Swin-L backbone has the highest mAP in this comparison, so we select it. Training then addresses the bee dominance in 2 ways: fine-tuning on a crop-mosaic pool in which the combined annotation share of the 3 rare classes rises from 19.9% to 55.1%, and a class-weighted simplex equiangular tight frame (ETF) loss that pulls the projected states of matched decoder queries toward fixed class directions. The full schedule spans 12+3+2 epochs. Without inference-time ensembling or test-time augmentation, we rank first on FinalTest at 0.5062 mAP@[.5:.95].

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了CVPPA@ECCV 2026 BuzzSpot挑战赛的解决方案。针对1920x1080野外关键帧中蜜蜂、大黄蜂、食蚜蝇和飞蛾的小目标检测问题（中位框仅占帧面积0.16%，蜜蜂占80%标签），作者通过对比10种检测器配置选出Co-DINO (Swin-L骨干)，并采用两种策略应对类别不平衡：crop-mosaic池微调（三类稀有类别标注占比从19.9%提升至55.1%）以及类别加权单纯形等角紧框架（ETF）损失。整个训练计划共12+3+2个epoch，不使用测试时增强或集成，最终以0.5062 mAP@[.5:.95]在FinalTest上排名第一。
AI.motivation: 挑战赛任务存在两个核心难点：目标极小（中位框仅占帧面积的0.16%）以及类别高度不平衡（蜜蜂占80%标注）。小目标检测需要高性能检测器配置，而类别不平衡则导致稀有类别的检测性能被忽视，需要有针对性的训练策略来改善。
AI.method: 方法包含三个关键环节：(1) 配置选择：在保留关键帧上比较10种检测器配置，选出性能最好的Co-DINO (Swin-L骨干)；(2) 数据层面：通过crop-mosaic池进行微调，使三种稀有类别的合并标注占比从19.9%提升到55.1%；(3) 损失函数层面：采用类别加权单纯形等角紧框架（ETF）损失，将匹配的decoder query的投影状态拉向固定的类别方向。训练计划为12+3+2轮epoch。
AI.result: 在不使用推理时集成或测试时增强的情况下，该方法在FinalTest上以0.5062 mAP@[.5:.95]的成绩排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 该解决方案证明了通过合理的检测器选择、针对性的数据增强（crop-mosaic）以及类别加权ETF损失的组合，能够有效应对小目标和类别不平衡的小目标检测任务，并以显著优势在挑战赛中夺冠。

title: Deep probabilistic logic programming for diagnostic reasoning from incomplete information: A case study in stroke detection
comment: Accepted for presentation at IJCLR 2026. This is the accepted version, _not_ the camera-ready version for the post-proceedings of the conference
summary: In medical applications, raw data is frequently associated with significant privacy concerns, lending particular importance to the encoding of summary statistics from the literature. On the other hand, deep learning has become an invaluable tool for assessing symptoms based on visual or auditory sensor data. DeepProbLog allows for an extensible neuro-symbolic approach that accommodates connectionist components to analyse patient images within a transparent and rigorous probabilistic framework, namely probabilistic logic programming under the distribution semantics. Framed as a case study in stroke detection from multimodal data, this contribution explores the pathway from summary statistics available in the literature to a DeepProbLog-based diagnostic system. It suggests a workflow using established maximum entropy techniques to complete available probabilistic information and the probabilistic logic programming system ProbLog 2 to move from the entropy-maximising causal model to a discriminative neuro-symbolic model expressible within DeepProbLog. The relative performance of models derived from less complete data is analysed alongside the potential of the probabilistic inductive logic programming system ProbFOIL 2 for compressing large discriminative models, and the perspectives and implications of using DeepProbLog for diagnostic reasoning are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了如何利用DeepProbLog这一神经符号框架构建医疗诊断系统，以中风检测为案例，展示了从文献中的汇总统计数据出发，通过最大熵技术补全概率信息，再经由ProbLog 2转化为可判别性的神经符号模型的全流程。
AI.motivation: 医疗数据常涉及隐私问题，因此利用文献中的汇总统计数据（而非原始数据）进行建模尤为重要；同时，深度学习虽擅长分析症状数据，但缺乏透明性和可解释性，需要一种既能利用深度学习的表征能力、又能提供严谨概率推理框架的方法。
AI.method: 提出一种从文献汇总统计到DeepProbLog诊断系统的工作流：(1) 使用最大熵技术补全不完整的概率信息；(2) 利用概率逻辑编程系统ProbLog 2将熵最大化的因果模型转化为可判别的神经符号模型；(3) 在DeepProbLog框架下实现可扩展的神经符号推理，并探讨使用ProbFOIL 2压缩大型判别模型。
AI.result: 以多模态中风检测为案例研究，比较了基于不同完整度数据派生模型的相对性能，并分析了ProbFOIL 2在压缩大型判别模型方面的潜力，同时讨论了DeepProbLog用于诊断推理的视角与影响。
AI.conclusion: DeepProbLog提供了一种在隐私敏感场景下结合深度学习和概率逻辑编程的可行途径，能够从文献统计数据中构建透明、严谨且可扩展的神经符号诊断系统，为医学诊断推理提供了新范式。

title: EvTrajGS: Accurate and Efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting from Unposed Event Streams
summary: Event cameras, with high temporal resolution, high dynamic range, and asynchronous sensing characteristics, have shown great potential for dense 3D reconstruction. Traditional reconstruction methods based on off-the-shelf pose estimates achieve high efficiency but produce low-fidelity results, as inaccurate pose initialization introduces cumulative reconstruction errors. In contrast, recent SLAM-style methods stabilize joint pose-scene optimization through incremental tracking and mapping, yielding higher reconstruction fidelity at the expense of considerable computational overhead. To address this trade-off, this paper presents EvTrajGS, an accurate and efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for unposed event streams. Our method enables reliable joint pose-scene optimization initialized from coarse pose priors, eliminating the need for computationally expensive SLAM-style pipelines. EvTrajGS parameterizes camera motion as a continuous-time trajectory initialized from discrete camera poses, providing a unified representation for pose refinement. We then aggregate adjacent trajectory states into a temporally coupled pose, promoting temporally consistent pose updates during joint optimization. Additionally, we introduce a loss-reweighted event sampling strategy to adaptively emphasize temporally under-reconstructed intervals. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that EvTrajGS outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of both geometric reconstruction quality and pose estimation accuracy, achieving 3.8 dB higher PSNR, 0.1 higher SSIM, and over 40\% lower ATE RMSE while retaining high computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EvTrajGS，一个面向未标定事件流的精确且高效的3D高斯泼溅框架。该方法将相机运动参数化为连续时间轨迹，从粗位姿先验初始化，通过时间耦合位姿和损失重新加权的事件采样策略实现联合位姿-场景优化，在保持计算效率的同时显著提升重建质量和位姿精度。
AI.motivation: 传统基于现成位姿估计的重建方法虽然高效，但位姿初始化不准确会导致累积重建误差，产生低保真结果；而SLAM式方法通过增量跟踪和建图获得更高精度，但计算开销巨大。作者旨在解决这一效率与精度之间的权衡问题。
AI.method: EvTrajGS包含三个核心组件：(1) 将相机运动参数化为连续时间轨迹，从离散的粗位姿先验初始化，提供统一的位姿精化表示；(2) 聚合相邻轨迹状态为时间耦合位姿，促进联合优化过程中时间一致的位姿更新；(3) 引入损失重新加权的事件采样策略，自适应强调时间上欠重建的区间。
AI.result: 在合成和真实数据集上，EvTrajGS在几何重建质量和位姿估计精度上均优于现有最先进方法：PSNR提升3.8 dB，SSIM提升0.1，ATE RMSE降低超过40%，同时保持高计算效率。
AI.conclusion: EvTrajGS证明了从粗位姿先验出发即可实现可靠的联合位姿-场景优化，无需昂贵的SLAM式管线，在精度与效率之间取得了理想的平衡，为事件相机稠密三维重建提供了新的高效解决方案。

title: VoxZip: Semantic-Anchored Temporal KV Cache Compression for Long-Context Audio Inference
summary: Recent advancements in Speech Large Language Models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in understanding complex audio tasks. Despite this progress, their long-context inference remains severely bottlenecked by prohibitive KV cache memory demands. Existing text-centric compression methods struggle here, often disrupting speech continuity or discarding crucial semantic cues. To address this, we propose VoxZip, a train-free, two-stage semantic-anchored KV cache compression framework. The first stage uses automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcriptions as explicit semantic anchors to temporally align, compress, and fuse audio tokens, significantly reducing the initial KV cache while elevating token information density. To further improve the compression ratio, the second stage employs a dynamic filtering strategy based on temporally decayed accumulated attention to evict non-essential tokens while mitigating early-token bias. Comprehensive evaluations on Qwen3-Omni across six diverse audio benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of our approach. VoxZip excels in long-audio reasoning and consistently maintains high-fidelity perception on short-form tasks. Notably, it sustains over 90\% of the uncompressed baseline performance even under an aggressive 20x KV cache compression in long-context scenarios. Furthermore, at a 4x compression ratio, VoxZip yields a 1.9x increase in inference throughput alongside a 3.3x reduction in peak memory overhead. Code and models will be available at https://github.com/MM-Speech/VoxZip.

AI.tldr: VoxZip 是一种无需训练的、两阶段语义锚定 KV 缓存压缩框架，通过 ASR 转录作为语义锚点对音频令牌进行时间对齐、压缩和融合，再结合基于时间衰减注意力的动态过滤策略，在 Qwen3-Omni 上实现高达 20 倍 KV 缓存压缩且保持 90% 以上的基线性能，同时显著提升推理吞吐并降低峰值内存开销。
AI.motivation: 语音大语言模型在复杂音频任务上表现优异，但长上下文推理受限于 KV 缓存带来的巨大内存开销。现有的以文本为中心的压缩方法在语音场景中效果不佳，容易破坏语音连续性或丢失关键语义线索。
AI.method: 提出 VoxZip 两阶段框架：第一阶段利用 ASR 转录作为显式语义锚点，对音频令牌进行时间对齐、压缩与融合，减少初始 KV 缓存并提升信息密度；第二阶段基于时间衰减的累积注意力进行动态过滤，驱逐非必要令牌同时缓解早期令牌偏差问题。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-Omni 上的六个音频基准测试中，VoxZip 在长音频推理任务中表现优异，在 20 倍 KV 缓存压缩下仍保持超过 90% 的基线性能；在 4 倍压缩率下实现 1.9 倍推理吞吐提升和 3.3 倍峰值内存开销降低。
AI.conclusion: VoxZip 证明了利用 ASR 语义锚点进行 KV 缓存压缩在语音场景中的有效性，能够在不显著损失性能的前提下大幅提升推理效率，为语音大模型的长上下文部署提供了一种实用的训练无关解决方案。

title: RobustDefect-LLM: Explainable and Robustness-Aware Industrial Surface Defect Classification with Decision Support and AI-Assisted Reporting
comment: 27 pages, 11 figures, 16 tables, preprint manuscript, the source code is publicly available
summary: This paper presents RobustDefect-LLM, an industrial surface-defect inspection framework integrating deep-learning classification, operator-facing visual evidence, confidence-aware decision support, controlled AI-assisted reporting, traceable storage, and mobile interaction in a unified quality-control workflow. Here, robustness-aware denotes explicit evaluation under controlled image degradation and confidence-aware review routing, not an intrinsic robustness guarantee. Four transfer-learning-based convolutional neural networks, ResNet50, EfficientNet-B0, DenseNet121, and MobileNetV3-Large, were evaluated on 1,799 images from the six-class NEU-DET dataset using fixed training, validation, and held-out in-domain test partitions. MobileNetV3-Large achieved the highest numerical test accuracy (99.26%) and macro F1-score (0.9926), with a bootstrap 95% accuracy CI of 0.9815-1.0000. An exact paired McNemar test found no significant difference from DenseNet121 (p = 1.000). The selected model averaged 0.060 s per CPU forward pass (16.66 FPS). Under combined synthetic degradation, accuracy fell to 87.78% at mild intensity and below 40% at stronger intensities, revealing sensitivity to severe image-quality deterioration. Grad-CAM supplied visual evidence, while predictions with confidence below 0.90 or a top-2 margin below 0.10 were routed to HUMAN REVIEW. This conservative policy provided 12.22% automatic coverage and 100% observed selective accuracy among 33 eligible cases (95% CI: 89.43%-100.00%), while routing both observed classification errors to review. Under nominal controlled conditions, all 100 generated reports passed deterministic consistency checks, with a mean latency of 1.66 s. Results support the feasibility of the integrated workflow while emphasizing the need for calibration, repeated evaluation, and real-world industrial validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RobustDefect-LLM，一个集成深度学习分类、视觉证据展示、置信度感知决策支持、辅助报告生成、可追溯存储和移动交互的工业表面缺陷检测框架。在NEU-DET数据集上，MobileNetV3-Large达到最高准确率99.26%，但模型在强图像退化下性能显著下降，保守的置信度路由策略仅覆盖12.22%的自动决策样本。
AI.motivation: 工业表面缺陷检测需要将深度学习分类与实际质量控制流程整合，但现有方法缺乏统一的端到端工作流，且对模型在真实工业环境中的鲁棒性评估不足。
AI.method: 评估四种迁移学习CNN（ResNet50、EfficientNet-B0、DenseNet121、MobileNetV3-Large）于六类NEU-DET数据集，采用固定划分训练/验证/测试集，结合合成图像退化测试、Grad-CAM可视化、置信度阈值路由（<0.90或top-2 margin<0.10转人工审查）、确定性报告一致性检查及移动端交互设计。
AI.result: MobileNetV3-Large以99.26%准确率和0.9926宏F1分居首（bootstrap 95% CI: 0.9815-1.0000），与DenseNet121无显著差异（p=1.000）。CPU推理0.060s/张（16.66 FPS）。轻度退化下准确率降至87.78%，强退化下低于40%。保守路由策略仅12.22%自动覆盖率，但100%选择性准确率（33例中，95% CI: 89.43%-100.00%），两类错误均被路由。报告生成100%通过一致性检查，平均延迟1.66秒。
AI.conclusion: 该集成工作流在受控条件下具有可行性，但需强调模型对严重图像退化的敏感性、选择性分类策略的低自动覆盖率等问题，未来需进行校准、重复评估和真实工业环境验证。

title: FailForge: Distilling Procedural Competence from Persistent Failures into Code Agents
summary: Rejection sampling fine-tuning (RFT) is widely used to train code agents by generating trajectories on verifiable software engineering tasks, retaining those that pass the tests, and fine-tuning on the successful rollouts. However, even strong code agents repeatedly fail on a substantial fraction of such tasks, and standard RFT simply discards these failures. The discarded samples are precisely the hardest and most informative ones, drawn from verifiable instances that are costly to curate. Stronger base models may reduce the number of failures, but the remaining hard cases still define the frontier for further improvement. We propose FailForge, an agentic framework that converts failed rollouts into training signal. For each failed instance, an agent diagnoses the failure from error feedback and execution traces, distills the diagnosis into a concise and actionable skill, and injects the skill into the agent context for a guided second attempt. Trajectories that succeed under skill guidance are folded back into the RFT corpus. Crucially, the skill is removed at training time, so the model internalizes the recovered behavior rather than relying on external hints at inference. FailForge recovers over 26% of previously failed instances at marginal additional cost, and training Qwen3.5-4B on the augmented corpus improves the SWE-bench Verified resolve rate by 6.6 points over a strong RFT baseline, with gains concentrated on the hardest problems.

AI.tldr: FailForge是一个智能体框架，将代码agent在可验证软件工程任务中失败的轨迹转化为训练信号。它通过诊断失败、提炼可操作的技能、引导二次尝试来回收失败样本，并在训练时移除技能提示，使模型内化恢复的行为。实验表明FailForge回收了超过26%的失败实例，将Qwen3.5-4B在SWE-bench Verified上的解决率提升了6.6个百分点。
AI.motivation: 标准RFT会丢弃失败的样本，但这些正是最难、最有信息量的样本。更强的基座模型只能减少失败数量，剩余的困难案例仍然定义了进一步改进的前沿。此外，收集这些可验证实例成本高昂，不能轻易浪费。
AI.method: FailForge框架包含三个步骤：(1) 智能体从错误反馈和执行轨迹中诊断失败原因；(2) 将诊断提炼为简洁可操作的技能；(3) 将技能注入agent上下文进行引导二次尝试。成功的轨迹被回收进RFT语料库，但在训练时移除技能，迫使模型内化所学行为而非依赖外部提示。
AI.result: FailForge以边际额外成本回收了超过26%的先前失败实例。使用增强后的语料库训练Qwen3.5-4B，在SWE-bench Verified上的解决率比强RFT基线提升了6.6个百分点，且增益集中在最困难的问题上。
AI.conclusion: 失败样本可以被系统地转化为训练信号而不是简单丢弃，这为代码agent的持续改进提供了新的路径，尤其在处理困难问题上效果显著。

title: Goal-oriented Navigation Instruction Generation with Tour Video Priors
summary: Navigation Instruction Generation (NIG) aims to produce step-by-step natural language instructions for navigation guidance. Existing studies primarily treat NIG as an auxiliary task for vision-andlanguage navigation (VLN), focusing on data augmentation or multi-task learning. However, generating navigation instructions from compact environmental priors requires meticulous spatial reasoning, especially when the target route does not simply follow the demonstrated tour, and remains challenging for current multimodal models. In this work, we introduce VideoNIG, a goal-oriented video-grounded NIG task that generates navigation instructions from ego-centric tour videos, an initial observation, and a textual or visual goal, without relying on intermediate representations such as graphs and maps. We instantiate VideoNIG in a controlled simulator benchmark with 60K tour videos across continuous indoor environments and 37K multimodal prompts with progressive difficulty levels. We further introduce a diagnostic evaluation protocol that combines text similarity, choice-based spatial consistency tests, and downstream navigation execution. To address this task, we propose a two-stage Curriculum Learning framework that decomposes the learning into foundational motion perception and long-horizon navigation reasoning. Specifically, we first employ Action Warmup for spatial action-view alignment, followed by Complexity Progression using trajectories with increasing exploratory difficulty. Extensive experiments show that existing MLLMs struggle with VideoNIG, while our approach significantly improves instruction quality across complementary diagnostic metrics. Finally, integrating VideoNIG-generated instructions with a VLN agent demonstrates the executability of this task formulation for end-to-end navigation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VideoNIG，一个以目标为导向的视频接地导航指令生成任务，从第一人称游览视频、初始观察和文本/视觉目标中生成导航指令，无需中间表示（如图形和地图）。作者构建了一个包含60K游览视频和37K多模态提示的受控模拟器基准，并提出了两阶段课程学习框架（Action Warmup + Complexity Progression）来解决该任务。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将导航指令生成（NIG）视为视觉语言导航（VLN）的辅助任务（如数据增强或多任务学习），而从紧凑环境先验中生成导航指令需要精细的空间推理，尤其是目标路线不简单跟随已演示的游览路径时，现有多模态模型仍难以处理。
AI.method: 1) 提出VideoNIG任务形式化，从第一人称游览视频、初始观察和文本/视觉目标生成指令，不依赖图形和地图等中间表示；2) 在受控模拟器基准中实例化，包含60K视频和37K多模态提示，设置渐进难度；3) 提出两阶段课程学习框架：先进行Action Warmup实现空间动作-视角对齐，再通过Complexity Progression使用递增探索难度的轨迹进行长时程导航推理训练；4) 引入组合诊断评估协议：文本相似度、基于选择的空間一致性测试和下游导航执行。
AI.result: 实验表明现有多模态大语言模型在VideoNIG上表现不佳，而所提出的方法在互补诊断指标上显著提升了指令质量。将VideoNIG生成的指令集成到VLN智能体中，验证了该任务形式化对端到端导航的可执行性。
AI.conclusion: VideoNIG将NIG从辅助任务提升为独立的目标导向视频接地任务，通过课程学习方法有效提升了多模态模型的导航指令生成能力，并为端到端导航提供了新的可执行任务形式。

title: SDDBMs: Soft Denoising Diffusion Bridge Models
summary: Diffusion bridge models leverage Doob's \(h\)-transform to construct stochastic transports between arbitrary endpoint distributions, and have shown strong potential in image-to-image translation and restoration. However, most existing bridge models rely on hard endpoint conditioning, which forces the terminal state to match a prescribed target exactly. This hard constraint induces terminal-boundary singularities: the terminal law collapses to a Dirac measure, and the resulting drift coefficients become ill-conditioned near the endpoint. In this paper, we propose Soft Denoising Diffusion Bridge Models (SDDBMs), a generalized framework that regularizes diffusion bridges directly at the level of their terminal constraints. Instead of imposing an exact endpoint, SDDBMs prescribe a non-degenerate Gaussian terminal marginal under the transformed path measure, with a flexible terminal center and variance. Starting from this prescribed marginal, we develop a complete closed-form construction of the soft bridge, including the Gaussian terminal reweighting and soft \(h\)-function, the induced Gaussian forward marginals and \(\mathbf{x}_0\)-free dynamics. Theoretically, SDDBMs provide a unified probabilistic perspective that encompasses existing diffusion bridge models, including DDBMs, GOUB, and UniDB, as special cases under specific parameter choices. Extensive experiments on image restoration tasks demonstrate that SDDBMs achieve improved numerical stability and superior generation quality over existing bridge-based methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出软去噪扩散桥模型（SDDBMs），通过在终端约束层面引入非退化高斯边际分布来替代硬性端点约束，从而消除扩散桥模型中由于终端状态精确匹配导致的边界奇异性和病态漂移系数问题，并在图像恢复任务中验证了改进的数值稳定性和生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散桥模型（如DDBMs、GOUB、UniDB）依赖硬端点条件，强制终端状态精确匹配目标分布，导致终端定律坍缩为Dirac测度，漂移系数在端点附近出现病态条件数，引发数值不稳定和生成质量下降问题。
AI.method: SDDBMs在路径测度变换层面直接正则化终端约束：用非退化的高斯终端边际分布（含灵活的中心和方差参数）替代精确端点。论文给出了完整的闭式构造，包括高斯终端重加权、软h函数、诱导的高斯前向边际以及不含x0的动力学方程。
AI.result: 在图像恢复任务上的大量实验表明，SDDBMs相比现有基于桥的方法取得了更优的数值稳定性和更高的生成质量。理论上，该框架统一了DDBMs、GOUB、UniDB等现有扩散桥模型，可作为其特定参数选择下的特例。
AI.conclusion: SDDBMs通过软化终端约束，为扩散桥模型提供了一种统一的概率视角，既解决了硬端点导致的奇异性问题，又以闭式解形式保持了方法的可计算性，在图像恢复中展现了实际优势。

title: Population-Scalable Multi-Agent World Modeling
comment: Technical report. Project page: https://rhos.ai/research/khora. Online demo: https://ophilus.ai/khora
summary: World models have recently achieved impressive progress in visual prediction and interactive generation, but extending them to multi-agent environments introduces a fundamental scalability challenge. Existing methods generally assume a fixed number of agents during training and inference, which ties the model to a pre-determined agent population and limits inference-time scalability. Our key insight is that cross-view consistency should arise from a shared world state whose evolution does not assume a predefined number of agents, while agent-specific observations should be generated by querying this state through a unified rendering interface. Based on this insight, we propose Khora, a scalable multi-agent world model that supports inference-time expansion to arbitrary numbers of agents without retraining. Our framework decouples world-state evolution from visual rendering and introduces a population-agnostic rendering mechanism for incorporating other agent information. This design maintains cross-view consistency through the shared world state rather than through dense interactions among observation streams inside the expensive video generator, enabling approximately linear practical scaling with the number of queried views. Qualitative experiments demonstrate that our approach generalizes to unseen numbers of agents while maintaining visual quality and multi-agent consistency. We further implement a real-time interactive system to demonstrate scalable open-world simulation.

AI.tldr: Khora是一个可扩展的多智能体世界模型，通过解耦世界状态演化与视觉渲染，并引入群体无关的渲染机制，实现在推理时扩展到任意数量的智能体而无需重新训练，同时保持跨视角一致性和视觉质量。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型在多智能体环境中面临根本性的可扩展性挑战：大多数方法在训练和推理时假设固定数量的智能体，这使模型绑定于预定的智能体种群，限制了推理时的可扩展性。
AI.method: 核心洞见是跨视角一致性应源于共享世界状态的演化（不假设预定义数量的智能体），而智能体特定的观察应通过统一的渲染接口查询该状态来生成。框架将世界状态演化与视觉渲染解耦，并引入群体无关的渲染机制来整合其他智能体信息。通过共享世界状态而非视频生成器内观察流之间的密集交互来维持跨视角一致性，从而实现对查询视角数量的近似线性扩展。
AI.result: 定性实验表明该方法能泛化到未见过的智能体数量，同时保持视觉质量和多智能体一致性。此外实现了实时交互系统以演示可扩展的开放世界模拟。
AI.conclusion: Khora通过解耦世界状态与渲染、采用群体无关的渲染接口，成功解决了多智能体世界模型的可扩展性难题，实现了无需重新训练即可在推理时扩展智能体数量的能力，为开放世界模拟提供了可行的技术路径。

title: Unaccountable Delegation, Fading Skills: Mapping the Risks of Workplace AI Agents
summary: To anticipate socio-technical risks from AI agents, organizations need taxonomies to classify them. However, existing AI risk taxonomies focus on broad risks and do not capture job-specific risks introduced by agents. To address this gap, we make three main contributions. First, we developed a multi-layer framework from a literature review of AI agents. The framework models three core components and their interactions: agents, goals, and environment. Second, we embedded this framework in a structured prompt and applied it to descriptions of 2,078 job tasks from the O*NET database, producing 8,356 risk scenarios labeled by severity and deployment mode (automation or augmentation). We validated these scenarios with 45 workers across 10 job roles and an independent LLM judge, confirming their plausibility and alignment with job tasks. Finally, we extended an existing taxonomy to create a 15-category taxonomy of workplace AI agent risks that covers all our risk scenarios. Our analysis highlights four findings. First, augmentation is not inherently safe because overreliance on agents can gradually erode workers' skills and oversight. Second, Erroneous Agent Actions accounts for the largest share of risk scenarios and has the highest concentration of severe risks. Many arise at the human-agent boundary. Third, automation is associated mainly with organizational risks, while augmentation is associated mainly with risks to workers. Fourth, workers found our taxonomy easier to use for a risk classification task than two other taxonomies and preferred it in 64% of non-tied comparisons with a recent generative AI risk taxonomy. These findings show that workplace AI agent risks do not arise from agents alone; they also depend on how people work with agents and how agents are deployed. Safer workplaces require not only safer agents but also carefully designed human-AI agent collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向工作场所AI代理（AI agent）风险的多层框架和15类风险分类体系，基于O*NET数据库中2,078个工作任务进行分析，生成8,356个风险场景，并通过45名工人和独立LLM判断器验证。研究发现：增强（augmentation）并非天然安全，代理错误行为占比最高且严重风险集中，自动化主要关联组织风险，增强主要关联工人风险，且该分类法在风险分类任务中优于其他两种现有分类法。
AI.motivation: 现有AI风险分类法侧重于宽泛风险，未能捕捉AI代理引入的工作岗位特定风险，因此需要开发能对AI代理进行分类和风险评估的工具。
AI.method: 首先通过文献综述开发出包含代理、目标、环境三大核心组件及其交互的多层框架；将该框架嵌入结构化提示，应用于O*NET数据库中2,078个工作任务描述，生成8,356个按严重程度和部署模式（自动化或增强）标注的风险场景；通过45名工人和独立LLM判断器验证场景合理性；最后扩展现有分类法，创建15类工作场所AI代理风险分类体系。
AI.result: 提出15类工作场所AI代理风险分类法，涵盖所有风险场景。四项主要发现：增强模式因过度依赖导致技能和监管侵蚀而非天然安全；代理错误行为占最大风险份额且严重风险最集中，多发生在人机边界；自动化主要关联组织风险，增强主要关联工人风险；工人在分类任务中发现该分类法更易用，在64%非并列比较中偏好它优于最新生成式AI风险分类法。
AI.conclusion: 工作场所AI代理风险不仅源于代理本身，还取决于人机协作方式和代理部署模式。更安全的工作场所需要更安全的代理，更需要精心设计的人机协作。

title: REVEAL: A Rubric-Guided Agent for Explicit Evidence Sufficiency Verificationin Long-Video Question Answering
summary: Recently, retrieval-augmented and memory-augmented methods have emerged as two promising paradigms for long-video question answering. However, existing methods typically rely on rigid, fixed-length temporal chunking (e.g., 10s) and static offline memory banks, which not only fragment coherent continuous events but also fail to adapt during real-time reasoning. Moreover, whether using multi-scale summaries or multimodal knowledge graphs, current approaches prioritize retrieval relevance while overlooking evidence sufficiency, often stopping to answer once only semantically relevant clues are retrieved, even when key temporal, causal, or fine-grained action evidence is still missing. To tackle these challenges, we propose REVEAL, a rubric-guided agent framework. As a foundation, we introduce an adaptive visual-similarity-based preprocessing pipeline that groups visually coherent adjacent frames into natural event units to construct an offline-online video memory---capturing global video context offline while dynamically maintaining question-conditioned memory online. Built upon this structured memory, REVEAL uses an automatically constructed rubric library to explicitly verify whether retrieved evidence satisfies sufficiency criteria, pinpoints missing clues upon verification failure, and directs targeted re-retrieval for complementary information. Without any extra training, REVEAL consistently outperforms both closed-source and open-source state-of-the-art methods across extensive experiments. These results show that explicitly verifying evidence sufficiency, rather than stopping at semantic relevance, retrieves the decisive clues that prior methods miss and yields more reliable long-video reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出了REVEAL框架，通过自适应视觉相似度预处理构建离线-在线视频记忆，并利用自动构建的rubric库显式验证证据充分性，实现更可靠的长视频问答推理。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频问答方法存在两大问题：一是依赖固定长度的时间分块和静态离线记忆库，破坏了连续事件的完整性且无法适应实时推理；二是只关注检索相关性而忽视证据充分性，在关键的时间、因果或细粒度动作证据缺失时就停止回答。
AI.method: REVEAL包含两个核心组件：1) 自适应视觉相似度预处理管道，将视觉连贯的相邻帧分组为自然事件单元，构建离线-在线视频记忆（离线捕获全局上下文，在线动态维护问题条件化记忆）；2) 自动构建的rubric库，显式验证检索证据是否满足充分性标准，在验证失败时定位缺失线索并引导定向补充检索。
AI.result: 无需额外训练，REVEAL在广泛的实验中一致优于闭源和开源的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式验证证据充分性而非止步于语义相关性，能够检索到先前方法遗漏的关键线索，从而产生更可靠的长视频推理。

title: ForestBench: A Unified Graph Framework for Evaluating Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on Large Language Models (LLMs) are proliferating rapidly, but their heterogeneous execution traces provide no common basis for evaluation across methods. Outcome-only benchmarks discard collaborations, whereas LLM-as-Judge evaluation requires additional, model-dependent inference and can vary with the LLM and rubric. We introduce a generalizable evaluation framework that maps native MAS traces into a shared space of unified collaboration graphs, enabling different methods to be evaluated under the same representation, reference set, and metric panel. Candidate graphs are compared with a query-specific reference forest. Each forest is a benchmark-provided collection of verified-success graphs: it records diverse ways in which representative MAS methods can complete the task, rather than prescribing a unique optimal process. Instantiating the framework as ForestBench, we filter $844$ collaboration-necessary queries from seven public datasets, precompute ten successful target-conditioned reference graphs per query, and evaluate six representative MAS frameworks. Controlled backbone, reference-construction, and perturbation studies test the stability and scope of evaluation. Once the benchmark forests are built, ForestBench scores a trace in milliseconds without further LLM inference, providing a reusable structural basis for comparing diverse MAS collaboration traces.

AI.tldr: 提出ForestBench，一个基于统一协作图表示的多智能体系统（MAS）评估框架。它将异构MAS执行轨迹映射到共享的协作图空间，通过与查询特定参考森林（由已验证成功的参考图组成）比较来评估，无需额外LLM推理，可在毫秒级完成评分。
AI.motivation: 现有MAS评估缺乏统一基础：基于结果的基准忽略了协作过程，LLM-as-Judge评估需要额外的模型依赖推理且结果随LLM和评分标准而变化。需要一种通用、稳定、可复用的评估框架。
AI.method: 将原生MAS轨迹映射为统一协作图，候选图与查询特定的参考森林比较。参考森林由基准提供的已验证成功图组成，记录多种完成任务的代表性方式而非单一最优过程。从7个公开数据集过滤844个需要协作的查询，每个查询预计算10个成功的目标条件参考图，评估6个代表性MAS框架，并通过受控骨干、参考构建和扰动研究测试稳定性。
AI.result: 在844个协作必需查询上评估6个MAS框架，构建了森林基准，实现了无需额外LLM推理的毫秒级评分，并通过受控研究验证了评估的稳定性与适用范围。
AI.conclusion: ForestBench提供了可复用的结构化基础，使得不同MAS的协作轨迹可以在统一表示、参考集和指标面板下公平比较，避免了结果导向评估的片面性和LLM评判的不可靠性。

title: VADER: Adaptive Debiasing for Hallucination Mitigation in Video Large Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in open-ended video understanding, yet they remain prone to fluent responses unsupported by video evidence. Existing training-free methods typically apply a globally fixed visual intervention or construct a contrastive branch through input perturbation. The former cannot accommodate video-dependent fusion paths, while the latter can be compensated by cross-frame redundancy. We therefore propose Video-Adaptive Debiasing via Evidence Reweighting (VADER), a training-free framework with two complementary modules. Visual Focus Reallocation (VFR) automatically instantiates an intervention policy for each video-question input: it diagnoses layer-wise visual-to-text evidence flow, determines where to intervene, and derives how strongly to reallocate pre-softmax attention from system-token to video-token blocks. Selective Evidence Erasure (SEE) independently masks high-importance visual tokens in every frame, constructing a prior-biased branch that is difficult to compensate through neighboring frames. Contrastive decoding then down-weights predictions that remain confident after selective evidence erasure. Across multiple VideoLLMs, VADER yields substantial improvements on event-level grounding and temporal consistency; on LLaVA-Video-7B, it reaches 72.60% accuracy on EventHallusion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VADER，一个无需训练的框架，通过视觉焦点重分配（VFR）和选择性证据擦除（SEE）两个互补模块，为每个视频-问题输入自适应地干预证据流，降低大视觉语言模型在视频理解中产生无证据支撑的流畅回复的倾向。
AI.motivation: 现有大视觉语言模型虽在开放式视频理解中表现优异，但容易产生缺乏视频证据支持的回答。已有无训练方法要么使用全局固定的视觉干预策略，无法适应视频依赖的融合路径；要么通过输入扰动构建对比分支，但会被跨帧冗余所补偿，导致失效。
AI.method: VADER包含两个模块：1）视觉焦点重分配（VFR）自动为每个视频-问题输入实例化干预策略，诊断逐层视觉到文本的证据流，确定干预位置，并计算如何将softmax前的注意力从系统token重分配到视频token块；2）选择性证据擦除（SEE）独立遮罩每帧中高重要性的视觉token，构建难以被相邻帧补偿的先验偏置分支，通过对比解码降低在证据擦除后仍保持自信的预测权重。
AI.result: 在多个VideoLLM上，VADER在事件级grounding和时间一致性上带来显著改进；在LLaVA-Video-7B上，EventHallusion准确率达到72.60%。
AI.conclusion: VADER通过视频自适应、证据重加权的无训练机制，有效缓解了LVLM在视频理解中依赖先验知识而非视频证据的问题，并在多个模型上验证了其泛化性与有效性。

title: Walking through Discussions: A Mobile Visual Analytics System for In-Situ Group Discussion Analysis
summary: Group discussion-based teaching is widely used to foster collaborative learning, yet teachers in physical classrooms often struggle to simultaneously monitor multiple groups and quickly diagnose a target group before intervening. Existing visual analytics tools primarily support post-hoc analysis on desktop, providing limited support for in-situ walk-around teaching. To address this gap, we present MobileGroupVis, a mobile visual analytics system for in-situ analysis of classroom group discussions. MobileGroupVis integrates multi-group monitoring, single-group diagnosis, and instructional intervention into a concise analytical workflow tailored for small-screen touch interaction. The system is powered by a lightweight streaming analysis pipeline that converts group audio into structured discussion data and further extracts interaction patterns, topic progression, and topic deviation through a dialogue analysis module. To enable both glanceable overview and traceable diagnosis, we design six coordinated views, including a compact glyph that visually encodes word count, interaction intensity, and topic deviation for efficient cross-group comparison and anomaly localization, along with detailed views for opinion evolution, interaction dynamics, topic coverage, and dialogue records. We evaluate MobileGroupVis through two case studies and expert interviews. The results provide preliminary evidence that MobileGroupVis supports teachers in understanding discussion processes, identifying groups in need of attention, and facilitating in-class intervention.

AI.tldr: MobileGroupVis是一个面向课堂小组讨论的移动端可视分析系统，使教师能够在教室内走动时实时监控多个小组、诊断目标小组问题并进行教学干预，通过轻量级流式分析管线和六种协调视图实现。
AI.motivation: 基于小组讨论的教学方式虽被广泛采用，但教师在实体教室中难以同时监控多个小组并及时诊断问题；现有可视分析工具主要支持桌面端的课后分析，缺乏对课堂走动式教学的实时支持。
AI.method: 提出MobileGroupVis移动可视分析系统，包含：1) 轻量级流式分析管线，将小组音频转换为结构化讨论数据；2) 对话分析模块提取交互模式、话题进展和话题偏离；3) 六种协调视图设计（紧凑图示编码词数、交互强度和话题偏离，以及观点演化、交互动态、话题覆盖和对话记录等详细视图），适配小屏幕触控交互。
AI.result: 通过两个案例研究和专家访谈进行评估，初步证据表明MobileGroupVis能够支持教师理解讨论过程、识别需要关注的小组并促进课堂干预。
AI.conclusion: MobileGroupVis填补了移动端实时课堂小组讨论可视分析的空白，验证了移动可视分析在课堂教学场景中的可行性，为后续研究提供了基础。

title: VLZip: Unified Visual and Textual Compression for Interleaved Long-Context Modeling
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) face significant challenges with ultra-long, interleaved image-text sequences due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention. Current solutions either resort to aggressive token pruning, risking irreversible information loss, or adopt efficient but less precise architectures, while largely ignoring the equally vital textual component. We introduce VLZip, a framework that unifies visual and textual compression for high-fidelity reasoning within a pure Transformer. At its core, VLZip hierarchically distills visual and textual segments into compact, layer-specific "soft prefixes" and injects them into each decoder layer's hidden states, drastically shortening the attention sequence while preserving fine-grained global context. To address deficient evaluations in the field, we also introduce LongVLBench, a new benchmark derived from video narratives that demands holistic, narrative-level reasoning. Extensive experiments show VLZip achieves leading performance on long-context multimodal reasoning, enabling training up to 120K tokens, a 6x increase over the baseline, and inference beyond 280K tokens with significantly reduced memory, while demonstrating the memory scalability to handle up to 2M tokens. By excelling at extreme context lengths where existing methods collapse, VLZip establishes an efficient and powerful new standard for long-context multimodal AI. Code is available at https://github.com/ShareLab-SII/VLZip.

AI.tldr: VLZip是一个统一视觉与文本压缩的框架，通过将视觉和文本片段分层蒸馏为层特定的"软前缀"注入各解码器层，在纯Transformer架构中显著缩短注意力序列长度同时保留细粒度全局上下文。作者还引入了LongVLBench基准，在超长多模态推理任务上实现了领先性能，支持120K训练token、280K推理token及2M token的内存扩展能力。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在处理超长图文交错序列时面临自注意力的二次复杂度问题。现有方案要么激进剪枝token导致不可逆信息损失，要么采用高效但不精确的架构，同时普遍忽略了同样关键的文字组件。此外，该领域缺乏能够评估整体叙事级推理能力的基准。
AI.method: VLZip的核心是分层将视觉和文本片段蒸馏为紧凑的、层特定的"软前缀"，并将其注入每个解码器层的隐藏状态中，从而大幅缩短注意力序列同时保留细粒度全局上下文。同时引入LongVLBench基准，该基准源自视频叙事，要求进行整体叙事级推理。
AI.result: VLZip在长上下文多模态推理上取得领先性能，支持120K token的训练（比基线提升6倍），推理可超过280K token且显著降低内存消耗，并展示了处理高达2M token的内存可扩展性。在极端上下文长度下现有方法崩溃的场景中，VLZip表现优异。
AI.conclusion: VLZip通过统一视觉和文本压缩的方式，为长上下文多模态AI建立了一个高效而强大的新标准，在现有方法失效的极端上下文中仍能保持高保真推理能力。

title: Business Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents in a Realistic Marketplace
summary: Running a business is a challenging form of intelligent work. Operators must infer opportunities from partial signals, commit capital under uncertainty, adapt to delayed outcomes in a changing market, and satisfy regulatory obligations before trading legally. Frontier LLM agents can increasingly complete complex workflows, yet business-related capabilities are rarely evaluated in existing agent benchmarks. We introduce \textbf{Business Arena}, a controlled environment where an AI agent runs a cross-border shop, buying from suppliers and selling to buyers over a long horizon. We ground the arena in real Alibaba.com sourcing data and market conditions calibrated from authoritative sources. Delayed and coupled consequences make individual business decisions difficult to judge, but their combined outcome is measurable through profit. Because profit alone cannot explain why an agent succeeds or fails, we compare agents with human-designed strategies to estimate available opportunity, use skill-level metrics to reveal underlying strengths and weaknesses, and trace realized gains and losses to the actions that produced them. We use mechanism ablations to establish that strong results reflect genuine business intelligence rather than neglect or simulator-specific shortcuts. We evaluate 15 frontier models and find a ninefold difference in mean final net worth. Even the best model falls behind human-designed strategies, indicating that business operation remains challenging for LLM agents. Skill-level analysis reveals operating styles, from margin-focused premium sellers to high-turnover wholesalers and customer-service specialists, while action-level attribution identifies the sourcing, pricing, and recovery decisions that create or destroy value. Together, Business Arena takes a first step toward a realistic and trustworthy testbed for evaluating end-to-end business agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Business Arena，一个受控环境基准，用于评估AI智能体运营跨境电商业务的端到端能力。智能体需要从供应商处采购并向买家销售，长期运营。基于真实的Alibaba.com采购数据校准市场条件，通过利润衡量综合表现，并结合技能级指标和行动级归因进行深入分析。评估15个前沿模型发现平均最终净资产差异达9倍，即使最佳模型也落后于人类设计策略，表明商业运营对LLM智能体仍具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准很少评估商业相关能力，而商业运营是复杂的智能工作——需要从不完整信号推断机会、在不确定性下投入资本、适应市场变化和延迟结果、并满足监管合规要求。前沿LLM智能体已能完成复杂工作流，但缺乏针对端到端商业运营能力的可靠评测基准。
AI.method: 构建Business Arena受控环境：智能体运营跨境电商店铺，长期从供应商采购、向买家销售。数据基于真实Alibaba.com采购数据和权威来源校准的市场条件。评估方法包括：与人类设计策略对比估算可用机会、技能级指标揭示优劣势、行动级归因追踪收益来源。使用机制消融确保结果反映真实商业智能而非模拟器捷径。
AI.result: 评估15个前沿模型，发现最终平均净资产存在9倍差异。即使表现最好的模型也落后于人类设计的策略。技能级分析揭示了不同运营风格（利润导向的溢价卖家、高周转批发商、客服专家），行动级归因识别出采购、定价和恢复决策中的价值创造与破坏。
AI.conclusion: Business Arena为端到端商业智能体评估提供了现实且可信的测试环境，首次系统性地揭示了LLM智能体在商业运营方面的能力差距，为未来提升智能体商业决策能力提供了可量化的评估框架。

title: Agentic Visual Reasoning in Whole-Slide Pathology Images via Active Perception
summary: Whole-slide visual reasoning requires identifying sparse diagnostic evidence in gigapixel pathology slides and integrating observations across spatial scales. Existing WSI methods either compress densely sampled patches into global representations or use pretrained vision-language models with heuristic region selection, weakening links between predictions and morphology or lacking pathology-trained observation policies. We present AdaptivePath, an active-perception framework that formulates WSI evidence acquisition as sequential decision making. The Navigator learns question-agnostic abnormality-driven navigation from pathologist-reviewed labels to select observation locations and spatial extents, avoiding costly question-specific trajectory annotations. We train this policy through alternating representation learning and proximal policy optimization, followed by fine-tuning with geometric and appearance consistency objectives to stabilize focus trajectories. During inference, the Navigator hierarchically acquires sparse observations from low to high magnification under a limited ROI budget.
