SymDiag translates natural-language CoT into symbolic constraints and performs step-level satisfiability/entailment checks to (i) localize failing steps and (ii) produce verifiable diagnostic evidence, including counterexamples, inconsistency witnesses, and missing-premise indicators. A central challenge is that apparent ``logic violations'' can be caused either by genuine reasoning defects or by neural-to-symbolic translation noise. SymDiag therefore incorporates a Self-Auditor that disentangles TranslationError from ReasoningError via dual symbolic encodings consistency checks, enabling robust diagnosis under partial observability. Across diverse mathematical, logical, scientific, and general reasoning benchmarks, SymDiag improves detection of unfaithful reasoning and provides substantially more effective feedback for multi-round reasoning repair than outcome-only verification and LLM-based judging, offering a principled foundation for trustworthy and scalable reasoning diagnosis.

AI.tldr: SymDiag 是一个神经符号框架，将推理验证重构为结构化故障诊断：将自然语言思维链（CoT）翻译为符号约束并执行步骤级可满足性/蕴含检查，以定位失败步骤并生成可验证的诊断证据（如反例、不一致性证人、缺失前提指示）。其核心创新是 Self-Auditor 模块，通过双重符号编码一致性检查来区分翻译错误与真实推理错误，从而在部分可观测条件下实现稳健诊断。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型作为数据驱动的推理器时，其思维链即使最终答案正确也可能是不可信的。现有验证信号缺乏诊断力：答案匹配只观察结果，LLM 作为评判者提供主观且不可验证的批评，标量奖励（如 PRM/RM）无法指出多步推导中具体在哪一步失败。因此需要一种能定位失败步骤并提供可验证证据的结构化诊断方法。
AI.method: SymDiag 采用神经符号方法：首先将自然语言 CoT 翻译为符号约束，然后执行步骤级可满足性/蕴含检查来（i）定位失败步骤，并（ii）生成可验证的诊断证据，包括反例、不一致性证人和缺失前提指示。针对"逻辑违规"可能源于真实推理缺陷或神经到符号翻译噪声的挑战，SymDiag 引入 Self-Auditor 模块，通过双重符号编码的一致性检查来分离 TranslationError 与 ReasoningError。
AI.result: 在数学、逻辑、科学和通用推理等多类基准上，SymDiag 相比仅基于结果的验证和 LLM 评判方法，显著提高了不可信推理的检测能力，并为多轮推理修复提供了更有效的反馈。
AI.conclusion: SymDiag 为可信且可扩展的推理诊断提供了原则性基础，表明将推理验证重构为结构化故障诊断能够比现有方法提供更深层、更可验证的推理质量信号。

title: Mismatch Matters: On-Policy Distillation Beyond Token Agreement
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as a core component of modern LLM post-training pipelines, yet we reveal a failure mode: degenerate agreement, where students exploit repetitive loops to achieve near-perfect token agreement with the teacher despite globally flawed responses. We therefore shift our focus from agreement to teacher-student mismatch, and find that mismatch tokens can be mainly categorized into two types: student-excess tokens and student-deficit tokens. Student-excess tokens are generated by the student but assigned near-zero probability by the teacher; their log-ratio corrections grow unbounded and destabilize the update. Student-deficit tokens, in contrast, are preferred by the teacher but rarely sampled by the student; their absence blocks the transfer of the teacher's reasoning patterns. To tackle these mismatch directions, we propose TIDE (Token-level Independent Deficit-Excess correction), which applies bounded Hellinger shaping to suppress the most severe sampled excesses and an analytic teacher top-$K$ injection to restore deficient probability mass without requiring deficit tokens to be sampled. Across mathematical reasoning benchmarks with multiple Qwen3 teacher-student pairs, TIDE consistently outperforms standard OPD and recent token-selection and reward-shaping baselines. Moreover, the gains of TIDE are more pronounced under strong teacher-student mismatch, where it improves Avg@8 from 6.9% to 20.3%, reduces average response length by a factor of 3.6, and substantially reduces formatting failures. Code is available at https://github.com/yzc-666/TIDE

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了on-policy distillation (OPD)中的一个失败模式——"退化的趋同"（degenerate agreement），即学生通过重复循环实现与教师的近似完美token匹配但整体回答有缺陷。作者提出TIDE（Token-level Independent Deficit-Excess correction）方法，通过有界的Hellinger整形抑制学生多余token，并通过解析性的教师top-K注入来恢复学生缺失的token概率质量，在数学推理基准上显著优于标准OPD及相关基线。
AI.motivation: 现有OPD方法过分关注学生与教师之间的token一致性（agreement），但论文发现学生可以通过重复循环"作弊"达到高一致性却产出全局有缺陷的答案。因此需要从"一致性"转向"师生不匹配"（mismatch）视角，重新审视蒸馏过程中的两类关键错误token。
AI.method: 1) 将mismatch tokens分为两类：student-excess tokens（学生生成但教师认为概率接近0的token，其log-ratio修正无界增长导致不稳定）和student-deficit tokens（教师偏好但学生很少采样的token，其缺失阻碍教师推理模式传递）。2) 提出TIDE方法：对有界Hellinger整形来抑制严重采样的excess token；对解析性的教师top-K注入来恢复缺失的概率质量，无需实际采样deficit token。
AI.result: 在多个数学推理基准上，使用多组Qwen3师生对，TIDE一致优于标准OPD、近期token选择方法和奖励整形基线。在强师生不匹配场景下，Avg@8从6.9%提升到20.3%，平均响应长度减少3.6倍，并显著减少格式错误。
AI.conclusion: TIDE通过分别处理两类mismatch token（有界整形抑制excess、解析注入恢复deficit），有效解决了OPD中的退化趋同问题，且在不匹配程度越大时优势越明显，是一种更稳健的蒸馏策略。

title: UPolarSQ: Polar Representation Learning for Optic Disc and Peripapillary Atrophy Segmentation and Quantification in Fundus Photographs
summary: Myopia-induced posterior-pole remodeling is frequently accompanied by Optic Disc (OD) deformation and Peripapillary Atrophy (PPA), both of which provide clinically relevant structural biomarkers. In Cartesian fundus images, however, PPA often appears as an irregular and partially visible crescent adjacent to the OD, leading to fragmented segmentation and post-processing-dependent quantification. We propose UPolarSQ, a unified polar-domain framework for OD/PPA segmentation and biomarker quantification in myopic fundus images. UPolarSQ first maps an OD-centered region of interest into polar coordinates, where OD and PPA boundaries can be represented as radial profiles. It then employs UPolarSeg, a U-Net-based segmentation network enhanced with a Radial-Angular-Decoupled Module and boundary-aware auxiliary supervision to model anisotropic polar features and radial boundary transitions. Clinical biomarkers, including disc shape and PPA-width-related measurements, are deterministically extracted from the predicted polar masks, aligning segmentation and quantification within a shared geometric representation. Experiments on internal and external cohorts demonstrate that UPolarSQ improves OD/PPA segmentation and supports reliable polar-native biomarker estimation for myopic analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UPolarSQ，一个统一的极坐标域框架，用于近视眼眼底图像中视盘（OD）和视盘周围萎缩（PPA）的分割与生物标志物量化。通过将OD中心区域映射到极坐标，利用增强的U-Net网络（UPolarSeg）分割OD/PPA边界，并从中确定性提取盘形和PPA宽度相关临床生物标志物。
AI.motivation: 近视引起的后极重塑常伴随视盘形变和PPA，这些是重要的临床结构生物标志物。然而在笛卡尔坐标系眼底图像中，PPA常呈现不规则且部分可见的新月形，导致分割碎片化和量化依赖后处理，缺乏统一且可靠的框架。
AI.method: 首先将OD中心的感兴趣区域映射到极坐标，使OD和PPA边界可表示为径向轮廓；然后采用UPolarSeg（基于U-Net，增强径向-角度解耦模块和边界感知辅助监督）建模各向异性极坐标特征和径向边界过渡；最后从预测的极坐标掩膜中确定性提取临床生物标志物（包括盘形和PPA宽度相关测量）。
AI.result: 在内外部队列上的实验表明，UPolarSQ改善了OD/PPA分割性能，并支持可靠的极坐标原生生物标志物估计，适用于近视分析。
AI.conclusion: UPolarSQ通过统一的极坐标几何表示将对齐分割与量化，为近视眼底分析提供了更稳健的OD/PPA分割和生物标志物估计方案。

title: Deferred Audio Pruning with Local Audio-Visual Dynamics for Omni-LLMs
summary: Omni-modal LLMs jointly process audio, video, and text, but long multimodal sequences incur substantial prefill and KV-cache costs. Existing omni-modal compression methods primarily focus on pre-LLM token reduction, leaving modality-specific compression across the LLM boundary underexplored. We propose A-PACK, a two-stage framework that defers audio pruning until query-conditioned multimodal interactions emerge. Our analysis shows that audio exhibits higher task-relevant information density and representational diversity per token than video. We further find that local audio-visual dynamics provide a more effective cue for visual selection than token-wise matching. We therefore preserve audio and compress video with local dynamics before the LLM, then progressively prune low-relevance audio and visual tokens and their KV-cache entries inside the LLM. Across four benchmarks on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B/3B, A-PACK achieves the strongest average performance among the evaluated prior methods while reducing prefill FLOPs by up to 78% and improving decoding throughput by up to 2.21x.

AI.tldr: A-PACK是一个两阶段的跨模态压缩框架，针对全模态LLM（如Qwen2.5-Omni）提出在LLM内部而非仅LLM之前进行音频和视频token的渐进式剪枝。实验表明该方法在四个基准上达到最优平均性能，同时将prefill FLOPs降低最多78%，解码吞吐量提升最多2.21倍。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态LLM处理音视频和文本时，长多模态序列导致巨大的prefill和KV-cache开销。已有的压缩方法主要聚焦于LLM之前的token缩减，忽略了跨LLM边界进行模态特定压缩的潜力。作者通过分析发现音频在每个token上具有更高的任务相关信息密度和表征多样性，且局部音视频动态比逐token匹配更适合指导视觉token选择，这启发了新的压缩策略。
AI.method: A-PACK采用两阶段框架：第一阶段（LLM之前）保留音频并利用局部音视频动态线索压缩视频token；第二阶段（LLM内部）逐步剪枝低相关性的音频和视觉token及其对应的KV-cache条目。设计思路是基于音频比视频具有更高的信息密度，以及局部跨模态动态比逐token匹配更有效的发现。
AI.result: 在四个基准上对Qwen2.5-Omni-7B/3B进行评估，A-PACK在既有方法中取得最强平均性能，同时将prefill FLOPs降低最多78%，解码吞吐量提升最多2.21倍。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明跨LLM边界进行模态特定的渐进式压缩是可行的，通过延迟音频剪枝到查询条件多模态交互产生后再进行，可以在保持性能的同时显著减少计算开销。此方法填补了全模态压缩研究中仅关注LLM前token缩减的空白。

title: Agentic Auto-Research is Fuzz Testing
summary: Autonomous research agents can generate experiments faster than researchers can validate them. Researchers have responded by scaling the proposer and ranking more samples with a learned judge or human reviewers. We argue that this *generate-and-rank* paradigm misses the problem of sparse feedback. Within a declared research problem, an agent follows the control loop of a greybox fuzzer: it proposes a candidate, executes it, observes feedback, and chooses what to try next. A fuzzer rarely finds a bug, but coverage makes partial progress observable on every execution. Fuzzers then use that signal to mutate inputs and allocate effort, rather than only to rank completed runs. Auto-research needs the same two capabilities. First, each experiment should expose a cheap, dense signal of epistemic progress before final scientific validation is available. Second, that signal should determine the next intervention so that the agent searches rather than repeatedly samples. Because the optimized progress signal is guidance rather than a verdict, final validation must still decide what counts as a discovery using evidence protected from adaptive reuse. We propose controlled tests of whether candidate signals predict validated progress, whether feedback-directed search yields more validated discoveries per unit cost than repeated sampling, and whether protected validation reduces false discoveries. Feedback architecture, not only generation, is a central bottleneck in auto-research.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地指出自主研究代理系统采用的"生成-排序"范式忽视了稀疏反馈的关键问题，提出应将研究代理视为灰盒模糊测试器，通过廉价密集的信号引导实验搜索方向，同时用受保护的验证机制防止自适应重用导致的虚假发现。
AI.motivation: 当前自主研究代理能快速生成大量实验，但验证成为瓶颈。现有的生成-排序范式（用学习型judge或人工评审对更多样本进行排序）只解决"排名"问题，忽视了实验过程中的稀疏反馈问题——大多数实验无法直接产生最终的科学验证信号，导致代理只是重复采样而非真正搜索。
AI.method: 作者类比灰盒模糊测试器的控制环路（提出候选→执行→观察反馈→选择下一步），提出自动研究需要两种能力：(1) 每个实验在最终科学验证可用之前，应暴露廉价、密集的认知进展信号；(2) 该信号应决定下一步干预，使代理进行搜索而非重复采样。同时提出受保护验证机制，将优化信号视为指导而非判决，防止证据因自适应重用而产生统计偏差。
AI.result: 本文提出三项受控测试：(1) 候选信号是否能预测经过验证的进展；(2) 反馈驱动的搜索是否能比重复采样产生更多经验证的发现（按单位成本计算）；(3) 受保护的验证是否能减少虚假发现。
AI.conclusion: 反馈架构（而非单纯的生成能力）是自动研究中的核心瓶颈。研究代理系统需要从"生成-排名"范式转向"反馈驱动的搜索"范式，将每个实验视为探索步骤而非独立的候选样本。

title: LASA: Language-and-Source-Anchored Alignment for Domain Generalized Semantic Segmentation
summary: Domain Generalization Semantic Segmentation (DGSS) focuses on generalizing knowledge from labeled source domains to unseen target domains where data is unavailable during the training phase. While conventional methods utilize style randomization or feature normalization to mitigate domain shifts, they often impair feature integrity. Specifically, style randomization distorts the underlying feature manifold due to its coarse-grained nature, while feature normalization suppresses discriminative, domain-sensitive semantic details owing to its rigid design. To address these limitations, we propose the Language-and-Source-Anchored Alignment (LASA) framework, which comprises three synergistic components: Text-and-Source-Guided Style Transfer (TSGST), Domain-Aware Query Adapter (DAQA), and Domain-Aware Decoder Optimizer (DADO). Concretely, the TSGST module addresses manifold distortion by utilizing source features as structural anchors and vision-language model (VLM) priors as fine-grained guidance. To restore suppressed discriminative and domain-sensitive details, the DAQA module recalibrates object queries via categorical guidance and domain-aware signatures, while the DADO module aligns the resulting query distributions with a shared classifier to ensure consistent categorical responses across domains. Extensive experiments on challenging benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LASA框架用于域泛化语义分割，通过三个协同组件（TSGST、DAQA、DADO）解决传统方法中风格随机化导致的特征流形扭曲和特征归一化导致的判别性细节抑制问题，在多个基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有DGSS方法（风格随机化和特征归一化）虽能缓解域偏移，但存在固有缺陷：风格随机化因粗粒度特性会扭曲底层特征流形；特征归一化因刚性设计会抑制判别性强且对域敏感的语义细节，从而损害特征完整性。
AI.method: 提出LASA框架，包含三个协同组件：1) TSGST模块利用源域特征作为结构锚点、VLM先验作为细粒度指导，解决流形扭曲问题；2) DAQA模块通过类别指导和域感知签名重新校准对象查询，恢复被抑制的判别性和域敏感细节；3) DADO模块将查询分布与共享分类器对齐，确保跨域类别响应一致性。
AI.result: 在多个挑战性基准上的大量实验表明，该方法显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过语言和源域锚定的对齐策略，LASA框架有效克服了传统DGSS方法在特征流形保持和判别细节保留方面的局限，为域泛化语义分割提供了更优的解决方案。

title: Improving Generalization Robustness of Multimodal RLVR
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) makes Multimodal Large Language Models more accurate, but the gains are brittle: simply paraphrasing a question or changing the prompt template can degrade them, which challenges reliable deployment in high-stakes scenarios like medical VQA. We trace this to two issues of the standard RL objective. First, the binary verifier conflates format with content, so the reward signal cannot tell a wrong answer apart from a misformatted one. Second, the training distribution covers only a thin slice of the real-world prompts that the model might meet at deployment, so policies that perform well on the training distribution can behave differently under unseen prompts during test. Both failures call for a robust post-training method that helps the policy cover a broader distribution of semantically equivalent prompts, and we identify two measures that help achieve this objective: separating format from semantics in the reward, and applying policy invariance across perturbed prompts with equivalent semantics. We therefore propose Prompt-Invariant RLVR (PIRL), consisting of a dynamic trinary reward and a consistency regularizer based on an embedding-space adversary. Under stress testing, PIRL's average accuracy on benchmarks drops by only $\le 1\%$, where GRPO drops ~3%. On dynamic evaluation, PIRL also achieves the smallest performance drop.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Prompt-Invariant RLVR (PIRL)方法，通过动态三值奖励和基于嵌入空间对抗的一致性正则化，解决多模态大语言模型在RLVR训练后面对提示词改写或模板变化时性能脆弱的问题。PIRL在压力测试下平均精度仅下降≤1%，而GRPO下降约3%。
AI.motivation: RLVR能提升多模态大语言模型的准确性，但这种提升很脆弱——改写问题或改变提示模板就会导致性能下降，阻碍了在医疗VQA等高危场景中的可靠部署。作者将此归因于标准RL目标的两个问题：一是二元验证器混淆格式与内容，无法区分错误答案与格式错误；二是训练分布只覆盖真实世界提示的狭窄切片，导致策略在未见提示下表现不一致。
AI.method: PIRL方法包含两个核心组件：1) 动态三值奖励（trinary reward），将格式与语义分离，使奖励信号能区分内容错误和格式错误；2) 基于嵌入空间对抗的一致性正则化器，通过对语义等价的扰动词施加策略不变性，促使策略覆盖更广泛的语义等价提示分布。
AI.result: 在压力测试下，PIRL在基准测试上的平均精度下降仅为≤1%，而GRPO下降约3%。在动态评估中，PIRL也实现了最小的性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为需要鲁棒的后训练方法帮助策略覆盖更广的语义等价提示分布，PIRL通过分离格式与语义的奖励设计以及跨等价扰动词的策略不变性，有效提升了RLVR在未见提示下的鲁棒性，使其更适合高危场景的可靠部署。

title: Towards Expert-level Medical AI for Real-time Video Consultations
summary: Audio-visual interaction is the standard for patient-physician consultations, enabling natural communication and effective assessment of illness through non-verbal cues. While text-based AI has shown promise, it discards essential perceptual dimensions and limits patients who cannot articulate symptoms in writing. Early efforts to extend medical AI to audio-visual interaction have demonstrated feasibility but not reached clinician-level performance. Here, we provide the first demonstration of expert-level AI in real-time clinical video consultations using AMIE (Articulate Medical Intelligence Explorer) in a video configuration. AMIE (Video) is a Gemini-based multi-agent system integrating low-latency dialogue, clinical reasoning, and real-time audio-visual perception. To guide development, we established a taxonomy and automated evaluations for clinical audio-visual cues in telehealth settings. In a randomized Objective Structured Clinical Examination (OSCE) study with 30 primary care physicians (PCPs), 15 patient actors and 100 clinical scenarios, we compared AMIE (Video), its text-only counterpart AMIE (Text), and PCPs consulting via video. Clinical evaluators rated AMIE (Video) on par or better than PCPs in history-taking, diagnosis, management, and physical observation and examination. Patient actors preferred AMIE's approach to assessing and explaining conditions, while PCPs were preferred for rapport and partnership building. In modality ablation, patient actors preferred AMIE (Video)'s interface over text chat for communicative effectiveness, convenience, and feeling understood. Limitations remain in fine anatomical precision, subtle affective nuances, and high-frequency movements. While further research is needed before real-world translation, these results mark an important milestone toward AI systems capable of augmenting care across the sensory complexity of clinical practice.

AI.tldr: 本文首次证明了AI在实时临床视频会诊中达到专家级水平。AMIE (Video)是一个基于Gemini的多智能体系统，结合低延迟对话、临床推理和实时音视频感知能力。在包含30名初级保健医生、15名患者演员和100个临床场景的随机OSCE研究中，AMIE (Video)在病史采集、诊断、管理和体格观察方面与医生相当或更优。患者演员更偏好AMIE的病情评估和解释方式，但医生在建立融洽关系和伙伴关系方面更受青睐。
AI.motivation: 文本AI虽然显示出潜力，但丢弃了重要的感知维度，且限制了无法用文字表达症状的患者。早期音频-视觉医疗AI的尝试虽证明可行性，但未达到临床医生水平。因此需要开发能在临床视频咨询中达到专家水平的AI系统。
AI.method: AMIE (Video)是一个基于Gemini的多智能体系统，整合了低延迟对话、临床推理和实时音视频感知。研究建立了临床音视频线索分类法及自动化评估方法，并进行了随机OSCE研究，比较AMIE (Video)、文本版AMIE和通过视频咨询的初级保健医生（PCPs）在100个临床场景中的表现。
AI.result: 临床评估者认为AMIE (Video)在病史采集、诊断、管理和体格观察与检查方面与PCPs持平或更好。患者演员偏好AMIE的病情评估和解释方式，而PCPs在融洽关系和伙伴关系建立方面更受欢迎。模态消融实验中，患者演员更偏好AMIE (Video)的界面而非文本聊天。局限在于精细解剖精度、微妙情感细微差别和高频运动方面仍有不足。
AI.conclusion: AMIE (Video)首次实现了AI在实时临床视频咨询中达到专家级水平，标志着AI系统向增强临床实践中感官复杂性的护理方向迈出了重要里程碑。但仍需进一步研究才能实现真实世界转化。

title: AdapterMoE: A Two-Stage Hard-Routing Mixture-of-Experts Architecture for Multi-Crop Disease Recognition with Calibrated Rejection and Incremental Learning
summary: Timely crop-disease identification is critical to food security. Multi-crop recognition suits Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), but conventional soft-routing MoE learns crop assignment freely end-to-end, letting a few experts dominate (expert collapse) with no semantic correspondence to crops, and facing high retraining costs, unstable rejection of non-target inputs, and a saturated accuracy ceiling. We shift the objective from accuracy toward a trade-off among deployment cost, scaling flexibility, and rejection stability, using deterministic hard routing. We propose AdapterMoE: a RouterHead classifies the crop and rejects non-target crops via a Maximum Softmax Probability threshold, with a dual-gate Energy+KNN out-of-distribution module catching distribution-shifted inputs; five per-crop Adapters atop a frozen EfficientNet-B0 backbone discriminate diseases, each calibrated via Temperature Scaling. Because experts are hard-isolated at the data level, the design avoids expert collapse and exposes an add_crop interface for local, per-crop updates instead of full retraining. On PlantVillage (5 crops, 26 classes), across a fair five-system comparison, AdapterMoE attains accuracy statistically indistinguishable from the best baselines (Macro-F1 within a 0.24-point band) while cutting training cost to about 9% of full-network baselines, expanding to a new crop in

AI.tldr: 提出AdapterMoE，一种基于确定性硬路由的MoE框架，用于多作物病害识别，通过冻结骨干网络+每作物适配器实现低训练成本、灵活扩展和稳定拒识。
AI.motivation: 传统软路由MoE存在专家坍缩、语义不对应、重训成本高、拒识不稳定和精度瓶颈等问题，需要一种兼顾部署成本、扩展灵活性和拒识稳定性的方案。
AI.method: RouterHead通过最大softmax概率阈值进行分类和拒识；双门控Energy+KNN模块处理分布偏移输入；五个每作物适配器基于冻结的EfficientNet-B0骨干进行病害判别，并用温度缩放校准。由于专家在数据层面硬隔离，避免了专家坍缩并支持add_crop接口进行局部增量更新。
AI.result: 在PlantVillage（5作物26类）上，与最优基线相比Macro-F1仅差0.24个百分点，统计上无显著差异，但训练成本降至全网络基线的约9%，且能扩展至新作物。
AI.conclusion: AdapterMoE在保持高精度的同时显著降低部署成本，提供灵活的作物扩展能力，并保证了拒识稳定性，是一种面向实用农业场景的可扩展MoE方案。

title: Three Generations of Healthcare IT: From the Digital Record to the Computable Care Process
summary: Objective. Healthcare IT is usually organized by the technologies it adopts. We instead organize it by the unit of information a system makes computable, and describe a computational layer whose object is patient-specific clinical intent. Approach. We give criteria for a computational layer, derive three (record, clinical state, and a proposed layer of intent), and formalize the Actionable Clinical Record (ACR) as the atomic object of the third layer. Discussion. The framework distinguishes prescribed, observed, and intended process; existing standards represent intent once it is structured but do not recover it from natural communication, the capability we localize. The ACR is complementary to FHIR workflow resources, guidelines, and process mining; a companion feasibility study illustrates tractability for one narrow subproblem. Conclusion. Computable clinical intent is a coherent research direction; the ACR, its readiness ladder, and an executable-correctness evaluation framework are reusable constructs for subsequent work to extend, evaluate, or falsify.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以"信息单元"而非"技术"来组织医疗IT，定义了一个以患者特定临床意图为对象的计算层，并形式化了可操作临床记录（ACR）作为该层的原子对象。
AI.motivation: 传统医疗IT按所采用的技术来组织，缺乏按系统可计算的信息单元进行组织的统一框架。作者希望将"患者特定的临床意图"提升为可计算的对象，弥补现有标准只能表达已结构化的意图、无法从自然语言交流中恢复意图的空白。
AI.method: 给出计算层的判定标准，推导出三个层次（记录层、临床状态层、以及提议的意图层），并将可操作临床记录（ACR）形式化为第三层的原子对象；同时引入就绪阶梯（readiness ladder）和可执行正确性评估框架。
AI.result: 该框架区分了规定过程、观察过程和意图过程；ACR与FHIR工作流资源、指南和流程挖掘具有互补性；配套可行性研究证明了一个狭窄子问题的可处理性。
AI.conclusion: 可计算的临床意图是一个连贯的研究方向；ACR、其就绪阶梯及可执行正确性评估框架是可复用的构建物，可供后续工作扩展、评估或证伪。

title: Multimodal Model Diffing for Feature Discovery and Control
comment: Preprint. Accepted at ICML 2026 Trustworthy AI for Good Workshop
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) exhibit strong visual understanding, yet the internal features that cause these behaviors remain difficult to identify, audit, or control. While applicable to post-hoc inspection, hidden states that are decomposed into interpretable feature directions using sparse autoencoders (SAEs) neither readily isolate which features are changed by multimodal training, nor are they directly useful for targeted control. We introduce MMDiff, a multimodal model-diffing framework that trains multimodal SAEs and turns them into feature-level interfaces for discovering and controlling multimodal behavior. MMDiff supports three uses: (i) feature isolation, by diffing a base-LM SAE against its multimodal-adapted counterpart to identify features altered by multimodal training; (ii) task-specific feature detection, via per-token contrastive firing analysis that isolates causal features; and (iii) feature-level control, by causally removing or steering the discovered feature directions. We train multimodal SAEs for three MLLM families, LLaVA-MORE, PaliGemma 2, and InternVL3.5, and evaluate on visual-spatial understanding, multimodal safety, and OCR. MMDiff discovers sparse, causally specific features whose removal selectively degrades target behaviors by an average of 12% on spatial tasks and 17% on OCR, and reduces attack success rate by 24% on multimodal safety attacks, with no impact on VQA performance. Steering these features improves spatial and OCR accuracy by +3.6% and +1.8% on average over a standard single-layer steering baseline. These results show that multimodal SAEs can serve not only as interpretability tools, but as mechanisms for auditing, steering, and controlling MLLMs behavior toward safer and more capable generations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MMDiff框架，通过训练多模态稀疏自编码器（SAEs）并将其转化为特征级接口，用于发现和控制多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的行为。支持特征隔离、任务特定特征检测和特征级控制三种用途，并在多个模型和多模态任务上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型虽具备强大的视觉理解能力，但其内部特征难以识别、审计和控制。现有的SAE方法分解的隐状态特征既无法便捷地隔离多模态训练所改变的特征，也难以直接用于目标控制，因此需要一种新的特征级接口来桥接可解释性与可控性。
AI.method: MMDiff框架包含三个核心用途：(i) 特征隔离——通过对比基础语言模型SAE与多模态适配后的SAE，识别被多模态训练改变的特征；(ii) 任务特定特征检测——利用逐token对比激活分析来分离因果特征；(iii) 特征级控制——通过因果性移除或引导已发现的特征方向。在LLaVA-MORE、PaliGemma 2和InternVL3.5三个MLLM家族上训练多模态SAE，并在视觉空间理解、多模态安全和OCR任务上评估。
AI.result: MMDiff发现的特征具有稀疏性和因果特异性：移除这些特征可选择性降低目标行为，在空间任务上平均下降12%、OCR任务上17%，多模态安全攻击成功率降低24%，且不影响VQA性能。引导这些特征相比标准单层引导基线，空间和OCR准确率分别平均提升+3.6%和+1.8%。
AI.conclusion: 多模态SAE不仅可作为可解释性工具，还能作为审计、引导和控制MLLM行为的机制，帮助实现更安全、更能干的多模态生成。

title: 360CityArena: A Realistic Virtual Urban Navigation Benchmark for Embodied Agents
summary: We present 360CityArena, a benchmark for evaluating the urban exploration capabilities of embodied agents within a photorealistic environment constructed from 360-degree videos. Existing outdoor benchmarks either lack sufficient photorealism or complexity, resulting in a considerable gap from real-world urban environments. 360CityArena is built on a realistic reconstruction of the Akihabara district in Tokyo, Japan, using 602 360-degree video segments covering 85 streets, and consists of 175 meticulously human-crafted tasks. It encompasses three task categories: Environment Understanding, Path Reasoning, and Spatial Reasoning, covering fundamental abilities required for urban exploration, such as localization, landmark search, path planning, and relational spatial reasoning, thereby enabling comprehensive evaluation in realistic urban scenes. Our evaluation using state-of-the-art LMM-based agents shows that even the strongest model, Gemini 2.5 Flash, performs far below human level (human: 77.3% vs. Gemini 2.5 Flash: 17.1%), revealing substantial challenges that remain in city-scale embodied navigation and reasoning. 360CityArena provides a necessary and challenging testbed for photorealistic urban-district navigation and spatial reasoning.

AI.tldr: 360CityArena是一个用于评估具身智能体在城市探索能力的基准测试平台，基于东京秋叶原地区602段360度视频构建的逼真环境，包含175个手工设计任务，涵盖环境理解、路径推理和空间推理三大类。实验表明最强模型Gemini 2.5 Flash准确率仅17.1%，远低于人类77.3%，揭示了城市规模具身导航的巨大挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有的户外基准测试要么缺乏足够的逼真度，要么复杂度不足，与真实城市环境存在较大差距，无法有效评估具身智能体在城市环境中的探索能力。
AI.method: 利用602段覆盖85条街道的360度视频，对日本东京秋叶原地区进行逼真重建，构建了包含175个人工设计任务的基准测试，任务分为环境理解、路径推理和空间推理三类，并使用最先进的LMM基础智能体进行评估。
AI.result: 最先进的模型Gemini 2.5 Flash准确率仅17.1%，而人类可达77.3%，两者之间存在巨大差距，表明当前模型在城市规模具身导航和推理方面仍有显著不足。
AI.conclusion: 360CityArena提供了一个必要且具有挑战性的测试平台，用于逼真城市区域导航和空间推理研究，并揭示了现有具身智能体在实际城市环境中的重大局限。

title: MRI super-resolution in ten sampling steps using a diffusion bridge model
summary: Objective. MRI provides excellent soft-tissue contrast, but long acquisition times can cause patient discomfort and lead to motion artifacts, forcing a trade-off between spatial resolution and scan time. Diffusion-based super-resolution (SR) reconstructs high-resolution (HR) images from low-resolution (LR) inputs, but typically needs many sampling steps and initializes from a Gaussian prior ill-suited to image restoration. We developed an efficient diffusion framework that reconstructs HR MRI directly from LR data. Approach. We propose super-resolution diffusion bridge model (SR-DBM), a super-resolution diffusion bridge model that casts SR as a stochastic transport between the LR and HR image distributions. Through a Doob's h-transform of a mean-reverting stochastic differential equation, SR-DBM pins the process to the paired HR and LR images at its endpoints, initializing reconstruction from the measured anatomy rather than from Gaussian noise. The HR image is recovered by a deterministic reverse trajectory in which a network predicts the clean image at each of only ten sampling steps. We evaluated SR-DBM on ultra-high-field 7T brain T1 MP2RAGE maps and pelvic T2-weighted prostate images against nine comparison methods using PSNR, SSIM, GMSD, and LPIPS. Main results. SR-DBM attained the highest PSNR and SSIM and the lowest GMSD on both datasets (brain: 27.66+-1.52 dB, 0.96+-0.02, 7.96+-1.86$; prostate: 27.87+-2.29 dB, 0.80+-0.05, 8.38+- 1.44), with statistically significant gains over every comparison method (two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test with Holm correction, p<0.05). The strongest baseline, SR-EMamba, ranked second. Qualitatively, SR-DBM produced the smallest residual errors and best preserved fine structures and lesions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SR-DBM，一种基于扩散桥模型的MRI超分辨率重建方法。与传统的从高斯噪声初始化的扩散模型不同，SR-DBM通过Doob's h变换将随机微分方程的两端分别锚定在低分辨率和高分辨率图像上，从真实解剖结构而非噪声出发进行重建，仅需十步采样即可获得高分辨率MRI图像。在7T脑部T1 MP2RAGE和盆腔前列腺T2加权图像上，该方法在PSNR、SSIM、GMSD、LPIPS四个指标上均优于九种对比方法。
AI.motivation: MRI采集时间长会导致患者不适和运动伪影，在空间分辨率和扫描时间之间存在权衡。现有基于扩散模型的超分辨率方法需要大量采样步骤，且从高斯先验初始化，这种先验不适合图像恢复任务，因此需要一种更高效、更适合图像复原的扩散框架。
AI.method: 将超分辨率重建建模为低分辨率和高分辨率图像分布之间的随机传输问题。通过Doob's h变换构造均值回归随机微分方程，使过程的两个端点分别锚定在配对的HR和LR图像上，从而从真实测量的解剖结构而非高斯噪声初始化重建。HR图像通过确定性反向轨迹恢复，网络在每个仅十步的采样步中预测干净图像。
AI.result: 在7T脑部T1 MP2RAGE和前列腺T2加权图像两个数据集上，SR-DBM在PSNR和SSIM上取得最高值、在GMSD上取得最低值（脑部：27.66±1.52 dB，0.96±0.02，7.96±1.86；前列腺：27.87±2.29 dB，0.80±0.05，8.38±1.44），且相对于所有对比方法均有统计学显著提升（双侧Wilcoxon符号秩检验，Holm校正，p<0.05）。最强的基线方法SR-EMamba排名第二。定性上，SR-DBM产生最小的残差误差，最佳地保留精细结构和病灶。
AI.conclusion: SR-DBM通过将扩散桥技术与MRI超分辨率相结合，解决了传统扩散SR方法需要大量采样步骤和从高斯噪声初始化的问题。该方法在保持高质量重建的同时大幅减少了采样步骤，并在多个评估指标上全面超越现有方法，为MRI超分辨率提供了一种高效且有效的解决方案。

title: PROSLEX: A Novel Dataset for Expert-Annotated Legal Statute Prediction for Indian Judiciary
summary: Legal Statute Prediction (LSP) involves automatically identifying relevant legal statutes given factual descriptions in legal documents, typically framed as a multi-label classification task within natural language processing and information retrieval research. While recent advances have begun incorporating Large Language Models (LLMs) for statute prediction, current approaches primarily focus on accuracy metrics without addressing the critical need for legal reasoning, a fundamental requirement in judicial contexts where decisions must be explainable and justifiable. To address this research gap, we present PROSLEX (PRediction Of Statutes and LEgal eXplanation), a comprehensive dataset comprising 1,623 expert-annotated legal documents from the Indian context. Each document is paired with statute predictions and detailed explanations, totaling 7,450 explanations, capturing the underlying legal reasoning. Using this dataset, we systematically evaluate various prompting strategies, including zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, and tree-of-thoughts approaches, to generate both statute predictions and their corresponding legal rationales. Our evaluation framework measures not only predictive performance but also the coherence and legal validity of generated explanations, positioning PROSLEX as a benchmark for developing explainable AI systems that can support legal practitioners while advancing research in interpretable legal NLP. To ensure reproducibility, we have made our PROSLEX dataset and model code available on GitHub: https://github.com/subinay494/Legal_Statute_Prediction_Explanation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PROSLEX数据集，包含1,623份来自印度法律背景的人工标注文件，每个文件配有条文预测和详细解释（共7,450条解释），用于法律条文预测（LSP）及法律推理生成任务。研究系统评估了零样本、少样本、思维链和思维树等多种提示策略，不仅衡量预测准确性，还评估生成解释的连贯性和法律有效性，旨在推动可解释AI在法律领域的应用。
AI.motivation: 现有法律条文预测研究主要使用大语言模型（LLMs）并专注于准确率指标，但忽略了法律推理这一司法场景中的核心需求——决策必须可解释、可辩护。现有研究缺乏将条文预测与法律解释结合的数据集和评估框架，存在明显的研究空白。
AI.method: 构建包含1,623份印度法律文件、7,450条专家标注解释的PROSLEX数据集；系统评估多种提示策略（零样本、少样本、思维链、思维树）来生成条文预测及法律推理；评估框架同时衡量预测性能和解释的连贯性与法律有效性。
AI.result: 通过PROSLEX基准数据集，系统比较了不同提示策略在条文预测和法律解释生成方面的表现；提供了可复现的代码和数据集，为可解释法律NLP研究建立了基准。
AI.conclusion: PROSLEX填补了法律条文预测领域缺乏法律推理解释基准的空白，为推动可解释AI系统在法律实践中的支持作用奠定了基础，同时为可解释法律NLP研究提供了开放资源。

title: LogiShot: Logically Coherent Cross-Shot Video Generation
summary: Generating cross-shot videos that are logically connected is essential for content creation. Currently, most cross-shot video-generation workflows, such as short-drama production, still rely on isolated textual scripts or explicit reference images to specify the generated content. Consequently, when user instructions are underspecified or ambiguous, a generated clip may appear visually plausible on its own but fail to align with the overall narrative, leading to disjointed content. We argue that achieving cross-shot logical coherence in video generation requires establishing logical connections across shots and maintaining visual consistency. To this end, we propose LogiShot, which incorporates information through two complementary paths: 1) LogiShot jointly encodes the context video and other conditioning signals, yielding dense multimodal cues that provide visual-semantic evidence for cross-shot generation; 2) the model maintains a visual memory of the context video throughout generation to preserve visual consistency across shots. Additionally, we construct a dataset with 110K samples and a dedicated benchmark for evaluating cross-shot logical coherence. Experiments demonstrate that LogiShot consistently outperforms existing baselines in terms of logical coherence across multiple shots. Model and data will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: LogiShot是一种用于跨镜头视频生成的框架，通过联合编码上下文视频和其他条件信号以提供多模态线索，并在生成过程中维护视觉记忆以确保跨镜头的一致性。作者构建了110K样本的数据集和专门基准，实验证明其在逻辑连贯性方面优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有跨镜头视频生成方法依赖孤立的文本脚本或显式参考图像来指定内容，当用户指令不明确或模糊时，生成的片段虽然在视觉上合理但可能与整体叙事不连贯，导致内容脱节。作者认为实现跨镜头逻辑连贯需要建立镜头间的逻辑连接并保持视觉一致性。
AI.method: LogiShot通过两条互补路径整合信息：1) 联合编码上下文视频和其他条件信号，产生密集的多模态线索，为跨镜头生成提供视觉-语义证据；2) 在生成过程中维护上下文视频的视觉记忆以保持跨镜头的视觉一致性。同时构建了包含110K样本的数据集和专门评估跨镜头逻辑连贯性的基准。
AI.result: 实验表明LogiShot在多个镜头间的逻辑连贯性方面持续优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: LogiShot证明了结合多模态上下文编码与视觉记忆机制可以有效提升跨镜头视频生成的逻辑连贯性，模型和数据将公开发布以供进一步研究。

title: Findings of the First Teaching Monster Challenge: A Benchmark of Pedagogical Content Knowledge in AI Agents
summary: AI agents can now solve problems, answer like subject experts, and generate long-form multimodal content. However, whether they can adapt a lesson to fit a specified learner, which education calls Pedagogical Content Knowledge (PCK), has not been benchmarked. To measure it, we introduce the Teaching Monster Challenge, the first instructional video generation benchmark to treat the learner persona as an explicit evaluation criterion. Each system is given a topic and a learner persona and must generate a complete instructional video. Every video is screened by an LLM-judge, ranked by crowd pairwise voting, and finalized by an expert panel. The first edition shows that today's systems handle the content well but are far weaker at presenting it and adapting it to the learner. The same process exposes a limit of automatic judging. The LLM-judge separates a clear low-performing tail but ranks the strongest systems poorly. The strongest systems receive nearly identical scores from the judge, so its ranking of them does not match human preference. Progress therefore requires not only better teaching systems but also better automatic judges, and we release the benchmark, rubric, and human judgments as a testbed for both.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Teaching Monster Challenge"，这是第一个将学习者画像作为显式评估标准的教学视频生成基准。通过LLM评委、人群配对投票和专家小组三重评估，发现现有系统在内容生成上表现良好，但在教学呈现和适应性调整上明显不足，同时揭示了自动评委在区分顶级系统时的局限性。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI代理已能解决问题、像专家一样回答并生成多模态长内容，但能否根据指定学习者调整教学（即教育领域的教学内容知识PCK）尚未被基准化评估。作者旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 每个系统被给予一个主题和学习者画像，需生成完整的教学视频。评估流程分三步：LLM评委筛选、人群配对投票排序、专家小组最终审定。基准包含评分标准、人类判断及完整数据集。
AI.result: 第一版结果显示：现有系统在教学内容上处理良好，但在呈现方式和学习者适应性上明显薄弱。同时暴露了自动评判的局限——LLM评委能分离出明显低性能的系统，但对最强系统给出的分数几乎相同，其排名与人类偏好不一致。
AI.conclusion: 进步不仅需要更好的教学系统，也需要更好的自动评委。作者公开了基准、评分标准和人类判断，作为两者共同发展的测试平台。

title: Visual Token Codec: Unleashing Spatial Redundancy for ViT Feature Coding
summary: Distributed deployment of large vision foundation models often partitions a ViT backbone and exchanges intermediate token features between computing nodes, making efficient feature compression critical under bandwidth and computation constraints. Existing ViT feature codecs typically flatten heterogeneous global and patch tokens into an L x C pseudo image, causing entropy models to mainly capture sequence-axis dependencies while overlooking the native two-dimensional patch-grid structure. In this paper, we show that ViT patch tokens retain strong local spatial correlations on the original grid. To exploit this structural prior, we propose the Visual Token Codec (VTC), a dual-path learned codec that separates global and patch tokens into dedicated coding paths. Global tokens are compressed with a lightweight factorized prior, whereas patch tokens are encoded on the patch-token grid using a spatial-channel context entropy model. To support intermediate-layer compression and practical rate adaptation, VTC further incorporates feature-matching supervision after subsequent ViT blocks and variable-rate modules within a single codec. Experiments on DINOv2 and SAM3 show that VTC consistently outperforms representative ViT feature coding baselines on classification, segmentation, and detection tasks. At 90% of uncompressed-feature performance, VTC reduces bitrate by 15.7x-37.4x across these tasks. We further provide intermediate-layer rate-utility analyses for practical transmission- and storage-oriented deployment scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VTC（Visual Token Codec），一种双路径学习的ViT特征编码器，将全局token和patch token分开编码，利用patch token在原始网格上的空间相关性设计空间-通道上下文熵模型，在压缩率与下游任务性能之间取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的ViT特征编解码器通常将异构的全局token和patch token扁平化成L×C伪图像，导致熵模型主要捕获序列轴依赖而忽视了patch token在原生二维网格上的结构信息。作者观察到ViT patch token在原始网格上保留强局部空间相关性，因此需要利用这一结构先验来提升压缩效率。
AI.method: VTC采用双路径架构：全局token用轻量级因子化先验压缩；patch token在patch-token网格上用空间-通道上下文熵模型编码。同时引入后续ViT块的特征匹配监督以支持中间层压缩，并集成可变速率模块实现单一编解码器内的码率自适应。
AI.result: 在DINOv2和SAM3上的实验表明，VTC在分类、分割和检测任务上一致优于代表性ViT特征编码基线。在达到未压缩特征性能的90%时，VTC跨任务将码率降低15.7倍至37.4倍。
AI.conclusion: VTC通过利用patch token的二维网格空间结构先验，显著提升了ViT特征的压缩效率，并提供了中间层率-效用分析以支持实际传输和存储部署场景。

title: SLAP: Selective Local Vision-Language Alignment for Fish Re-Identification via Partial Optimal Transport
comment: This is the author version prior to incorporating the camera-ready comments. The final version will be included in the Proceedings of the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
summary: Individual fish re-identification (ReID) is a fine-grained recognition problem in which identity-discriminative cues are often localized to specific body regions rather than distributed uniformly across the animal. Nevertheless, recent CLIP-based ReID methods rely predominantly on global image-text alignment, allowing background and weakly discriminative regions to contribute to cross-modal supervision. We propose a selective local vision-language alignment framework that establishes localized correspondences between visual patch embeddings and multiple identity-aware prompt embeddings through Partial Optimal Transport (POT). Rather than enforcing exhaustive correspondence, POT enables selective matching between visual patches and prompt embeddings, allowing the model to emphasize the strongest cross-modal correspondences while avoiding forced alignment of weakly matching regions, thereby yielding more discriminative visual representations for retrieval. The framework is trained end-to-end, while only the adapted visual encoder is retained during inference. Experiments on the longitudinal Symphodus melops dataset demonstrate consistent improvements over recent CLIP-based ReID methods under both closed-set and open-set evaluation protocols. Additional evaluations on other datasets further demonstrate the generalization capability of the proposed method across diverse marine ReID benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种选择性局部视觉-语言对齐框架，通过部分最优传输（POT）实现鱼类个体重识别，避免全局对齐带来的背景干扰。
AI.motivation: 现有基于CLIP的鱼类个体重识别方法依赖全局图像-文本对齐，使得背景和弱判别区域也参与跨模态监督，影响识别精度。而鱼类个体身份判别线索往往集中在特定身体区域而非均匀分布。
AI.method: 提出选择性局部视觉-语言对齐框架，通过部分最优传输（POT）建立视觉patch嵌入与多个身份感知prompt嵌入之间的局部对应关系。POT允许选择性匹配最强的跨模态对应，避免弱匹配区域的强制对齐，模型端到端训练，推理时仅保留适配后的视觉编码器。
AI.result: 在纵向Symphodus melops数据集上，闭集和开集评估协议下均一致优于近期基于CLIP的重识别方法；在其他数据集上的额外评估也验证了该方法在多种海洋重识别基准上的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过POT实现的选择性局部对齐能有效抑制背景和弱判别区域的干扰，生成更具判别力的视觉表示，提升鱼类个体重识别性能，并具有良好的跨数据集泛化能力。

title: AquiLLM: An Architecture for Supporting Tacit Knowledge Capture in Research Groups
comment: Accepted for publication in the NGEN-AI 2026 proceedings
summary: Recent advances in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and large language models (LLMs) enable researchers to integrate AI into scientific workflows. However, using proprietary commercial AI systems raises concerns about transparency, reproducibility and privacy, which are essential for scientific practices. To this end, AquiLLM was developed as an open-source modular RAG-LLM framework using open-weight models, designed to support research groups in capturing tacit knowledge. In this work, we present a series of architectural improvements and feature enhancements to AquiLLM, including local embedding and reranking, multimodal capabilities, OpenAI-compatible inference interfaces, user interface improvements, semantic and episodic memory capabilities, and skills support. These enhancements were informed by discussions with domain experts, including astrophysicists and environmental researchers, and represent a step toward AI systems more closely aligned with scientific research practices.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了AquiLLM——一个开源模块化的RAG-LLM框架，使用开放权重模型支持科研团队捕获隐性知识，并提出了一系列架构改进和功能增强，包括本地嵌入与重排序、多模态能力、OpenAI兼容推理接口、语义与情景记忆以及技能支持等。
AI.motivation: 商业专有AI系统在科学研究中引发透明度、可复现性和隐私方面的担忧，而这些是科学实践的核心要求。因此需要开发开源、基于开放权重模型的AI框架，以更好地贴合科研工作流程。
AI.method: 基于AquiLLM框架进行模块化架构改进，新增本地嵌入和重排序、多模态能力、OpenAI兼容推理接口、用户界面优化、语义与情景记忆，以及技能支持；改进过程中与天体物理学家和环境研究者等领域专家进行了讨论。
AI.result: 通过一系列架构和功能增强，使AquiLLM更贴近科研实践需求，朝着与科学研究实践更紧密结合的AI系统方向迈进。
AI.conclusion: 开源、开放权重的模块化RAG-LLM框架能够有效支持科研团队捕获隐性知识，是替代商业专有AI系统的可行方案，未来有望更深入地融入科研工作流程。

title: Toward Mask Annotation-Free Surgical Instrument Segmentation from Endoscopic Images Using Text-Prompted Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3)
comment: Accepted at the Medical Image Understanding and Analysis (MIUA)
summary: Surgical instrument segmentation is a fundamental task for computer-assisted interventions, yet most existing methods rely on pixel-level annotations or manual spatial prompts, which limit scalability and automation. The recently introduced Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) offers a pathway to annotation-free, automatic segmentation via text-based prompting; however, the instrument name as a text prompt could not be directly used due to a large domain gap. To overcome these limitations, we propose a two-stage framework that achieves instance-level segmentation without requiring ground truth masks or manual interaction. In the first stage, we leverage a natural-language-aligned generic prompt - "tool" - to produce binary masks using SAM3's zero-shot capability. In the second stage, these masks are extended to instance-level by integrating a vision-language model (Qwen) that is fine-tuned on SAM3-generated masked regions for instrument classification. We evaluate our approach on the EndoVis 2017 and 2018 datasets. Results show that, while our two-stage approach does not reach the performance of current fully supervised methods, it significantly outperforms the direct use of SAM3 for instance-level instrument segmentation with text prompts. Overall, our findings highlight both the limitations and potential of SAM3, suggesting a promising direction toward annotation-free surgical instrument segmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个两阶段框架，利用SAM3的零样本文本提示能力和视觉语言模型（Qwen），实现无需像素级标注和人工交互的手术器械实例分割。第一阶段用通用提示词"tool"生成二值掩膜，第二阶段通过微调的Qwen进行分类得到实例级分割，在EndoVis 2017和2018数据集上验证了效果。
AI.motivation: 现有手术器械分割方法依赖像素级标注或人工空间提示，难以扩展和自动化。虽然SAM3支持文本提示的自动分割，但由于领域差异，直接用器械名称作为文本提示效果不佳。因此需要探索无需标注、无需人工交互的自动化分割方案。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段利用SAM3的零样本能力，使用自然语言对齐的通用提示词"tool"生成二值分割掩膜；第二阶段将二值掩膜扩展到实例级，通过微调视觉语言模型Qwen对SAM3生成的掩膜区域进行器械分类。
AI.result: 在EndoVis 2017和2018数据集上，两阶段方法虽未达到全监督方法的性能，但显著优于直接使用SAM3配合文本提示进行实例级器械分割的效果。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了SAM3在手术器械分割中的局限性和潜力，为无标注手术器械实例分割提供了有前景的方向。

title: Full-bandwidth transformer
summary: Autoregressive transformers compute along two axes: horizontally across generated tokens, and vertically through model depth. Dense attention gives each token broad horizontal access to the past, but the vertical feedback channel between decoding steps remains narrow: only the sampled token returns to the bottom of the stack, while the top-layer hidden state is discarded. We introduce the \emph{full-bandwidth transformer}, which widens this channel with \emph{latent feedback}: at each decoding step, the previous top-layer hidden state is fused with the sampled token embedding through a gated linear unit and fed back as the next input. Latent feedback lets non-verbalized computation re-enter the stack with a renewed depth budget, while preserving the standard transformer architecture, KV cache, and language-modeling objective. To train full-bandwidth transformers without losing parallel teacher forcing, we use a scheduled multi-pass objective that introduces latent feedback late in pretraining and mixes a small fraction of deeper feedback passes for stability. We train 1B-parameter full-bandwidth transformers up to 400B tokens and find that latent feedback improves validation loss, 5-shot language-model evaluation, math and coding generation, and instruction-tuned performance. With negligible per-token decoding overhead, full-bandwidth transformers match or approach standard transformers trained with roughly $1.5\times$ more tokens, and manage to produce shorter reasoning traces at equal or better accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"全带宽Transformer"（full-bandwidth transformer），通过潜在反馈（latent feedback）机制，在解码每一步将上一层的隐藏状态与采样token嵌入通过门控线性单元融合后作为下一输入反馈回堆栈，拓宽了标准Transformer中仅采样token返回底部的狭窄垂直反馈通道。该工作在1B参数、400B token规模上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 标准自回归Transformer在水平和垂直两个轴上计算，但垂直反馈通道非常狭窄：解码时仅采样token返回栈底，而顶层隐藏状态被丢弃。这意味着非语言化的计算状态无法在下一步继续参与生成，造成计算资源的浪费，限制了模型的深度表达能力。
AI.method: 提出latent feedback机制：在每个解码步骤，将前一步的顶层隐藏状态与当前采样token的嵌入通过门控线性单元（GLU）融合，作为下一步的输入反馈回堆栈。该方法保持了标准Transformer架构、KV缓存和语言建模目标不变。为满足并行teacher forcing训练，采用"调度多遍目标"（scheduled multi-pass objective）：在预训练后期引入潜在反馈，并混合少量更深的反馈通道以保证训练稳定性。
AI.result: 在1B参数、最高400B token的训练规模下，潜在反馈改善了验证损失、5-shot语言模型评估、数学和代码生成以及指令微调性能。在每token解码开销可忽略不计的情况下，全带宽Transformer能达到或接近用约1.5倍token训练的标准Transformer的性能，并且在等精度下生成更短的推理轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 通过拓宽解码步骤之间的垂直反馈通道，全带宽Transformer证明了让非语言化计算状态重新进入模型堆栈的价值。该方法在几乎不增加计算开销的前提下提升性能，为自回归语言模型的架构设计和训练策略提供了新的方向。

title: Zero-Shot Traffic Accident Detection via a Coarse-to-Fine VLM-Tracking Pipeline
comment: Accepted at the AUTOPILOT Workshop, CVPR 2026, Denver, CO
summary: Traffic surveillance cameras capture accidents continuously, yet converting raw CCTV footage into structured event records that pinpoint when, where, and what type of collision occurred remains unsolved at scale. The ACCIDENT @ CVPR benchmark evaluates exactly this joint prediction under a strict constraint: no labeled real-world training data is available. We introduce a training-free, two-pass coarse-to-fine pipeline that pairs a frozen Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct vision-language model with YOLO11x object detection and BoT-SORT tracking. A first pass sparsely samples the full clip to anchor the collision moment in time; a second pass re-examines a tight window around that estimate using frames annotated with stable vehicle identities and normalized bounding-box coordinates, which gives the model both a visual overlay and an explicit numeric description of the same scene. On the official 2,027-clip real-CCTV test set, our system achieves a three-way harmonic mean score of 0.504, surpassing all organizer-published baselines including the best multi-model ensemble (0.412) by a 22% relative margin.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练的、两阶段"由粗到细"的事故检测流水线，结合冻结的Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct视觉语言模型、YOLO11x目标检测和BoT-SORT跟踪，在ACCIDENT@CVPR基准上实现了0.504的三元谐波均值得分，超越所有组织者发布的基线（包括最佳多模型集成0.412），相对提升22%。
AI.motivation: 将原始CCTV监控视频转化为结构化的事故事件记录（何时、何地、何种碰撞类型）在大规模场景下尚未解决，且ACCIDENT@CVPR基准要求在无标注真实训练数据的严格约束下进行联合预测，这构成了核心挑战。
AI.method: 提出一个双通道"由粗到细"流水线：第一遍对整段视频稀疏采样以粗略定位碰撞发生的时刻；第二遍在tight时间窗口内使用带有稳定车辆身份和归一化边界框坐标的帧进行精细复查，同时向视觉语言模型提供视觉叠加层和显式数值描述。
AI.result: 在官方2,027段真实CCTV测试集上达到0.504的三元谐波均值，比最佳多模型集成基线（0.412）相对提升22%。
AI.conclusion: 训练无关的视觉语言模型结合目标检测与跟踪的组合方案，能够在无标注真实数据条件下，有效完成CCTV事故检测的时间定位、空间定位和分类联合任务。

title: LLM Reasoning for Subjective Tasks: Failure Modes, Mitigation, and Dynamic Reasoning Routing
summary: Recommendation systems thrive on personalization, where ''correctness'' is rarely a binary truth but a matter of subjective human preference. As Large Language Models (LLMs) are deployed as autonomous verifiers of safety and quality guidelines, they face a distinctive challenge: context-aware preference alignment. Recent gains in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) are indexed mostly on objective, mathematical tasks. Through a large-scale study spanning both proprietary and open-source models on four real-world verification tasks from a production recommender platform, we ask whether explicit reasoning generalizes to subjective, human-centric industry rubrics. We expose a fundamental vulnerability: rigid, math-centric reasoning traces actively degrade verification, and applying standard RLVR triggers a phenomenon we term reasoning collapse, in which the policy abandons deliberation in favor of rapid heuristic guessing. We introduce a conditional length-penalized post-training algorithm that intertwines verification accuracy with bounded reasoning length, halting collapse and recovering performance. Finally, we show that a reasoning trace's efficacy is tightly coupled with its socio-linguistic framing: across 1500 synthesized personas, verification accuracy swings by nearly 0.38 macro-F1 depending solely on the adopted reasoning persona---evidence that much subjective-verification error is really reasoning-style mismatch. This observation motivates a mid-training architecture that routes reasoning through contextually aligned personas. This work offers both a scalable algorithmic patch and a long-term architectural blueprint for aligning reasoning models with real-world subjective constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM在主观、以人为本的推荐系统验证任务中进行偏好对齐的挑战。研究发现传统基于数学推理的RLVR方法在主观验证中会导致"推理崩溃"，并提出了一种带条件长度惩罚的后训练算法来恢复性能。此外，研究发现推理轨迹的效果与社交语言框架（persona）紧密相关，验证准确率可因推理persona不同波动近0.38 macro-F1，进而提出一种通过上下文对齐persona进行推理路由的中期训练架构。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统的个性化本质决定了"正确性"不是二元真值而是主观的人类偏好。随着LLM被部署为安全与质量指南的自主验证器，它们面临上下文感知偏好对齐的独特挑战。现有RLVR的进展主要基于客观数学任务，本文旨在探究显式推理是否能泛化到主观、人本主义的行业验证标准。
AI.method: 1) 在四个来自生产推荐平台的真实世界验证任务上进行大规模实验，涵盖专有和开源模型；2) 提出一种条件长度惩罚的后训练算法，将验证准确性与有界推理长度交织在一起；3) 通过1500个合成persona来系统化地研究推理轨迹的社交语言框架对验证准确率的影响；4) 提出一种中期训练架构，将推理路由至上下文对齐的persona。
AI.result: 研究发现：刚性、数学中心的推理轨迹会主动降低验证性能；标准RLVR会导致"推理崩溃"现象（策略放弃深思熟虑转而快速启发式猜测）；所提出的条件长度惩罚算法能阻止崩溃并恢复性能；推理persona的社交语言框架可导致验证准确率产生近0.38 macro-F1的波动，即大部分主观验证错误实际上是推理风格不匹配。
AI.conclusion: 本文既提供了可扩展的算法补丁，也为将推理模型与真实世界主观约束对齐提供了长期架构蓝图。核心洞见是主观验证中的错误往往源于推理风格与上下文的不匹配，而非推理能力本身的不足。

title: Sparse Attention to Emotion: Efficient Facial Emotion Recognition via Token Reduction
summary: Facial Emotion Recognition (FER) is an important task that has significant implications across various fields such as biometrics, health, and human-computer interaction. Current Vision Transformer-based approaches display quadratic complexity $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$, with N being the input sequence length, making them cumbersome to deploy at the edge. In this paper, we hypothesize that the FER task does not necessarily require all facial information to correctly interpret emotional states, as specific regions such as the eyes, the mouth, and parts of the cheeks carry discriminative information that can be sufficient to recognize emotions. Based on this, we propose Sparse Attention to Emotion (SAE), a model that discards image tokens that have no added value to the emotional context, while preserving good accuracy and achieving a significant gain in computational cost. Surprisingly, even after suppressing 90\% of the image tokens, our model achieves competitive accuracy to state of the art methods at much lower cost, providing a lightweight Facial Emotion Recognition approach. Experimental results demonstrate that SAE achieves new state of the art results on the RAF-DB dataset while reducing the computational complexity by up to 90\%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAE（Sparse Attention to Emotion）模型，通过丢弃对情绪识别无价值的图像token，在保持竞争力的同时将计算复杂度降低高达90%，并在RAF-DB数据集上达到新的最先进水平。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Vision Transformer的FER方法具有O(N²)的二次复杂度，难以在边缘设备上部署。作者假设FER任务不需要全部面部信息，眼睛、嘴巴和部分脸颊区域即可提供足够的判别性信息来完成情绪识别。
AI.method: 提出SAE模型，采用稀疏注意力机制，主动丢弃对情绪上下文无附加价值的图像token，保留具有判别性的面部关键区域（眼睛、嘴巴、脸颊等），从而在保持精度的同时大幅降低计算成本。
AI.result: 即使抑制90%的图像token，模型仍能达到与最先进方法相当的精度。在RAF-DB数据集上取得新的最先进结果，同时将计算复杂度降低高达90%。
AI.conclusion: 证明了稀疏注意力在FER任务中的有效性——面部情绪识别并不需要完整的面部信息，通过选择性关注关键区域可以在大幅降低计算成本的同时保持甚至提升识别精度，为边缘设备上的轻量化FER提供了可行方案。

title: From Manuals to Maintenance: Fine-Tuning MedGemma for Multi-Modal Imaging System Support in Low-Resource Settings
comment: Accepted at the AFRICAI 2026 Workshop, a satellite event at MICCAI 2026. To appear in Springer Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNCS)
summary: Imaging device downtime is a major barrier to healthcare delivery in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), often driven by limited access to specialized biomedical engineering support. We present a multi-modality medical equipment maintenance question-answering (QA) framework and demonstrate the fine-tuning of a medical foundation model for specialized technical troubleshooting tasks. Guided by a multi-country survey across nine LMICs, we curated technical manuals from MRI and ultrasound systems to generate the INGENZI_DatasetV1, containing 10,294 high-quality, filtered QA-context pairs. Using QLoRA-based parameter-efficient fine-tuning, we adapted the MedGemma-4b-it model to interpret system error logs and generate step-by-step equipment repair instructions. Compared to the baseline model, the fine-tuned system achieved substantial improvements across metrics, including F1 score (0.22 to 0.38), ROUGE-2 (0.18 to 0.41), and BERTScore F1 (0.86 to 0.91). These metric gains demonstrate that the model generates significantly more precise and procedurally accurate technical responses to new troubleshooting queries. This work establishes a reliable foundation for AI-assisted diagnostic and maintenance tools in resource-constrained settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个多模态医疗设备维护问答框架，通过微调医学基础模型（MedGemma-4b-it）来实现低中收入国家（LMICs）医疗影像设备（MRI和超声）的故障诊断和维修指导。作者基于九个LMICs的多国调查，构建了包含10,294个高质量QA上下文对的INGENZI_DatasetV1数据集，并使用QLoRA参数高效微调技术训练模型。实验结果表明，微调后的模型在F1、ROUGE-2和BERTScore等指标上均有显著提升，为资源受限环境下的AI辅助诊断和维护工具奠定了基础。
AI.motivation: 低中收入国家（LMICs）的医疗影像设备频繁停机是医疗服务的主要障碍，根本原因在于缺乏专业的生物医学工程支持。这一问题严重影响了这些地区的医疗可及性，迫切需要一种AI辅助的维护和故障诊断方案来解决专业人才短缺的困境。
AI.method: 该研究采用多步骤方法论：（1）在九个LMICs开展多国调查以了解实际维护需求；（2）从MRI和超声系统收集技术手册，构建包含10,294个QA上下文对的INGENZI_DatasetV1数据集；（3）使用QLoRA参数高效微调技术，将MedGemma-4b-it医学基础模型适配到设备故障诊断和维修指导任务上，使其能够解析系统错误日志并生成逐步维修指令。
AI.result: 与基线模型相比，微调后的系统在多个评估指标上取得显著改进：F1分数从0.22提升至0.38，ROUGE-2从0.18提升至0.41，BERTScore F1从0.86提升至0.91。这些提升表明模型能生成更精确、程序上更准确的技术响应。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为资源受限环境中AI辅助的医疗设备诊断和维护工具建立了可靠基础，证明通过精心构建的专业数据集和参数高效微调，医学基础模型可以有效胜任专业化的技术故障排查任务，有望显著改善LMICs地区的设备维护能力。

title: AeroReformer2: Spoken-Query Referring Segmentation for Aerial Images
summary: Spoken language offers a natural, hands-free interface for specifying an arbitrary target in dense remote-sensing imagery, yet existing referring remote-sensing image segmentation benchmarks accept only written expressions. To bridge this gap, we introduce \dataset, a spoken-query benchmark derived from RISBench that adds accent- and voice-diverse speech while preserving the original image, mask, and data splits. Its hard evaluation sets combine rotor, wind, and mixed interference with three signal-to-noise levels. We also propose \model, an efficient bilateral network that combines a boundary-preserving visual path with token-preserving speech encoding, kernel linear cross-modal attention, and a resolution refinement head. The design conditions visual features at two scales without materializing a dense speech--visual affinity matrix, then restores fine boundaries using high-resolution visual features. On the clean test split, \model with Swin-Base achieves 62.09\% mean intersection over union (mIoU) and 68.22\% overall intersection over union (oIoU), outperforming the strongest audio-adapted remote-sensing baseline by 5.38 and 2.08 percentage points, respectively. It retains the best hard-set mIoU at 54.09\%. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first benchmark and model study of full-sentence spoken-query referring segmentation for remote-sensing imagery. The code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文首次引入语音查询的遥感图像指代分割任务，构建了基于RISBench的语音查询基准数据集（含口音和声音多样性及噪声干扰测试集），并提出一个高效的 bilateral 网络模型，在速度和精度上均超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感图像指代分割仅支持书面表达，而语音作为一种自然、免提的交互方式，在遥感场景中具有实用价值。作者希望通过引入语音查询来弥合这一空白，使遥感图像目标指定更加便捷。
AI.method: 提出一个高效的bilateral网络，包含边界保持视觉路径、token保持语音编码、核线性跨模态注意力以及分辨率细化头。该设计在两种尺度上条件化视觉特征而不物化密集的语音-视觉亲和矩阵，并使用高分辨率视觉特征恢复细粒度边界。
AI.result: 在干净测试集上，Swin-Base骨架实现62.09% mIoU和68.22% oIoU，分别超过最强的音频适配遥感基线5.38和2.08个百分点；在困难集上保持最优的54.09% mIoU。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个全句子语音查询遥感图像指代分割的基准和模型研究，展示了语音交互在遥感目标指定中的可行性和有效性，代码将公开。

title: Decoding Phenotypes: A Framework for Fusing Genomic Language Models and Neuroimaging
summary: Neuroimaging and genetic testing are two important clinical references for nervous system diseases, offering complementary diagnostic information. However, integrating genomic and neuroimaging data for precise disease diagnosis is challenging due to cross-modality heterogeneity. Existing imaging-genetics approaches mainly encode genetic information as hard-coded labels, which lose the local sequence context around disease-associated variants. To address this limitation, we propose GeneFuse, a multimodal learning framework that aligns genetic representations from pre-trained Genomic Language Models (GLMs) with features extracted from images. GeneFuse integrates two components: (1) Genotype-Conditioned Feature Modulation (GCFM), a FiLM-inspired module that uses genomic embeddings to modulate image feature maps; and (2) Uncertainty-aware Genomic Residual Fusion (U-GRF), a fusion strategy that uses imaging-derived predictive uncertainty to gate the contribution of genotypic features. We evaluate GeneFuse on early cognitive decline identification (NC vs. MCI) and dementia screening (NC vs. AD). In the APOE-centered setting, GeneFuse achieves AUROCs of 0.77 and 0.83, outperforming existing imaging-genetics fusion methods. These results indicate that GLM-derived genomic embeddings provide additional information to imaging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeneFuse，一个多模态学习框架，将预训练基因组语言模型(GLM)的遗传表征与神经影像特征对齐融合，用于神经系统疾病诊断。GeneFuse包含两个核心组件：基因型条件特征调制(GCFM)模块和不确定性感知基因组残差融合(U-GRF)策略。在早期认知衰退识别和痴呆筛查任务中，GeneFuse分别达到0.77和0.83的AUROC，优于现有影像-遗传学融合方法。
AI.motivation: 神经影像和基因检测为神经系统疾病提供互补的诊断信息，但跨模态异质性使得整合基因组和影像数据进行精准诊断充满挑战。现有影像-遗传学方法主要将遗传信息编码为硬编码标签，丢失了疾病相关变异周围的局部序列上下文信息。
AI.method: GeneFuse包含两个组件：(1) Genotype-Conditioned Feature Modulation (GCFM)：采用FiLM启发的模块，利用基因组嵌入调制图像特征图；(2) Uncertainty-aware Genomic Residual Fusion (U-GRF)：利用影像衍生的预测不确定性来门控基因型特征的贡献，实现融合策略。
AI.result: 在APOE中心化设置下，GeneFuse在早期认知衰退识别(NC vs. MCI)和痴呆筛查(NC vs. AD)任务中分别达到0.77和0.83的AUROC，优于现有影像-遗传学融合方法。
AI.conclusion: GLM衍生的基因组嵌入能够为影像提供额外的补充信息，表明预训练基因组语言模型在影像-遗传学多模态学习中具有应用潜力。

title: City Sentinel: A Unified AI-Based Smart Surveillance Framework for Real-Time Multi-Threat Detection Using Deep Learning
summary: Rapid urbanization has increased the need for surveillance systems that can monitor multiple public safety risks at the same time. Traditional systems often use separate solutions for facial recognition, vehicle identification, fire detection, and behavioral analysis, resulting in fragmented infrastructure and multiple interfaces for operators to manage. This paper presents City Sentinel, a unified AI-based surveillance framework that integrates six detection capabilities into one scalable platform: facial recognition, automatic number plate recognition (ANPR), fire and smoke detection, weapon and knife detection, violence detection, and road accident detection. The system combines a Next.js operator dashboard, FastAPI backend, cloud-based PostgreSQL event storage, InsightFace and YOLOv8 vision models, and EasyOCR for plate recognition. Camera streams are processed through dedicated inference workers using RTSP. On a workstation equipped with an NVIDIA RTX 3060 GPU, the system achieves a median end-to-end latency of 743 ms and supports four concurrent RTSP streams within a two-second latency limit. It achieves a 91.2% face-match rate, 85.7% plate-reading accuracy, and mAP@0.5 scores of 0.846 to 0.889 across the fire, knife, and weapon detection modules. In user-acceptance testing, operators could enroll a new identity in under one minute and identify a flagged person from live footage in an average of 12 seconds. The results demonstrate that a modular, open-source, multi-model architecture can provide broad surveillance coverage, cloud-based auditability, and flexibility for adding new detection capabilities while maintaining practical real-time performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了City Sentinel，一个统一的AI驱动监控框架，将六种检测能力（人脸识别、车牌识别、烟火检测、武器刀具检测、暴力检测、交通事故检测）集成到一个可扩展平台中，在RTX 3060工作站上实现了743ms的中位端到端延迟、四路并发RTSP流支持和良好的检测精度，证明了模块化多模型架构在实时监控中的实用性。
AI.motivation: 快速城市化增加了对同时监控多种公共安全风险的需求，但传统系统通常为不同检测任务使用独立解决方案，导致基础设施碎片化、操作员需管理多个界面，缺乏统一和高效的一体化监控平台。
AI.method: 构建统一框架，集成六种检测能力；采用Next.js操作员仪表板、FastAPI后端、云PostgreSQL事件存储、InsightFace和YOLOv8视觉模型、EasyOCR车牌识别；通过专用推理工作进程使用RTSP处理摄像头流。
AI.result: 在配备NVIDIA RTX 3060 GPU的工作站上实现743ms中位端到端延迟，支持四路并发RTSP流且延迟在两秒内；人脸匹配率91.2%，车牌读取准确率85.7%，火焰、刀具和武器检测模块的mAP@0.5在0.846至0.889之间；操作员可在不到一分钟内注册新身份，平均12秒从实时画面识别出标记人员。
AI.conclusion: 模块化、开源、多模型架构能够提供广泛的监控覆盖、基于云的审计能力和添加新检测功能的灵活性，同时保持实用的实时性能。

title: Integrated Multimodal AI System for Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning, Object Sensing, and Damage Analysis
summary: This work presents a unified multimodal AI system for damage assessment that integrates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) models, thermal spectrum perception, vision foundation model pipelines, and exploratory wireless signal sensing. A RAG component is developed to ground a locally hosted language model in project-specific documentation, including specialized damage level classification criteria to mitigate hallucinations during inference. Controlled comparisons against static few-shot prompting demonstrate that dynamic retrieval improves grounding and factual consistency. We further compare vector-based RAG with a knowledge graph variant constructed via entity-relation extraction, and show that graph-based retrieval produces stronger responses for damage assessment queries requiring cross-document reasoning, motivating hybrid dense, sparse, and graph-aware retrieval. To address limitations of EO imagery under adverse lighting and weather conditions, infrared (IR)/thermal sensing is employed for object detection and segmentation. Our detectors generate candidate detections, yielding improved segmentation of a broad array of objects. Paired IR versus visible spectrum tracking experiments reveal failure modes, motivating multimodal fusion for robust object detection and damage analysis. Vision foundation and vision-language models are leveraged to generate synthetic damage imagery and classify damage severity with high accuracy, supporting training and validation of downstream damage assessment models. Finally, exploratory Wireless-based sensing demonstrates potential to detect presence, motion, and post-event environmental changes where EO and IR sensing are ineffective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的灾害评估多模态AI系统，融合RAG模型、红外热感知、视觉基础模型管道和无线信号感知。RAG组件通过项目文档检索接地本地语言模型以减少幻觉，知识图谱检索在多文档推理上表现更优。红外热感知弥补EO图像在恶劣环境下的不足，视觉基础模型用于合成灾损图像和严重度分类，无线感知则在EO/IR失效场景下探测存在性、运动和灾后环境变化。
AI.motivation: 传统灾害评估依赖EO（可见光）图像，在光照不足、恶劣天气条件下性能受限；同时大语言模型在灾害评估推理中容易产生幻觉，缺乏项目级文档接地；单一模态感知难以覆盖所有灾害场景。
AI.method: 构建多模态统一AI系统，包括：(1) RAG组件将本地语言模型接地到项目文档和损伤等级分类标准中，对比向量检索与知识图谱检索变体；(2) 红外/热感用于目标检测和分割，与可见光谱跟踪进行对比实验；(3) 利用视觉基础和视觉-语言模型生成合成损伤图像并分类严重度；(4) 探索性无线信号感知用于EO/IR失效场景下的存在检测和运动感知。
AI.result: 动态检索相比静态少样本提示显著提升接地性和事实一致性；基于图检索的RAG在跨文档推理的灾害评估查询中表现更强；红外检测器改进了目标分割性能；视觉基础模型在损伤严重度分类上达到高精度；无线传感展示了在EO/IR失效条件下探测环境变化的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 多模态融合（EO+IR+无线+LLM检索）是提升灾害评估鲁棒性的关键方向，建议采用混合稠密、稀疏和图感知检索策略，并结合多模态感知以应对各种复杂灾害场景。

title: From Recovery to Drop-off: How Action Post-training Reduces a VLM's Late-Layer Depth Decodability
comment: Accepted to the archival proceedings track of the Embodied Multimodal Reasoning (EMR) Workshop at ECCV 2026
summary: How much of a vision-language model's (VLM) spatial understanding remains after the action post-training process of building a vision-language-action model (VLA)? We probe depth perception, a primitive of spatiogeometric understanding, from every decoder layer of a weight-matched open-source base VLM/VLA pair: Molmo2-ER and MolmoAct2-LIBERO. First, the VLA decodes depth worse at every layer, a persistent gap we call the floor. Second, the degradation is not uniform: while the base VLM's depth decodability improves through its final layers, the VLA's collapses, an additional late-layer drop we call the cliff. We causally localize the cliff to late-layer MLP interference: ablating the late-layer MLP writes recovers the majority of the terminal decodability cliff, while matched attention ablations and the same intervention in the weight-matched base VLM produce no comparable recovery. A module-level decomposition explains this dissociation: the base VLM carries depth most accessibly in accumulated MLP writes, whereas action post-training collapses depth decodability in the late accumulated writes.

AI.tldr: 本文探究了视觉语言模型（VLM）在经过动作后训练转变成视觉语言动作模型（VLA）后，其空间理解能力（特别是深度感知）的保留程度。研究发现VLA在所有层都表现出深度解码能力的持续退化（"floor"），且在后期层出现额外崩溃（"cliff"），并通过因果消融实验定位到后期层MLP写入的干扰是主要原因。
AI.motivation: 理解VLA在动作后训练过程中损失了多少VLM原有的空间理解能力，特别是深度感知这一空间几何理解的基础能力，并定位退化发生的具体机制。
AI.method: 对权重匹配的开源基础VLM/VLA对（Molmo2-ER和MolmoAct2-LIBERO）进行逐解码器层的深度感知探测；对VLM和VLA的后期层进行MLP写入和注意力消融的因果干预实验；通过模块级分解分析深度信息在累积写入中的分布差异。
AI.result: VLA在所有层都表现出持续的深度解码退化（floor）；VLM深度可解码性在后期层持续改善而VLA发生崩溃（cliff）；消融后期MLP写入可恢复大部分终端可解码性悬崖，而注意力消融和基础VLM上的相同干预无此效果；深度信息在基础VLM中主要累积于MLP写入，而动作后训练破坏了后期累积写入中的深度可解码性。
AI.conclusion: 动作后训练会显著损害VLM的空间理解能力，且退化具有层次特异性——集中于后期层MLP写入中的深度信息丢失，这为理解和改进VLA的构建过程提供了有价值的机制性洞见。

title: Not an A11y: How Android Accessibility Exposes Mobile AI Agents to Indirect Prompt Injection
summary: The rise of autonomous AI agents represents a major paradigm shift in how users interact with mobile devices. Frameworks such as MobileRun and Mobile-Use can autonomously navigate Android applications and execute complex multi-step tasks. To interpret user interfaces, these frameworks rely primarily on Android accessibility (A11y) trees and secondarily on visual screenshots. In this paper, we demonstrate that this architectural dependence on unsanitized accessibility metadata, together with visual input, introduces a systemic vulnerability to indirect prompt injection. We show that adversarial prompts can cause autonomous agents to abandon their original objectives, violate context boundaries, and perform unauthorized device actions. Our empirical evaluation demonstrates goal hijacking, context drift, and unauthorized actions across visually hidden and fully exposed attack scenarios. In aggregate, MobileRun reaches an attack success rate of 0.822 with Gemma4:31B, while Mobile-Use with Qwen3.6:35B reduces this to 0.150 but does not eliminate context drift or unauthorized actions. These findings reveal that current mobile agent frameworks fail to enforce semantic context boundaries, treating passive environmental text as trusted instructions. Finally, we present a taxonomy of these attacks and discuss the need for zero-trust input validation, dedicated security agents, and strict context isolation within mobile agent architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了移动端自主AI代理框架（如MobileRun和Mobile-Use）因依赖未净化的Android无障碍（A11y）元数据和视觉截图，存在系统性间接提示注入漏洞。攻击者可通过对抗性提示使代理偏离原始目标、违反上下文边界并执行未经授权的设备操作。实验显示MobileRun在Gemma4:31B下的攻击成功率达0.822，Mobile-Use结合Qwen3.6:35B可降至0.150但仍无法消除上下文漂移和未授权操作。
AI.motivation: 自主AI代理在移动设备上的应用日益广泛，但这些框架在解析用户界面时主要依赖无障碍树和截图，将环境中的被动文本视为可信指令，缺乏语义上下文边界的强制约束，从而引入了尚未被充分研究的系统性安全漏洞。
AI.method: 论文通过实证评估，设计了可视隐藏和完全暴露两类攻击场景，对MobileRun和Mobile-Use两大框架进行间接提示注入测试，量化了目标劫持、上下文漂移和未授权操作三类攻击的成功率，并构建了攻击分类体系。
AI.result: MobileRun在Gemma4:31B下攻击成功率达0.822；Mobile-Use配合Qwen3.6:35B将成功率降至0.150，但未能彻底消除上下文漂移和未授权操作，表明当前移动代理框架普遍缺乏语义边界保护。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出移动代理架构需要零信任输入验证、专用安全代理和严格的上下文隔离机制；通过攻击分类学为该领域的安全设计提供了系统性指导框架。

title: ToolVision: Learning When and How to Use Visual Tools with Capability-Aligned Supervision
summary: Thinking with images allows a multimodal model to compensate for limited perception by invoking visual tools through code. Yet the prevailing SFT-then-RL recipe creates a different supervision misalignment at each stage. SFT is expected to teach how to use tools, but trajectories from stronger teachers may succeed through perceptual capabilities that a smaller student cannot reliably reproduce or exploit, causing the student to imitate tool-call patterns without learning how to make them useful. RL is expected to teach when to use tools, but outcome-only rewards make fallible tool execution a liability and suppress tool use, whereas a blanket bonus for every correct tool-using trajectory encourages valid but ineffective operations. To address these two misalignments, we introduce ToolVision. During SFT, a multi-agent pipeline explores candidate trajectories, and a committee including student-scale models scores stepwise evidence gain to rank and prune the search branches. Only successfully executed trajectories with correct final answers are retained for SFT. Before RL, ToolVision compares the learner's performance with and without tools, then rewards successful tool use only on questions where tools provide a clear benefit. Both signals are constructed automatically from public task data without additional human annotations of tool use or necessity. ToolVision-8B improves over its base on all seven main benchmarks, surpasses Thyme-7B, CodeVision-8B, and CodeDance-7B on all three high-resolution benchmarks, and outperforms Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking on V* and HRBench 8K. We will publicly release the datasets and source code.

AI.tldr: ToolVision 提出一种新的多模态模型视觉工具调用训练框架，通过多智能体SFT数据筛选和RL前的工具收益评估，分别解决SFT阶段和RL阶段的监督不一致问题，在不需额外人工标注的情况下提升了模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的SFT-then-RL训练范式存在两个阶段的监督不一致问题：(1) SFT阶段，学生模型从更强的教师模型学到的轨迹可能依赖教师自身的感知能力，导致学生只模仿工具调用模式而不理解如何有效使用工具；(2) RL阶段，仅基于结果的奖励使工具执行失败成为负担从而抑制工具使用，而对的工具使用轨迹给予一律奖励又会鼓励无效操作。
AI.method: ToolVision 包含两个关键组件：(1) SFT阶段，使用多智能体管道探索候选轨迹，由包含学生规模模型的委员会对逐步证据增益进行评分和排序，裁剪搜索分支，仅保留成功执行且最终答案正确的轨迹用于训练；(2) RL阶段前，对比学习者使用工具和不使用工具的表现，仅在工具带来明确益处的题目上对成功的工具使用给予奖励。所有信号均从公开任务数据自动构建，无需额外人工标注。
AI.result: ToolVision-8B 在所有七个主要基准上优于其基础模型，在三个高分辨率基准上全面超越 Thyme-7B、CodeVision-8B 和 CodeDance-7B，并在 V* 和 HRBench 8K 上超越 Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking。
AI.conclusion: 通过分别针对SFT和RL阶段的监督不一致问题设计相应的数据筛选和奖励机制，ToolVision 证明多模态模型可以通过图像思维激发视觉工具调用的有效性，且整个流程无需额外人工标注即可实现显著性能提升。

title: Depth-Aware Implicit Neural Representation Priors for 3D Gravity Inversion
summary: Gravimetry images subsurface density contrasts associated with geological structures, geothermal systems, and intrusive bodies. Recovering a three-dimensional density model from gravity observations is highly ill-posed because of its non-uniqueness, limited data coverage, and the attenuation of the gravity field with depth. Classical inversion methods rely on explicit regularization and parameter tuning, whereas supervised deep-learning approaches require representative gravity--density pairs that are rarely available. This paper proposes an unsupervised depth-aware implicit neural representation for 3D gravity inversion. The density volume is represented by multiple coordinate-based neural networks assigned to overlapping depth slabs and optimized directly from the observed gravity measurements through the sensitivity matrix. Slab-specific Fourier features, physics-based depth gains, and scheduled regularization provide structural priors without requiring labeled density models. Experiments on four synthetic scenarios show that the proposed method provides better overall performance in terms of RMSE, PSNR, and SSIM than the evaluated conventional and neural baselines. It also recovers more compact and spatially coherent density bodies, improves the separation of nearby anomalies, preserves internal structures, and reconstructs their vertical extent better. These results indicate that the proposed depth-aware formulation helps to mitigate the depth ambiguity inherent in gravity inversion. In the field experiment, where no ground-truth density model was available, the method produced compact, separated, and vertically coherent anomalies consistent with the observed gravity pattern.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无监督的深度感知隐式神经表示方法用于三维重力反演。通过将密度体积表示为多个基于坐标的神经网络（分配给重叠深度层），直接从观测重力测量通过灵敏度矩阵优化，无需标记密度模型。
AI.motivation: 重力反演（从重力观测恢复地下三维密度模型）是高度病态问题，存在非唯一性、数据覆盖有限以及重力场随深度衰减等问题。传统反演方法依赖显式正则化和参数调优，而有监督深度学习方法需要难以获取的重力-密度配对数据。
AI.method: 提出无监督深度感知隐式神经表示：将密度体表示为多个基于坐标的神经网络，分配给重叠的深度片层，并通过灵敏度矩阵直接从观测重力数据优化。采用片层特定傅里叶特征、基于物理的深度增益和调度正则化提供结构先验，无需标记密度模型。
AI.result: 在四个合成场景中，该方法在RMSE、PSNR和SSIM指标上优于传统和神经基线方法。能恢复更紧凑且空间连贯的密度体、改善邻近异常体的分离、保持内部结构并更好地重建垂直延伸。野外实验中无真实密度模型，但产生了与观测重力模式一致的紧凑、分离且垂直连贯的异常体。
AI.conclusion: 提出的深度感知公式有助于缓解重力反演中固有的深度模糊性问题，为无监督三维重力反演提供了一条有效路径。

title: From Noise to Meaning: Meaningful Secret Sharing with Tamper Detection for Facial Recognition
comment: Accepted at the IEEE International Joint Conference on Biometrics (IJCB) 2026
summary: Popularity of AI-based face recognition system directly demands protection of sensitive biometric data used for training. Visual secret sharing is an interesting idea, as it splits facial images into secret shares that look random and spread across many institutions. However, these shares look like noise and can easily spark suspicion and recognized as encrypted content. This makes them open to targeted collection and harvest-now-decrypt-later attacks. Additionally, visual secret sharing does not detect tampering, allowing attackers to modify shares and threaten the integrity of reconstruction. In this paper, we introduce a new method that turns distracting noise-like secret shares into visually appealing cover images with additional cryptographic tamper detection. The proposed technique works with visual secret sharing and introduces cover images to embed the shares using adaptive least significant bit steganography. Here, cover images with perceptual transparency are used to store secret shares while guaranteeing complete privacy. A two layer authentication using strong digital watermarking and cryptographic hashing is used to protect the integrity of shares. The proposed technique shows high resilience in stopping bit-flipping, cropping, and substitution attacks. Extensive experiments on multiple public face datasets show that the technique shows better FR accuracy, while eliminating share conspicuousness and guaranteeing integrity. The proposed framework sets a new standard for protecting facial data in such a way that privacy, security, and integrity are protected.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合视觉秘密共享、自适应LSB隐写和数字水印/哈希双重认证的新方法，将人脸秘密共享隐藏于视觉上自然的封面图像中，同时提供篡改检测，兼顾隐私、安全与完整性。
AI.motivation: AI人脸识别系统需要保护敏感生物识别数据，但传统视觉秘密共享生成的秘密共享看起来像噪声，容易引起怀疑并被识别为加密内容，面临定向收集和先收割后解密攻击；同时缺乏篡改检测能力，攻击者可修改共享图像威胁重建完整性。
AI.method: 该方法结合视觉秘密共享技术，利用自适应最低有效位（LSB）隐写术将秘密共享嵌入到具有感知透明度的封面图像中；并使用强数字水印和密码学哈希构成两层认证机制来保护共享的完整性。
AI.result: 在多个公开人脸数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在保持更好人脸识别（FR）准确率的同时，消除了共享图像的显著性并保证了完整性，能有效抵抗位翻转、裁剪和替换攻击。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为保护人脸数据设立了新标准，同时保障隐私性、安全性和完整性。

title: Reading is not Reasoning: Bridging the Agentic Policy Gap in Vision-Text Compression
summary: Multi-step language-model agents repeatedly process growing interaction histories, leading to substantial context costs. Vision--text compression reduces these costs by rendering history as images, but the resulting modality shift creates a marked capability gap. Through controlled evaluations of history recovery, matched-state decisions, and complete trajectories, we show that this gap cannot be explained by OCR quality alone. Visual-history agents exhibit systematic drift in action selection, query formulation, stopping, and evidence use, revealing an agentic policy gap. We introduce \textbf{CAPS}, a two-stage \textbf{C}ross-modal \textbf{A}gentic \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{S}elf-distillation framework that uses the same model's stronger text-history policy to supervise its visual-history counterpart. Offline trajectory self-distillation transfers successful text-policy behavior to visual-history inputs, while online policy self-distillation provides dense supervision on states visited by the visual-history policy during reinforcement learning. On SearchQA, CAPS improves over AgentOCR by 5.0\% and 3.4\% with 3B and 7B backbones, respectively. On full-history ALFWorld, the corresponding gains are 15.6\% and 14.5\%. Across settings, CAPS reduces average memory-context cost by up to 63.3\% and peak cost by up to 83.4\% relative to matched text-history policies. These results show that explicit cross-modal policy self-distillation can preserve agent capability under vision--text compression. Our code will be made publicly available in a future release.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAPS框架，通过跨模态策略自蒸馏，将文本历史策略的知识迁移到视觉历史策略，解决了多步语言模型代理在视觉-文本压缩下能力下降的问题。
AI.motivation: 多步语言模型代理处理不断增长的历史交互记录会产生巨大的上下文成本。视觉-文本压缩虽能降低成本，但会造成模态转换带来的显著能力差距。作者发现这种差距无法仅用OCR质量解释，存在系统性的智能体策略差距，需要专门的方法来弥合。
AI.method: CAPS是一个两阶段的跨模态智能体策略自蒸馏框架：(1) 离线轨迹自蒸馏——利用同一模型较强的文本历史策略来监督其视觉历史对应策略；(2) 在线策略自蒸馏——在强化学习过程中，对视觉历史策略访问的状态提供密集监督。
AI.result: 在SearchQA上，CAPS相比AgentOCR在3B和7B骨干网络上分别提升5.0%和3.4%；在完整历史的ALFWorld上分别提升15.6%和14.5%。平均内存上下文成本最多降低63.3%，峰值成本最多降低83.4%。
AI.conclusion: 显式的跨模态策略自蒸馏能够在视觉-文本压缩下保持智能体能力，弥合视觉历史与文本历史策略之间的能力差距，同时显著降低上下文成本。

title: Zero-shot 2D Grounding with Novel Affordance Types
summary: 2D affordance grounding aims to locate the region of an object that a human can interact with. Existing research focuses on recognizing affordance types seen during training and does not study models' ability to generalize to novel affordances, which is crucial for real-world applications. We propose the task of zero-shot 2D grounding with novel affordance types (NAT) and introduce the NAT benchmarks. We then propose AffordAnything, a training-free method that leverages segmentation cues, motivated by the strong correlation between affordance regions and object subparts. To further improve performance, we develop AffordAnything+, a trainable variant that learns to combine these cues. On the proposed AGD20K-NAT benchmark, our best model AffordAnything+ achieves a substantial improvement of 12.3% (absolute) in IoU@0.4 over the SOTA affordance grounding method, OOAL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出零样本2D可交互性定位任务(NAT)，引入NAT基准测试，并提出AffordAnything（无需训练，利用分割线索）及其可训练变体AffordAnything+（学习组合线索）。在AGD20K-NAT基准上，AffordAnything+相比SOTA方法OOAL在IoU@0.4上提升12.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有2D可交互性定位研究仅关注训练中见过的可交互性类型，无法泛化到未见过的可交互性类型，这限制了实际应用。已有方法忽略了模型对新型可交互性的泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出零样本2D可交互性定位任务(NAT)；构建NAT基准；提出AffordAnything（训练免费方法，利用分割线索，基于可交互性区域与物体子部分强相关的观察）；开发AffordAnything+（可训练变体，学习如何组合这些线索）。
AI.result: 在AGD20K-NAT基准上，AffordAnything+在IoU@0.4上比SOTA方法OOAL提升12.3%（绝对提升）。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用物体子部分与可交互性区域的相关性，可以实现对未见可交互性类型的良好泛化；组合分割线索的可训练方法效果优于纯训练免费方法。

title: CoRe-UIE: Rethinking Coexisting and Region-wise Degradation for Underwater Image Enhancement
summary: Underwater images often suffer from diverse and coexisting degradations, including color distortion, scattering haze, texture attenuation, and uneven illumination. These degradations vary across regions and may coexist locally, making conventional uniform restoration difficult to adapt to different degradation patterns. To address this problem, we propose Coexisting and Region-wise Degradation for Underwater Image Enhancement (\textbf{CoRe-UIE}), a degradation-oriented expert collaboration framework. CoRe-UIE combines a content-preserving shared expert with four shared-backbone routed experts for color correction, scattering suppression, texture recovery, and illumination protection. The routed experts share the same architecture but have independent parameters, and are assigned to different regions through input-derived degradation cues and region-adaptive Top-\(k\) routing. We further introduce a Hilbert--Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC)-based representation constraint to reduce statistical dependence among expert features and alleviate redundant expert responses. Experiments on UIEB, LSUI, and U45 demonstrate that CoRe-UIE achieves competitive quantitative performance and visually balanced enhancement under diverse underwater degradation conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出CoRe-UIE，一个面向水下图像增强的退化导向专家协作框架，结合内容保持共享专家和四个基于共享主干的路由专家（分别处理颜色校正、散射抑制、纹理恢复和光照保护），通过输入派生的退化线索和区域自适应Top-k路由进行专家分配，并引入基于HSIC的表示约束以减少专家特征间的统计依赖性，在UIEB、LSUI和U45数据集上取得具有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 水下图像常遭受多种共存且区域变化的退化（颜色失真、散射雾、纹理衰减、光照不均），这些退化随区域而异且可能在局部共存，传统的统一恢复方法难以适应不同的退化模式。
