AI.method: 1) 提出CoRe-UIE框架，包含一个内容保持共享专家和四个共享主干路由专家（颜色校正、散射抑制、纹理恢复、光照保护）。2) 路由专家共享相同架构但参数独立，通过输入派生的退化线索和区域自适应Top-k路由分配到不同区域。3) 引入基于希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则（HSIC）的表示约束，降低专家特征间的统计依赖性，缓解专家响应冗余。
AI.result: 在UIEB、LSUI和U45三个数据集上的实验表明，CoRe-UIE在多种水下退化条件下取得具有竞争力的定量性能和视觉上均衡的增强效果。
AI.conclusion: CoRe-UIE通过退化导向的专家协作和区域自适应路由，有效解决了水下图像中多种退化共存和区域分布不均的难题，实现了对不同退化模式的灵活适应和均衡增强。

title: Can Webcam Gaze Constrain Mesa-Objectives in Driving Models? An Instrument Precision Analysis
summary: Current hazard detection systems in autonomous driving may develop mesa objectives, learned internal goals that achieve high training performance through spurious correlations rather than genuine hazard recognition. We investigate whether human gaze patterns, captured via webcam-based eye tracking (WebGazer.js), can serve as privileged information to constrain mesa-objective formation. We collected 137,663 frame-level gaze samples synchronized with hazard annotations across 388 real dashcam clips, then test this hypothesis across two calibration protocols (9-point/45-click and 11-point/440-click), two model architectures (Random Forest and causal Transformer), and five random seeds per experiment with paired t-tests. No experiment yields a statistically significant improvement from gaze (p = 0.919, 0.578, and 0.667 respectively). A geometric analysis reveals the root cause: WebGazer's reported error (~130-257 px depending on configuration) exceeds 93% of detected hazard object sizes (median 36 px), rendering object-level gaze attribution physically impossible at this instrument precision.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨自动驾驶危险检测系统中可能产生的"Mesa目标"（通过虚假相关性而非真实危险识别获得高训练性能的内部目标），并测试人类凝视模式（通过WebGazer.js网页摄像头眼动追踪获取）能否作为特权信息约束这种目标形成。研究收集了388个真实行车记录仪视频中的137,663帧级凝视样本，测试了两种校准协议、两种模型架构和随机种子，但所有实验均未显示凝视数据的统计学显著改进。几何分析揭示根本原因：WebGazer的定位误差（130-257像素）超过了93%危险物体的大小（中位数36像素），在该仪器精度下物体级凝视归因在物理上不可能实现。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶危险检测系统可能发展出"mesa目标"——通过虚假相关性而非真正识别危险来达到高训练性能的内部目标，这会导致系统在真实环境中失效。作者假设人类凝视模式可作为特权信息来约束这种错误目标形成，但需要验证该假设是否成立。
AI.method: 收集388个真实行车记录仪视频中的137,663帧级凝视样本（与危险标注同步），设计两个校准协议（9点/45次点击与11点/440次点击）、两种模型架构（随机森林与因果Transformer）、每实验五种随机种子并配合配对t检验，通过几何分析评估眼动追踪精度对危险物体归因的可行性。
AI.result: 所有实验均未显示凝视数据带来统计学显著的性能提升（p值分别为0.919、0.578、0.667）。几何分析发现WebGazer报告的误差（约130-257像素，依配置而定）超过93%已检测危险物体的大小（中位数36像素），在该仪器精度下物体级凝视归因物理上不可行。
AI.conclusion: 当前WebGazer等网页摄像头眼动追踪技术在精度上不足以支撑危险物体级别的凝视归因，无法作为有效特权信息约束mesa目标的形成。该工作提供了一个负结果，提示研究界需要更高精度的眼动追踪硬件，或重新思考凝视信息在自动驾驶危险检测中的使用方式。

title: Context Is Not Authority: Structured Runtime Governance for Financial Market Agents
comment: 15 pages, 1 figure, 9 tables. Qiangqiang Liu and Yichi Zhang are corresponding authors
summary: Financial agents can turn correct context into an unauthorized effect: a customer-facing commitment, trade, or deployed policy. We present SAGE-Fin, a finance-specific authority-handoff contract that makes the proposed effect, not merely its text, the object of runtime control. SAGE-Fin compiles proposals into typed, adapter-bound candidates; records missing or stale institutional obligations as coverage debt; contracts authority under current market, account, policy, and dialogue state; and requires an exact-artifact receipt whose nominal type matches the consuming response, execution, or policy adapter. Evidence and workflow progress cannot substitute for effect authority, and prior authorization is rechecked after state changes. Across an authored 616-case catalog, five deterministic specifications yield 3,080 outputs; a label-isolated harness obtains 616/616 binary reference-prototype parity, including 3/3 named response-gate fixtures, while 22 tests cover selected paths. These results establish executable conformance, not independent safety accuracy. Separately, SAGE-Fin's response gate processed real customer-facing production requests at a confidential digital-asset platform. An operational team independent of the implementation team reached a strongly positive post-deployment conclusion on practical usefulness and workflow fit, and end-user feedback was also strongly positive. Disclosure permits only the review's independence, stakeholder classes, assessed dimensions, and directional conclusion, so this is qualitative field corroboration rather than an aggregate effect estimate. Three distinct de-identified predecessor failures, with independently confirmed 0/3 interception, ground repeated-emission drift, stale account evidence, and missing escalation state without estimating prevalence or treatment effect.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAGE-Fin，一个面向金融领域的授权交接合约系统，将"拟议效果"而非文本作为运行时控制的客体，通过类型化适配器候选编译、覆盖债务记录、状态依赖的授权收缩以及精确工件收据验证，实现对金融代理效果层级的严格管控。
AI.motivation: 金融代理存在核心风险：正确的上下文可能被转化为未经授权的效果（如客户承诺、交易或部署策略）。传统控制仅审查文本内容，无法管控实际执行的效果，需要一种以效果本身为控制对象的权威交接机制。
AI.method: SAGE-Fin将提议编译为类型化、适配器绑定的候选方案；将缺失或过时的机构义务记录为覆盖债务；在当前的行情、账户、政策和对话状态下收缩授权；并要求精确工件收据，其名义类型必须与消费响应、执行或策略适配器匹配。证据和工作流进展不能替代效果授权，状态变更后重新检查先前授权。
AI.result: 在616例人工构建的案例目录上，五种确定性规范产生3080个输出；标签隔离测试装置获得616/616二元参考原型一致性，包含3/3命名响应门夹具，22项测试覆盖选定路径。在生产部署中，独立运营团队和终端用户均给出强烈正面评价。三个去标识化的前序失败案例（0/3拦截被独立确认）揭示了重复发射漂移、过时账户证据和缺失升级状态等问题。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了可执行的一致性而非独立的安全准确性；定性现场验证而非聚合效应估计。作者明确区分了合成测试的一致性与真实部署的定性印证，并对局限（不估计发生率或治疗效果）保持透明。

title: EndoMD-SLAM: Endoscopic Gaussian Splatting SLAM under Optical Degradation with Memory and Static-Transient Decomposition
summary: Dense 3D reconstruction is critical for clinical endoscopic navigation and documentation. While Gaussian Splatting SLAM systems show promise in this domain, they fundamentally rely on strict multi-view photometric consistency. In routine procedures, this assumption is severely violated by intermittent optical degradations like moving debris and water flushing. Standard systems erroneously fuse these cameraattached artifacts into the persistent 3D geometry, causing severe tracking drift and irreversible map corruption. To address this limitation, we propose EndoMD-SLAM, a framework designed to maintain stability under optical degradation through specialized tracking and mapping mechanisms. On the tracking side, a memory-driven gating mechanism detects unreliable observations to suspend map updates and utilizes historical keyframes for drift-aware relocalization. On the mapping side, a self-supervised static-transient decomposition isolates visual contaminants into a dedicated transient field. This explicit separation prevents artifacts from structurally entangling with the persistent anatomical map. We curate a degradationfocused benchmark from colonoscopy videos to systematically evaluate these failure modes. Extensive experiments show that while standard baselines fail under severe optical degradation, EndoMD-SLAM preserves geometric integrity, reducing absolute trajectory error by 91% and improving rendering fidelity by 9.9 dB PSNR.

AI.tldr: 提出EndoMD-SLAM，一种在光学退化（如碎片和水流冲洗）条件下保持稳定的密集3D重建SLAM框架，通过记忆驱动门控机制和自监督静态-瞬态分解，将轨迹误差降低91%，渲染质量提升9.9dB PSNR。
AI.motivation: 传统的Gaussian Splatting SLAM系统依赖严格的多视角光度一致性假设，但在临床内镜手术中，间歇性光学退化（如移动碎片、水流冲洗）会严重违反该假设，导致系统将相机附着伪影错误融合进持久3D几何中，造成跟踪漂移和地图不可逆损坏。
AI.method: 1）跟踪侧：提出记忆驱动门控机制，检测不可靠观测并暂停地图更新，利用历史关键帧进行漂移感知重定位；2）建图侧：采用自监督静态-瞬态分解，将视觉污染物分离到专门瞬态场中，防止伪影与持久解剖地图结构纠缠。
AI.result: 在基于结肠镜视频构建的退化聚焦基准上，标准基线在严重光学退化下失效，而EndoMD-SLAM保持几何完整性，绝对轨迹误差降低91%，渲染保真度提升9.9dB PSNR。
AI.conclusion: EndoMD-SLAM通过专门设计的跟踪和建图机制有效应对内镜场景中的光学退化挑战，显著提升了临床环境下密集3D重建的鲁棒性和可靠性。

title: Topology-Aware Global-Local Mamba Networks for Palm Vein Biometrics
summary: Palm-vein recognition is a fine-grained biometric task in which both local vascular texture and the global layout of the vessel tree carry discriminative information, while public datasets remain limited. We propose a topology-aware global-local backbone that combines multi-scale local features, a structureguided directional stream built on a fixed Sobel-magnitude edge prior, and a four-direction state-space scan global pathway within six Topology-Aware Blocks. A staged gated fusion integrates local, structural, and global representations in that order. On HKPUNIR, our method achieves 99.13% top-1 accuracy and 0.08% EER with 7.2 M parameters; on VERA Palm Vein, it achieves 92.42% accuracy and 0.61% EER. Across both datasets it attains the lowest EER among ResNet50, Vim-S, ViT-S, and GLVM at the smallest parameter count, while GLVM remains the strongest in top-1 accuracy and the cheapest in FLOPs. Code is available upon request.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种拓扑感知的全局-局部骨干网络用于掌静脉识别，通过多尺度局部特征、基于Sobel边缘先验的结构引导方向流和四方向状态空间扫描全局通路，结合分级门控融合，在HKPUNIR和VERA数据集上达到SOTA级别的EER性能，且参数量最小。
AI.motivation: 掌静脉识别是细粒度生物识别任务，其判别信息同时存在于局部血管纹理和全局血管树布局中，但公开数据集有限，现有方法未能充分同时建模局部与全局结构信息。
AI.method: 提出拓扑感知的全局-局部骨干网络，包含：(1)多尺度局部特征提取；(2)基于固定Sobel幅度边缘先验的结构引导方向流；(3)四方向状态空间扫描的全局通路，集成在六个拓扑感知块中；最后通过分级门控融合按局部→结构→全局顺序整合三类表示。
AI.result: 在HKPUNIR上达到99.13% top-1准确率和0.08% EER（7.2M参数）；在VERA Palm Vein上达到92.42%准确率和0.61% EER。在两个数据集上均以最小参数量取得最低EER，优于ResNet50、Vim-S、ViT-S和GLVM；GLVM在top-1准确率和FLOPs方面仍保持最优。
AI.conclusion: 提出的拓扑感知全局-局部骨干在掌静脉识别上以最小参数量取得最优或接近最优的识别性能，验证了局部纹理、结构先验与全局布局联合建模的有效性，但top-1准确率方面尚未全面超越GLVM。

title: DualCert: A Solver for the Traveling Salesman Problem with Constraint-Coupled Learning
summary: Large traveling salesman problem (TSP) instances require a solver to allocate limited computation while preserving the validity of its outputs. Existing neural--operations-research (OR) hybrids predict guidance without requiring learned transitions to satisfy constraints discovered during search. DualCert introduces \emph{constraint-coupled learning}, in which current degree equations and dynamically separated subtour-elimination constraints (SECs) define each learned transition. At each refinement, the degree equations and selected, strictly satisfied SEC equations, with positive slacks, define an iterate-dependent primal-slack Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) manifold. Repaired dual variables and violated SEC rows define a local cost field. An exact constrained mirror-descent step maps each finite state to a positive state on the same manifold. Where selected rows and deterministic ties remain fixed, implicit differentiation maps parameter perturbations into the manifold tangent space and reuses the forward constraint operator for the local-cost-field derivative. The terminal edge state allocates computation across Held--Karp ascent, candidate-graph edge tests, and tour construction under a fixed budget. Deterministic verification recomputes original costs and accepts only verified candidate-graph lower bounds and edge decisions. On 1,000 held-out TSP1000 instances, DualCert attains a mean tour-cost gap of \(0.0573\%\) from Lin--Kernighan--Helsgaun version 3 (LKH-3) reference tours in \(9.55\) batch-amortized seconds per instance. It returns a verified candidate-graph lower bound for every instance and achieves \(81.46\%\) edge-decision coverage. The mean gap is \(67.1\%\) smaller than the reported NeuroLKH mean gap. Thus, optimization constraints govern learning, while deterministic verification preserves output validity.

AI.tldr: DualCert提出了一种"约束耦合学习"方法，将TSP求解中的度约束和子回路消除约束直接嵌入神经网络的学习过渡中，通过原始-对偶KKT流形上的精确约束镜像下降步更新状态，并由确定性验证保证输出有效性。在1000个TSP1000实例上，平均 tour 成本差距为0.0573%（相对LKH-3），比NeuroLKH低67.1%，且每个实例都能获得经验证的下界。
AI.motivation: 大型TSP实例要求求解器在有限计算预算下分配资源，同时保证输出有效性。现有的神经-运筹混合方法仅预测指导信息，无法保证学习出的过渡满足搜索过程中发现的约束，导致输出可靠性不足。
AI.method: 提出约束耦合学习框架：1) 用度方程和动态分离的SEC方程定义每次学习过渡的KKT流形；2) 修复对偶变量和违规SEC行以构造局部成本场；3) 通过精确的约束镜像下降步将有限状态映射到同一流形上的正状态；4) 利用隐式微分通过前向约束算子计算导数；5) 终端状态在固定预算下分配Held-Karp上升、候选图边测试和tour构建的计算；6) 确定性验证重新计算原始成本，仅接受验证过的下界和边决策。
AI.result: 在1000个TSP1000实例上，平均tour成本差距为0.0573%（相对LKH-3参考），每个实例批处理摊销时间9.55秒。每个实例均获得可验证的候选图下界，边决策覆盖率达81.46%。平均差距比NeuroLKH报告的平均差距小67.1%。
AI.conclusion: 优化约束主导学习过程，而确定性验证保持输出有效性。该方法证明了神经-运筹混合方法可以在保证输出有效性的同时，通过嵌入约束实现更优的求解性能。

title: Damage Classification for 3D Point Cloud Data via 3D Data Analysis and Vision Foundation Model-based 2D Projections
summary: Fine-grained damage classification of 3D point cloud data (PCD) remains a persistent challenge, constrained by high computational demands and limited labeled data. This study examines two methods: 3D PCD-based damage assessment (3PDA) algorithm and 2D projection damage assessment (2PDA) In our 3PDA analysis algorithm, TDA is used to derive compact representations of 3D PCD segmented by pointNet, which are then integrated with anomaly detection algorithms to quantify structural degradation. We show that TDA effectively compresses geometric structure from VFM-segmented components into discriminative feature vectors and that anomaly detection models can reliably distinguish components with varying damage severity using only 3D PCD inputs. In the 2D projection analysis algorithm, we leverage large VFMs for granular damage detection by projecting 3D PCD into 2D views. These projections allow VFM based models to achieve competitive classification performance while requiring only a fraction of the computational cost associated with full 3D data processing. Our results demonstrate that 2D VFM pipelines in 2PDA can perform strongly on fine-grained damage classification tasks, highlighting their viability as lightweight, resource-efficient alternatives to traditional 3PDA architectures. Comparative evaluation shows that the 3PDA attains higher accuracy but only for a narrow subset of object geometries and at substantially higher computational cost due to its reliance on TDA and the scarcity of high-fidelity 3D datasets. In contrast, the 2PDA algorithm yields slightly lower accuracy but offers an order of magnitude reduction in time complexity and generalizes across a far broader range of object categories.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了两种三维点云损伤分类方法：基于3D点云的损伤评估算法（3PDA）和基于2D投影的损伤评估算法（2PDA）。3PDA利用拓扑数据分析（TDA）和点网分割结合异常检测，精度更高但计算成本高且泛化性有限；2PDA将3D点云投影到2D视图，借助视觉基础模型（VFM）实现，精度略低但计算复杂度降低一个数量级，且泛化能力更强。
AI.motivation: 三维点云数据的细粒度损伤分类面临高计算需求和标注数据稀缺的双重挑战，需要探索更高效且实用的解决方案。
AI.method: 3PDA方法：使用点网（PointNet）分割3D点云，通过拓扑数据分析（TDA）提取紧凑特征表示，再结合异常检测算法量化结构退化。2PDA方法：将3D点云投影为2D视图，利用大规模视觉基础模型（VFM）进行细粒度损伤检测。
AI.result: TDA能有效压缩VFM分割组件的几何结构为判别性特征向量，异常检测模型可基于3D点云可靠区分不同损伤严重度。2PDA的2D VFM管道在细粒度损伤分类上表现强劲，3PDA精度更高但仅适用于狭窄的物体几何子集且计算成本高，2PDA精度略低但时间复杂度降低一个数量级且泛化范围更广。
AI.conclusion: 2D VFM管道（2PDA）可作为传统3PDA架构的轻量级、资源高效替代方案，在精度与计算效率之间提供了更优的平衡。

title: A Multi-Scale Temporal Framework with Dynamic Fusion for EEG-Based Emotion Recognition
comment: The paper has been accepted at: IEEE | 2026 9th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI 2026)
summary: Mixed emotions represent a clinically relevant but still underexplored target for automatic emotion recognition. EEG provides millisecond-level access to neural activity, yet most EEG pipelines analyze the signal through a single temporal window, thereby fixing the temporal structure available to the model. This study introduces a multi-scale temporal framework for EEG-based emotion recognition. The EEG waveform is decomposed into windows of one or several durations, processed by a shared attention-based encoder, and integrated through a dynamic fusion module that assigns sample-specific weights across temporal scales. The framework is evaluated under a subject-independent protocol in binary and three-class settings, with the three-class task including the mixed affective category. The best results are 65.22% for the two-class task and 45.43% for the three-class task. Both are obtained with three-scale dynamic-fusion configurations and remain substantially above the full-signal baseline. The best-performing temporal scales differ between the two tasks. Dynamic fusion outperforms concatenation in the highest-scoring two-class configuration and slightly exceeds it in the highest-scoring three-class configuration, although these multi-scale settings require substantially more computation than the full-signal baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多尺度时间框架用于EEG情绪识别，将脑电波形分解为不同时长的窗口，通过共享注意力编码器处理，并用动态融合模块为每个样本分配跨时间尺度的权重。在主体无关协议下，二分类和三分类任务分别达到65.22%和45.43%的准确率，均显著高于全信号基线。
AI.motivation: 混合情绪是临床上重要但尚未充分探索的自动情绪识别目标。EEG能提供毫秒级神经活动访问，但大多数EEG流水线通过单一时间窗口分析信号，固化了模型可用的时间结构，限制了情绪识别性能。
AI.method: 提出多尺度时间框架：将EEG波形分解为一个或多个时长的窗口，由共享的基于注意力的编码器处理，再通过动态融合模块跨时间尺度分配样本特定权重进行整合。在二分类和三分类（含混合情感类）设置下采用主体无关协议评估。
AI.result: 二分类任务最佳准确率65.22%，三分类任务最佳准确率45.43%，两者均采用三尺度动态融合配置，且都显著高于全信号基线。最佳时间尺度在两个任务间有所不同。动态融合在最高得分二分类配置中优于拼接方法，在三分类配置中略优于拼接。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度动态融合框架能有效提升EEG情绪识别性能，但多尺度设置相比全信号基线需要更多计算量。不同任务的最佳时间尺度不同，表明时间结构选择对情绪识别至关重要。

title: RMR-Net: Degradation-Evidence-Guided Road-Image Restoration for Defect Detection
summary: Vehicle-mounted road cameras are vulnerable to motion blur, defocus, poor illumination, and noise, which can erase thin cracks and pothole boundaries needed by road defect detectors. This paper presents RMR-Net, a compact task-aware restoration front end that estimates degradation evidence from the image, optionally fuses it with existing corruption context/parameters, conditions lightweight restoration blocks, and returns high-frequency pavement detail through a bounded residual path. The experimental scope is deliberately controlled: the conditioning information used on the Image and Vision Computing New Zealand (IVCNZ) pothole dataset and the Road Damage Dataset: Potholes, Cracks and Manholes (PCM) consists of saved synthetic-generator parameters, not measured vehicle telemetry. A clean-trained, frozen YOLO11s detector evaluates every image source. Across eight held-out degradation conditions, RMR-Net obtains the highest mAP50 in seven, including 0.140-0.427 for IVCNZ motion blur and 0.060-0.233 for PCM defocus. A compact ablation identifies the bounded detail path as the largest local contributor, while degradation conditioning and detector-aware stability terms provide complementary guidance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RMR-Net，一个紧凑的任务感知修复前端，用于处理车载道路摄像头图像中的运动模糊、失焦、光照不足和噪声问题，以提升路面缺陷检测性能。
AI.motivation: 车载道路摄像头图像常受运动模糊、失焦、光照不足和噪声影响，这些退化会抹去细裂缝和坑洞边界，从而严重损害路面缺陷检测器的性能。
AI.method: RMR-Net从图像中估计退化证据，可选择与现有损坏上下文/参数融合，条件化轻量级修复块，并通过有界残差路径返回高频路面细节。实验使用保存的合成生成器参数作为条件信息，用干净训练的冻结YOLO11s检测器评估所有图像来源。
AI.result: 在八个保留退化条件下，RMR-Net在七个中获得最高mAP50，包括IVCNZ运动模糊0.140-0.427和PCM失焦0.060-0.233。消融实验表明有界细节路径贡献最大，退化条件化和检测器感知稳定项提供互补指导。
AI.conclusion: RMR-Net作为紧凑的任务感知修复前端，能有效恢复路面高频细节并显著提升退化条件下的路面缺陷检测性能，各部分组件具有互补性。

title: Who Bridges Safety? Identifying and Targeting Cross-Lingual Shared Safety Pathways
summary: Uncovering the internal mechanisms underlying the safety capabilities of large language models (LLMs) is crucial for developing trustworthy artificial intelligence. Currently, mechanistic interpretability studies on multilingual safety are largely confined to local components, such as isolated neurons. However, this static and fragmented perspective overlooks the synergy among components and fails to elucidate how safety signals dynamically propagate within the model to drive safety decisions ultimately. In this work, we move beyond isolated neurons to identify and target the cross-layer functional pathways formed during safety signal propagation, thereby uncovering the mechanisms driving the cross-lingual safety gap. Specifically, we first identify monolingual safety pathways and validate their impact on refusing harmful requests. Subsequent cross-lingual analyses reveal a sparse subset of cross-lingual shared safety pathways, confirming that this intersection acts as the internal bridge transferring safety capabilities from high-resource (HR) languages to non-high-resource (NHR) languages. Building on these mechanistic findings, we propose a pathways-targeted alignment method based on the cross-lingual shared safety pathways. Experimental results show that updating only a small fraction of pathway parameters significantly improves safety in NHR languages while largely preserving the model's general capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文超越单一神经元分析，识别跨层功能通路以揭示LLM跨语言安全差距的机制，并提出基于通路靶向的对齐方法，通过更新少量通路参数显著提升非高资源语言的安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有对LLM多语言安全的机制可解释性研究局限于孤立神经元等局部组件，这种静态碎片化的视角忽略了组件间的协同作用，无法解释安全信号如何在模型中动态传播并最终驱动安全决策。
AI.method: 1. 识别单语安全通路并验证其对拒绝有害请求的影响；2. 跨语言分析发现稀疏的跨语言共享安全通路子集，确认其作为安全能力从高资源语言迁移至非高资源语言的内部桥梁；3. 基于这些机制发现，提出通路靶向对齐方法。
AI.result: 仅更新一小部分通路参数，即可显著提升非高资源语言的安全性，同时大部分保留模型的通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 跨层功能通路是理解LLM安全机制的关键单元，跨语言共享安全通路可作为安全能力迁移的桥梁，通路靶向的对齐方法是提升低资源语言安全性的有效且高效手段。

title: Fourier Self-Supervision for Fine-Grained Generalized Category Discovery
summary: Generalized Category Discovery aims to recognize known categories while identifying novel ones within unlabeled data. Existing methods, typically based on self-supervision and contrastive learning, often struggle to capture fine-grained distinctions, relying on superficial visual cues rather than the intrinsic attributes humans use for categorization. We introduce Fourier Self-Supervision, that leverages the Fourier transform of images to enhance the discrimination of subtle differences and support the discovery of new categories. Our method employs a dual frequency filtering strategy: a low-pass filter first extracts broad, abstract attributes that capture high-level category information, while a high-pass filter emphasizes fine details such as edges and textures that are essential for fine-grained recognition. Each operates on a dedicated latent space, and their overlapping representations together yield a richer, more complete feature space. This dual-frequency approach not only refines feature extraction to identify novel categories, but also strengthens the model's discriminative power in fine-grained category discovery. Experiments on multiple fine-grained datasets show that incorporating Fourier Self-Supervision outperforms state-of-the-art methods, even when the number of classes is unknown, demonstrating its effectiveness for Generalized Category Discovery. Our code is available at: https://github.com/SarahRastegar/FourEx.

AI.tldr: 本文提出傅里叶自监督方法（FourEx），利用图像傅里叶变换的双频滤波策略（低通+高通）分别提取粗粒度抽象属性和细粒度边缘纹理细节，在广义类别发现任务中提升细粒度区分能力，在多个细粒度数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的广义类别发现方法主要基于自监督和对比学习，往往依赖表面视觉线索，难以捕捉人类分类时所依据的内在细粒度属性，导致对微妙差异的区分能力不足。
AI.method: 提出Fourier Self-Supervision方法，采用双频滤波策略：低通滤波器提取高层次类别信息的宽泛抽象属性，高通滤波器强调对细粒度识别至关重要的边缘和纹理等细节。两种滤波各自在独立潜空间上操作，其重叠表征共同构成更丰富的特征空间。
AI.result: 在多个细粒度数据集上的实验表明，即使类别数量未知，融合傅里叶自监督的方法仍能超越现有最先进方法，展现其在广义类别发现中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 双频傅里叶方法不仅优化了特征提取以识别新类别，还增强了模型在细粒度类别发现中的判别能力，验证了频率域信息对提升广义类别发现性能的重要价值。

title: Different Feedback, Different Updates: Selective Self-Learning from User Interactions for Large Language Models
summary: User feedback offers natural supervision for persistent LLM improvement, but a single message may support multiple behavioral changes with different scopes of generalization. We introduce SLIFT, a selective self-learning framework built on a task-relative view of user feedback. SLIFT decomposes each feedback message into atomic components and interprets each component relative to the original task as Fix, Spec, or Null: requirements for task validity, compatible condition-specific refinements, or content with no reliable positive update direction. To incorporate each change at the appropriate scope, SLIFT trains two complementary LoRA adapters on a shared frozen backbone: a Generalist that consolidates Fix requirements into default behavior through feedback-conditioned self-distillation, and a Specialist that observes only the task and Generalist response to supply residual guidance for applicable, unmet Spec refinements. Null components induce no positive update. Across backbones, SLIFT achieves strong performance on both MemoryBench and WildFB, with targeted analyses further examining its underlying mechanisms. We release our code at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SLIFT.

AI.tldr: SLIFT是一个基于任务相对视角的选择性自学习框架，将用户反馈分解为Fix、Spec和Null三类原子组件，通过通用适配器（Generalist）和专用适配器（Specialist）在共享冻结骨干网络上分别处理不同范围的泛化需求，在MemoryBench和WildFB上均取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 用户反馈为LLM的持续改进提供了自然的监督信号，但单条反馈消息可能同时蕴含多种不同泛化范围的行为变更需求，现有的学习框架难以精确区分并分别处理这些不同粒度的指令。
AI.method: SLIFT将每条反馈消息分解为原子组件，并相对于原始任务将其分类为Fix（任务有效性要求）、Spec（条件特定细化）或Null（无可靠正向更新方向）。框架在共享冻结骨干上训练两个互补LoRA适配器：Generalist通过反馈条件自蒸馏整合Fix需求到默认行为中；Specialist仅观察任务和Generalist响应，为适用的、未满足的Spec细化提供残差指导。Null组件不产生正向更新。
AI.result: 在多种骨干网络上，SLIFT在MemoryBench和WildFB基准上都取得了强劲性能，并通过针对性分析进一步验证了其底层机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SLIFT通过任务相对的反馈分解和双适配器架构，实现了对用户反馈中不同泛化范围变更的精确学习，为基于用户反馈的LLM持续改进提供了一种有效且可解释的解决方案。

title: Detecting Clear Contact Lenses for Iris Recognition: A Two-Stage Mask-Guided Attention Approach
summary: This work focuses on the impact and detection of clear contact lenses in the context of iris recognition. While the detection of cosmetic or patterned contact lenses has been extensively studied under the presentation attack detection (PAD) paradigm, clear prescription contact lenses, that are typically transparent, have received comparatively less attention despite their widespread use. Unlike patterned lenses, clear lenses introduce no salient texture artifact, making them difficult to detect and are often assumed to have no impact on iris recognition. We first examine this assumption using the commercial VeriEye matcher on four benchmark datasets and show that clear lenses marginally degrade genuine match scores and increase verification error. We then propose a two-stage contact-lens detection framework. Stage~1 uses an existing PAD model to identify patterned lenses, while Stage~2 focuses on the more challenging clear-lens versus no-lens distinction using a ConvNeXt-Base model equipped with Mask-Guided Spatial Attention (MGSA). The proposed MGSA module incorporates a Hough-derived anatomical ROI mask together with learned spatial attention and Squeeze-and-Excitation channel recalibration, allowing the network to focus on subtle limbal cues associated with clear lens wear. Across four datasets, the full pipeline consisting of both patterned and clear contact lens detection achieves between 90.0\%--98.8\% accuracy. Finally, we introduce a z-score calibration method that adjusts VeriEye match scores when a clear lens is detected in the input images. This calibration reduces EER by 4.1\%--28.3\% across datasets, demonstrating that reliable clear contact lens detection can directly improve iris verification performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了透明隐形眼镜对虹膜识别的影响与检测问题。作者首先通过商业VeriEye匹配器在四个基准数据集上验证了透明镜片会轻微降低匹配分数并增加验证误差；随后提出两阶段检测框架（Stage 1用现有PAD模型检测花纹镜片，Stage 2用带掩码引导空间注意力MGSA的ConvNeXt-Base模型区分透明镜片与无镜片），在四个数据集上达到90.0%-98.8%准确率；最后提出z-score校准方法，将验证EER降低4.1%-28.3%。
AI.motivation: 尽管化妆品或有花纹的隐形眼镜在演示攻击检测（PAD）范式下已被广泛研究，但透明处方隐形眼镜由于使用广泛且无显著纹理伪影，其检测研究相对不足，且常被假设对虹膜识别无影响。作者旨在检验这一假设并开发针对透明镜片的检测与校准方法。
AI.method: 提出两阶段接触镜检测框架：Stage 1使用现有PAD模型识别花纹镜片；Stage 2使用ConvNeXt-Base模型配合Mask-Guided Spatial Attention（MGSA）模块区分透明镜片与无镜片。MGSA结合了Hough变换推导的解剖ROI掩码、学习空间注意力和Squeeze-and-Excitation通道重校准，聚焦于透明镜片佩戴相关的微妙角巩膜缘线索。最后提出z-score校准方法调整VeriEye匹配分数。
AI.result: 两阶段流水线在四个数据集上实现90.0%-98.8%的检测准确率；z-score校准将各数据集EER降低4.1%-28.3%，证明可靠的透明镜片检测可直接改善虹膜验证性能。
AI.conclusion: 透明隐形眼镜确实会对虹膜识别产生可测量的负面影响，且可靠的透明镜片检测不仅能实现高精度分类，还能通过分数校准实质性提升虹膜验证系统的性能。

title: RAVEN-Eval: Rubric-Guided Automatic Evaluation for AI Video Generation Models Based on LMM Preference Judgement
summary: AI video generation has advanced rapidly and entered widespread commercial use. As a result, quality differences among videos produced by state-of-the-art AI video generation models~(AIVGMs) have become increasingly difficult to discern using conventional evaluation criteria, such as visual fidelity and semantic instruction following. Meanwhile, human evaluation now requires more expertise and sustained attention, substantially increasing annotation costs. This calls for automated evaluation that can reliably distinguish fine-grained differences among advanced AIVGMs with minimal human intervention. To address this challenge, we present RAVEN-Eval, a rubric-guided automated evaluation framework for AIVGMs, built primarily on the LMM-as-a-judge paradigm. Through an automatic task curation and quality-filtering pipeline, RAVEN-Eval curates 150 text-to-video~(T2V) tasks and 100 image-to-video~(I2V) tasks, and systematically collects more than 4,500 AIGVs. At its core, RAVEN-Eval adopts rubric-guided automated LMM preference judgement, in which LMM judges conduct pairwise comparisons according to task-specific rubrics. It further introduces an anchor-based model insertion approach to reduce the evaluation cost of incorporating new models. Finally, we evaluate 20 high-performance AIVGMs, as well as the judging capabilities of 13 LMM judges, and establish the RAVEN-Eval Leaderboards. Overall, RAVEN-Eval paves a scalable path for automatic and trustworthy evaluation of rapidly evolving AIVGMs.

AI.tldr: RAVEN-Eval是一个基于LMM-as-a-judge范式的自动化视频生成模型评估框架，通过自动任务策展和质量过滤管线收集了150个T2V任务和100个I2V任务及4500多个AIGV，采用rubric引导的LMM成对偏好判断，并引入基于锚点的模型插入方法以降低评估成本，最终评估了20个高性能AIVGM和13个LMM裁判，建立了RAVEN-Eval排行榜。
AI.motivation: 先进的AI视频生成模型之间的质量差异已难以用传统评估标准（如视觉保真度和语义指令遵循）区分，而人工评估需要更高的专业水平和持续注意力，标注成本大幅增加，亟需一种能可靠区分先进AIVGM细微差异且最少人工干预的自动化评估方法。
AI.method: RAVEN-Eval框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 自动任务策展和质量过滤管线，策展150个T2V任务和100个I2V任务，系统收集超过4500个AI生成视频；(2) rubric引导的自动化LMM偏好判断，即LMM裁判根据任务特定的评分标准进行成对比较；(3) 基于锚点的模型插入方法，通过锚点比较降低纳入新模型的评估成本。
AI.result: 在20个高性能AIVGM和13个LMM裁判上进行了系统评估，建立了RAVEN-Eval排行榜，验证了该框架能够可靠地区分先进视频生成模型之间的细粒度质量差异。
AI.conclusion: RAVEN-Eval为快速演进的AIVGM提供了一条可扩展、自动且可信的评估路径，有效降低了人工干预需求，同时能够捕捉先进模型之间的细微质量差异。

title: DeepFreqMark: End-To-End Learnable Frequency-Domain Watermarking with Spherical Attack Simulation for Latent Diffusion Models
summary: The proliferation of AI-generated images produced by Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) has raised critical concerns regarding copyright infringement and misinformation. Although existing frequency-domain watermarking methods embed handcrafted geometric patterns into the initial latent noise prior to generation, they suffer from limited capacity and rigid pattern designs. We propose DeepFreqMark, an end-to-end learnable frequency-domain watermarking framework that replaces manual pattern engineering with a neural message encoder and decoder. To circumvent the computational bottleneck caused by Denoising Diffusion Implicit Model (DDIM) inversion during training, we introduce a Spherical Linear Interpolation (Slerp)-based attack simulation. This approach operates directly on the noise latent while strictly preserving the Gaussian variance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DeepFreqMark achieves significantly lower Bit Error Rates (BER) than baseline methods under real-world attacks and scales to 256 bits message capacity. Our source code is available at https://github.com/chenhsiu48/DeepFreqMark.

AI.tldr: DeepFreqMark 是一个端到端可学习的频域水印框架，用于在潜在扩散模型生成的图像中嵌入可逆水印。它用神经编解码器取代传统手工设计的几何图案，并通过 Slerp 攻击模拟来避开 DDIM 反演的计算瓶颈，实现更低的比特错误率和 256 比特的容量。
AI.motivation: LDM 生成图像的泛滥引发版权侵权和虚假信息问题。现有频域水印方法虽能嵌入水印到初始噪声中，但存在容量有限和图案设计僵化的局限，需要更灵活、可学习的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出 DeepFreqMark 端到端可学习框架，用神经网络消息编码器和解码器替代手工图案工程；引入基于 Slerp 的攻击模拟方法，直接在噪声潜变量上操作并严格保持高斯方差，从而规避训练中 DDIM 反演带来的计算瓶颈。
AI.result: 在真实世界攻击下，DeepFreqMark 相比基线方法实现了显著更低的比特错误率（BER），并可将消息容量扩展到 256 比特。
AI.conclusion: DeepFreqMark 验证了可学习频域水印在 LDM 图像生成中的有效性，兼顾了水印鲁棒性与嵌入容量的提升，为 AI 图像溯源和保护提供了新思路。

title: Motif 3: Technical Report
summary: We introduce Motif 3, a decoder-only Mixture-of-Experts language model with 314 billion total parameters and 13.2 billion activated per token. Each sparse MoE layer contains 384 routed experts, with eight selected per token. This fine-grained sparsity provides substantial expert capacity while limiting computation. Motif 3 is built around Grouped Differential Latent Attention (GDLA), which integrates grouped differential attention with the compressed key-value representation of Multi-head Latent Attention. The architecture further incorporates modified manifold-constrained hyper-connections, Expert Specific PolyNorm activations, and multi-token prediction to improve optimization stability, expert specialization, and inference efficiency. We pretrain Motif 3 on approximately 12.5 trillion tokens spanning web documents, STEM, code, mathematics, multilingual content, and domain-specialized corpora. Expert-balancing and numerical-stabilization techniques support stable training at scale, while selective MXFP8 computation and communication, memory-efficient fused kernels, and window-aware context parallelism enable training with context lengths up to 256K tokens. Our post-training pipeline combines general supervised fine-tuning, six specialist teachers trained with reinforcement learning, a software-engineering teacher trained with supervised fine-tuning, and Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation. The resulting unified model consolidates complementary capabilities in reasoning, coding, tool use, professional work, long-context understanding, calibrated abstention, and instruction following. Across a broad evaluation suite, Motif 3 demonstrates competitive performance against leading open weight models, including strong results on long-horizon agentic tasks, mathematical reasoning, scientific knowledge, and hallucination-sensitive evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Motif 3，一个具有3140亿总参数、单token激活132亿参数的decoder-only MoE语言模型。模型采用细粒度稀疏路由（384个专家/层，每token选8个），核心架构基于GDLA（分组差分潜在注意力），融合了压缩KV表示、流形约束超连接、专家特定PolyNorm激活和多token预测。在约12.5万亿token上预训练，并通过多教师强化学习蒸馏进行后训练，在多项基准上达到领先水平。
AI.motivation: 在保持计算效率的同时提升模型容量和性能，通过细粒度MoE架构和创新的注意力机制（GDLA）来平衡专家容量与计算开销，并解决大规模训练中的稳定性、专家专业化和推理效率问题。
AI.method: 1) 架构：GDLA注意力（分组差分注意力+MLA压缩KV）、流形约束超连接、专家特定PolyNorm激活、多token预测；2) 预训练：约12.5万亿token，覆盖多领域语料，采用专家平衡和数值稳定技术；3) 训练优化：选择性MXFP8计算/通信、内存高效融合内核、窗口感知上下文并行（支持256K上下文）；4) 后训练：通用SFT + 六个RL训练的专业教师 + 软件工程SFT教师 + 多教师在线策略蒸馏。
AI.result: 在广泛的评估套件上，Motif 3在推理、编码、工具使用、专业工作、长上下文理解、校准性弃答和指令跟随等方面展现出与领先开源模型竞争的性能，尤其在长horizon智能体任务、数学推理、科学知识和幻觉敏感评估上表现突出。
AI.conclusion: Motif 3通过细粒度MoE与创新注意力架构（GDLA）的结合，加上精心设计的后训练蒸馏管线，成功整合了多种互补能力，验证了该架构路线在大规模语言模型中的有效性。

title: SignLlama: Enhancing Gloss-free Sign Language Translation by Prioritizing Visual Features for LLMs
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success across a wide range of tasks. However, fine-tuning LLMs for Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation (GFSLT) remains a challenge. In this paper, we investigate how to effectively adapt LLMs to the GFSLT task. We show that there are two key issues that need to be solved: (1) the inherent distributional gap between visual feature inputs and text feature inputs makes it difficult for LLMs to interpret visual inputs; and (2) existing approaches typically concatenate visual and textual features in an autoregressive framework, which leads to the model overemphasizing textual inputs and deprioritizing visual cues, as LLMs are pretrained predominantly on text-centric data. To address the first challenge, we propose a simple yet effective method named Filtered Pseudo-Gloss CTC Pretraining, which leverages filtered pseudo-gloss sequences generated from text sequences to supervise the training of the visual backbone. To tackle the second issue, we introduce a Visual-Prioritized Distillation training strategy. Specifically, we define a visual-only prediction path in which text inputs are masked, and the model is required to generate the target sequence relying solely on visual inputs. To guide this path, the outputs from the standard visual-textual prediction are then distilled into the visual-only prediction path, encouraging the model to prioritize visual features. Comprehensive experiments and qualitative analyses demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model. The proposed SignLlama achieves very competitive performance on multiple datasets for GFSLT tasks, without using any extra modalities or external sign language datasets for pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SignLlama模型，通过过滤器伪词汇CTC预训练和视觉优先蒸馏策略，有效解决LLM在无术语手语翻译（GFSLT）中视觉-文本分布差异和文本偏置的问题，在多个数据集上取得优异成绩。
AI.motivation: LLM在手语翻译任务中面临两个关键挑战：(1)视觉特征与文本特征之间存在固有的分布差距，LLM难以理解视觉输入；(2)现有的自回归框架中视觉和文本特征拼接方式会使模型过度关注文本而忽视视觉线索，因为LLM预训练主要基于文本数据。
AI.method: 提出两种方法：(1)Filtered Pseudo-Gloss CTC Pretraining——利用从文本序列生成的过滤伪词汇序列来监督视觉骨干网络的训练，缩小视觉与文本特征的分布差距；(2)Visual-Prioritized Distillation训练策略——定义一条仅依赖视觉输入的预测路径（掩码文本输入），并将标准视觉-文本预测路径的输出蒸馏到该路径中，促使模型优先利用视觉特征。
AI.result: SignLlama在多个GFSLT数据集上取得了极具竞争力的性能，且无需使用任何额外模态或外部手语数据集进行预训练。
AI.conclusion: 通过解决视觉-文本分布差异和文本偏置问题，所提出的方法有效实现了LLM向无术语手语翻译任务的适配，验证了模型的鲁棒性和实用性。

title: MELLON - Multimodal Enhanced LLM for Online Navigation
summary: Web navigation agents are capable of addressing various types of tasks on different websites. Current baselines on web navigation are either unimodal or lack strong reasoning abilities given multimodal inputs. Focusing on the WebShop benchmark, a real-world website simulation, we explore the alignment of text and images, as well as multimodal reasoning and planning abilities, to enhance the performance of web navigation agents. We propose three innovative multimodal enhancements: Multimodal Enhanced LLM for Online Navigation (MELLON), VQAgent, and Multimodal Ranker. MELLON demonstrates a significant improvement in task completion accuracy, with a 9.26% increase after just one epoch of training. Our findings suggest the necessity of further exploration into multimodal approaches, with a focus on more extensive training and alignment strategies to enhance the effectiveness of web navigation agents.

AI.tldr: 本文针对WebShop基准测试，探索了多模态（文本与图像对齐）推理和规划能力对Web导航智能体性能的提升，提出了三种创新性的多模态增强方法：MELLON、VQAgent和多模态排序器（Multimodal Ranker），其中MELLON仅经过一个epoch的训练即在任务完成准确率上提升了9.26%。
AI.motivation: 现有的Web导航智能体基线要么是单模态的，要么在给定多模态输入时缺乏强大的推理能力。作者希望通过探索文本和图像的对齐以及多模态推理和规划能力，来增强Web导航智能体的整体表现。
AI.method: 提出了三种多模态增强方法：1) MELLON（Multimodal Enhanced LLM for Online Navigation），用于多模态增强在线导航；2) VQAgent，利用向量量化进行多模态推理；3) 多模态排序器（Multimodal Ranker），用于多模态信息重排序。研究在WebShop基准（一个真实世界网站模拟环境）上进行验证。
AI.result: MELLON方法在任务完成准确率上取得了显著提升，仅经过一个epoch的训练后准确率就提高了9.26%。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，多模态方法在Web导航领域具有重要的探索价值，未来需要进一步关注更广泛的训练策略和对齐策略，以持续提升Web导航智能体的有效性。

title: GeoAI-based post-segmentation quality validation of building footprints via spatial feature engineering
summary: Deep learning-based building footprint extraction from high-resolution imagery often produces topologically inconsistent vectors unfit for direct GIS database ingestion. To address this, we present a multidomain GeoAI quality control framework that automates error detection to systematically purify vector footprint databases. Candidate footprints were generated across five UAV survey sites in Bangladesh using U-Net (ResNet-34) and SAM-LoRA (ViT-B). The extracted raster masks were vectorized, geometrically regularized, and consolidated under a spatial-exclusivity constraint to eliminate duplicate representations. We used twenty-four predictors capturing geometric, spatial-contextual, and raster-derived spectral and texture properties. Machine Learning (ML) classifiers were trained on a development partition (Sites B-D) and rigorously validated on a spatially independent test set (Site E) excluded from hyperparameter tuning and class balancing. The experimental results demonstrate that geometric and spatial-contextual predictors using Decision Tree (DT) provide the most effective discriminatory evidence for identifying object-level boundary deformations. DT achieved an accuracy of 95.31%, an F1-score of 91.06%, and a Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) of 0.880 on the unseen testing site. At the database level, this framework successfully identified 87.34% of erroneous footprints while maintaining 98.31% of acceptable structures, reducing the residual error proportion from 27.32% to 4.62% and improving final database purity to 95.38%. This translates into a relative error reduction of 83.09%. The findings indicate that post-segmentation object-level ML provides a highly transferable, robust mechanism for automated quality assurance in production-ready geographic information system (GIS) workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多域GeoAI质量控制框架，利用机器学习分类器自动检测深度学习建筑足迹提取中的拓扑错误，在孟加拉国五个UAV调查站点的实验中，将数据库错误率从27.32%降至4.62%，纯度提升至95.38%。
AI.motivation: 深度学习提取的建筑足迹常产生拓扑不一致的矢量结果，无法直接用于GIS数据库。现有方法缺乏系统化的自动错误检测与质量控制机制。
AI.method: 使用U-Net(ResNet-34)和SAM-LoRA(ViT-B)生成候选足迹，经矢量化、几何正则化和空间排他性约束合并。提取24个预测因子（几何、空间上下文、栅格光谱与纹理特征），训练ML分类器（如决策树）检测对象级边界变形，并在空间独立的测试集上验证。
AI.result: 决策树模型在未见测试站点上达到95.31%准确率、91.06% F1分数和0.880 MCC；框架识别出87.34%的错误足迹，保留98.31%正确结构，最终数据库纯度达95.38%，相对错误减少83.09%。
AI.conclusion: 分割后对象级ML分类提供高度可迁移、稳健的自动化质量保证机制，适用于生产级GIS工作流。

title: RISE-RL: Rubric-Informed Selective Exploration for Open-Ended Reinforcement Learning
summary: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) for open-ended tasks is challenging because responses must satisfy multidimensional criteria without following a single correct generation trajectory. Existing rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods compress fine-grained criterion-level feedback into scalar rewards, making persistent capability gaps difficult to target under limited on-policy exploration. We propose $\textbf{RISE-RL}$ (Rubric-Informed Selective Exploration), which uses repeatedly missed rubric criteria to elicit privileged trajectories that are difficult to discover through unguided exploration alone. RISE-RL retains only trajectories whose complete-rubric reward exceeds the mean reward of natural rollouts, and then re-evaluates them under the original prompt to emphasize behaviors that remain weakly supported by the natural policy. The resulting guidance signal is optimized through a separate auxiliary objective and removed once its additional benefit diminishes. Experiments with 4B and 14B models across writing, chat, health, and science show that RISE-RL achieves the highest mean score on every evaluated benchmark under guidance-free evaluation. Compared with standard Rubric-RL, it improves the average score by 1.3 points at the 4B scale and $\textbf{3.3 points at the 14B scale}$, including a $\textbf{6.0-point}$ gain on CreativeWriting-V3. It also improves creative-writing diversity and yields gains on objectively scored medical and scientific benchmarks. These results indicate that selective internalization through reward filtering and policy support shaping is effective for open-ended reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: RISE-RL是一种基于评分标准的选择性探索方法，通过反复未达标的评分标准来引导策略生成难以通过无指导探索发现的轨迹，过滤出高奖励轨迹后通过辅助目标优化，并在收益减弱时移除该目标。在4B和14B规模的写作、聊天、健康与科学基准上均取得最优成绩。
AI.motivation: 开放任务中LLM的对齐具有挑战性，因为响应需满足多维标准而非单一正确轨迹。现有基于评分标准的RL方法将细粒度标准级反馈压缩为标量奖励，导致在有限的在线策略探索下难以针对性解决持续性能力差距。
AI.method: RISE-RL利用反复未达标的评分标准来引出难以通过无指导探索发现的特权轨迹；仅保留完整评分奖励超过自然轨迹均值的轨迹，并在原始提示下重新评估以强化自然策略支持薄弱的行为；通过独立辅助目标优化该引导信号，并在其附加收益减弱时移除。
AI.result: 在4B和14B模型上的写作、聊天、健康与科学基准中均获得最高平均分。相比标准Rubric-RL，4B规模平均提高1.3分，14B规模平均提高3.3分，其中CreativeWriting-V3提升6.0分；同时改善了创意写作多样性，并在客观评分的医学和科学基准上获得提升。
AI.conclusion: 选择性内化——通过奖励过滤与策略支持塑造——对开放任务强化学习是有效的，表明基于评分标准的有选择引导能显著改善多维度对齐性能。

title: Triple Expert Learning from Noisy Labels for Semi-Supervised Vision Foundation Model Adaptation
comment: Accepted for publication at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026. Official list of accepted papers: https://bmvc2026.bmva.org/programme/accepted_papers/
summary: Semi-supervised adaptation of vision foundation models (VFMs) commonly freezes the pretrained backbone and updates lightweight modules such as LoRA. However, pseudo-labels have mixed reliability, and a single LoRA adapter must absorb reliable, ambiguous, and noisy gradients in the same low-rank space. This can make VFM adaptation sensitive to pseudo-label noise. We propose \textbf{TriNoL}, a \textbf{Tri}ple-expert learning framework from \textbf{No}isy \textbf{L}abels for semi-supervised VFM adaptation. TriNoL routes unlabeled samples into three confidence regions and assigns them to three LoRA experts: a Positive Expert for high-confidence pseudo-labels, an Alignment Expert for medium-confidence ambiguous samples, and a Negative Expert for low-confidence noisy samples. The VFM backbone remains frozen, and only the LoRA experts and classifier head are updated. By separating different pseudo-label reliability regions into specialized adaptation paths, TriNoL improves robustness to noisy supervision while keeping the training cost low.

AI.tldr: 提出TriNoL框架，通过三重专家（Positive/Alighment/Negative）将半监督视觉基础模型适配中的伪标签按置信度分路径处理，提高对噪声伪标签的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 半监督视觉基础模型适配中，伪标签可靠性参差不齐，单一LoRA适配器必须在同一低秩空间中吸收可靠、模糊和噪声梯度，导致模型对伪标签噪声敏感。
AI.method: 将未标注样本按置信度分为三个区域（高/中/低），分别分配给三个LoRA专家：Positive Expert处理高置信伪标签、Alignment Expert处理中等置信模糊样本、Negative Expert处理低置信噪声样本。冻结VFM主干，仅更新LoRA专家和分类头。
AI.result: 通过分离不同伪标签可靠性区域到专业化适配路径，提升了对噪声监督的鲁棒性，同时保持较低训练成本。
AI.conclusion: TriNoL通过差异化专家路径处理不同置信度伪标签，在半监督VFM适配中有效缓解伪标签噪声问题。

title: ChronoState: Hidden Elapsed-Time Conditioning for Temporal-State Action Selection in Frozen-Backbone Language Models
comment: Submitted to SPIE Defense and Commercial Sensing 2027
summary: Temporal decisions in language-model systems often depend on both symbolic task state and elapsed wall-clock time, such as cache expiration, job completion, quota resets, deadlines, or stale sessions. We study whether elapsed time can be supplied as a non-token, system-side scalar and composed with visible symbolic state by a frozen-backbone language model. We introduce ChronoState, a compositional temporal-state benchmark in which symbolic state appears in the prompt, elapsed seconds tau are supplied through a hidden chronometric-injection channel, and the model selects a forced-choice temporal action. Here, "hidden" means hidden from the user-visible token sequence, not from model computation. Using Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct as a frozen bf16 backbone with a 31-dimensional sinusoidal-plus-log time encoding, gated FiLM residual modulation, and a rank-8 LoRA action surface, hidden-time CI reaches 0.9305 +/- 0.0134 accuracy and 0.9410 +/- 0.0103 balanced accuracy. No-time and shuffled-time controls fall to 0.5511 +/- 0.0042 and 0.3323 +/- 0.0097, respectively, with high shuffled-time wrong-state consistency supporting causal dependence on the injected scalar within the trained distribution. Generalization remains strong for held-out templates, durations, and multi-constraint compositions, but held-out quota-family transfer is weak at 0.5065 +/- 0.0559, while a fair prompt+LoRA timestamp baseline reaches 0.9893 +/- 0.0052. Thus, ChronoState supports a narrow conclusion: hidden elapsed time can be composed with symbolic task state under direct supervision, but does not establish autonomous time tracking, broad unseen-family abstraction, or superiority over prompt-injected timestamps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ChronoState基准，研究是否可将经过的时间作为非token的系统侧标量与符号任务状态组合，供冻结骨干语言模型进行时间决策。隐藏时间通道可达0.93+准确率，但泛化有限，不及提示词注入时间戳方法。
AI.motivation: 语言模型系统的时间决策通常同时依赖符号任务状态和现实时钟时间（如缓存过期、配额重置、截止时间等）。现有方法未系统研究经过的时间能否以非token的标量形式注入冻结骨干模型并与可见的符号状态组合。
AI.method: 引入ChronoState组合时间状态基准；符号状态出现在提示词中，经过秒数tau通过隐藏的计时注入通道提供；使用Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct冻结bf16骨干，采用31维正弦加对数时间编码、门控FiLM残差调制和rank-8 LoRA动作表面。
AI.result: 隐藏时间CI达到0.9305±0.0134准确率；无时间和洗牌时间对照分别降至0.5511±0.0042和0.3323±0.0097。跨模板、时长和多约束组合泛化强，但跨配额族迁移弱（0.5065±0.0559），而提示词+LoRA时间戳基线达0.9893±0.0052。
AI.conclusion: ChronoState支持一个窄结论：隐藏经过时间可在直接监督下与符号任务状态组合，但不能建立自主时间追踪、广泛的未见族抽象或优于提示词注入时间戳的优越性。

title: Model the Edit, Not the Image: Visual Autoregressive Editing from a Source-Centric Perspective
summary: Next-scale visual autoregressive models (VARs) have emerged as a powerful generative paradigm, producing high-quality images through efficient coarse-to-fine prediction. However, their potential for text-guided image editing remains largely underexplored. Existing training-free VAR editing approaches often formulate editing as target-conditioned regeneration guided or constrained by the source image, and may rely on inversion, test-time optimization, attention control, or user-provided masks. This generation-centric formulation does not fully exploit the multiscale source representations provided by VARs and may introduce additional computation or intervention. We instead take a source-centric perspective on VAR editing, in which the encoded source image tokens serve as the primary visual state and the editing process focuses on condition-induced changes. Based on this perspective, we propose \textbf{EditMod}, which compares source- and target-conditioned predictions under a shared autoregressive context, treats their difference as a scale-wise editing direction, and applies it as a residual update to source tokens at selected scales. Experiments show that EditMod achieves leading source-image fidelity while maintaining strong text alignment, and completes end-to-end editing of a 1K image in only 1.57 seconds on a single A100 GPU without per-image preparation.

AI.tldr: EditMod是一种基于源中心视角的文本引导图像编辑方法，用于视觉自回归模型（VARs）。它通过比较共享自回归上下文下源与目标条件预测的差异，将其作为尺度级编辑方向，并以残差更新的方式应用到源token上，实现无需逐图准备的高效端到端编辑（1K图像仅需1.57秒）。
AI.motivation: 现有的VAR编辑方法采用生成中心视角，将编辑视为受源图像引导或约束的目标条件再生，需要依赖反演、测试时优化、注意力控制或用户掩码，没能充分利用VAR提供的多尺度源表征，且引入了额外计算或人工干预。
AI.method: 提出源中心视角：编码后的源图像token作为主要视觉状态，编辑过程聚焦于条件引起的改变。具体通过比较源条件和目标条件在共享自回归上下文下的预测，将二者差异作为尺度级编辑方向，以残差更新方式应用到选定尺度的源token上。
AI.result: EditMod在保持强文本对齐的同时实现了领先的源图像保真度，并且在单块A100 GPU上仅需1.57秒即可完成1K图像的端到端编辑，且无需逐图准备。
AI.conclusion: 通过从生成中心转向源中心的编辑范式，EditMod证明可以更充分地利用VAR的多尺度源表征，实现高效且高保真的文本引导图像编辑，无需额外计算或人工干预。

title: TRACE: TRajectory Attribution for Automated Context Engineering
summary:
Production AI agents fail when their context sources -- system prompts, knowledge bases, tool descriptions, and procedural skills -- contain errors or gaps. Current maintenance relies on manual log review and ad-hoc debugging, creating a scalability bottleneck as interaction volume grows.
  We present TRACE (TRajectory Attribution for Automated Context Engineering), an automated feedback loop that mines historical agent trajectories to diagnose and remediate context failures. Our key insight is that trajectories are rich with implicit dissatisfaction signals -- user corrections, rephrasing, abandonment cues -- that reveal precisely where context sources failed, without explicit feedback collection. Unlike model fine-tuning, TRACE operates on the context layer, enabling rapid iteration without retraining.
  We make four contributions: (1) a trajectory mining framework that systematically extracts diagnostic information from historical agent executions; (2) multi-component causal attribution that extends textual gradients from monolithic prompt optimization to heterogeneous context sources (skills, knowledge bases, tools, prompts); (3) exploratory verification, where agents actively read context sources to distinguish content gaps requiring CREATE from stale content requiring UPDATE, achieving 96% operation accuracy; and (4) a reusable simulation methodology and verifiable benchmark addressing the absence of open datasets for context debugging, with a six-category fault taxonomy, ground truth annotations, and a cross-layer verification protocol.
  On 60 dissatisfaction traces spanning three complexity tiers (up to 16 execution nodes), TRACE achieves 72.7% root cause attribution and 82% end-to-end fix effectiveness, showing that over 80% of context-layer failures can be automatically diagnosed and remediated by mining historical trajectories, an overlooked resource in production systems.

AI.tldr: TRACE是一个自动化反馈循环系统，通过挖掘历史agent轨迹中的隐含不满信号（用户纠正、重述、放弃行为）来诊断和修复上下文层故障，无需模型微调即可实现快速迭代，在60条不满轨迹上达到72.7%根因归因准确率和82%端到端修复效果。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中的AI agent常因上下文源（系统提示、知识库、工具描述、程序技能）中的错误或缺口而失败，当前依赖人工日志审查和临时调试，随着交互量增长形成可扩展性瓶颈。
AI.method: TRACE包含四个核心贡献：(1)轨迹挖掘框架，系统性地从历史agent执行中提取诊断信息；(2)多组件因果归因，将文本梯度从单一prompt优化扩展到异构上下文源；(3)探索性验证，agent主动读取上下文源以区分内容缺口（需要CREATE）与过时内容（需要UPDATE），达到96%操作准确率；(4)可复用的仿真方法和可验证基准，包含六类故障分类法、真值标注和跨层验证协议。
AI.result: 在60条不满轨迹上（跨越三个复杂度层级，最多16个执行节点），TRACE达到72.7%根因归因准确率和82%端到端修复效果，并实现96%的操作准确率。
AI.conclusion: 超过80%的上下文层故障可以通过挖掘历史轨迹来自动诊断和修复，历史轨迹是生产系统中被忽视的重要资源，TRACE证明了这一点并提供了完整的解决方案。

title: Learning human joint torques from pixels
summary: Estimating human joint torques from visual observations is a key step toward bringing biomechanical analysis from controlled laboratories to real-world movement scenarios. Existing torque estimation methods typically depend on surface electromyography, motion-capture markers, force plates, or simulated imitation data, which limits their applicability to ordinary RGB images. In this work, we introduce VID, a vision-based inverse dynamics dataset and benchmark for predicting human joint torques directly from real monocular images. VID contains 63,369 synchronized frames with real human images, kinematic annotations, anthropometric attributes, and OpenSim-derived dynamic labels, providing paired visual and biomechanical supervision for real-image inverse dynamics. We further define a standardized evaluation protocol covering overall torque estimation, joint-specific analysis, and action-specific prediction. To establish a strong reference model, we propose VID-Network, which combines pose-pretrained spatial probabilistic features, marker regression, and temporal torque inference to recover joint torques from image sequences. Experiments on VID show that VID-Network achieves an overall mPJE of 1.7612 N$\cdot$m/kg, improving over the best compared baseline by 39.81\%, and obtains the lowest error across all evaluated joint types and most action categories. VID establishes a first practical benchmark for vision-driven human inverse dynamics and provides a foundation for studying biomechanical inference in less constrained environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了VID，一个基于视觉的逆动力学数据集和基准，用于直接从真实单目图像预测人体关节力矩。VID包含63,369帧同步数据，并提出了VID-Network模型，在关节力矩预测上取得39.81%的相对误差降低。
AI.motivation: 现有的人体关节力矩估计方法依赖表面肌电、动捕标记、力板或模拟数据，难以应用于普通RGB图像。作者希望将生物力学分析从受控实验室推广到真实世界场景，因此需要建立一个基于真实图像的逆动力学基准。
AI.method: 作者构建了VID数据集，包含同步的真实人体图像、运动学标注、人体测量属性和OpenSim导出的动力学标签。同时提出VID-Network，该网络结合姿态预训练的空间概率特征、标记点回归和时间序列力矩推理，从图像序列中恢复关节力矩。
AI.result: VID-Network在VID上取得整体mPJE为1.7612 N·m/kg，相比最佳基线提升39.81%，并在所有关节类型和大多数动作类别上取得最低误差。
AI.conclusion: VID建立了首个实用的视觉驱动人体逆动力学基准，为在较少约束环境下研究生物力学推断提供了基础，推动了从实验室到真实场景的生物力学分析应用。

title: CIDER: A Dataset of Contextual Disclosure Boundaries for Privacy Preference Alignment
summary: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human privacy preferences requires capturing individuals' disclosure boundaries beyond general privacy norms. However, a gap remains in eliciting such nuanced preferences to evaluate alignment in realistic settings. We introduce CIDER, a dataset of 14,850 human annotations from 169 users, forming 1,650 contextual disclosure boundary sets across 60 interpersonal communication scenarios involving information sharing that violates privacy norms. Each boundary represents a real user's disclosure decisions over 9 sharing variants in a scenario, for a given communication role and AI-mediated condition. We formulate a task in which models predict a user's disclosure decision from historical boundaries, with varying levels of contextual information. Across 12 open and proprietary models, in-context personalization improves prediction accuracy by up to 11.41 percentage points using only 6 historical examples. Larger models such as GPT-5.4 (with medium reasoning effort) and Claude Sonnet 4.6 are better at leveraging semantic context to understand user-specific, context-dependent disclosure preferences for more accurate predictions, while smaller models tend to rely on structured heuristics based on disclosure granularity and identifiability. Personalization generally improves prediction accuracy, but the improvement is often accompanied by imbalanced shifts in false-positive and false-negative rates across models, with only Claude Sonnet 4.6 achieving balanced improvements in both. Our findings reveal both the promise and limitations of inference-time personalization for privacy preference modeling and position CIDER as a resource for advancing personalized privacy alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CIDER数据集（14,850条人类标注、169名用户、1,650个情境化披露边界集、覆盖60个对话场景），用于评估大语言模型在个性化隐私偏好建模方面的对齐能力。实验发现基于上下文的个性化能将预测准确率提升最多11.41个百分点，但不同模型的提升在假阳性和假阴性率上存在不均衡偏移，仅Claude Sonnet 4.6实现了二者的均衡提升。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM与人类隐私偏好的对齐缺乏对个体化披露边界的捕捉——隐私偏好不仅是通用规范，更依赖个人的具体情境和角色。因此需要一个能表达细微、上下文依赖的个体披露偏好的数据集来评估模型在现实场景中的隐私对齐表现。
AI.method: 构建CIDER数据集，收集169名用户在60个人际沟通场景中对9种信息分享变体的真实披露决策。定义了一个预测任务：模型根据用户的历史披露边界，在不同上下文信息水平下预测该用户当前的披露决策。对12个开源及专有模型进行了系统评估，比较不同规模模型在个性化预测中的表现及误差分布。
AI.result: 1) 仅用6个历史样例进行上下文个性化，预测准确率最高提升11.41个百分点；2) 大型模型（如GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6）能更好利用语义上下文理解用户特定偏好，而小模型更依赖基于披露粒度与可识别性的结构化启发式；3) 个性化在多数模型中伴随假阳性/假阴性率的不均衡偏移，仅Claude Sonnet 4.6实现了二者均衡提升。
AI.conclusion: 推断时个性化在隐私偏好建模上既有显著潜力也存在局限：模型规模的扩大有助于语义级隐私理解，但预测误差的均衡性仍是当前对齐的一大挑战。CIDER为推进个性化隐私对齐研究提供了重要资源。

title: TLDChoiceNet: Quantitatively Choosing a Transfer Learning Dataset
summary: Transfer learning is particularly useful in settings with limited training data, and within image classification it is common to transfer learn upon massive datasets like ImageNet , CIFAR-100, or COCO . Qualitatively, it seems a transfer learning dataset should have both more classes and more examples per class than the fine tuning dataset; however, a quantitative method to choose the best transfer learning dataset does not currently exist. In this paper, we design TLDChoiceNet, a model to choose the best transfer learning dataset given a fine tuning dataset by predicting the test-set accuracy after fine-tuning. A simple version 1 achieves 0.154 MSE on the test dataset, while a version 2 leveraging an ImageNet pre-trained ResNet50 v2 embedding with per-class information attains a 5X lower MSE of 0.031. We further design two metrics that enable an unsupervised method of choosing an optimal transfer learning dataset: distribution distance (DD), which linearly regresses against fine-tune accuracy with an R2 of 0.89, and average class correlation (ACC), which improves the R2 to 0.97. Our results underscore that a dataset's low-level statistics can explain the transfer learning effect, and that using a pre-trained ImageNet can embed different classes further apart in latent feature space.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TLDChoiceNet模型，用于在给定微调数据集时选择最佳的迁移学习数据集。通过预测微调后的测试集准确率来实现选择，并设计了两个无监督指标（分布距离DD和平均类相关性ACC）来指导数据集选择，实验表明低层统计特征能解释迁移学习效果。
AI.motivation: 在图像分类中，迁移学习通常基于ImageNet、CIFAR-100或COCO等大规模数据集，但当前缺乏定量的方法来选择最优的迁移学习数据集，只能依赖定性判断（如类别数量和每类样本数应多于微调数据集）。
AI.method: 设计了TLDChoiceNet模型来预测微调后的测试集准确率，从而选择最佳迁移学习数据集。包含两个版本：简单版v1（MSE 0.154）和利用ImageNet预训练ResNet50 v2嵌入及每类信息的v2版（MSE降低5倍至0.031）。此外设计了两个无监督指标：分布距离（DD）和平均类相关性（ACC），分别达到R²为0.89和0.97的线性回归效果。
AI.result: TLDChoiceNet v1达到0.154 MSE，v2版本将MSE降低5倍至0.031。分布距离和平均类相关性指标分别以R²为0.89和0.97的拟合度与微调准确率线性相关。
AI.conclusion: 数据集的低层统计特征能够解释迁移学习效果，且使用ImageNet预训练模型可以将不同类别在潜在特征空间中嵌入得更远，从而提升迁移学习的有效性。

title: From Relevance to Execution Utility: Reward-Aware Dynamic Execution Gating for Skill-Based LLM Agents
summary: Agent skills are increasingly used to equip large language model (LLM) agents with reusable procedural knowledge. Although recent work has substantially improved skill retrieval due to the increasing skill libraries, retrieving a plausible skill bundle does not guarantee that executing it is worthwhile. Since every skill-conditioned rollout is computationally expensive, deciding whether a retrieved bundle should be executed has become an increasingly important challenge. To this end, we introduce the Reward-Aware Dynamic Execution Gate (RADEG), a lightweight, retriever-agnostic decision layer between skill retrieval and agent execution. RADEG learns a low-cost surrogate model that predicts the execution utility of a query--bundle pair before the expensive rollout is launched. To obtain informative supervision while controlling for task difficulty, we locally perturb each retrieved bundle by deleting, adding, or replacing one skill, producing matched same-query rollouts that isolate the effect of bundle composition on verifier reward. During deployment, RADEG updates only a warm-started logistic head as new verifier feedback becomes available, enabling inexpensive adaptation of the execute/skip boundary without retraining either the retriever or the agent. Under a query-level held-out evaluation on 288 collected rollouts, RADEG substantially reduces unnecessary agent executions while preserving a large fraction of the downstream verifier reward. It consistently outperforms relevance-based and random gating across different execution budgets, demonstrating that execution-aware surrogate modeling provides a practical and cost-effective complement to skill retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RADEG（Reward-Aware Dynamic Execution Gate），一个轻量级的、与检索器无关的决策层，位于技能检索和智能体执行之间。RADEG通过学习低成本替代模型来预测查询-技能包对的执行效用，在昂贵的实际执行前决定是否值得执行。通过局部扰动技能包生成匹配的对照样本，并在部署时仅更新逻辑回归头以低成本适应，从而大幅减少不必要的智能体执行，同时保留大部分下游验证器奖励。
AI.motivation: 随着技能库规模增大，技能检索的准确性虽有提升，但检索到合理的技能包并不能保证执行它是值得的。由于每次技能条件化执行（rollout）计算开销巨大，如何在执行前判断检索到的技能包是否值得执行成为一个日益重要的挑战。现有的相关性基线和随机门控方法无法有效考虑执行效用。
AI.method: RADEG包含三个关键设计：(1) 学习一个低成本替代模型，预测查询-技能包对的执行效用（验证器奖励）；(2) 通过局部扰动每个检索到的技能包（删除、添加或替换一个技能），生成匹配的同一查询对照样本，以隔离技能包组合对验证器奖励的影响，获得信息丰富的监督信号并控制任务难度；(3) 部署时仅更新一个热启动的逻辑回归头，利用新的验证器反馈实现执行/跳过边界的低成本自适应，无需重新训练检索器或智能体。
AI.result: 在288个收集的rollout上进行查询级别留出评估，RADEG大幅减少了不必要的智能体执行，同时保留了大部分下游验证器奖励。在不同执行预算下，RADEG一致优于基于相关性的门控和随机门控方法。
AI.conclusion: 执行感知的替代建模为技能检索提供了实用且成本效益高的补充方案。RADEG证明了在执行前进行效用预测是可行且有效的，为大规模LLM智能体系统中的资源优化提供了新思路。

title: SI-Edit: Toward Sketch-Instruction Guided Local Image Editing with Pixel-Level Precision
summary: Despite rapid advances in generative models, achieving pixel-level precision in sketch-based image editing remains a persistent challenge, particularly for fine-grained local deformations. This gap stems primarily from the critical shortage of high-quality, publicly available benchmark datasets that jointly provide geometric constraints and semantic instructions. To address this issue, we first introduce **SI-Data**, a high-quality dataset specifically designed for instruction-guided local sketch editing. We develop an automated pipeline leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to synthesize comprehensive quadruplets comprising original images, local geometric sketches, semantic instructions, and corresponding edited images. By providing both reliable spatial anchors and explicit semantic intent, SI-Data uniquely enables collaborative spatial-semantic learning. Building upon this, we propose a collaborative framework called **SI-Edit** that integrates semantic instructions with precise geometric constraints. Furthermore, to address the lack of standardized evaluation, we establish a comprehensive set of metrics designed to measure both structural fidelity (e.g., sketch-to-edge alignment) and semantic adherence. Experimental results demonstrate that SI-Edit provides more reliable structural control than baselines for sketch-based image editing, and achieves precise, pixel-level local refinements aligned with user intent. The data and code are released on the [project page](https://github.com/ywxsuperstar/SIEdit).

AI.tldr: 本文提出SI-Data数据集和SI-Edit框架，解决基于草图的图像编辑中像素级精度不足的问题。SI-Data利用多模态大语言模型自动生成包含原图、局部几何草图、语义指令和编辑后图像的四元组数据；SI-Edit将语义指令与精确几何约束协作融合，实现精细的局部编辑，并通过新的评估指标验证了其结构保真度和语义一致性方面的优越性。
AI.motivation: 基于草图的图像编辑在细粒度局部形变方面仍缺乏像素级精度，根本原因在于缺少同时提供几何约束和语义指令的高质量公开基准数据集。现有数据集的不足阻碍了该领域的发展。
AI.method: 1) 提出SI-Data数据集，利用多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)构建自动化流水线，合成包含原始图像、局部几何草图、语义指令和编辑后图像的四元组数据。2) 提出SI-Edit协作框架，将语义指令与精确几何约束有机结合。3) 建立综合评估指标，同时衡量结构保真度（如草图到边缘对齐）和语义遵循度。
AI.result: 实验结果表明SI-Edit在结构控制方面优于基线方法，能够实现符合用户意图的精确像素级局部细化编辑。
AI.conclusion: 通过SI-Data数据集填补了数据缺失的空白，SI-Edit框架验证了空间-语义协作学习的有效性，为基于草图的图像编辑提供了可靠的解决方案，且数据和代码已开源。

title: Agentic Router: An Execution-Grounded Continual Learning Approach With Memory
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents provide a promising interface for command-line-based network operations, but a plausible command may still fail or introduce operational risk after execution. Existing approaches mainly focus on command generation or final configuration correctness, and do not use execution-grounded experience to jointly improve candidate coverage and action selection. We propose an execution-grounded dual-path consequence-aware agent for CLI-based SONiC operations, which generates multiple complete actions, predicts their execution consequences, and selects the final action through utility- and risk-aware reranking. The proposal-side path abstracts reusable operational lessons into retrievable guidance to improve feasible-action coverage without modifying the proposal LLM, while the selection-side path adapts the consequence predictor through session-level LoRA updates using real SSH feedback to improve conditional selection quality. Experiments over multi-turn SONiC operation sessions with different Qwen3 proposal models show that the framework improves feasible-action coverage and top-1 execution success, and that the two adaptation paths provide complementary gains over interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出一个面向命令行SONiC网络运维的执行落地双路径后果感知智能体框架，通过生成多条候选动作、预测执行后果及效用/风险重排序提升可行动作覆盖率和顶端执行成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体用于CLI网络运维时，仅关注命令生成或最终配置正确性，未利用执行落地的经验来联合改善候选覆盖与动作选择，导致可行的命令仍可能失败或引入运维风险。
AI.method: 采用双路径架构：提案侧将可复用的运维经验抽象为可检索指导，在不修改提案LLM的前提下提升可行动作覆盖；选择侧通过会话级LoRA更新适配后果预测器，利用真实SSH反馈改善条件选择质量。最终通过效用与风险感知的重排序选取最终动作。
AI.result: 在多种Qwen3提案模型的多轮SONiC运维会话实验中，框架提升了可行动作覆盖率和Top-1执行成功率，且两条适应路径在交互过程中提供互补增益。
AI.conclusion: 执行落地经验可有效提升LLM智能体在CLI网络运维中的候选生成质量与动作选择准确性，双路径互补增强策略优于单一优化方向。

title: Contrastive Mask Fidelity: Reference-Free Auditing of Ground-Truth Masks in Remote Sensing Semantic Segmentation
summary: Semantic segmentation models are trained and evaluated against human-drawn masks, yet remote-sensing annotations are often coarse, incomplete, or misaligned; high overlap scores may then reflect agreement with imperfect labels rather than faithfulness to the image, creating an evaluation paradox. We introduce Contrastive Mask Fidelity (CMF), a training-free, reference-free metric that scores competing class masks directly against image evidence. CMF composites keep and erase counterfactual views of each mask and asks a frozen vision-language judge whether class evidence is concentrated inside the mask and absent outside. We validate CMF on controlled mask corruptions, then audit 10,731 image-class pairs across ten remote-sensing benchmarks using candidate masks from Seg-Probe, a training-free open-vocabulary probe built on SegEarth-OV3 that outperforms prior baselines on nine of ten datasets. The audit reveals systematic, class-dependent annotation distortion: man-made classes such as buildings, roads, and cars favor the candidate mask on 62-85% of pairs, whereas ambiguous land cover more often favors human annotations. On a blinded three-annotator consensus, CMF matches expert judgment on 81% of pairs, exceeding keep-only scoring, model confidence, and a trained label-quality baseline. Finally, conservative class-wise arbitration yields supervision that improves cross-domain transfer over raw annotations and matched replacement controls, positioning CMF as a scalable tool for auditing ground truth rather than presuming it infallible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对比掩码保真度（CMF），一个无需训练、无需参考的度量指标，通过对比"保留"和"擦除"的反事实视图，直接用图像证据评估语义分割候选掩码的质量。在十个遥感基准的10,731个图像-类别对上审计后发现，人造类别（建筑、道路、汽车）的候选掩码更优（62-85%），而模糊土地覆盖则人类标注更优。CMF在81%的配对中与专家判断一致，超越现有基线，其保守的类别级仲裁可提升跨域迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 遥感分割标注常存在粗糙、不完整或错位的问题，导致高重叠分数可能反映的是与不完美标签的一致性而非对图像的忠实度，形成评估悖论。现有指标依赖人类标注，无法公正衡量分割质量，需要一种直接基于图像证据的评估方法。
AI.method: CMF通过创建掩码内"保留"和掩码外"擦除"的反事实视图，使用冻结的视觉-语言模型判断类别证据是否集中在掩码内部而外部缺失。同时引入Seg-Probe（基于SegEarth-OV3的无训练开放词汇探针）生成候选掩码，并采用保守的类别级仲裁进行监督学习。
AI.result: CMF在受控掩码损坏验证中有效；审计10个基准数据集揭示了系统性的、与类别相关的标注失真模式；在三个标注者的盲审共识上，CMF在81%的配对中匹配专家判断，优于仅保留评分、模型置信度和训练过的标签质量基线。
AI.conclusion: CMF可作为大规模审计地面真值而非假定其无误的可扩展工具，通过保守的类别级仲裁产生的监督能改善跨域迁移性能，优于原始标注和匹配的替换对照。

title: Structure-Preserving Uncertainty Propagation in First-Order Proof Search
comment: 79 pages, 6 figures. Executable binaries, documentation, examples, and public samplers: https://github.com/tammet/gkreasoner
summary:
GK is a query-directed first-order prover that extends ordinary resolution-based proof search with explicit positive and negative claims, numerical confidence values, and prioritized default rules with exceptions. It works directly with non-ground clauses, including equality and function terms. Candidate proofs are found by bounded first-order proof search; exception conditions of defaults are checked by further bounded searches, recursively when exceptions themselves depend on defaults. This avoids requiring a finite global grounding, while allowing incomplete searches to be reported as such.
  This paper adds structure-preserving quantitative reporting to that framework. Retained proof histories are used in two calculations. The first reconstructs the uncertain ground premises used by each proof and computes the probability that at least one retained proof is available, without counting shared premises independently. The second resolves positive and negative support at intermediate atoms before that support is propagated through later rules; the same calculation evaluates uncertain exception conditions for individual rule applications. Reports separate positive support, negative support, conflict, and ignorance and identify detected incomplete calculations or fallbacks. The implementation performs bounded reconstruction and dependency traversal after proof search and still requires no global grounding. Analytic examples and independent simulators reproduce the reference calculations on their stated fragments. Comparisons with probabilistic logic, probabilistic ASP, default logic, and goal-directed ASP identify cases of agreement, semantic difference, unsupported translation, and incomplete computation.

AI.tldr: 本文在查询导向的一阶自动定理证明器GK框架中，增加了保留结构信息的定量报告功能。通过利用保留的证明历史进行两种计算：一是重构不确定的基前提并计算至少一个证明可用的概率（不重复计算共享前提）；二是在中间原子处解析正负支持后再向后传播，并评估不确定的例外条件。报告区分正支持、负支持、冲突和未知，并标识不完整的计算。该方法无需全局基化，实验和分析案例验证了其正确性。
AI.motivation: GK证明器虽然能处理带例外条件的优先默认规则和数值置信度，但缺乏结构化的定量报告机制。现有方法在报告不确定前提的概率支持时，可能会重复计算共享前提，且对中间原子的正负支持处理不够精细，需要一种无需全局基化、能忠实反映证明结构与不确定性传播的报告框架。
AI.method: 利用保留的证明历史进行两种计算：(1) 重构每个证明使用的不确定基前提，计算出至少一个保留证明可用的概率，避免对共享前提重复计数；(2) 在中间原子处先解析正负支持，再将支持向后传播到后续规则，同时用相同计算评估个别规则应用的不确定例外条件。报告区分正支持、负支持、冲突和未知，并标记检测到的不完整计算或回退。实现采用有界重构和依赖遍历，在证明搜索后进行，不需要全局基化。
AI.result: 通过解析例子和独立模拟器在指定片段上复现了参考计算。与概率逻辑、概率ASP、默认逻辑和目标导向ASP的比较，识别出一致、语义差异、不支持的翻译和不完整计算等情形。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够在无需全局基化的前提下，为带默认规则和例外条件的一阶证明搜索提供结构保持的定量报告，正确区分支持类型并揭示不确定性传播路径，同时明确了与其他逻辑框架的语义边界。

title: View-Adaptive Renderer for View-Consistent 2D-to-3D Generation
summary: Reconstructing 3D shapes from a single image remains a fundamental yet challenging problem in computer vision. Traditional monocular 3D generation pipelines typically synthesize multiple views from a single input image before applying Neural Radiance Field (NeRF)-based reconstruction. However, inherent projective ambiguities often produce visual discontinuities across generated viewpoints, leading to inaccuracies in reconstructed 3D models. Current solutions either incur significant additional computational burdens or fail to adequately resolve practical inconsistencies between synthesized views. To address these limitations, we propose a novel viewpoint-adaptive neural rendering framework that enables robust 3D reconstruction even when given partially inconsistent multi-view inputs. Our approach introduces view-adaptive neural renderers that independently correct viewpoint-dependent errors while simultaneously sharing a global feature backbone to preserve structural coherence. Furthermore, we propose a self-attention fusion module that adaptively integrates multi-view information, ensuring geometric consistency without relying heavily on indirect regularizations or computationally intensive methods. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our method consistently improves 3D reconstruction fidelity. Importantly, our approach achieves near state-of-the-art performance without diffusion-based SDS supervision, relying primarily on photometric rendering loss with lightweight attention regularizers. This balance between accuracy and efficiency makes the proposed framework highly practical for real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种视角自适应的神经渲染框架，能够从单一图像重建3D形状，即使面对部分不一致的多视角输入也能实现鲁棒重建。该方法引入视角自适应神经渲染器独立修正视角相关误差，同时共享全局特征骨干以保持结构一致性，并通过自注意力融合模块自适应整合多视角信息。
AI.motivation: 传统的单目3D生成流程通常先从单图合成多视角，再进行基于NeRF的重建。然而固有的投影歧义会导致生成视角间出现视觉不连续，造成重建3D模型不准确。现有解决方案要么带来显著的计算负担，要么无法充分解决合成视角之间的实际不一致问题。
AI.method: 提出一个新颖的视角自适应神经渲染框架，包含三个关键组件：(1) 视角自适应神经渲染器，独立修正视角相关误差；(2) 全局特征骨干共享机制，保持结构连贯性；(3) 自注意力融合模块，自适应整合多视角信息以确保几何一致性，无需依赖间接正则化或计算密集型方法。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法持续提升3D重建保真度。在不使用扩散SDS监督的情况下，仅依靠光度渲染损失和轻量注意力正则化即可达到接近最先进的性能水平。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在准确性与效率之间取得良好平衡，使框架对实际应用具有高度实用性，为解决单目3D重建中多视角不一致问题提供了有效方案。

title: Signature-Guided Capacity Occupancy for Dense Expert Merging
summary: Dense expert merging combines domain-specialized language models into one single checkpoint, typically by admitting task-vector support in weight space. However, this admission is governed by three decisions that existing methods answer only partially: where to open layer capacity from cross-expert conflict, who should occupy that capacity based on domain demand, and how to admit the resulting support without relying on costly recipe search. To tackle these issues, we propose SigMerge (Signature-Guided Capacity Occupancy), a structured capacity assignment framework for dense expert merging. Starting from a dense base merge, conflict signatures set each layer's capacity from cross-expert conflict, positive base-merge deficits set each domain's share of that capacity, and a sequential occupancy rule admits each expert delta up to the resulting layer-domain budget. Across 21 paired settings spanning seven dense base merges and three model pools, SigMerge improves every one (by 15.0% on average) and achieves the best average rank (1.67) among six merging methods, outperforming three categories of merging baselines.

AI.tldr: SigMerge是一种面向稠密专家合并的结构化容量分配框架，通过冲突签名设定层容量、正基合并赤字分配领域份额、顺序占用规则按预算注入专家增量，在21个配对设置中全部提升，平均提升15.0%，平均排名1.67，优于三类合并基线。
AI.motivation: 现有稠密专家合并方法在三个关键决策上只能部分回答：哪里（where）从跨专家冲突中开放层容量、谁（who）基于领域需求占用该容量、以及如何（how）无需昂贵配方搜索地注入支持。
AI.method: SigMerge采用三个步骤：1) 冲突签名从跨专家冲突中确定每层的容量；2) 正基合并赤字确定每个领域在该容量中的份额；3) 顺序占用规则在层-领域预算内注入每个专家增量。
AI.result: 在21个配对设置（涵盖7个稠密基合并和3个模型池）中，SigMerge全部得到改进（平均提升15.0%），取得最佳平均排名（1.67），优于三类别共六种合并方法。
AI.conclusion: SigMerge通过结构化的容量分配框架系统地解决了稠密专家合并中的关键决策问题，无需搜索即可实现一致且显著的性能提升，优于现有合并基线。

title: Visual Distortion Detection in UGC Images Using Large Multimodal Models
summary:
The localized depiction of perceptual quality has long been a crucial, yet underexplored, challenge in image quality assessment (IQA). Existing approaches based on large multimodal models (LMMs) predominantly rely on text-driven supervised fine-tuning (SFT).
  However, this training paradigm exhibits notable limitations in detection accuracy. Moreover, synthetically distorted images, which are often used as the primary training data source,
  show a significant generalization gap when deployed in real-world scenarios; thus, the \textbf{synthetic-to-authentic (\textit{S2A})} problem represents a critical challenge. Motivated by these issues, we propose \textbf{\textit{VIGIL}}, which leverages the LMM architecture for precise visual distortion detection. From a candidate pool of over 1000K samples, we construct the \textbf{\textit{VIGIL-140K}} training set, which consists of over 140K distorted images. These images are obtained through rigorous quality filtering and carefully crafted distortion injection, covering 8 major synthetic distortion categories.
  Our model leverages different layers of the large language model (LLM) decoder, treating them as \textit{multiple detectors} that perform synchronous distortion detection using multi-level features. Additionally, we retain distortion cues from predictions assigned to the non-distortion class, which helps mitigate the ambiguous foreground-background (\textit{FG-BG}) separation commonly encountered in the \textit{S2A} problem.
  After post-processing, our model consistently outperforms strong baselines on both in-domain synthetic distortion detection and \textit{S2A} tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VIGIL，一种基于大多模态模型（LMM）的图像质量评估方法，用于精确的视觉失真检测。构建了包含14万张失真图像的VIGIL-140K训练集，利用LLM解码器多层作为多检测器进行同步失真检测，并保留非失真类别的预测线索以缓解合成到真实（S2A）场景下的前后景分离问题，在域内合成失真检测和S2A任务上均优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于LMM的IQA方法依赖文本驱动的监督微调（SFT），在检测精度上存在明显局限；同时合成失真图像与真实场景之间存在显著的泛化差距（即S2A问题），这构成了图像质量评估中的关键挑战。
AI.method: 1) 从超100万候选样本中构建VIGIL-140K训练集，包含14万+失真图像，通过严格质量过滤和精心设计的失真注入，覆盖8大类合成失真；2) 利用LLM解码器的不同层作为多个检测器，使用多层级特征进行同步失真检测；3) 保留非失真类别的预测线索，缓解S2A问题中的前后景（FG-BG）模糊分离。
AI.result: 经过后处理后，VIGIL在域内合成失真检测和S2A任务上均持续优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过构造大规模高质量训练集和利用LMM多层级特征的同步检测策略，结合对非失真类别信号的保留，VIGIL有效解决了定位失真检测精度不足和S2A泛化问题，验证了该方法的有效性。

title: CRUISE: Vision-Language Model-Guided Uncertainty-Aware Cross-Modal Sensor Fusion for Robust Autonomous Driving
summary: Modern autonomous vehicles are equipped with multiple sensors, such as cameras, LiDAR, and radar, for comprehensive environmental perception. However, robust cross-modal feature fusion remains a critical challenge, as the reliability of each sensor varies significantly across diverse real-world driving conditions, including poor visibility and adverse weather. While uncertainty quantification (UQ) mitigates this issue by allowing models to prioritize reliable signals, existing uncertainty-aware fusion methods typically rely on simple feature-level uncertainty estimates and thus often fail to generalize effectively in complex, out-of-distribution scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose CRUISE, a novel uncertainty-aware cross-modal sensor fusion framework. CRUISE integrates a vision-language model (VLM)-guided UQ module that generates fine-grained, pixel-level uncertainty estimates. By leveraging the VLM's rich prior knowledge and superior contextual reasoning, our approach provides a highly informative guide for the fusion process. Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic adaptive mechanism that explicitly models and captures cross-modal dependencies, ensuring the framework fully exploits the inherent complementary nature of multi-sensor inputs.

AI.tldr: CRUISE是一个新型的不确定性感知跨模态传感器融合框架，利用视觉语言模型(VLM)生成细粒度像素级不确定性估计，并引入动态自适应机制建模跨模态依赖，以提升自动驾驶在复杂恶劣条件下的多传感器融合鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶车辆配备多种传感器，但跨模态特征融合面临挑战，因为各传感器在不同驾驶条件下可靠性差异大。现有不确定性感知融合方法仅依赖简单的特征级不确定性估计，难以在复杂分布外场景中有效泛化。
AI.method: CRUISE框架包含两个核心组件：(1) VLM引导的不确定性量化(UQ)模块，利用视觉语言模型的先验知识和上下文推理能力生成细粒度像素级不确定性估计，为融合过程提供高信息量的指导；(2) 动态自适应机制，显式建模和捕捉跨模态依赖关系，充分挖掘多传感器输入的互补特性。
AI.result: 论文摘要未提供具体的定量实验结果，但提出CRUISE框架旨在提升复杂分布外场景下跨模态融合的泛化能力和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入VLM引导的细粒度不确定性量化和动态跨模态依赖建模，CRUISE有望解决现有不确定性感知融合方法在复杂真实驾驶场景中泛化不足的局限，提升自动驾驶感知系统在恶劣环境下的可靠性。

title: When Latents Forget Pixels: Restoring Fidelity in Diffusion Transformer Super-Resolution
summary: Image super-resolution (SR) with large generative models has recently achieved remarkable perceptual quality, yet maintaining fidelity to the LR observation remains challenging. In particular, we observe that diffusion transformers (DiTs) built on latent representations suffer from a critical limitation: the compression bottleneck of the VAE weakens fine-grained spatial information, leading to hallucinated details that are weakly grounded in the input image. In this work, we revisit generative SR from a representation perspective and propose a pixel-grounded super-resolution (PGSR) framework that preserves LR-observed pixel evidence before VAE compression and reuses it throughout restoration. Instead of relying solely on the compressed latent condition, PGSR extracts pre-VAE pixel evidence from the upsampled LR image and reuses it at two stages. First, Condition-Side Trajectory Guidance fuses LR-derived pixel evidence with the latent LR condition to guide the latent restoration trajectory. Second, Decoder-Side Pixel Grounding injects multi-scale pixel features into the frozen VAE decoder to ground the final rendering with LR-observed cues. To efficiently adapt large pretrained DiT models, we keep the latent autoencoder and main flow-matching backbone frozen, and train only lightweight restoration modules. We further study an efficient local-window attention variant for improved high-resolution efficiency and scalability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PGSR improves the realism--fidelity trade-off and produces more faithful, visually convincing results than existing latent generative SR approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出像素接地超分辨率（PGSR）框架，通过在VAE压缩前提取像素证据并在条件端和解码器端重复使用，解决扩散Transformer在生成超分辨率中因潜在表示压缩瓶颈导致的幻觉细节问题，实现更好的真实感与保真度权衡。
AI.motivation: 基于大型生成模型的图像超分辨率虽取得显著感知质量，但存在保真度挑战。研究发现扩散Transformer（DiTs）在潜在表示上有关键局限性：VAE的压缩瓶颈削弱了细粒度空间信息，导致产生与输入图像弱相关的幻觉细节。
