AI.method: PGSR框架包含两个核心模块：1）Condition-Side Trajectory Guidance（条件端轨迹引导）：将LR像素证据与潜在LR条件融合，引导潜在恢复轨迹；2）Decoder-Side Pixel Grounding（解码器端像素接地）：将多尺度像素特征注入冻结的VAE解码器，用LR观测线索接地最终渲染。同时保持潜在自编码器和主流程匹配主干冻结，仅训练轻量级恢复模块，并研究局部窗口注意力变体提升高分辨率效率。
AI.result: 大量实验表明PGSR改善了真实感与保真度的权衡，相比现有潜在生成SR方法产生更忠实且视觉上更有说服力的结果。
AI.conclusion: 从表示学习视角重新审视生成式SR，证明在VAE压缩前保留并复用像素证据能够有效缓解潜在生成模型的保真度缺陷，为高性能SR提供了高效可扩展的方案。

title: Omni2LoRA: Coherence-Preserving Parametric Memory for Efficient Omni Language Models
summary: Omnimodal language models (OLMs) enable unified audio-visual understanding, but processing long joint token sequences makes inference computationally prohibitive. While recent token compression methods attempt to alleviate this burden, compressing modalities in isolation often destroys the temporal cross-modal anchors necessary for coherent reasoning. We introduce Omni2LoRA, a two-stage framework for efficient parametric memory compression via coherence-preserving context distillation that bypasses the token bottleneck entirely. First, a Perceiver hypernetwork processes intermediate representations from a frozen OLM to encode the multimodal context into a full-rank Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapter in a single forward pass. To prevent the resulting parameter footprint from scaling linearly with recording length, we optimize a discrete rank allocation policy via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that uses a modality-ablated counterfactual reward to explicitly penalize the loss of audio-visual coherence, forcing the model to allocate its fixed sub-linear rank budget to synergistic cross-modal anchors rather than isolated visual features. Across three omnimodal backbones, Omni2LoRA operating at a 30% rank budget outperforms direct full-context inference and strong token-compression baselines (OmniZip, OMAC, O-MARC) on four audio-visual question answering benchmarks, improving average accuracy by 8-12% over the strongest baseline and remaining stable under compression ratios as tight as 75%, where token-pruning methods degrade sharply. By converting multimodal memory into a fixed-budget, reusable parameter state, our method drives answer-time multimodal-token load to zero, cutting per-query Time to First Token (TTFT) by up to 12x relative to full-context inference and amortizing to under 0.5s after a handful of queries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Omni2LoRA，一种两阶段框架，通过一致性保持的上下文蒸馏实现高效的参数化记忆压缩，完全绕过token瓶颈。它使用Perceiver超网络将多模态上下文编码为低秩适配器（LoRA），并通过GRPO优化离散秩分配策略，以固定次线性秩预算分配到跨模态锚点上。在四个音视频问答基准上，以30%秩预算运行即超越全上下文推理和强token压缩基线，准确率提升8-12%，并将TTFT降低至多12倍。
AI.motivation: 全模态语言模型（OLMs）在处理长联合token序列时推理计算开销巨大。现有的token压缩方法在孤立压缩各模态时会破坏时间交叉模态锚点，导致推理连贯性受损。因此需要一种绕过token瓶颈的压缩方法，既能大幅压缩计算开销，又能保留跨模态一致性。
AI.method: Omni2LoRA采用两阶段框架：(1) Perceiver超网络从冻结的OLM中间表示中，通过单次前向传播将多模态上下文编码为全秩LoRA适配器；(2) 为避免参数随录音长度线性增长，使用GRPO优化离散秩分配策略，通过模态消融的反事实奖励显式惩罚音视频一致性的损失，迫使模型将固定次线性秩预算分配给协同的跨模态锚点而非孤立的视觉特征。
AI.result: 在三个全模态骨干网络上，Omni2LoRA以30%秩预算运行时，在四个音视频问答基准上优于直接全上下文推理和强token压缩基线（OmniZip、OMAC、O-MARC），平均准确率比最强基线提升8-12%，并在75%压缩比下保持稳定（此场景下token剪枝方法急剧退化）。每查询TTFT相对全上下文推理降低至多12倍，多次查询后摊销至0.5秒以下。
AI.conclusion: 通过将多模态记忆转换为固定预算、可复用的参数状态，Omni2LoRA将答案时的多模态token负载降至零，在显著降低推理延迟的同时保持甚至提升推理准确性，为高效全模态推理提供了一种突破token瓶颈的新范式。

title: Bright-Channel Retinex Enhancement with a Conditional Overdispered-Noise Analysis
summary: I present a training-free low-light enhancement method that combines local bright-channel illumination estimation, Retinex division, and edge-preserving denoising. For a fixed illumination estimate, a conditional Negative -Binominal psueduo-count method characterises the heteroscedastic noise amplified by division. The unconstrained reflectance ratio is the pixelwise maximum-likelihood estimate, with a boundary solution for zero-valued observations; the implemented estimate additionally applies illumination filtering and range clipping. The NB model is a diagnostic noise analysis rather than a calibrated sensor model, and the final fixed-bandwidth bilateral filter is an empirical approximation rather than the exact Bayesian solution. On the LOL-v1 dataset, the methodobtains mean PSNR/SSIM of 17.74dB/0.739, the highest values among the evaluated with conventional methods. A 400X600 image is processed at approximately 43 FPS on an Apple M2 Pro CPU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的低光图像增强方法，结合局部亮通道光照估计、Retinex除法与边缘保持去噪。通过条件负二项分布伪计数方法刻画除法放大的异方差噪声，利用像素级最大似然估计求解无约束反射率比，并在LOL-v1数据集上取得传统方法中最高的PSNR/SSIM（17.74dB/0.739），在Apple M2 Pro CPU上以约43 FPS处理400×600图像。
AI.motivation: 低光图像增强是计算机视觉中的基础问题，现有方法要么依赖大量训练数据（深度学习模型），要么在噪声放大和边缘保持之间难以平衡。作者旨在提出一种无需训练、计算高效且能有效处理Retinex除法所放大噪声的低光增强方案。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心步骤：(1) 基于局部亮通道估计光照；(2) 通过Retinex除法获得反射率，其中用条件负二项(NB)分布伪计数方法建模除法放大的异方差噪声，并通过像素级最大似然估计求解无约束反射率比（含零观测的边界解）；(3) 对估计结果进行光照滤波、范围裁剪，最后用固定带宽双边滤波器进行边缘保持去噪。
AI.result: 在LOL-v1数据集上，该方法取得平均PSNR 17.74dB、SSIM 0.739，为所评估的传统方法中最高值。在Apple M2 Pro CPU上，处理400×600图像速度约为43 FPS，展现了良好的实时性。
AI.conclusion: 作者承认方法存在局限：NB模型仅是诊断性噪声分析而非精确的传感器标定模型，双边滤波也是经验近似而非精确贝叶斯解。但实验表明该方法在传统方法中取得了最优性能，且兼具无需训练和高计算效率的优势，为低光增强提供了一种实用的无训练方案。

title: SafeSceneReason: A Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark Connecting Industrial Hazards with Accident Knowledge
summary: Industrial-safety understanding requires more than detecting workers, equipment, and personal protective equipment. Models must also assess compliance, identify hazardous interactions, explain potential accident mechanisms, and recommend preventive actions. Existing safety datasets primarily focus on visual perception or isolated violation recognition and provide limited supervision for evidence-grounded reasoning. We introduce SafeSceneReason, a multimodal industrial-safety reasoning benchmark and companion training corpus that connects workplace scenes with knowledge from occupational accident investigations. SafeSceneReason combines two complementary data-construction pipelines. The scene-centric pipeline converts annotated workplace images into executable safety scene graphs and generates deterministic answers through program execution over objects, relations, and safety rules. The report-centric pipeline extracts figures and contextual evidence from accident reports and constructs multimodal questions using evidence graphs, explicit information boundaries, multi-step reasoning paths, and iterative verification. The resulting resource contains 110,581 verified scene-centric question--answer pairs and 13,114 refined report-centric question--answer pairs, covering perception, spatial and quantitative reasoning, compliance assessment, evidence synthesis, causal analysis, and mitigation-oriented decision making. Evaluation of representative proprietary and open-source vision--language models reveals substantial performance differences and persistent weaknesses in comparative, technical, and multi-evidence reasoning, demonstrating that strong general visual understanding does not yet guarantee reliable industrial-safety reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SafeSceneReason，一个多模态工业安全推理基准和配套训练语料库，通过场景中心和数据报告中心两条数据构建管道，将工作场所图像与职业事故调查知识连接起来，包含超过12万个问答对，用于评估视觉语言模型在工业安全合规评估、事故机理推理和预防建议等方面的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的工业安全数据集主要聚焦于视觉感知或孤立的违规识别，缺乏对证据支撑推理的监督。然而，实际的工业安全理解不仅需要检测工人、设备和防护装备，还需要评估合规性、识别危险交互、解释潜在事故机制并提出预防措施，现有数据集无法满足这些更高层次的需求。
AI.method: SafeSceneReason采用两条互补的数据构建管道：(1) 场景中心管道将标注的工作场所图像转换为可执行的安防场景图，并通过在对象、关系和安防规则上执行程序生成确定性答案；(2) 报告中心管道从事故报告中提取图形和上下文证据，利用证据图、显式信息边界、多步推理路径和迭代验证构建多模态问题。最终生成110,581个已验证的场景中心问答对和13,114个报告中心问答对，涵盖感知、空间和定量推理、合规评估、证据综合、因果分析和缓解导向决策。
AI.result: 评估多种代表性专有和开源视觉语言模型后发现，这些模型存在显著的性能差异，在比较推理、技术推理和多证据推理方面持续存在弱点，表明强大的通用视觉理解能力并不能保证可靠的工业安全推理能力。
AI.conclusion: SafeSceneReason填补了工业安全推理数据集缺乏的空白，为安全关键的视觉语言模型评估提供了更全面的基准。研究结果揭示了现有VLM在工业安全领域（尤其是复杂推理任务上）的不足，为该领域的进一步发展和模型改进指明了方向。

title: CodecArena: Codec Quality Assessment via Visual Reinforcement Learning
summary: Video coding is advancing into the low and ultra-low bitrate regime, driven by end-to-end codecs that replace the hand-crafted pipeline with jointly optimized neural networks and generative codecs that exploit the priors of video generation models. Yet the dominant metrics, LPIPS and DISTS, measure feature and texture similarity rather than content fidelity: a reconstruction that hallucinates a wrong face or blurs text into convincing strokes can still score well, even when a human rejects it instantly. To address this, we propose CodecArena, the first vision-language framework for video coding quality assessment, casting codec evaluation as source-conditioned comparative reasoning between a reference and its reconstructions. We optimize CodecArena with Facet-GRPO, a visual reinforcement learning scheme that aligns pairwise codec preferences while grounding the verdict in five fidelity facets: identity, objects, text, texture, and temporal consistency. Its facet-anchored reward uses automatically derived facet directions as weak anchors, rather than human per-facet labels, to prevent any single sub-score from dominating the holistic preference and to yield interpretable fine-grained quality judgments. To support training and evaluation in this underexplored regime, we construct two complementary resources: CodecArena-1K, a fully automatic preference dataset of 1,500 comparison groups built from traditional, neural, and generative codec reconstructions with fused vision-language and objective supervision; and CodecArena-Bench, a human-ranked benchmark with source-disjoint videos for fair out-of-domain evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CodecArena achieves state-of-the-art agreement with human judgments on source-disjoint content across diverse codecs and bitrates, surpassing perceptual metrics and prior vision-language evaluators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CodecArena，首个面向视频编码质量评估的视觉-语言框架。它将编码器评估建模为源条件对比推理任务，并利用Facet-GRPO视觉强化学习方案，在五个保真度维度（身份、物体、文本、纹理、时间一致性）上对齐编码器偏好。同时构建了自动标注数据集CodecArena-1K和人排名基准CodecArena-Bench，实验表明其在跨源内容上超越了传统感知指标和现有视觉语言评估器。
AI.motivation: 现有视频编码质量评估指标（LPIPS、DISTS）衡量的是特征和纹理相似性而非内容保真度，导致幻觉性重构（如错误人脸、模糊文本）仍能获得高分，与人类判断严重不符。低码率及超低码率端到端和生成式编码器的发展加剧了这一问题的紧迫性。
AI.method: 提出CodecArena框架：(1) 将编码器评估建模为参考-重建对的源条件比较推理；(2) 引入Facet-GRPO视觉强化学习，利用自动推导的保真度方向作为弱锚点，对五个维度（身份、物体、文本、纹理、时间一致性）进行对齐；(3) 构建全自动偏好数据集CodecArena-1K（1500组比较）和人排名基准CodecArena-Bench（跨源视频）。
AI.result: 在跨源内容上，CodecArena在多种编码器和码率条件下与人类判断的一致性达到最先进水平，全面超越现有感知指标和先前的视觉语言评估器。
AI.conclusion: CodecArena证明了视觉-语言框架结合多维度弱锚定强化学习可以有效地进行细粒度、可解释的视频编码质量评估，填补了低码率编解码评估中对内容保真度缺乏关注的空白。

title: An Explainable GNN Framework for Component-Level Anomaly Diagnosis
summary: Industrial processes are complex systems composed of multiple interacting sensors that generate multivariate time series (MTS). Detecting anomalies in such systems is critical for reliability and safety, yet understanding their origin is equally important. Existing Graph Neural Network (GNN)based methods for anomaly detection primarily focus on sensor-level deviations and either attribute anomalies directly to the deviating sensors. When diagnosis is attempted, generally, the most deviated sensor is identified as a root cause of a system fault. However, in many industrial systems, anomalies do not arise from faulty sensors but from disruptions in the influences governing the system dynamics. We propose an explainable GNN-based anomaly detection framework that shifts the perspective from sensor-level anomalies to component-level diagnosis, hypothesizing that anomalous measurements are symptoms of altered inter-sensor influences. Experiments show that the method effectively identifies and prioritizes the true faulty components, providing interpretable insights into system failures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可解释的基于图神经网络（GNN）的异常检测框架，将视角从传感器级异常转移到组件级诊断，假设异常测量值是由于传感器间影响关系被改变导致的症状，而非传感器本身故障。
AI.motivation: 现有基于GNN的工业异常检测方法主要关注传感器级别的偏差，通常在诊断时将偏差最大的传感器识别为根因。然而在许多工业系统中，异常并非源于传感器故障，而是源于控制系统动态的传感器间影响的扰动，因此需要新的诊断视角。
AI.method: 提出一个可解释的GNN异常检测框架，从组件级别定位故障，通过分析传感器间影响关系的改变来识别真正的故障组件，而非简单地将最偏差的传感器视为根因。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法能有效识别并优先排序真正的故障组件，提供关于系统故障的可解释性洞见。
AI.conclusion: 将异常检测从传感器级偏差转向组件级诊断，考虑传感器间影响关系的扰动，能够更好地揭示工业系统中故障的根本原因，为系统可靠性维护提供更准确的指导。

title: UniMoFlow: Grounding Instruction-Driven 3D Human Motion Editing in Generation
comment: 18 pages, including supplementary material; 8 figures and 7 tables. Code: https://github.com/Yilei-Hua/UniMoFlow. Submitted to AAAI 2027
summary: Instruction-driven editing of 3D human motion requires precise spatiotemporal localization, rich semantic grounding, and strict preservation of unmodified content. Existing methods either resort to training-free adaptation of generative models or rely solely on triplet supervision; however, adaptation often yields suboptimal control, and manually curated triplet datasets remain severely limited in scale and semantic diversity. To overcome this bottleneck, we ground motion editing directly within text-to-motion generation across data, architecture, and inference. At the data level, we develop a closed-loop synthesis-and-verification pipeline that produces Omni-MoEdit, a large-scale dataset spanning body-part, amplitude, temporal, action, and style edits. At the architectural level, we introduce UniMoFlow, a unified latent flow-matching model that shares broad semantic and kinematic knowledge between generation and editing. At the inference level, SAFE (Source-Anchored Flow Editing) complements UniMoFlow with controllable, source-anchored refinement. Furthermore, we augment standard evaluations with semantics-aware metrics to account for valid edits that inherently deviate from a single ground-truth reference. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved target-text alignment, edit effectiveness, and cycle consistency, while maintaining competitive source fidelity and text-to-motion generation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种指令驱动的3D人体运动编辑框架，通过数据、架构和推理三个层面的创新（Omni-MoEdit数据集、UniMoFlow统一模型、SAFE源锚定编辑），解决了现有方法在时空定位、语义建基和内容保持方面的不足，并引入了语义感知评估指标。
AI.motivation: 现有运动编辑方法存在两大瓶颈：训练自由的自适应生成模型控制效果欠佳，而依赖三元组监督的方法受限于手工数据集的规模与语义多样性不足。需要更鲁棒且可扩展的运动编辑方案。
AI.method: 在数据层面构建闭环的合成-验证流水线，生成大规模数据集Omni-MoEdit（覆盖身体部位、幅度、时序、动作和风格编辑）；在架构层面提出UniMoFlow，一个统一的潜在流匹配模型，在生成与编辑间共享语义和运动学知识；在推理层面引入SAFE（源锚定流编辑）实现可控的源锚定细化；并引入语义感知评估指标。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法在目标文本对齐、编辑有效性和循环一致性方面有显著提升，同时保持了有竞争力的源保真度和文本到运动生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 将运动编辑直接锚定在文本到运动生成框架中（数据、架构、推理三个层面协同），是突破运动编辑数据瓶颈和提升编辑质量的有效途径，且需配合语义感知指标来更准确评估编辑效果。

title: Emotion2Skill: Model-Internal Emotion Signals for Adaptive Skill Selection and Evolution
summary: Skill-based LLM agents select reusable procedures from an external library to solve complex tasks, yet their routing decisions rely entirely on text-level signals such as task descriptions, verbal reflections, and experience-derived rules, while the model's own internal representational state remains unobserved. Recent interpretability work has shown that LLMs maintain linear emotion representations that causally influence behavior; however, these representations have been exploited only for post-hoc analysis or direct output steering, and have not been used to inform agent-level decision-making. We propose Emotion2Skill, a framework that extracts LLM-internal emotion vectors and incorporates them into both skill selection and skill evolution. At each decision step, a 27-dimensional emotion state is extracted from the residual stream and mapped to a confidence-gated summary injected into the routing prompt. Beyond online selection, emotion trajectories are analyzed for abrupt internal-state shifts to pinpoint problematic skill invocations, guiding targeted SOP rewriting that replaces the coarse binary outcome signal of prior methods. On WebShop and ALFWorld, Emotion2Skill with Qwen3-8B improves over the Zero-Shot baseline by +26.9% success rate and +25.5% average success respectively, outperforming all baselines on both benchmarks with consistent gains on Qwen3-14B. Co-activation analysis further reveals semantically coherent emotion--skill pairings, confirming that the routing improvements reflect meaningful internal-state signals rather than opaque statistical correlations. These results establish LLM-internal emotion representations as an effective decision-level signal for orchestrating agent skill systems, extending their utility beyond interpretability and output steering. The code is available at https://github.com/BoHan-LIN04/Emotion2Skill.

AI.tldr: 提出Emotion2Skill框架，从LLM残差流中提取内部情感向量，将其融入技能选择（路由）和技能进化（SOP重写）过程，在WebShop和ALFWorld上显著提升智能体成功率，证明LLM内部情感表示可作为决策级信号用于智能体技能编排。
AI.motivation: 现有基于技能的LLM智能体在路由决策时仅依赖文本级信号（任务描述、反思、经验规则），忽略了模型自身的内部表征状态。虽然已有工作证明LLM存在因果影响行为的线性情感表示，但这些表示仅被用于事后分析或输出操纵，尚未用于智能体层面的决策。
AI.method: 1) 在每个决策步骤从残差流中提取27维情感状态，映射为置信度门控摘要注入路由提示词；2) 分析情感轨迹中突发的内部状态转移，定位问题技能调用，指导针对性的SOP重写（替代先前方法粗粒度的二元结果信号）。
AI.result: 在WebShop和ALFWorld上，Emotion2Skill配合Qwen3-8B相比零样本基线分别提升+26.9%成功率和+25.5%平均成功率，在两个基准上均优于所有基线，且在Qwen3-14B上有一致性提升。共激活分析显示语义连贯的情感-技能配对，证实改进来源于有意义的内部状态信号而非统计相关性。
AI.conclusion: LLM内部情感表示可作为有效的决策级信号用于编排智能体技能系统，将其效用从可解释性和输出操纵扩展到智能体层面的决策制定。

title: Right Answer, Wrong Heat: Explanation-Aware Evaluation and Thermal-Grounded Feedback for MLLMs on Infrared Images
comment: This manuscript is currently under peer review. Copyright may subsequently be transferred to the publisher, after which the availability of this version may be subject to the publisher's policy
summary: General-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly applied to infrared images, where they are commonly scored by answer accuracy alone. However, a correct answer does not ensure that the model's explanation is grounded in infrared thermal evidence. We introduce an explanation-aware evaluation framework that separates answer correctness, output-level explanation groundedness, and thermal grounding for infrared visual questions. Using a Dual-LLM Consensus Judge with a preliminary human-anchor calibration check, we find that correct answers can still rely on weak or visible-light evidence; withholding the original infrared image and showing only a visible-like rendering erodes thermal grounding with little accuracy change; and this erosion is observed most strongly for more capable models but disappears when infrared remains available. We further propose Thermal-Grounded Feedback (TGF), a training-free feedback loop that diagnoses explanation-side failures and revises the explanation while preserving the selected answer. On local paired-input validation, TGF improves explanation-side grounding without changing answers. These findings suggest that future trustworthy MLLMs for infrared scene understanding should be evaluated and developed to produce thermally grounded explanations rather than merely accurate answers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个面向红外图像视觉问答的解释感知评估框架，将答案正确性与解释的热学基础性分离评估，并提出训练免费的TGF反馈循环来修正解释而非答案，从而提升MLLM在红外场景中的可信赖性。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）越来越多地应用于红外图像，但现有评估仅依据答案准确性打分。然而，正确答案并不能保证模型的解释真正基于红外热学证据，因此需要一种能够区分答案正确性与解释热学基础性的评估框架。
AI.method: 提出解释感知评估框架，分离答案正确性、输出级解释基础性以及红外热学基础性三个维度；采用双LLM共识评判器（Dual-LLM Consensus Judge）并辅以人类锚定校准检查；进一步提出训练免费的Thermal-Grounded Feedback (TGF)反馈循环，诊断解释侧失败并修正解释，同时保留选定答案。
AI.result: 发现正确回答仍可能依赖薄弱或可见光证据；遮蔽原始红外图像仅显示可见光类似渲染会侵蚀热学基础性而准确率几乎不变；这种侵蚀在能力更强的模型中表现最明显，但红外图像可用时消失。在本地配对输入验证中，TGF在不改变答案的情况下提升了解释侧的基础性。
AI.conclusion: 未来面向红外场景理解的可信MLLM应不仅追求准确答案，更应被评估和发展为产出热学基础性解释的模型，而非仅追求答案正确。

title: SkillSentry: Reliable Skill Execution for LLM Agents via Runtime Assurance
summary: LLM agents are increasingly equipped with skills to perform complex tasks through multi-step reasoning and tool use. Although skills provide reusable procedural knowledge, agents may still execute them unreliably. Even when an agent has demonstrated the capability to complete tasks under the guidance of a skill, it may fail to do so consistently across similar tasks or repeated runs due to deviations from the skill procedure or incorrect execution of individual steps. Such instability limits the practical reliability of LLM agents. To address this problem, we propose SkillSentry, a skill-oriented runtime assurance framework built upon a new domain-specific language (DSL) for representing runtime guidance for skill execution. SkillSentry initializes the runtime guidance by combining a skill specification extracted from the corresponding skill document with execution experience mined from historical successful and failed traces. It then wraps around the agent execution loop to monitor and guide skill execution under the current guidance, while iteratively refining the guidance using newly collected traces. We evaluate SkillSentry on 15 skills across two LLM agents, each paired with two backbone models, i.e., Claude Code with Claude-Haiku-4.5 and Claude-Opus-4.6, and Codex with GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.4. Our results show that SkillSentry improves the task success rate of LLM agents by 24.1% across skills, on average, while exhibiting lower variability across repeated runs.

AI.tldr: SkillSentry是一个面向LLM代理的技能导向运行时保障框架，基于新的领域特定语言（DSL）表示技能执行时的运行时指导，通过结合技能规范和从历史轨迹中挖掘的执行经验来初始化指导，并在代理执行循环中监控和引导技能执行，同时利用新收集的轨迹迭代优化指导。在15个技能、两个LLM代理（Claude Code和Codex）及四种骨干模型上评估，平均任务成功率提升24.1%，且重复运行中的变异性更低。
AI.motivation: LLM代理尽管具备通过多步推理和工具使用执行复杂任务的技能，但技能执行并不可靠——即使代理在技能指导下已展示出完成任务的能力，在类似任务或重复运行中仍可能因偏离技能流程或个别步骤执行错误而失败，这种不稳定性限制了LLM代理的实际可靠性。
AI.method: 提出SkillSentry框架：(1) 设计一种新的领域特定语言（DSL）用于表示技能执行的运行时指导；(2) 通过结合从技能文档中提取的规范与从历史成功/失败轨迹中挖掘的执行经验来初始化运行时指导；(3) 将框架包裹在代理执行循环周围，在指导下监控和引导技能执行；(4) 利用新收集的轨迹迭代精化指导。
AI.result: 在15个技能、两个LLM代理（Claude Code搭配Claude-Haiku-4.5和Claude-Opus-4.6，Codex搭配GPT-5.2和GPT-5.4）上评估，SkillSentry平均提升任务成功率24.1%，并在重复运行中表现出更低的变异性。
AI.conclusion: SkillSentry通过技能导向的运行时保障有效提升了LLM代理执行技能的一致性和可靠性，为解决代理技能执行不稳定问题提供了可行方案。

title: Multi-Submap Implicit Neural SLAM with Local-to-Global Loop Closure for Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction
summary: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF)-based SLAM has demonstrated impressive results in small-scale scene reconstruction, yet scaling these methods to extensive, complex environments remains challenging due to catastrophic forgetting and accumulated trajectory drift. This paper presents a robust, large-scale neural SLAM system featuring a multi-submap architecture and a dual-tier loop closure mechanism. Specifically, we propose a progressive mapping strategy that dynamically allocates neural submaps to maintain high-fidelity representations without memory explosion. For robust pose estimation, an optical-flow-based tracking module is integrated to handle aggressive motions. To address global consistency, we introduce a local-to-global loop closure framework leveraging the foundation model for high-performance global descriptor extraction, significantly enhancing relocalization accuracy under varying viewpoints. Furthermore, an inter-submap online distillation algorithm is designed during back-end optimization to enforce geometric and appearance consistency across overlapping submap boundaries. To validate the system, we developed a customized handheld mechatronic platform and conducted extensive evaluations on both public benchmarks and our large-scale indoor-outdoor datasets. Experimental results, including direct deployment on an onboard computing unit, demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art neural SLAM methods in reconstruction quality and localization robustness, providing a scalable solution for real-world robotic perception and digital twinning. We will release the code publicly on \href{https://github.com/dtc111111/MSN-SLAM}{https://github.com/dtc111111/MSN-SLAM} .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多子图架构和双层回环闭合机制的大规模神经SLAM系统，通过渐进式映射策略、光流跟踪模块和局部到全局的回环框架，解决了NeRF-based SLAM在大规模复杂环境中的灾难性遗忘和轨迹漂移问题，并在重建质量和定位鲁棒性上超越了现有方法。
AI.motivation: NeRF-based SLAM在小规模场景重建中表现优异，但扩展到大规模复杂环境时面临两大挑战：灾难性遗忘（catastrophic forgetting）和累积轨迹漂移（accumulated trajectory drift），现有方法难以兼顾高保真重建与全局一致性。
AI.method: 1) 渐进式映射策略：动态分配神经子图，避免内存爆炸并保持高保真表示；2) 基于光流的跟踪模块：处理剧烈运动下的鲁棒位姿估计；3) 局部到全局回环闭合框架：利用基础模型提取全局描述子，提升变视角下的重定位精度；4) 子图间在线蒸馏算法：在后端优化中强制子图边界处几何和外观一致性。
AI.result: 在公共基准和自建大规模室内外数据集上进行了广泛评估，并直接在机载计算单元上进行部署测试，结果表明该方法在重建质量和定位鲁棒性上优于最先进的神经SLAM方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为大规模真实世界机器人感知和数字孪生提供了可扩展的解决方案，并将公开代码。

title: RefineAny3D: Depth Refinement as Semantic Alignment for Monocular 3D Detection
summary: Monocular 3D object detection spans two regimes: closed-set detectors operating within a fixed category vocabulary, and open-vocabulary detectors that localize arbitrary categories by leveraging depth foundation models for 3D geometry. We find that current depth foundation models, despite their strong zero-shot generalization, lack the object-level precision 3D detection demands: substituting a state-of-the-art depth foundation model for a strong detector's predicted depth degrades accuracy, even falling below the detector's own prediction. Rather than pushing detectors or depth models to be more accurate end-to-end, we treat object-level depth refinement as a stand-alone task and present RefineAny3D, a vision-language model that corrects depth without ever predicting a numerical value. Our key insight is that depth error has a direct visual signature in image space: when projected onto the image, a correctly placed box tightly encloses the object, while a too-far box projects too small and a too-close box projects too large. Depth refinement thus reduces to a visual alignment problem rather than a metric regression problem, which we instantiate by extending the VLM's vocabulary with action tokens that replace numerical depth output with categorical decisions, and by supervising the model on a large-scale chain-of-thought dataset that grounds each decision in explicit visual evidence. Applied as a single post-hoc step, RefineAny3D delivers consistent gains across closed-set detectors, open-vocabulary detectors, and 3D auto-labeling tools, and generalizes to novel categories, scenes, and cameras without retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RefineAny3D，一种基于视觉语言模型的单目3D物体检测深度后处理细化方法。核心洞察是将深度误差转化为图像空间的视觉对齐问题——正确的3D框投影后应紧密包围物体，而非数值回归问题。通过扩展VLM词汇表添加动作token（分类决策而非数值输出），并在大规模思维链数据集上监督训练，该方法可作为即插即用的后处理步骤，为闭集检测器、开放词汇检测器和3D自动标注工具提供一致的性能提升，且无需重新训练即可泛化到新类别、场景和相机。
AI.motivation: 现有深度基础模型在零样本泛化上表现优异，但缺乏3D检测所需的物体级精度——直接将最先进的深度基础模型替换到检测器上反而会降低精度。作者认为与其让检测器或深度模型端到端地更精确，不如将物体级深度细化作为独立任务处理。
AI.method: 提出RefineAny3D，一个视觉语言模型，不预测数值深度而是进行视觉对齐判断。关键洞察：深度误差在图像空间有直接视觉特征——正确放置的框紧密包围物体，太远的框投影过小，太近的框投影过大。方法包括：(1)扩展VLM词汇表，用动作token替代数值深度输出，变为分类决策；(2)构建大规模思维链数据集，将每个决策锚定在明确的视觉证据上。
AI.result: 作为单一后处理步骤应用时，RefineAny3D在闭集检测器、开放词汇检测器和3D自动标注工具上均带来一致的性能提升，并能泛化到新类别、场景和相机，无需重新训练。
AI.conclusion: 深度细化本质上是一个视觉对齐问题而非度量回归问题，通过将这一洞察实例化为VLM架构和思维链训练范式，可以在不牺牲泛化能力的前提下提升3D检测的整体精度。

title: Privileged Likelihood Is Not Automatically Value: Three Checks for Token Credit in On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Outcome verifiers score completed reasoning traces but do not assign credit to intermediate tokens. Privileged self-distillation attempts to fill this gap by rescoring a model's own rollout with training-only information. A token likelihood change, however, is not automatically outcome credit. We separate three questions: whether the score tracks better actions, whether feedback construction changes what is compared, and what behavior the training loss reinforces. We establish these distinctions formally. When a rollout is scored using hindsight feedback written about that same rollout, its content determines both the tokens and the scoring context, creating direct self-dependence. Using feedback from another rollout of the same problem removes this dependence but does not guarantee a useful score. In matched experiments with a 20B model on AIME 2025, the implemented additive score is near chance (AUC=0.505) and slightly favors incorrect traces after length adjustment. In the paired comparison, the outcome-only control records 64.2\%, versus 24.2\%--33.9\% for five token-score variants. The results motivate validating score meaning, feedback construction, and training behavior separately before calling a likelihood signal credit.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地审视了"特权自我蒸馏"中令牌似然变化作为结果信用的有效性。作者将三个问题分开：分数是否追踪更好的行为、反馈构建改变比较对象、训练损失强化何种行为。通过在AIME 2025上用20B模型做匹配实验，发现所实现的加性分数接近随机（AUC=0.505），令牌分数变体表现远差于仅结果对照（24.2%-33.9% vs 64.2%），结论是类似然信号尚不能被称为"信用"。
AI.motivation: 结果验证器只给完整推理轨迹打分，不赋予中间令牌信用。特权自我蒸馏试图通过用训练时信息重新给模型自身rollout打分来填补这一空白，但令牌似然变化并不自动等同于结果信用。作者希望澄清这种混淆，并在实证上检验其有效性。
AI.method: 作者将三个问题形式化区分：(1)分数是否追踪更好的动作；(2)反馈构建是否改变被比较的对象；(3)训练损失强化何种行为。当一个rollout用关于同一rollout的事后反馈打分时，内容同时决定令牌与打分上下文，形成直接自依赖；改用同一问题的另一rollout反馈可去除该依赖。实验中用20B模型在AIME 2025上对比加性分数与令牌分数变体。
AI.result: 匹配实验中，实现的加性分数接近随机水平（AUC=0.505），长度调整后甚至略微偏向错误轨迹。成对比较中，仅结果对照组达到64.2%，而五种令牌分数变体仅达24.2%-33.9%。
AI.conclusion: 在将类似然信号称为信用之前，必须分别验证分数意义、反馈构建和训练行为。作者的工作为这一领域建立了清晰的形式化区分，并提供了警示性的实证证据。

title: OGG-FR: Orthogonal Gradient Gaming and Frequency Rectification for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Infrared Image Super-Resolution
comment: This manuscript is currently under peer review. Copyright may subsequently be transferred to the publisher, after which the availability of this version may be subject to the publisher's policy
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) infrared image super-resolution aims to recover weak thermal structures for deployment on resource-constrained platforms; lightweight models are therefore preferred, but multi-loss training can be unstable. A common strategy combines pixel-domain and frequency-domain objectives; however, low contrast, limited high-frequency content, and sensor-specific noise often make their gradients weakly aligned or conflicting. To address this optimization ambiguity, we propose Orthogonal Gradient Gaming and Frequency Rectification (OGG-FR), a plug-and-play optimization framework that decomposes the frequency gradient into a redundant parallel component and an orthogonal innovation component relative to the pixel gradient. In the conflict regime, OGG-FR computes a safe base gradient using the Multiple Gradient Descent Algorithm (MGDA) and adds a variance-rectified orthogonal innovation; in the compatible regime, it discards redundant parallel information and injects the orthogonal innovation according to a confidence score estimated from the high-frequency residual. Experimental results on the UAV thermal benchmark show broad gains under BI and BD degradations at $\times 4$ and $\times 8$ scales, while gradient analyses support the effectiveness of the proposed conflict-aware update rule.

AI.tldr: 提出OGG-FR，一种即插即用的优化框架，通过将频率梯度分解为与像素梯度平行的冗余分量和正交创新分量，解决UAV红外图像超分辨率中多损失训练的梯度冲突问题。
AI.motivation: UAV红外图像超分辨率需要轻量级模型部署在资源受限平台，但多损失训练（像素域+频率域）不稳定。红外图像低对比度、高频内容有限且存在传感器噪声，导致像素梯度与频率梯度弱对齐或冲突，造成优化歧义。
AI.method: OGG-FR框架：(1) 将频率梯度相对于像素梯度分解为冗余平行分量和正交创新分量；(2) 冲突模式下，用MGDA计算安全基梯度并添加方差校正的正交创新；(3) 兼容模式下，丢弃冗余平行信息，根据高频残差评估的置信度分数注入正交创新。
AI.result: 在UAV热成像基准上，BI和BD降质条件下，×4和×8倍率均获得广泛性能提升；梯度分析验证了所提出冲突感知更新规则的有效性。
AI.conclusion: OGG-FR作为即插即用优化框架，有效解决了多损失训练的梯度冲突问题，提升了轻量级UAV红外超分辨率性能。

title: LightAIR: Lightweight Action Inversion and Riemannian Rectification for Text-based Person Anomaly Search
summary: Traditional Text-based Person Search (TPS) is typically limited to matching static appearance attributes, severely neglecting dynamic action information. The Text-based Person Anomaly Search (TPAS) task bridges this gap, requiring models to locate micro-level specific abnormal behaviors while matching macro-level appearance of pedestrians. However, current TPAS methods face fundamental limitations: external explicit pose estimators are fragile in unconstrained surveillance scenarios, and implicit learning encounters visual decoupling failure under pixel-level entanglement, causing dominant appearance information to easily swallow and contaminate subtle action features. Furthermore, performing contrastive optimization on hard negative samples (``same appearance, different actions'') in conventional Euclidean spaces induces severe shortcut learning. To address these, we propose the Lightweight Action Inversion and Riemannian rectification network (LightAIR). First, it introduces textual semantic priors as anchors via a lightweight action inversion operator to extract pure action features, thereby overcoming visual-inherent coupling. Subsequently, it employs orthogonal null-space projection to constrain appearance features within the orthogonal complement space of action features, guaranteeing strict forward decoupling. Finally, we designed a gradient rectification module that computes the Riemannian gradient to constrain the backpropagation trajectory, forcing the gradient flow to update strictly along the tangent space that preserves decoupling properties, thereby cutting off harmful shortcuts. Extensive experiments on the widely used TPAS and TIPR datasets demonstrate that LightAIR significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods. Codes are available at https://github.com/rainy-london/LightAIR

AI.tldr: 本文提出LightAIR网络，用于文本行人异常搜索（TPAS）任务，通过轻量级动作反演算子提取纯动作特征，利用正交零空间投影实现外观-动作严格前向解耦，并通过黎曼梯度约束反向传播路径，解决了现有方法中视觉耦合、解耦失败和捷径学习等问题，在TPAS和TIPR数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统基于文本的行人搜索仅匹配静态外观属性，忽略了动态动作信息。而现有TPAS方法存在三个根本性局限：外部显式姿态估计器在无约束监控场景中脆弱；隐式学习在像素级纠缠下遭遇视觉解耦失败，外观信息容易淹没和污染细微动作特征；在传统欧氏空间中对"相同外观、不同动作"的硬负样本进行对比优化会引发严重的捷径学习。
AI.method: LightAIR包含三个核心模块：(1) 轻量级动作反演算子：引入文本语义先验作为锚点，提取纯净的动作特征，克服视觉固有耦合；(2) 正交零空间投影：将外观特征约束在动作特征的正交补空间中，保证严格的前向解耦；(3) 梯度修正模块：计算黎曼梯度以约束反向传播轨迹，迫使梯度流严格沿保持解耦性质的切空间更新，切断有害捷径。
AI.result: 在广泛使用的TPAS和TIPR数据集上的大量实验表明，LightAIR显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: LightAIR通过前向解耦（正交零空间投影）与反向解耦（黎曼梯度修正）的双重机制，有效解决了TPAS任务中外观与动作特征的耦合问题，为文本行人异常搜索提供了新的解决方案。

title: P$^{3}$: Joint Program-and-Proof Planning for Verified Code Generation
summary: Verified code generation asks a large language model (LLM) to generate both an executable program and a machine-checkable proof that the program meets a formal specification, promising software that is correct by construction. The de facto workflow decouples the two halves of the problem: first synthesize a program, then attempt to prove it correct. We observe that this sequential pipeline can be both ineffective and inefficient in practice. A program generated without anticipating its proof can be subtly incorrect or structurally difficult to verify, forcing the LLM into brittle repair loops that alternate between patching the code and patching the proof. Inspired by Dijkstra's view that a program and its correctness argument should be developed hand in hand, we propose $P^3$, an LLM-based agentic workflow that first derives a unified program-and-proof plan from the specification, then elaborates the implementation and proof scaffold under this shared plan. To evaluate verified code generation in realistic settings, we further introduce Lean4Commit0, a repository-derived, library-level benchmark built by extracting core APIs from real-world software repositories and translating their requirements, including relational specifications across APIs, into Lean tasks. Using four frontier LLM backends, we evaluate $P^3$ on Verina, AlgoVeri, and our Lean4Commit0 benchmark, where it achieves the highest solve rate in every benchmark--model setting. Compared with the stronger baseline, it improves solve rates by 4.6--11.2 percentage points and reduces per-task API cost by up to roughly 40\% and wall-clock time by up to roughly 37\% on the difficult subset of each benchmark. A targeted ablation further shows gains of 3.3--8.3 points over implementation-only planning, isolating the benefit of planning the program and proof jointly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出P³，一个LLM驱动的智能体工作流，用于验证代码生成。与传统"先生成程序再证明正确性"的串行流程不同，P³受Dijkstra启发，先从规范中推导统一的程序-证明联合计划，再在该共享计划下细化实现和证明脚手架。作者还引入了Lean4Commit0基准，从真实软件仓库提取核心API并翻译为Lean任务。实验表明P³在Verina、AlgoVeri和Lean4Commit0上均取得最高求解率，相比强基线提升4.6-11.2个百分点，API成本降低约40%，耗时降低约37%。
AI.motivation: 现有的验证代码生成流程将程序合成与正确性证明解耦为串行管道，但这种方法在实践中既低效又无效。不预先考虑证明的程序可能隐含错误或结构上难以验证，导致LLM陷入修补代码和修补证明的脆弱循环。作者希望借鉴Dijkstra"程序与正确性论证应协同开发"的理念，解决这一根本性瓶颈。
AI.method: P³工作流包含两阶段：首先从规范推导统一的程序-证明联合计划，然后在该共享计划约束下细化实现和证明脚手架。此外，作者构建Lean4Commit0基准，从真实软件仓库提取核心API（包括API间的关联规范）并翻译为Lean验证任务。使用四种前沿LLM后端进行评估。
AI.result: 在Verina、AlgoVeri和Lean4Commit0三个基准上，P³在所有基准-模型组合中均取得最高求解率。相比更强基线，求解率提升4.6-11.2个百分点；在困难子集上，每次任务的API成本降低约40%，墙钟时间降低约37%。消融实验显示，联合规划相比仅实现规划带来3.3-8.3个百分点的额外增益。
AI.conclusion: 联合规划程序和证明是提升验证代码生成效率与效果的关键。P³验证了"先统一规划、再协同生成"的范式优于"先程序后证明"的串行范式，同时Lean4Commit0为真实仓库场景下的验证代码生成提供了更贴近实际的评估基准。

title: Not All Visual Tokens Are Equally Safe to Remove:Consequence-Sensitive Visual Token Compression
summary: Visual token compression for vision--language models (VLMs) has largely relied on criteria such as attention, redundancy, and uncertainty to maximize average accuracy under a fixed compute budget, implicitly assuming that all errors carry equal cost. However, the consequence of an incorrect prediction on downstream tasks is rarely symmetric: misreading an invoice amount can be far more costly than misclassifying a background color. Motivated by this, we introduce consequence-sensitive visual token compression, which allocates visual computation across requests according to their potential error costs. Our method follows a calibrate-then-allocate procedure, estimating consequence-specific error-budget curves offline and applying the calibrated token budgets online using consequence signals available from question or task information. On a controlled within-task benchmark, high- and low-consequence questions are drawn from the same document images, so content alone cannot reveal which questions are costly to get wrong. In this setting, our method reduces high-stakes errors from 0.300 to 0.133 under the same total token budget, whereas a content-driven allocator performs no better than uniform allocation. Measuring how error rates change with token budget across different cost ratios, we derive an allocation frontier: uniform allocation is optimal when errors are equally costly, and token transfer toward high-consequence questions becomes increasingly beneficial as the cost gap grows. This allocation principle generalizes well across three dense vision-language benchmarks, two budget realization mechanisms (token deletion and resolution reallocation), two VLM architectures, and multiple token selection strategies. On a realistic mixed workload, consequence-sensitive allocation reduces cost-weighted error by 38% while achieving approximately 21% lower latency than full-resolution inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种后果敏感的视觉token压缩方法，根据请求的潜在错误成本分配视觉计算资源，采用"先校准后分配"的流程，在相同token预算下显著降低高代价错误，并实现更低的延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉token压缩方法基于注意力、冗余度或不确定性等准则优化平均准确率，隐含假设所有错误代价相等。但现实下游任务中错误代价往往不对称（如读错发票金额远重于误分类背景颜色），因此需要根据潜在错误成本来分配视觉计算资源。
AI.method: 采用"校准-分配"两步流程：(1) 离线阶段估计后果特定的错误-预算曲线；(2) 在线阶段利用问题或任务信息中的后果信号，按校准后的token预算进行分配。该方法通过成本比率驱动token在高后果与低后果问题间转移。
AI.result: 在受控基准中，高风险错误率从0.300降至0.133（相同总token预算），内容驱动分配器不优于均匀分配。在三个密集视觉-语言基准、两种预算实现机制（token删除和分辨率重分配）、两种VLM架构及多种token选择策略上均验证有效。在真实混合负载下，代价加权错误降低38%，延迟比全分辨率推理降低约21%。
AI.conclusion: 当错误代价不对称时，均匀分配并非最优；将token从低后果问题转移至高后果问题能带来显著收益，且收益随代价差距增大而增加。后果敏感分配策略在多种基准和架构下具有良好的泛化能力，为视觉token压缩提供了新的优化视角。

title: MMArch: Benchmarking Multimodal Reasoning Grounded in Architectural Evidence
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) perform strongly on engineering imagery, yet existing benchmarks mostly test drawing recognition, information extraction, or compliance checking, leaving open whether models can combine distributed visual evidence with engineering principles to reach a conclusion. We introduce MMArch, a benchmark for architecture and civil engineering spanning ten subdomains and built entirely from figures in peer-reviewed papers. Its $1{,}212$ short-answer items are produced by a decoupled planner--writer pipeline and validated through automated screening, a blind adversarial audit, and expert review, so that answering requires perceiving the relevant evidence, identifying the governing principle, and applying it, not exploiting textual or single-figure shortcuts. Evaluating $18$ open-weight and proprietary MLLMs against a domain-expert panel, we find a wide gap: the strongest open-source model attains about $30\%$ and the best proprietary system $52\%$, while human experts reach $95\%$, more than forty points ahead. Our error analysis shows that failures concentrate in applying principles and combining evidence across figures rather than in locating it, pointing to substantial headroom for future research. Code and data are available at https://dcx-swjtu.github.io/MMArch/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MMArch，一个基于同行评审论文中图表构建的建筑与土木工程多模态大语言模型基准，包含1212个短答题，覆盖10个子领域。评测18个开源与专有MLLM，最强开源模型约30%，最佳专有系统52%，而人类专家达95%，差距显著，错误集中在原理应用与跨图证据整合而非证据定位。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM基准大多只测试图纸识别、信息提取或合规检查，未检验模型能否将分布式视觉证据与工程原理结合以得出结论，因此需要一个能真实评估MLLM工程推理能力的基准。
AI.method: 采用解耦的规划器-写作者（planner-writer）流水线生成题目，并通过自动化筛选、盲对抗审计和专家评审三重验证。题目全部来自同行评审论文中的图表，要求模型感知相关证据、识别支配原理并加以应用，杜绝文本或单图捷径。
AI.result: 评估18个开源与专有MLLM，最强开源模型约30%，最佳专有系统52%，人类专家达95%，领先超过40个百分点。错误分析显示，失败主要集中在原理应用和跨图证据整合，而非证据定位。
AI.conclusion: MLLM在建筑与土木工程多图表分布式推理上仍与人类专家存在巨大差距，主要瓶颈在于深层原理应用和多图证据综合，这为未来研究指明了方向。

title: Rethinking Medical Landmark Localization with Prototype Learning-based Progressive Offset Correction
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted by MICCAI MLMI 2026
summary: Accurate landmark localization in medical images is a fundamental step for quantitative clinical measurement and downstream analysis. Existing localization methods have advanced, among which multi-stage refinement is a superior solution. Although this strategy mitigates the anatomical ambiguity inherent in single-stage global predictions, its high computational cost limits practical applicability. In this work, we propose a parameter-economic model, PPOC-LL, which leverages Prototype learning-based Progressive Offset Correction for Landmark Localization. Our contribution is three-fold. First, to drive coarse-to-fine landmark optimization, we introduce a multi-scale dynamic perception strategy for patch-level feature pyramid modeling. Second, to effectively handle anatomically similar patterns, we design a similarity-driven prototype learning mechanism that captures informative local semantics for robust offset prediction. Last, to stabilize the model learning and improve the overall performance, we incorporate a novel error-aware reliability regularization via tolerance-based balancing. We collected a large validation cohort, including two public and one private datasets spanning X-ray and ultrasound modalities, covering cephalometric, symphysis-fetal head, and fetal heart landmarks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PPOC-LL achieves satisfactory performance with a favorable trade-off between accuracy and model complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PPOC-LL模型，一种基于原型学习的渐进式偏移校正方法，用于医学图像中的标志点定位。该方法通过多尺度动态感知、相似性驱动原型学习和误差感知可靠性正则化，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算成本，并在多个X射线和超声数据集上验证了准确性与模型复杂度之间的良好平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像标志点定位方法中，多阶段细化策略虽能缓解单阶段全局预测的解剖学模糊问题，但其高昂的计算成本限制了实际临床应用，因此需要一种参数经济的方法在精度和效率之间取得更好平衡。
AI.method: PPOC-LL包含三个核心贡献：(1) 多尺度动态感知策略，用于补丁级特征金字塔建模，驱动由粗到细的标志点优化；(2) 相似性驱动的原型学习机制，捕获信息丰富的局部语义以稳健预测偏移量；(3) 基于容差平衡的误差感知可靠性正则化，稳定模型学习并提升整体性能。
AI.result: 在包含两个公开数据集和一个私有数据集的大规模验证队列上进行了实验，涵盖X射线和超声模态、头颅测量、骶骨-胎头和胎心标志点，结果表明PPOC-LL取得了满意的性能，并在准确性与模型复杂度之间实现了有利的权衡。
AI.conclusion: PPOC-LL证明通过原型学习驱动的渐进式偏移校正策略，可以在保持高质量标志点定位精度的同时显著降低计算开销，为医学图像标志点定位提供了一种高性能且参数经济的解决方案。

title: RAGMesh with FaME-G2E: Long-Form Text-Driven 3D Face Generation and Editing
summary: Text-driven 3D face generation and editing remains challenging due to the difficulty of translating long-form descriptions into fine-grained facial geometry. Existing methods primarily align global textual semantics with facial structures but often struggle to capture subtle local deformations, such as eyebrow tension, cheek contraction, and asymmetric mouth motions, resulting in limited geometric fidelity and editing precision. To facilitate fine-grained text-driven facial modeling, we first construct FaME-G2E, a large-scale multimodal dataset containing detailed text--mesh annotations and paired text--blendshape samples for unified 3D facial generation and editing. Based on this dataset, we propose RAGMesh, a retrieval-augmented framework that leverages text-correlated geometric priors to improve high-fidelity facial synthesis and editing. Specifically, the Multi-Scale Retrieval Fusion (MSRF) module retrieves semantically consistent global and regional facial priors and fuses them in the blendshape space, suppressing conflicting local deformations while preserving coherent deformation patterns. Furthermore, we introduce Adaptive RAG-guided Supervision (AdaRAGS), a region-aware constraint that explicitly aligns textual semantics with corresponding facial regions, enhancing regional controllability and editing accuracy. Extensive experiments on FaME-G2E demonstrate that RAGMesh achieves superior performance over state-of-the-art methods in local geometric accuracy, text-guided controllability, regional editing precision, and inference efficiency. Video demo is available at https://youtu.be/Yr0_XkpWcNk, and the source code and dataset will be released upon paper acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAGMesh，一个基于检索增强的框架，用于细粒度文本驱动的3D面部生成与编辑。作者首先构建了FaME-G2E大规模多模态数据集（包含详细的文本-网格注释和文本-blendshape配对样本），然后提出多尺度检索融合（MSRF）模块和自适应RAG引导监督（AdaRAGS）模块，以解决现有方法难以捕捉细微局部形变的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动的3D面部生成方法主要对齐全局文本语义与面部结构，难以捕捉精细的局部形变（如眉毛张力、脸颊收缩、不对称嘴部运动），导致几何保真度和编辑精度有限。缺乏细粒度文本-面部几何对齐的数据和机制是核心瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 构建FaME-G2E多模态数据集，包含详细的文本-网格注释和文本-blendshape配对样本；2) 提出RAGMesh框架，包含MSRF模块（Multi-Scale Retrieval Fusion），从全局和区域层面检索语义一致的几何先验并在blendshape空间中融合，抑制冲突的局部形变同时保持一致的形变模式；3) 引入AdaRAGS（Adaptive RAG-guided Supervision）区域感知约束，显式对齐文本语义与对应面部区域，增强区域可控性和编辑精度。
AI.result: 在FaME-G2E数据集上的大量实验表明，RAGMesh在局部几何精度、文本引导可控性、区域编辑精度和推理效率方面均优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过检索增强的几何先验和区域感知监督，RAGMesh有效解决了细粒度文本驱动3D面部建模的挑战，实现了高保真度的面部生成与精确编辑。代码和数据集将公开发布。

title: CADEngBench: It Looks Like CAD, but Does It Work? Evaluating Parametric Design, Assembly Reasoning, and Physics Simulation
summary: A CAD model is not engineering-grade merely because it looks correct. It must satisfy design requirements, respond predictably to parameter changes, support controlled edits, match a reference structural response under a declared analysis, and connect to other parts through valid joints. We present CADEngBench, a two-track benchmark for these capabilities. CADEngBench-P evaluates 300 parametric parts, each used for one zero-to-CAD task and one functional-editing task (600 tasks in total), through boundary-representation (B-Rep) validity, engineering and DFM checks, parameter-family perturbations, functional editing, and matched linear-static FEA in CalculiX. CADEngBench-A evaluates 150 body pairs through ranked joint retrieval, exact face-and-edge grounding, joint-frame prediction, and kinematic verification. Across eight multimodal, code-capable models, editing supplied CAD is substantially easier than generating it, while complex edits and matched FEA remain difficult. Assembly predictions often locate the relevant region but fail to recover the recorded joint or mating entities. These results show that CAD evaluation must test engineering behavior rather than appearance alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CADEngBench，一个双轨道的CAD工程级能力评估基准。CADEngBench-P评估300个参数化零件的零到CAD生成和功能编辑任务（共600个任务），涵盖B-Rep有效性、工程与DFM检查、参数族扰动、功能编辑和线性静态FEA匹配。CADEngBench-A评估150对部件组的联合检索、面边接地、关节框架预测和运动学验证。实验发现编辑比生成更容易，复杂编辑与FEA匹配仍困难，装配预测常定位到区域但无法恢复关节或配合实体。
AI.motivation: 传统CAD评估仅关注外观正确性，而工程级CAD模型需要满足设计需求、参数变化响应、受控编辑、结构响应匹配和有效连接。现有基准无法评估这些工程行为，因此需要一个新的评估框架。
AI.method: 构建双轨道基准：CADEngBench-P对300个参数化零件进行零到CAD生成和功能编辑两类任务，使用B-Rep有效性、工程/DFM检查、参数族扰动、功能编辑和CalculiX线性静态FEA进行验证；CADEngBench-A对150对部件组进行关节检索、面边接地、关节帧预测和运动学验证。
AI.result: 在8个多模态、代码能力强模型中，编辑已提供的CAD比生成CAD容易得多，复杂编辑和匹配FEA仍然困难。装配预测常能定位到相关区域但无法恢复记录的关节或配合实体。
AI.conclusion: CAD评估必须测试工程行为而非仅测试外观，CADEngBench为这一目标提供了结构和验证框架。

title: NBA_Streaming: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Fine-Grained Basketball Commentary Generation in Continuous Streams
summary: Live basketball commentary generation requires determining when an event is sufficiently observable and describing it before subsequent events unfold. However, existing methods are primarily designed for pre-segmented clips or complete videos, making them unsuitable for continuous streams. Existing datasets also provide limited supervision for player identities, fine-grained actions, event attributes, and coherent event chains, restricting the factual richness of generated commentary. To address these limitations, we introduce NBA_Streaming, a large-scale benchmark for online fine-grained basketball commentary generation. It contains 307 hours of basketball broadcasts and approximately 35K temporally aligned events, with annotations of event boundaries, player identities, fine-grained actions, event chains, and natural-language commentary. By moving from isolated clips to continuous streams, NBA_Streaming enables unified evaluation of event localization, response reliability, factual grounding, and commentary quality under causal constraints. We further propose a causal two-stage framework that combines completion-first localization with ball-centric semantic grounding, enabling the system to identify complete events from observed streams and organize scene, event, identity, and action cues for commentary generation. Extensive experiments reveal the difficulty of NBA_Streaming, where existing baselines struggle with online timing, factual grounding, and fine-grained description. Our framework consistently improves over strong alternatives, while the remaining gap highlights NBA_Streaming as a valuable benchmark for streaming sports video understanding and generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NBA_Streaming，一个大规模在线细粒度篮球解说生成基准，包含307小时直播和约3.5万个时间对齐事件，并提出了一个因果两阶段框架（完成优先定位+以球为中心的语义接地）来在连续流中生成符合事实的解说。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要针对预分割片段或完整视频设计，不适用于连续流式数据；现有数据集对球员身份、细粒度动作、事件属性和事件链的监督有限，限制了生成解说的事实丰富度。
AI.method: 提出因果两阶段框架：第一阶段采用完成优先定位（completion-first localization）从观测流中识别完整事件；第二阶段采用以球为中心的语义接地（ball-centric semantic grounding）组织场景、事件、身份和动作线索用于解说生成。
AI.result: 实验表明NBA_Streaming具有挑战性，现有基线在在线时序、事实接地和细粒度描述方面表现不佳；所提框架一致优于强基线，但仍有性能差距。
AI.conclusion: NBA_Streaming填补了从孤立片段到连续流式视频理解与生成的研究空白，是一个有价值的基准，为流式体育视频理解与解说生成提供了统一的评估范式。

title: Linearized 2-Simplicial Attention
summary: We present a linearized form of 2-simplicial attention by rewriting the trilinear score as an inner product between a composite query and a key, so that the sum over one token axis takes the same form as ordinary softmax attention. We then approximate this sum with positive random features and store the entire past in a fixed-size state, while the second axis stays explicit over a short window of recent tokens. This enables us to achieve linear cost in sequence length combined with a global reach that windowed 2-simplicial attention lacks. We implement it with custom Triton kernels and combine it with Kimi Delta Attention to build a model with no softmax attention at all. Under matched compute, this model achieves the highest mean downstream accuracy among the compared architectures, and at 16k context it improves mean accuracy over a KDA hybrid while lowering LAMBADA perplexity from 715.6 to 602.6.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种2-单纯形注意力的线性化形式，通过将三线性分数重写为复合查询与键的内积，使沿一个token轴的求和与普通softmax注意力形式一致。利用正随机特征近似该求和并将全部历史存储于固定大小的状态中，而另一轴则通过近期token的短窗口保持显式。这实现了序列长度的线性复杂度，同时具备窗口化2-单纯形注意力所缺乏的全局覆盖能力。
AI.motivation: 窗口化2-单纯形注意力虽然能捕捉高阶交互，但缺乏全局感受野；而完整的2-单纯形注意力复杂度高昂。作者希望在线性成本下同时获得全局覆盖和高阶交互建模能力。
AI.method: 1) 将三线性分数重写为复合查询与键的内积形式；2) 使用正随机特征近似token轴的求和，使历史信息压缩为固定大小状态；3) 第二轴保持短窗口显式计算；4) 使用自定义Triton内核实现；5) 与Kimi Delta Attention结合构建完全无softmax注意力的模型。
AI.result: 在匹配计算量下，该模型在比较的架构中取得了最高的平均下游准确率；在16k上下文长度下，相比KDA混合模型，平均准确率提升，同时将LAMBADA困惑度从715.6降至602.6。
AI.conclusion: 通过线性化2-单纯形注意力并结合窗口化的第二轴设计，成功在不使用任何softmax注意力的情况下，以线性复杂度实现了优于现有混合架构的下游性能，证明了高阶注意力线性化的可行性与有效性。

title: PatchHead: Learning Spatial Patch Evidence for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: AI-generated image detectors generalize poorly when their training and test images originate from different generators or datasets. Despite the rich spatial representations produced by vision foundation models like DINO, existing detectors typically classify images using only the globally aggregated CLS token. We hypothesize that globally aggregating DINO features into a single CLS token obscures spatially distributed generation traces. To test this hypothesis, we introduce PatchHead, a lightweight spatial aggregation head that preserves the two-dimensional organization of DINO patch tokens and integrates evidence across neighboring regions. During training, we freeze the pretrained DINO backbone and optimize only the inserted LoRA adapters, PatchHead, and auxiliary projection head. Across nine cross-dataset benchmarks spanning manually curated and in-the-wild settings, PatchHead ranks first on seven datasets and second on the remaining two. It improves the strongest prior method from 91.6% to 94.6% in average balanced accuracy (+3.0 points) and raises the worst-case accuracy from 82.4% to 89.4% (+6.9 points), while introducing only 8.6% more trainable parameters and 0.08% additional FLOPs. Further qualitative analysis suggests that PatchHead (i) reduces class-conditional domain discrepancy, and (ii) redirects the representation from content-dominated saliency toward spatially distributed authenticity evidence. Together, these observations provide a representation-level account of why spatial patch aggregation transfers more reliably across generators and datasets than a single CLS-based global representation. Our code and models will be made available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PatchHead，一种轻量的空间聚合头，用于改进AI生成图像检测器的跨生成器/跨数据集泛化能力。通过保留DINO patch token的二维空间结构并整合邻近区域的证据，PatchHead在九个跨数据集基准上显著优于现有最强方法，平均准确率提升3.0个百分点，最差情况准确率提升6.9个百分点，仅增加8.6%的可训练参数和0.08%的FLOPs。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI生成图像检测器在训练和测试图像来自不同生成器或数据集时泛化性能差。尽管DINO等视觉基础模型能产生丰富的空间表征，现有检测器通常只使用全局聚合的CLS token进行分类。作者假设全局聚合DINO特征为单一CLS token会掩盖空间分布的生成痕迹，这是泛化失败的根本原因。
AI.method: 提出PatchHead，一个轻量级空间聚合头，保留DINO patch token的二维组织结构，并跨邻近区域整合证据。训练时冻结预训练的DINO骨干网络，仅优化插入的LoRA适配器、PatchHead和辅助投影头。通过空间聚合而非全局聚合来捕获分布式的生成痕迹，减少类别条件域差异。
AI.result: 在九个跨数据集基准上，PatchHead在七个数据集上排名第一，两个数据集上排名第二。相较最强先验方法，平均平衡准确率从91.6%提升到94.6%（+3.0点），最差情况准确率从82.4%提升到89.4%（+6.9点）。仅增加8.6%的可训练参数和0.08%的FLOPs。定性分析表明PatchHead降低了类别条件域差异，并将表示从内容主导的显著性转向空间分布的生成真实性证据。
AI.conclusion: 空间patch聚合比单一的CLS全局表示在跨生成器和数据集的泛化中更可靠。PatchHead以极低的计算和参数开销，通过保留DINO特征的空间组织来捕获分布式生成痕迹，在多个基准上实现了显著的性能提升，为AI生成图像检测的表示层面理解提供了新视角。

title: ASPaeroFlow: Decomposition Heuristics for Joint Air Traffic Flow & Capacity Management
comment: To cite this contribution, please cite the ATMOS 2026 paper not the arXiv version; the arXiv version includes the supplementary material. Experimental results are available at: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21869481
summary: While mathematical models act as vital decision support systems for operational Air Traffic Flow and Capacity Management (ATFCM), existing approaches isolate Air Traffic Flow Management (ATFM) from Dynamic Airspace Configuration (DAC). This separation introduces an unresolved circular dependency between fixed-demand and fixed-capacity assumptions. Although joint optimization resolves this gap, the enlarged search space renders exact models computationally intractable for medium- to large-scale instances. To bridge this gap, we propose ASPaeroFlow: a heuristic for the joint ATFCM; it combines instance-space decomposition heuristics with a local exact approach using Answer Set Programming. We benchmark ASPaeroFlow from small to industry-sized instances and compare it with exact and alternative approaches. The results indicate that (1) the heuristic provides a computational middle ground between exact methods and operational baselines; (2) simultaneous optimization can outperform sequential optimization on joint ATFCM; and (3) an ablation study indicates that DAC has a larger impact on solution quality than flow measures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASPaeroFlow，一种结合实例空间分解启发式与基于Answer Set Programming的局部精确方法的联合ATFCM启发式算法，在中小到行业规模实例上提供精确方法与运营基线之间的计算中间地带。
AI.motivation: 现有ATFCM模型将ATFM与DAC分离，导致固定需求与固定容量假设之间存在未解决的循环依赖。虽然联合优化能解决此问题，但扩大的搜索空间使精确模型在中大规模实例上计算不可行。
AI.method: 提出ASPaeroFlow启发式算法，将实例空间分解启发式与使用Answer Set Programming的局部精确方法相结合，用于联合ATFCM优化。
AI.result: 在从小规模到行业规模实例上的基准测试表明：(1)该启发式提供了精确方法与运营基线之间的计算中间地带；(2)联合优化可优于顺序优化；(3)消融研究表明DAC对解质量的影响大于流量管理措施。
AI.conclusion: ASPaeroFlow有效弥合了精确方法与运营基线之间的计算差距，证实了联合ATFCM优化的价值，并揭示了DAC在联合优化中比流量措施具有更大的影响权重。

title: RL-Native Distillation: Exploiting Scored Trajectories for Few-Step Image Generation
summary: Efficient text-to-image generation requires both reinforcement-learning (RL)-based reward alignment and few-step distillation, yet these procedures are typically performed sequentially, increasing training cost and risking the loss of reward gains during compression. We instead take an RL-native perspective: diffusion RL already generates reward-scored finite-step trajectories, whose intermediate states provide a natural source of distillation supervision rather than a disposable byproduct of sampling. Based on this insight, we propose REST (Reward-Enhanced Scored-Trajectory Distillation), a single-stage RL-distillation co-training framework that attaches a decoupled student to an arbitrary RL teacher. The student learns segment-wise from the teacher's evolving rollout trajectories while leaving the original teacher optimization unchanged. To prevent uniform imitation from preserving undesirable low-reward behaviors, we further introduce Advantage-Modulated Distillation (AMD), which transforms rollout advantages into signed weights over a base distillation loss. AMD strengthens supervision from preferred trajectories and mildly repels the student from low-reward ones. The resulting framework is lightweight and plug-and-play, requires no extra image rollouts, no separate distillation dataset, and no adversarial training. Experiments on compositional generation, visual text rendering, and human-preference alignment show that REST enables few-step CFG-free inference that matches or surpasses its 40-step RL teacher, with an overall additional training cost below 25% over pure RL. REST improves DrawBench PickScore over RTDMD by 0.82 while requiring only one-fifth of the training iterations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出REST框架，将RL奖励对齐与少步蒸馏统一为单阶段协同训练，从RL教师模型的滚动轨迹中提取蒸馏监督信号，并引入AMD机制加权区分高低奖励轨迹，实现轻量级即插即用的少步无CFG推理。
AI.motivation: 传统文本到图像生成需要依次进行RL奖励对齐和少步蒸馏，这种串行流程不仅增加训练成本，还会在压缩阶段丢失已获得的奖励增益。作者希望打破这种顺序范式，直接从RL原生视角出发，将奖励评分轨迹的中间状态作为蒸馏监督来源。
AI.method: 提出REST（奖励增强评分轨迹蒸馏）：将解耦的学生模型附加到任意RL教师模型上，学生从教师不断演化的推出轨迹中分段学习，同时保持教师优化不变。引入优势调节蒸馏（AMD），将推出优势转化为符号权重施加于基础蒸馏损失之上，增强高奖励轨迹的监督并轻微排斥低奖励轨迹。
AI.result: 在组合生成、视觉文本渲染和人类偏好对齐实验上，REST实现了与40步RL教师相当甚至更优的少步无CFG推理，额外训练成本仅为纯RL的25%以下；在DrawBench数据集上较RTDMD提升0.82 PickScore，且仅需其五分之一的训练迭代次数。
AI.conclusion: REST证明RL训练与蒸馏可以单阶段协同进行而非串行执行，通过将轨迹中间状态转化为蒸馏监督避免了奖励损失和额外训练开销，为高效文本到图像生成提供了一种轻量化、即插即用的解决方案。

title: CoRE: Consensus Rewards via Equilibrium for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
summary: On unlabeled test data, reinforcement learning lacks a ground-truth reward; test-time RL methods derive one from the model's own roll-outs, rewarding those that match the majority vote over $N$ sampled answers. That vote discards a correct answer whenever it is a minority and scores every majority-matching roll-out identically. We replace it with \emph{CoRE} (Consensus Rewards via Equilibrium): the $N$ roll-outs form a graph whose edges combine answer agreement, reasoning similarity, and generation confidence, and replicator dynamics extract its dominant set, yielding a refined pseudo-label, a graded per-roll-out reward, and a per-question cohesiveness gate. CoRE strictly generalizes voting: majority voting is recovered as a special case; a block-value analysis gives a sharp threshold for when consensus recovers a correct minority against a larger wrong plurality; and confidence calibration provably lowers that threshold multiplicatively. Across seven backbones and five benchmarks (42 model--benchmark cells, three seeds each), \emph{CoRE} improves the untrained base by $+21.7$ points on average versus $+20.4$ for majority-vote TTRL, wins wherever agreement is contestable with margins over the vote of up to $+7.5$ points, and reaches the voting baseline's plateau accuracy in $54$--$70$\% fewer steps. Consensus, not counting: treating the roll-out group as a graph rather than a ballot box turns a brittle vote into a calibrated, graded, self-supervised reward at no extra roll-out cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoRE（Consensus Rewards via Equilibrium）方法，将测试时强化学习的N个roll-out构建为图（结合答案一致性、推理相似性和生成置信度），通过复制子动力学提取主导集合，得到细化的伪标签、分级奖励和问题间一致性门控。CoRE在7个骨干网络和5个基准（42个模型-基准组合，各3个种子）上平均提升未训练基线+21.7分（优于多数投票TTRL的+20.4），且在可达投票基线精度的前提下节省54%-70%的训练步数。
AI.motivation: 测试时强化学习缺乏真实奖励，现有的多数投票方法存在两个缺陷：一是当正确答案属于少数派时会被直接丢弃；二是所有与多数一致的roll-out得到相同分数，无法区分质量。作者希望用更精细的图结构替代投票箱，以捕获roll-out之间的共识关系。
AI.method: CoRE方法包含三个核心组件：1) 将N个roll-out建模为图，边权结合答案一致性、推理相似性和生成置信度；2) 使用复制子动力学（replicator dynamics）提取图中的主导集合，生成细化的伪标签和分级奖励；3) 引入每个问题的一致性门控（cohesiveness gate）。理论上通过块值分析给出共识恢复正确少数的阈值，并证明置信度校准可乘性降低该阈值。
AI.result: 在42个模型-基准组合上，CoRE平均提升未训练基线+21.7分，优于多数投票TTRL的+20.4分；在有争议场景中领先投票方法最多达+7.5分；在达到投票基线平台精度时节省54%-70%的训练步数。多数投票是CoRE的特例，证明了其严格泛化性。
AI.conclusion: CoRE表明将roll-out群体视为图而非投票箱，可以将脆弱的投票转化为经过校准的、分级的、自监督的奖励，且无需额外roll-out成本。共识而非计数是更优的测试时奖励信号来源。

title: BAG: Budget-Aware Gating for Diffusion Caching
summary: Diffusion caching is a lightweight strategy that accelerates Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) by reusing intermediate features across denoising steps, but existing paradigms face a fundamental trade-off: online heuristics lack global budget awareness, whereas static schedules lack instance adaptivity and fail to flexibly adapt to varying runtime budget constraints. To bridge this gap, we present BAG (Budget-Aware Gating), a novel caching policy that unifies global budget pacing with dynamic, instance-adaptive feature reuse. Rather than relying on hand-crafted rules, BAG employs a lightweight gating network that dynamically decides whether to execute a full computation or reuse cached features at each step by jointly conditioning on the budget state and local trajectory feedback. We train this policy via offline-to-online schedule distillation, transferring the decision-making of offline-searched schedules into a compact online gate. Extensive experiments on FLUX.1-dev and Wan2.1 demonstrate that BAG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art caching methods across various speedup tiers while remaining robust across different resolutions, seeds, and guidance scales. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: BAG (Budget-Aware Gating) 是一种新型扩散缓存策略，通过轻量级门控网络统一全局预算调控与实例自适应特征复用，解决了在线启发式缺乏全局预算感知与静态调度缺乏实例自适应性的问题，在FLUX.1-dev和Wan2.1上超越现有SOTA缓存方法。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散缓存方法存在根本性权衡：在线启发式方法缺乏全局预算感知，无法统筹整体计算资源分配；而静态调度方法缺乏实例自适应性，无法根据具体输入和运行时预算约束灵活调整。两者都难以在动态预算约束下达到最优性能。
AI.method: BAG采用一个轻量级门控网络，在每个去噪步骤中联合基于预算状态和局部轨迹反馈，动态决定执行完整计算还是复用缓存特征。训练上采用离线到在线的调度蒸馏策略，将离线搜索得到的最优调度的决策知识迁移到紧凑的在线门控网络中。
AI.result: 在FLUX.1-dev和Wan2.1上的大量实验表明，BAG在各种加速档位下均一致优于最先进的缓存方法，并且在不同分辨率、随机种子和引导尺度下保持稳健性。
AI.conclusion: BAG证明了将全局预算意识与实例自适应性统一到单一策略中是可行且有效的，为扩散模型推理加速提供了一个兼具灵活性和鲁棒性的新范式。

title: GeoPhysAdapter: Scale-Matched Geophysical Adaptation for Cross-Domain Landslide Mapping with Vision Foundation Models
summary: Newly triggered landslides rarely carry immediate annotations, so cross-domain transferability determines the value of landslide mapping for emergency response and regional risk assessment. Vision foundation models have strengthened representational transfer, yet on unseen regions, events, and data sources they still generate high-confidence false alarms. Terrain, material, and rainfall triggering can constrain such errors, but their supports are local, regional, and event-scale, so that resampling onto a 10~m grid misaligns them with the segmentation decision unit and compounds the uncertain geographic context problem (UGCoP). We propose GeoPhysAdapter, which anchors on a frozen vision foundation model, restricts terrain, material, and triggering to dense spatial guidance, regional modulation, and event-timing forcing, and applies bounded adaptation at two decision units, the pixel and the candidate landslide body, reverting exactly to the visual prediction where support is insufficient. On an event-isolated PILD dataset of four public sources, 55 global landslide events, and 7,890 test samples, 70.3% of cross-domain false-positive mass lies in near-pure spurious bodies of median equivalent diameter 207m, matching coarse-prior support rather than the pixel. Pixel-level adaptation removes a net 507,817 erroneous pixels and reduces error by 7.76%, whereas raising the decision unit to the candidate body, under identical samples, anchor, and baseline, increases error reduction to 23.99%, approximately 3.1 times the pixel-level effect, improves IoU by 0.031 (14.2% relative), and corrects 9.92 pixels per pixel harmed. The data and code are publicly available at: https://github.com/Liu-Zhihang/geophysadapter.

AI.tldr: 提出了GeoPhysAdapter，一种将地理物理先验（地形、物质、触发条件）锚定在冻结的视觉基础模型上的跨域滑坡测绘方法。该方法在像素级和候选滑坡体两种决策单元上进行有界适应，实验表明在体级决策单元上错误减少率约为像素级的3.1倍，显著提升了跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 新触发的滑坡很少带有即时标注，因此跨域迁移能力决定了滑坡测绘的应急响应和区域风险评估价值。尽管视觉基础模型增强了表征迁移，但在未见过的区域、事件和数据源上仍会产生高置信度的误报。地形、物质和降雨触发等先验信息可以有效约束这些错误，但它们分别支持局部、区域和事件尺度，重采样到10m网格后与分割决策单元错位，加剧了不确定地理上下文问题（UGCoP）。
AI.method: GeoPhysAdapter锚定在冻结的视觉基础模型上，将地形限制为稠密空间引导、物质限制为区域调制、触发限制为事件时序强迫，并在两个决策单元（像素级和候选滑坡体）上应用有界适应，在支撑不足时精确恢复到视觉预测。
AI.result: 在事件隔离的PILD数据集（4个公共数据源、55个全球滑坡事件、7890个测试样本）上，70.3%的跨域假阳性质量位于近似纯虚假的体块中（中位等效直径207m），与粗粒度先验支撑匹配而非像素。像素级适应去除507,817个错误像素并将错误降低7.76%，而将决策单元提升到候选体后，在相同样本、锚定和基线下错误降低23.99%（约为像素级效果的3.1倍），IoU提升0.031（相对14.2%），每受损像素纠正9.92个像素。
AI.conclusion: 将决策单元从像素级提升到候选滑坡体级能够更好地匹配地理物理先验的支撑尺度，从而显著提升跨域滑坡测绘的准确性，为应急响应和风险评估提供了更可靠的跨域滑坡映射方案。数据和代码已公开。

title: RealDenseFace: Real-time Monocular 3D Face Reconstruction from Dense UV-space Priors
summary: Recent monocular 3D face reconstruction methods achieve high fidelity by fitting a 3D Morphable Model (3DMM) to dense priors predicted by networks, but the optimization stage is computationally expensive, often taking tens of seconds per image. We present RealDenseFace, a real-time optimization-based 3D face reconstruction method with dense UV-space network predictions. Our key idea is to formulate 3DMM fitting as a nonlinear least-squares problem and solve it with a tailored Gauss-Newton solver that converges in only a few iterations. The reconstruction is conducted in two stages. In the first stage, the network predicts two dense UV-space maps from a single RGB image: a correspondence map for UV-to-image alignment, and a relative-depth map for geometric constraints along the viewing direction. In the second stage, the solver fits per-vertex targets sampled from these maps at the vertex UV coordinates. The solver supports all three reconstruction settings: single-image fitting, offline sequence reconstruction, and online tracking. Our method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on the NeRSemble SVFR benchmark. The online tracker runs at 80+ FPS, and the offline sequence reconstruction is over 20 times faster than previous optimization-based baselines.

AI.tldr: RealDenseFace提出了一种实时、基于优化的单目3D人脸重建方法。核心思想是将3DMM拟合表述为非线性最小二乘问题，并使用定制的高斯-牛顿求解器在几次迭代内收敛。方法分为两阶段：首先网络从单张RGB图像预测两个密集UV空间图（对应图和相对深度图），然后求解器在顶点UV坐标处拟合逐顶点目标。该方法支持单图像拟合、离线序列重建和在线跟踪三种设置，在NeRSemble SVFR基准上达到最先进精度，在线跟踪器运行速度超过80 FPS，离线序列重建比先前基于优化的基线快20倍以上。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于优化的单目3D人脸重建方法虽然通过将3DMM拟合到网络预测的密集先验实现高保真度，但其优化阶段计算开销巨大，每张图像需要数十秒的处理时间，严重限制了实时应用场景。
AI.method: 将3DMM拟合表述为非线性最小二乘问题，并设计定制的高斯-牛顿求解器实现快速收敛。重建分两阶段进行：第一阶段网络从单张RGB图像预测两个密集UV空间图（UV到图像对齐的对应图，以及用于视线方向几何约束的相对深度图）；第二阶段求解器在顶点UV坐标处采样这些图并拟合逐顶点目标。方法支持单图像拟合、离线序列重建和在线跟踪三种设置。
AI.result: 在NeRSemble SVFR基准上达到最先进精度；在线跟踪器运行速度超过80 FPS；离线序列重建比先前基于优化的基线快20倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 通过设计高效的优化求解器并配合密集UV空间网络预测，成功突破了基于优化的3D人脸重建方法在计算效率上的瓶颈，实现了实时性能的同时保持高重建精度。

title: Control-Oriented Scenario Tree Construction through Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multistage stochastic model predictive control (MPC) handles uncertainty by optimizing over a scenario tree, a finite branching approximation of future outcomes constructed from sampled forecasts. To build such a tree, conventional methods focus on matching the underlying probability distribution---e.g., via Wasserstein-based scenario reduction---but improved distributional accuracy does not necessarily yield better control performance. We propose a control-oriented approach that learns scenario tree construction directly from its impact on downstream decisions. Fixing the tree topology, we formulate tree construction as a sequential assignment of sampled scenarios to leaves. This assignment is parameterized by an attention-based policy over the scenario set and trained using reinforcement learning, with closed-loop control profit as the objective. Training is stabilized by an asymmetric critic that leverages realized future trajectories. We evaluate the method on a risk-averse battery arbitrage problem. Across a range of forecast set sizes, the learned construction consistently achieves the highest profit, outperforming classical forward and backward reduction methods and certainty-equivalent (single-trajectory forecast) control. The learned policy also exhibits greater robustness on challenging instances, consistently demonstrating better tail-risk characteristics. Analysis of the resulting trees indicates that our method constructs compact, selectively branching structures that capture high-impact events while keeping most trajectories nearly deterministic. These findings highlight that the value of a scenario tree depends critically on the decisions it supports, and provide an effective framework to train scenario tree constructors merely based on the closed-loop control optimization signal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向控制的场景树构建方法，通过强化学习直接优化闭环控制收益，而非传统地匹配概率分布，在风险规避的电池套利问题上优于经典场景缩减方法和确定性预测控制。
AI.motivation: 传统多阶段随机MPC构建场景树时专注于匹配潜在概率分布（如基于Wasserstein的场景缩减），但更好的分布精度并不必然带来更好的控制性能。场景树的价值取决于它所支持的决策，因此需要一种面向控制目标的场景树构建方法。
AI.method: 固定树拓扑结构，将场景树构建形式化为将采样场景顺序分配给叶节点的序列决策问题。该分配由基于注意力机制的策略参数化，并采用强化学习训练，以闭环控制利润为优化目标。通过利用已实现未来轨迹的非对称评论家网络来稳定训练过程。
AI.result: 在风险规避的电池套利问题上，所提出的学习方法在各种预测集规模下均取得最高利润，优于经典的前向/后向缩减方法和确定性等价控制。学习策略在困难实例上表现出更强的鲁棒性和更好的尾部风险特征。分析表明该方法构建了紧凑、选择性分叉的树结构，能捕获高影响事件同时保持大部分轨迹近乎确定性。
AI.conclusion: 场景树的价值关键取决于其所支持的决策。本文提供了一个有效的框架，仅基于闭环控制优化信号即可训练场景树构建器，证明了面向控制的场景树学习比传统的分布匹配方法更有效。

title: In-Loop Model Adaptation with Coupled Latent-Noise Guidance for High-Fidelity Subject-Driven Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in generating high-quality images from a given text prompt. Subject-driven generation aims to synthesize customized images to mimic the appearance of subjects in given reference images within different visual contexts specified by the text prompts. The central challenge here is that, when the reference image changes, the diffusion model cannot efficiently adapt to different visual contexts while consistently maintaining the subject identity. Existing methods either train the model with a large domain-specific dataset or fine-tune the model using the reference image for hundreds of iterations before actual image generation. In this work, we explore a new approach, called \textit{In-Loop Model Adaptation} (IMA), which adapts the core diffusion model at each generation step during the actual process of image generation, without being trained on the reference image before the generation process. To this end, we establish a DDIM inversion chain that maps the reference image to a sequence of latent, as well as a text-to-image generation chain which generates the image from the text prompt only. We then introduce a masked latent consistency loss and a noise regularization loss to characterize the latent-noise difference between the diffusion model and these two chains at each generation step. This coupled latent-noise loss is used to guide the in-loop model adaptation to preserve the subject identity specified by the reference image while maintaining accurate alignment with the text prompt, resulting in high-fidelity text-to-image generation. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed IMA method significantly improves the performance of subject-driven text-to-image generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为In-Loop Model Adaptation (IMA)的新方法，用于主体驱动的文本到图像生成。与现有方法不同，IMA不需要在生成前对参考图像进行训练或微调，而是在实际图像生成过程中，每一步都动态调整扩散模型。通过建立DDIM反演链（映射参考图像）和文本到图像生成链，并引入掩码潜在一致性损失和噪声正则化损失来引导模型适应，从而在保持主体身份的同时与文本提示准确对齐。
AI.motivation: 主体驱动的文本到图像生成面临核心挑战：当参考图像变化时，扩散模型难以在保持主体身份的同时高效适应不同视觉上下文。现有方法要么需要大规模领域数据集训练，要么需要在生成前用参考图像进行数百次迭代微调，效率低下且成本高昂。因此需要一种无需预训练即可在生成过程中自适应调整的方法。
AI.method: IMA方法包含三个关键组件：(1) 建立DDIM反演链，将参考图像映射为潜在变量序列；(2) 建立纯文本驱动的文本到图像生成链；(3) 引入掩码潜在一致性损失和噪声正则化损失，刻画扩散模型与这两条链之间在每一步生成过程中的潜在-噪声差异，通过耦合潜在-噪声损失指导模型在生成循环中动态适应，以保持主体身份。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提出的IMA方法显著提升了主体驱动的文本到图像生成性能，能够在保持主体身份一致性的同时实现与文本提示的准确对齐，生成高保真图像。
AI.conclusion: IMA通过将模型适应过程嵌入到实际生成循环中，避免了传统的预训练或预微调步骤，为高效的主体驱动生成提供了一条新路径。实验验证了该方法在性能和效率上的优越性。

title: LLM-Guided Heuristic Design from Simulation Traces: A Case Study in Dynamic Production and AGV Scheduling
summary:
Simulation-based optimization (SBO) evaluates executable policies under stochastic dynamics, but most methods treat the simulator as a black box: aggregate scores rank candidates without revealing why they fail or which policy logic should change. We present an LLM-guided heuristic design framework that uses repeated simulation for selection and event-level traces for diagnosis. Each incumbent is assessed through multiple replications, while replaying its lowest-scoring one produces a queryable trace. A manager agent formulates bottleneck hypotheses from this evidence, and editing agents implement parallel code-level revisions. After execution checks and repeated evaluation, best-so-far selection retains only improvements. LLM revision occurs between evaluation batches, while a fixed policy controls each simulation run.
  We evaluate the framework in a discrete-event simulation of dynamic production and automated guided vehicle (AGV) scheduling. Across five independent optimization runs with Gemini-3.1-Pro, final mean scores averaged 77.51 on the simulator's 0-100 scale. In the highest-scoring run, trace-based diagnoses motivated proactive charging, distance-aware AGV assignment, and rebalanced dispatch priorities, raising the best-so-far mean score from 62.49 to 78.61. On 100 matched seeds, the best final policy outscored representative rolling-MILP, rule-based, and metaheuristic policies on every seed and retained its advantage under random faults without re-optimization. After separate re-optimization for a longer horizon and variable order interarrival times, the resulting policies again outscored all baselines. Ablations with two LLM backbones showed that removing either parallel candidate generation or trace-database access reduced final mean scores. These results show that simulation traces can guide targeted code-level policy improvement in complex simulation-based scheduling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个LLM引导的启发式设计框架，利用重复模拟进行策略选择、事件级轨迹进行诊断。管理者智能体从轨迹中形成瓶颈假设，编辑智能体进行并行代码级修改，通过"目前最优"选择机制只保留改进。在动态生产与AGV调度仿真中，平均得分77.51，最佳策略在所有100个匹配种子上超越了滚动MILP、规则基和元启发式基线。
AI.motivation: 传统仿真优化(SBO)将模拟器视为黑盒，仅通过聚合分数排序候选方案，无法揭示策略失败的原因或应该修改哪些策略逻辑，缺乏可解释性和诊断能力。
AI.method: 1) 每个候选策略通过多次重复模拟评估；2) 回放得分最低的模拟轨迹生成可查询的日志；3) 管理者智能体基于轨迹证据形成瓶颈假设；4) 编辑智能体实现并行代码级修改；5) 执行检查和重复评估后，通过best-so-far选择只保留改进；6) LLM修订发生在评估批次之间，每次仿真运行由固定策略控制。
AI.result: 在动态生产与AGV调度仿真中，5次独立运行的最终平均得分为77.51(0-100分制)。最高得分运行中，基于轨迹的诊断促成了主动充电、距离感知AGV分配和重新平衡的调度优先级，将best-so-far平均分从62.49提升至78.61。在100个匹配种子上超越所有基线，在随机故障下无需重新优化仍保持优势；消融实验表明去除并行候选生成或轨迹数据库访问都会降低最终得分。
AI.conclusion: 仿真轨迹能够引导针对性的代码级策略改进，在复杂的基于仿真的调度问题中显著优于传统黑盒优化方法和基线策略。

title: Task-Adaptive 3D Cross-Field MRI Translation via Field-Conditioned Content-Style Pretraining
summary: Magnetic field strength is a major source of domain shift in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), affecting signal-to-noise ratio, tissue contrast, spatial detail, and the visibility of anatomical boundaries. The MRIxFields 2026 challenge investigates this problem through cross-field MRI translation across acquisitions at 0.1T, 1.5T, 3T, 5T, and 7T. Its three tasks, Any-to-7T, 0.1T-to-High, and Any-to-Any synthesis, require the generation of target-field image characteristics while preserving subject-specific anatomy. This problem is particularly challenging because paired acquisitions of the same subject across multiple field strengths are rarely available for training. We propose a 3D unpaired cross-field MRI translation framework based on field-conditioned content-style pretraining. The proposed framework first learns controllable field-to-field translation across all available field strengths by disentangling anatomical content from field-dependent contrast characteristics. The pretrained backbone is then adapted to task-specific target domains. Our model comprises a 3D content encoder, a 3D style encoder, a field-conditioned style generator, an AdaIN-modulated decoder, and a multi-field discriminator. Adversarial learning encourages realistic target-field appearance, while cycle-consistency, identity, content, style, and diversity constraints promote anatomical fidelity and controllable translation. We evaluate the proposed method on MRIxFields data spanning five field strengths and three MRI modalities. Experiments on paired test data demonstrate that the framework can adapt to the three challenge settings while preserving three-dimensional anatomical structure in the synthesized volumes. The implementation code is publicly available at https://github.com/Idea89560041/3D-MRI-Field-Translation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于场条件内容-风格预训练的3D无配对跨场MRI翻译框架，解决不同磁场强度（0.1T至7T）下MRI图像域偏移问题，可适配MRIxFields 2026挑战的三个任务，在保持受试者解剖结构的同时生成目标场图像特征。
AI.motivation: 磁场强度是MRI中域偏移的主要来源，影响信噪比、组织对比度和解剖边界可见性。跨场配对数据难以获取（同一受试者在多个场强下扫描极少见），使得跨场MRI翻译极具挑战。
AI.method: 提出3D无配对跨场MRI翻译框架：(1) 通过3D内容编码器与3D风格编码器解耦解剖内容与场依赖对比特征；(2) 场条件风格生成器生成目标场风格；(3) AdaIN调制解码器重建图像；(4) 多场判别器进行对抗学习。采用循环一致性、身份、内容、风格和多样性约束确保解剖保真度与可控翻译，先进行跨所有场强的预训练，再适配到具体任务。
AI.result: 在覆盖五个场强和三种MRI模态的MRIxFields数据上进行评估，配对测试数据实验表明框架能适配三个挑战设置，同时保持合成体数据中的三维解剖结构。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过场条件的内容-风格预训练策略，有效解决了无配对条件下跨场MRI翻译问题，为不同磁场强度间的图像转换提供了可行方案，代码已公开。

title: CircuitReason-1k: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Visual-to-Symbolic Reasoning inElectrical Circuits
summary: Electrical circuit analysis requires more than recognizing components in an image. A solver must ground symbols and labels, recover latent topology, select a physical model, formulate coupled equations, propagate intermediate quantities, and preserve units, signs, directions, and phase conventions. We introduce \benchmark, a benchmark of 1,000 authentic textbook problems for evaluating this complete long-horizon visual-to-symbolic reasoning process. Each problem pairs one or more circuit diagrams with a self-contained question, a typed or semantically specified answer, and a reference worked solution. An evidence-first construction pipeline aligns questions, figures, and solutions, while a reasoning-oriented taxonomy organizes problems by circuit type and dependency depth. Evaluation combines conservative typed scoring with identity-blinded multi-model semantic consensus, retaining every problem in the denominator. Across three commercial chatbot systems and six open-source multimodal large language models, the highest-scoring system reaches 84.8\% accuracy. However, performance consistently deteriorates on long-horizon problems, and qualitative analysis exposes persistent failures in topology-to-target binding, physical conventions, and late-stage output propagation. \benchmark{} provides a focused testbed for measuring whether multimodal models can transform technical visual evidence into sustained, physically valid symbolic reasoning. Code are available at GitHub - CircuitReason/CircuitReason1K.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了CircuitReason1K基准测试，包含1,000个真实教科书电路问题，用于评估多模态大语言模型完成"视觉到符号"长时序推理的完整能力。最高系统准确率达84.8%，但在长时序问题上表现持续下降，存在拓扑绑定、物理约定和输出传播方面的系统性失败。
AI.motivation: 电路分析不仅仅是图像中的元件识别，还需要接地符号与标签、恢复潜在拓扑、选择物理模型、构建耦合方程、传播中间量，并保持单位、符号、方向和相位约定。现有基准无法评估这种完整的视觉到符号的长时序推理过程，需要一个系统化的测试平台。
AI.method: 构建了1,000个真实教科书问题组成的基准，每个问题包含电路图、自包含问题、类型化或语义化的答案以及参考求解过程。采用"证据优先"的构建流程对齐问题、图形和解答，并通过面向推理的分类法按电路类型和依赖深度组织问题。评估结合保守类型化评分与身份遮蔽的多模型语义共识，所有问题均保留在分母中。
AI.result: 在三个商业聊天系统和六个开源多模态大语言模型上评估，最高系统准确率达84.8%。但性能在长时序问题上持续恶化，定性分析揭示了拓扑到目标绑定、物理约定以及后期输出传播方面的持续性失败。
AI.conclusion: CircuitReason1K为衡量多模态模型能否将技术视觉证据转化为持续、物理有效的符号推理提供了聚焦测试平台。

title: Did the Grid Erase the Event? EndoClock for Auditing Medical World-Model Pipelines
comment: Accepted for publication at the 1st MICCAI Workshop on Medical World Models (MWM 2026)
