summary: Medical world models commonly learn from multimodal recordings synchronized onto a fixed-rate grid. This preprocessing resamples each native stream onto a shared time axis. Each stream has an observation clock that governs when observations are emitted or updated. When this clock depends on the latent or acquisition state, it is endogenous. In such settings, synchronization may not be neutral and can erase task-relevant evidence before the model sees the data. We introduce a four-regime taxonomy that characterizes where the evidence needed to distinguish a target event or state survives. The relevant witness may remain in the sampled values, in grid-cell update patterns, in native timing, or only in an external acquisition channel. EndoClock operationalizes this taxonomy as a conservative pretraining audit. It reports the lowest witness-bearing representation supported by the available evidence, or unresolved when no regime can be established. We illustrate this failure in echocardiography, where B-mode video write-outs cease during pulsed-wave Doppler acquisition while the corresponding measurement events remain recorded only in an external acquisition log. This work is a preliminary failure alert and executable audit. Its practical message is to preserve the native observation process long enough to determine whether synchronization has erased information required by the intended task.

AI.tldr: 本文指出医学世界模型中常用的多模态数据同步预处理可能不是中性的，当观测时钟是内生的（取决于潜在或采集状态）时，同步可能在实际模型看到数据之前就抹除了与任务相关的证据。作者提出一个四区间分类法来刻画证据存续的位置，并开发了EndoClock工具作为保守的预训练审计，用于报告最低级别的证据承载表示或标记为未解决。
AI.motivation: 医学世界模型通常从多模态记录中学习，这些记录被同步到固定的时间网格上。然而，当观测时钟是内生的（取决于潜在或采集状态）时，这种同步处理可能不是中性的，会抹除任务关键证据，而现有方法未充分认识这一风险。
AI.method: 作者提出四区间分类法（采样值、网格单元更新模式、原生时序、外部采集通道），并设计EndoClock作为可执行的保守预训练审计工具，用于报告证据承载的最低表示级别，或在无法建立任何区间时标记为未解决。
AI.result: 在超声心动图中展示了该失效模式：在脉冲波多普勒采集期间，B模式视频写入停止，而对应的测量事件仅记录在外部采集日志中。这项工作提供了初步的失败警报和可执行审计。
AI.conclusion: 实际建议是：应保留原生观测过程足够长的时间，以确定同步是否抹除了目标任务所需的信息。这是一个初步的警示性工作。

title: OpenLoopEvolve: A Verifiable Self-Evolution Framework for Loop Policies in Long-Horizon Complex Tasks
summary: Long-horizon complex tasks require agents to repeatedly observe states, formulate plans, invoke tools, verify results, and recover from failures in continuously changing environments. However, such control experience often remains confined to a single context or a fixed prompt, and is difficult to accumulate and reuse across historical traces. This paper presents OpenLoopEvolve (OLE), a self-evolution framework centered on the Loop Policy. OLE represents an agent's observation, planning, memory, action, verification, recovery, stopping, and budget control as portable policy assets with versions and lineages, and provides online and offline evolution modes that can be selected according to practical needs: the online mode triggers candidate generation based on feedback from continuous operation, whereas the offline mode searches for candidate policies from archived traces and failure evidence. Both modes share an evolution mechanism consisting of autonomous proposals by a large language model, Champion--Challenger paired evaluation, and robust release. Policies released online are activated at a subsequent task boundary, monitored using subsequent feedback, and rolled back to their parent versions when degradation conditions are met. On the simulated business benchmark YC-Bench, both modes improve aggregate task performance, task success rate, and risk metrics relative to a fixed initial Loop Policy. The results indicate that treating the Loop Policy as a governable asset can support the accumulation, comparison, release, and reuse of control experience and improve agent performance on long-horizon complex tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OpenLoopEvolve (OLE)，一个以Loop Policy为核心的智能体自进化框架，将智能体的观察、规划、记忆、行动、验证、恢复、停止和预算控制表示为可移植的策略资产（带版本和谱系），支持在线和离线两种进化模式，通过LLM自主提案、Champion-Challenger配对评估和稳健发布机制实现策略持续演进。
AI.motivation: 长时程复杂任务需要智能体不断观察状态、规划、调用工具、验证结果并从失败中恢复，但这类控制经验通常局限于单一上下文或固定提示中，难以跨历史轨迹积累和复用，缺乏系统性的策略演化机制。
AI.method: OLE框架将Loop Policy定义为可移植策略资产（带版本和谱系），提供在线和离线两种进化模式：在线模式根据持续运行的反饋触发候选生成，离线模式从归档轨迹和失败证据中搜索候选策略。两种模式共享统一的进化机制，包括LLM自主提案、Champion-Challenger配对评估和稳健发布。在线发布的策略在后续任务边界激活，通过后续反馈监控，在满足退化条件时回滚到父版本。
AI.result: 在模拟商业基准YC-Bench上，两种模式相对于固定的初始Loop Policy均提升了聚合任务性能、任务成功率和风险指标。
AI.conclusion: 将Loop Policy视为可治理的资产能够支持控制经验的积累、比较、发布和复用，从而提升智能体在长时程复杂任务上的表现。

title: GRASP: Granularity-Aware Region Alignment and Semantic Prototype Learning for Fine-Grained Cross-Modal Understanding in Drone Views
comment: Accepted at the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM Multimedia 2026, MM '26). 10 pages, 6 figures
summary: Fine-grained cross-modal understanding in drone views is essential for aerial vision-language navigation. However, the inherent wide field of view and overhead perspective of drone scenarios impose dual challenges on vision-language understanding. At the macro level, overwhelming background clutter in visual representations leads to Cross-Modal Focus Misalignment, where the model prioritizes global environmental similarities over specific object details. At the micro level, Visual Isomorphism creates ambiguity, where candidates share similar geometric structures yet differ only in subtle attributes. To address these challenges, we propose the Granularity-Aware Region Alignment and Semantic Prototype (GRASP) learning framework, enhancing discriminative capability through two synergistic strategies. Specifically, we introduce Region-Focused Alignment (RFA) to promote object-centric cross-modal alignment while suppressing background interference. Concurrently, to tackle visual isomorphism, we propose Semantic Perturbation Enhanced Matching (SPEM), which leverages a foreground-purified Semantic Prototype Codebook (SPC) to construct semantically perturbed negatives for fine-grained semantic discrimination. Extensive experiments on the GeoText-1652 benchmark and the unseen ERA dataset demonstrate that GRASP achieves competitive performance in drone-view fine-grained image-text retrieval, validating its effectiveness for cross-modal understanding in aerial scenarios. Our code implementation is available at https://github.com/UCAS-JC/GRASP.

AI.tldr: GRASP框架通过区域聚焦对齐和语义扰动弹增强匹配两种协同策略，解决无人机视角下跨模态理解中的宏观注意力错位与微观视觉同构两大挑战，在GeoText-1652和ERA数据集上取得竞争力的细粒度图文检索性能。
AI.motivation: 无人机视角的细粒度跨模态理解面临双重挑战：宏观层面，宽视场和俯视角度导致大量背景杂波，造成跨模态焦点错位（模型关注全局环境相似性而非具体物体细节）；微观层面，视觉同构现象使候选物体几何结构相似但细微属性不同，产生语义歧义。
AI.method: 提出GRASP（粒度感知区域对齐与语义原型）学习框架，包含两个协同策略：1）区域聚焦对齐（RFA）促进以物体为中心的跨模态对齐并抑制背景干扰；2）语义扰动弹增强匹配（SPEM），利用前景纯化的语义原型码本（SPC）构建语义扰动的负样本，实现细粒度语义判别。
AI.result: 在GeoText-1652基准和未见过的ERA数据集上进行大量实验，GRASP在无人机视角细粒度图文检索中取得有竞争力的性能，验证了其在航空场景跨模态理解中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GRASP框架有效解决了无人机视角跨模态理解中的宏观注意力错位和微观视觉同构问题，代码已开源。

title: KVDiagnosis: A Diagnostic Benchmark for KV-Cache Compression in Long-Context Language Models
summary: KV-cache compression reduces long-context memory, but aggregate task scores reveal neither which correct executions fail nor why. We present KVDiagnosis, a diagnostic dataset and benchmark with three contributions. First, a 25-method taxonomy groups methods into five mechanism families and links them to eight verified implementations and their valid diagnostic measurements. Second, for every supported method setting, we evaluate all sources in each fixed split against a per-source FullCache control before selecting FullCache-correct/compressed-wrong (C-to-W) rows separately for each method-setting, so no compressor defines another's test set. Third, a common record format links paired outputs and run metadata to cache, likelihood, attention, and decoding measurements with explicit applicability states. On Qwen3-8B, four evidence-aware workloads yield 59 800 supported compressed runs over 2600 sources and 12 520 C-to-W rows. Under fixed diagnostic rules, 63.2% have low or partial measured/projected coverage. Only 19 rows (0.2%) combine high measured/projected coverage with strong likelihood drift; another 2,126 (17.0%) preserve structural position addressability, for which representation fidelity remains unknown, while showing the same drift. Against C-to-C success controls, all ten diagnostics separate failed from successful compression (stratified AUROC 0.684-0.871). Among 96 reproducible low-EAR failures, a controlled 4x evidence-attention boost repairs 29.2%, versus 6.3% under a count-matched sham intervention and 3.3% degradation on matched C-to-C controls. Code and data are available at https://github.com/ChosenQC/KVDiagnosis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KVDiagnosis，一个用于诊断KV-cache压缩失败的基准数据集与评测框架。它包含25种方法的分类体系（5大机制族），通过逐源FullCache对照选择C-to-W样本，统一记录格式关联输出与各类诊断测量。在Qwen3-8B上生成59,800次压缩运行，发现63.2%的失败覆盖度低/部分，且通过受控证据注意力增强可修复29.2%的失败。
AI.motivation: 现有KV-cache压缩评估仅依赖聚合任务分数，无法揭示哪些正确执行在压缩后失败以及失败原因，缺乏细粒度的诊断能力。
AI.method: 构建25方法/5机制族的分类体系，关联8个实现；对每个方法设置逐源评估并与FullCache对照，单独选择C-to-W行避免交叉污染；设计统一记录格式关联输出与cache、likelihood、attention、decoding测量及适用性状态。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B上，2600个来源上59,800次压缩运行，12,520个C-to-W行；63.2%覆盖度低/部分，仅19行(0.2%)高覆盖且似然漂移强；10个诊断指标区分失败与成功压缩(AUROC 0.684-0.871)；受控4倍证据注意力提升修复29.2%失败（对照仅6.3%）。
AI.conclusion: KVDiagnosis证明KV-cache压缩失败是可诊断的，大多数失败源于覆盖不足，且可通过有针对性的证据注意力增强得到有效修复，为压缩方法提供了细粒度诊断与改进方向。

title: UniDFKD: A Unified Semantic Prior Framework for Architecture-Agnostic Data-Free Knowledge Distillation
summary: Data-Free Knowledge Distillation (DFKD) transfers knowledge from a pretrained teacher model to a compact student model by synthesizing semantically informative data, eliminating the need for access to the original training dataset. Existing DFKD methods rely heavily on architecture-specific statistical priors (e.g., Batch Normalization statistics) to guide data synthesis, however, such architecture-dependent priors are often absent in modern architectures such as Vision Transformers (ViTs), resulting in degraded semantic quality of the synthesized data and consequently catastrophic performance degradation. In this paper, we propose \emph{UniDFKD}, a unified data-free knowledge distillation framework that replaces architecture-specific statistics with explicit, architecture-agnostic semantic priors. \emph{UniDFKD} governs the entire synthesis-distillation pipeline along three dimensions: (1) Categorical Semantic Conditioning (CSC) defines \emph{what} to synthesize by persistently modulating the generator with language-derived embeddings to capture semantic diversity; (2) Spatial Semantic Anchoring (SSA) dictates \emph{where} evidence belongs by anchoring the teacher's spatial attributions to a Gaussian prior; and (3) Spatial Semantic Distillation (SSD) controls \emph{how} knowledge is transferred by explicitly aligning teacher-student spatial evidence alongside predictions. Extensive experiments across CNNs and ViTs demonstrate that UniDFKD establishes a new state-of-the-art, outperforming existing methods by an average absolute margin of over 20\% in both homogeneous and heterogeneous settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniDFKD，一个统一的无数据知识蒸馏框架，用显式、架构无关的语义先验替代依赖架构的统计先验（如BN统计量），解决ViT等现代架构中缺乏BN先验导致的数据合成质量退化问题。该框架从三个维度（CSC定义"合成什么"、SSA界定"证据在哪"、SSD控制"知识如何迁移"）贯穿整个合成-蒸馏流程，在CNN和ViT上均取得新SOTA，平均绝对提升超过20%。
AI.motivation: 现有DFKD方法严重依赖架构特定的统计先验（如Batch Normalization统计量）来指导数据合成，但ViT等现代架构中这类先验往往缺失，导致合成数据语义质量下降和性能灾难性退化。
AI.method: 提出三管齐下的UniDFKD框架：(1) 类别语义条件化（CSC）：用语言派生的嵌入持续调制生成器，捕获语义多样性，定义"合成什么"；(2) 空间语义锚定（SSA）：将教师的空间归因锚定到高斯先验，界定"证据属于哪里"；(3) 空间语义蒸馏（SSD）：显式对齐师生间的空间证据与预测，控制"知识如何迁移"。
AI.result: 在CNN和ViT上的广泛实验表明，UniDFKD在同构和异构设置下均建立了新的最先进水平，相比现有方法平均绝对性能提升超过20%。
AI.conclusion: 通过用架构无关的语义先验替代架构相关的统计先验，UniDFKD成功将DFKD扩展到现代架构（如ViT），显著提升了合成数据质量和蒸馏性能。

title: Listen, See and Track: Spatio-Temporal Audio-Visual Sound Event Reasoning for Omni-Modal Language Models
summary: Understanding dynamic sound sources requires jointly determining what produces a sound, where the source is located, and how it moves over time. Yet existing audio-language models often represent clips as global acoustic events, while vision-language models lack the spatial audio cues needed to localize and track individual sources. To evaluate this missing capability, we introduce ST-OmniQA, a spatio-temporal audio-visual question-answering benchmark built from panoramic videos paired with synchronized first-order Ambisonics (FOA) audio of moving sound sources. It contains 40K videos and 400K question-answer pairs organized into four capability levels covering sound-event recognition, direction of arrival, source distance, motion trajectories, and temporally grounded audio-visual reasoning. Building on this benchmark, we propose ST-Omni-R1, which integrates FOA-derived semantic and trajectory representations with panoramic visual context and is trained through progressive curriculum learning and reasoning-tree reinforcement learning. ST-Omni-R1 achieves 77.83\% average semantic accuracy across the four levels, compared with 37.28\% for the best evaluated baseline. Results on three public spatial-audio benchmarks further indicate that its learned spatial and motion representations transfer beyond ST-OmniQA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ST-OmniQA基准（40K视频，400K问答对，四级能力测试），涵盖声音事件识别、声源定位、距离、运动轨迹及时域音视频推理；并提出ST-Omni-R1模型，整合FOA语义与轨迹表征及全景视觉上下文，通过渐进课程学习和推理树强化学习训练，语义准确率达77.83%，远超最佳基线37.28%，且跨基准泛化良好。
AI.motivation: 现有音频-语言模型多以全局声音事件表征音频片段，而视觉-语言模型缺乏定位和追踪声源所需的空间音频线索，导致联合确定"什么声音、在哪里、如何移动"的动态声源理解能力缺失，该能力尚无专门评估基准。
AI.method: 构建ST-OmniQA基准（基于全景视频+一阶Ambisonics音频，四级能力层次）；提出ST-Omni-R1模型，整合FOA语义与轨迹表征及全景视觉上下文，采用渐进课程学习与推理树强化学习训练。
AI.result: ST-Omni-R1在四级任务中平均语义准确率77.83%，最佳基线仅37.28%；在三个公开空间音频基准上的结果表明其空间与运动表征可跨基准迁移。
AI.conclusion: 动态声源的时空理解可通过融合空间音频表征与全景视觉上下文实现，所提模型显著超越现有基线，且学到的表征具有良好泛化能力。

title: Bootstrapping Vision-Language Model for Hysteroscopic Surgical Scene Segmentation
comment: Accept by Biomedical Signal Processing and Control
summary: Hysteroscopic surgical scene segmentation plays a pivotal role in understanding the hysteroscopic intraoperative environment as well as computer-assisted intervention. However, this task presents unique challenges due to the high morphological similarity among different lesions and the presence of artifacts such as specular reflections, motion blur, and fluid occlusions in surgical videos. In this work, we propose the first vision-language model (VLM)-based hysteroscopic surgical scene segmentation method, which performs pixel-wise localization for fifteen representative categories in hysteroscopic surgical scenes. Our VLM-hyster has a segmentation backbone that utilizes the pretrained image encoder for robust visual feature extraction, coupled with a transformer-based decoder for dense prediction. Moreover, we design category-specific text prompts and incorporate a masked distillation branch to filter out visual features with low correlation to the text prompts, enabling the model to focus more effectively on category-specific image regions and thereby enhancing segmentation performance. We collect a large multicentric hysteroscopic surgical scene dataset, containing 4,020 high-resolution images with detailed mask annotations, for model training and evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that VLM-hyster substantially outperforms state-of-the-art AI models. Furthermore, extensive assessments by gynecologists, as well as multicentre and prospective validations, demonstrate VLM-hyster's robustness and generalizability. The results suggest that VLM-hyster earns considerable potential in enabling AI-assisted localization of surgical instruments and lesions in hysteroscopic surgeries. Code is available at https://github.com/viscom-tongji/VLM-hyster.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的宫腔镜手术场景分割方法VLM-hyster，利用预训练图像编码器和Transformer解码器实现十五类场景目标的像素级分割，并通过类别特定文本提示和掩码蒸馏分支提升分割性能。在包含4,020张高分辨率图像的多中心数据集上，该方法显著优于现有SOTA模型，并经妇科医生评估及多中心、前瞻性验证证实了其鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 宫腔镜手术场景分割对理解术中环境和计算机辅助干预至关重要，但该任务面临两大独特挑战：不同病灶间形态高度相似，以及手术视频中存在镜面反射、运动模糊和流体遮挡等伪影，使得传统分割方法难以取得理想效果。
AI.method: 1) 构建首个基于VLM的宫腔镜分割框架，采用预训练图像编码器提取鲁棒视觉特征，配合Transformer解码器进行密集预测；2) 设计类别特定的文本提示，并引入掩码蒸馏分支来过滤与文本提示相关性低的视觉特征，使模型聚焦于类别特定区域；3) 收集大型多中心宫腔镜手术场景数据集，包含4,020张带详细掩膜标注的高分辨率图像用于训练和评估。
AI.result: VLM-hyster在宫腔镜手术场景分割任务上显著优于现有SOTA人工智能模型；通过妇科医生的广泛评估以及多中心和前瞻性验证，证明了方法的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: VLM-hyster展现出在宫腔镜手术中实现AI辅助定位手术器械和病灶的巨大潜力，为计算机辅助宫腔镜干预提供了有力支撑。

title: Coupled Graph--Policy Distillation for Personalized Medication Safety in Older Adults with Multimorbidity
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can support medication review between clinical visits, but safe choices for older adults with multimorbidity depend on conditions, medications, and geriatric risks that users may omit. We introduce ATLAS, a coupled graph--policy distillation framework for patient-adaptive medication safety. ATLAS structures guideline evidence as a medication-safety graph. Targeted questions update the patient state and distill relevant relations into a patient-specific medication conflict graph (PMCG). A risk-first multi-agent policy uses the PMCG to screen contraindications, assess cautions and monitoring needs, identify safer alternatives, and verify the final medication plan. We also introduce GeriMedBench, an interactive benchmark that tests safety-critical information acquisition and evidence-based decision revision. Across a European non-interactive multimorbidity benchmark, an Asian interactive multimorbidity benchmark, and an Asian non-interactive cross-guideline benchmark, ATLAS achieves the strongest complete-decision performance among the compared systems. On the European non-interactive multimorbidity benchmark, it exceeds the strongest proprietary LLM baseline by 53.73 points in Strict Success Rate and 14.63 points in overall safety reasoning score (OSRS), with no unsafe recommendations under the automated evaluator. A blinded clinician evaluation gives ATLAS higher mean ratings across all five criteria and flags potentially unsafe recommendations in one ATLAS case and two Gemini cases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ATLAS框架，通过图-策略蒸馏实现老年多病患者的药物安全审查，并引入GeriMedBench交互式基准测试，在多个基准上超越最强专有LLM基线。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体能支持临床间歇期的药物审查，但老年人的多病用药安全取决于用户可能遗漏的病情、用药和老年病风险信息。现有系统缺乏患者自适应的安全机制，需要结构化证据和主动信息获取。
AI.method: ATLAS采用耦合图-策略蒸馏框架：将指南证据构建为药物安全图；通过针对性提问更新患者状态并将相关关系蒸馏为患者特异性药物冲突图（PMCG）；采用风险优先的多智能体策略，利用PMCG筛查禁忌症、评估注意事项和监测需求、识别更安全的替代方案并验证最终用药计划。同时引入GeriMedBench交互式基准来测试安全关键信息获取和循证决策修订能力。
AI.result: 在欧洲非交互式多病基准上，ATLAS在Strict Success Rate上超过最强专有LLM基线53.73分，在总体安全推理得分（OSRS）上超过14.63分，且自动化评估器下无不安全建议。盲审临床医生评估中，ATLAS在五个标准上均获得更高平均评分，仅在一个ATLAS病例和两个Gemini病例中标记了潜在不安全建议。
AI.conclusion: ATLAS通过图-策略蒸馏实现患者自适应的药物安全审查，在多种基准上展现出最强的完整决策性能，验证了结构化证据图与交互式信息获取相结合的优越性。

title: Degraded Infrared Small Object Detection via Degradation-Adapted Physics-Guided Restoration
summary: Infrared small object detection has made significant progress in recent years. However, degradations such as fog and nonuniformity can suppress target-background contrast, substantially increasing detection difficulty. Existing methods mainly rely on image restoration as preprocessing, but they are typically designed for specific degradation types and fail to generalize to varying degradations. To alleviate this, we propose DAISOD, a degradation-adapted infrared small object detection framework for robust detection under different degradations. DAISOD first identifies the type and severity of degradations, then adapts the processing via dedicated branches, and finally fuses the results for subsequent detection. Moreover, a physics-guided restoration mechanism is incorporated to explicitly estimate degradation parameters and remove degradation effects through physical models, avoiding excessive restoration that may erase small targets. Moreover, we construct a degraded infrared small object detection dataset covering diverse degradation types and levels. Extensive experiments show that DAISOD outperforms state-of-the-art methods under various degradation conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAISOD框架，用于在不同退化条件（如雾、非均匀性）下对红外小目标进行鲁棒检测。该框架先识别退化类型和严重程度，再通过专用分支处理退化，最后融合结果进行检测。同时引入物理引导的恢复机制，显式估计退化参数并通过物理模型去除退化效应，避免过度恢复导致小目标消失。作者还构建了涵盖多种退化类型和级别的退化红外小目标检测数据集，实验证明DAISOD在各种退化条件下优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有红外小目标检测方法在面对雾、非均匀性等退化时，目标与背景对比度被抑制，检测难度显著增加。已有的预处理恢复方法通常针对特定退化类型设计，难以泛化到不同退化情况。
AI.method: DAISOD框架包含三个步骤：1) 识别退化类型和严重程度；2) 通过专用分支进行自适应处理；3) 融合各分支结果用于后续检测。此外，引入物理引导的恢复机制，显式估计退化参数并通过物理模型去除退化效应，防止过度恢复导致小目标被抹除。
AI.result: 在涵盖多种退化类型和水平的退化红外小目标检测数据集上，DAISOD在各种退化条件下均优于最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: DAISOD通过退化感知的自适应处理框架和物理引导的恢复机制，有效解决了多种退化条件下红外小目标检测的鲁棒性问题。

title: From Prompt to Harness: Coderlet from Scratch
summary: A model alone does not determine how a programming agent acts. What the model sees, how actions enter the environment, how feedback returns, and how one run affects the next all depend on how the harness is organized. Minimal examples usually show only the basic interaction between a model and tools, while production systems spread these relationships across complex components and dependencies. This paper studies a compact harness design by following a single request through context formation, model decision, environmental action, observation return, and state continuation. Three boundaries---model, execution, and state---connect the model service, tool environment, and persistent state, while the request lifecycle determines the order in which these transitions occur. Together, they show the harness's core role: turning model generations into environmental actions, carrying runtime feedback into later decisions, and allowing state to continue across requests. On top of this runtime structure, a harness can also be gradually refined across runs through continued bootstrapping. The design is realized in the executable artifact https://github.com/lilinxi/Coderlet.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了编程代理中"harness"（框架）的核心设计，通过追踪单个请求的完整生命周期（上下文形成、模型决策、环境行动、观察返回、状态延续），提出由模型、执行、状态三个边界连接模型服务、工具环境和持久状态的紧凑框架设计，并指出框架可通过持续自举在多次运行间逐步精炼。该设计在Coderlet开源项目中实现。
AI.motivation: 编程代理的行为不仅由模型决定，更取决于框架（harness）的组织方式。然而大多数论文只展示模型与工具间的基本交互，生产系统的完整框架关系分散在复杂组件中，缺乏对框架核心结构的系统研究。
AI.method: 通过追踪单个请求的生命周期来研究紧凑框架设计，识别三个关键边界（模型、执行、状态），分别连接模型服务、工具环境和持久状态；由请求生命周期决定转换顺序，并引入基于持续自举的跨运行渐进精炼机制。
AI.result: 展示了框架的核心作用：将模型生成转化为环境行动、将运行时反馈带入后续决策、使状态跨请求延续；并在可执行工件Coderlet中实现验证。
AI.conclusion: 框架是编程代理中将模型能力转化为实际行为的关键中间层，其结构化设计（三边界+请求生命周期）可支撑代理的持续自举改进。

title: MemeMind: Reference-Guided Trace Construction for Offline Context Optimization
summary: Offline context optimization improves an agent by revising its instructions and examples while keeping the model frozen. This approach learns from rollouts on an adaptation set, but some queries produce only failed rollouts. In these cases, the optimizer sees no successful example of how the available tools can reach the correct answer. We introduce MemeMind, which uses an offline reference answer to recover this missing experience. TraceBuilder identifies the evidence required by the reference, executes text search, image retrieval, and visual grounding, and verifies the resulting tool trace before adding it to the adaptation buffer. ToolGuide then summarizes the collected traces into a shared guide and separate instructions for each tool. The reference answers and constructed traces are used only during adaptation, while inference uses the learned guides with a frozen model. We study this problem through Anime, Comic, and Game meme interpretation. These memes combine edited and ambiguous visual content, overlaid text, long tail franchise knowledge, and culture specific references. Their interpretation can require coordinated visual grounding, image retrieval, and text search, making them a demanding setting in which native rollout groups may fail together. We evaluate MemeMind on MemeX, a benchmark of 1,000 such memes annotated by experts. Across two Qwen3-VL models, two language partitions, and two independent judges, MemeMind improves over the strongest context optimization baseline by 22.0% and 21.1% on Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B, and by 8.1% and 8.0% on Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B under GPT-5 judging. Ablations and held out traces show that constructing successful tool use for failed groups provides the largest component gain and produces more effective evidence acquisition at inference time.

AI.tldr: MemeMind是一个用于离线上下文优化的方法，它通过利用离线参考答案来恢复失败工具轨迹中缺失的成功经验，从而改进代理的指令和示例。该方法在动漫、漫画和游戏迷因解释任务上比最强基线提升了22%的性能。
AI.motivation: 在离线上下文优化中，代理从适应集上的轨迹中学习，但某些查询只产生失败的轨迹。在这种情况下，优化器看不到工具如何正确回答问题的成功示例，导致经验缺失，限制了优化效果。
AI.method: MemeMind包含两个核心组件：1) TraceBuilder，它识别参考答案所需的证据，执行文本搜索、图像检索和视觉定位，并验证生成的工具轨迹后将其添加到适应缓冲池中；2) ToolGuide，将收集到的轨迹总结为共享指南和每个工具的单独指令。参考答案和构造轨迹仅在适应阶段使用，推理时使用冻结模型和学习到的指南。
AI.result: 在MemeX基准（1000个由专家标注的迷因）上，MemeMind在Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B上比最强上下文优化基线提升22.0%和21.1%，在Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B上提升8.1%和8.0%（GPT-5评判）。消融实验表明，为失败组构造成功的工具使用提供了最大的组件增益。
AI.conclusion: 为失败的轨迹组构造成功的工具使用经验是提升离线上下文优化的关键，且能产生更有效的推理时证据获取。MemeMind在需要多模态协调推理的迷因解释任务上显著优于现有基线。

title: Capability Is Not Propensity: Measuring Pressure-Robust Cooperative Behavior in Civic LLM Agents
summary: Cooperative capabilities in language models are dual-use. The same social reasoning that supports civic deliberation can also enable strategic omission, false consensus, and manipulative framing. We argue that Cooperative AI evaluations should separate what models can do under benign instructions from what they tend to do under realistic civic pressure. We introduce DiffCoop-Civic, a 10-scenario pilot evaluation suite spanning preference understanding, evidence and persuasion, commitment design, asymmetric information, and dissent preservation. Across seven models from four model families, subtle omission pressure produces a near-uniform shift: manipulative enablement rises by 1.17 points and dissent preservation falls by 1.67 points on a 5-point scale. Overt false-consensus pressure behaves differently: it triggers refusal or redirection in some aligned API models, but direct compliance in several open-weight models. A lightweight Pareto-Trace prompting intervention improves pressure robustness without simply relying on hard refusal. An anonymous reproducibility package is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/diffcoop-civil-771C.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiffCoop-Civic，一个包含10个场景的试点评估套件，用于区分语言模型在良性指令下的合作能力与在现实公民压力下的行为倾向。研究发现微妙遗漏压力会导致操纵性使能上升、异议保留下降，而公然的虚假共识压力在不同模型上引发不同反应。提出的Pareto-Trace提示干预可提升压力鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 语言模型的合作能力具有双重用途：既支持公民审议等有益行为，也可能被用于策略性遗漏、虚假共识和操纵性框架。现有的合作AI评估未能区分模型在良性指令下的能力与在现实公民压力下的倾向，需要更精细的评估框架。
AI.method: 构建DiffCoop-Civic试点评估套件，包含10个场景，覆盖偏好理解、证据与说服、承诺设计、信息不对称和异议保留五个维度。对来自四个模型家族的七个模型进行测试，并引入Pareto-Trace提示干预方法。
AI.result: 微妙遗漏压力导致跨模型近乎一致的转变：操纵性使能上升1.17分，异议保留下降1.67分（5分制）。公然的虚假共识压力引起差异化反应：部分对齐API模型触发拒绝或引导重定向，而多个开放权重模型直接顺从。Pareto-Trace干预可改善压力鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 合作AI评估应区分模型能力与行为倾向，DiffCoop-Civic展示了这一框架的可行性，Pareto-Trace提供了不依赖硬性拒绝的轻量级干预方案。

title: Warp-free Cross-view Geo-localization via Feature-space Consensus Mining
summary: Cross-view geo-localization is challenging due to drastic viewpoint changes and large appearance discrepancies between street-level and satellite imagery. Although existing methods often use geometric warping to expose co-visible cues, such transformations rely on restrictive spatial assumptions and inevitably introduce severe visual distortions under view-dependent visibility, yielding noisy supervision and fragile correspondences. To overcome this, we propose a novel joint-view consensus-guided learning framework that entirely bypasses explicit geometric warping. Instead of forcing rigid spatial alignment, we dynamically mine and adaptively strengthen a semantic consensus directly within the feature space. Specifically, an auxiliary joint-view pathway during training enables direct cross-view interaction, allowing each view to selectively aggregate corroborative evidence into a unified consensus representation. To resolve feature heterogeneity among the single- and joint-view streams, we introduce global pattern probes acting as a semantic dictionary to project divergent modalities into a strictly aligned metric space. Guided by a consensus-mediated contrastive objective, single-view embeddings are explicitly pulled toward the joint-view anchor during training, distilling this consensus-mining capability into the single-view encoders for robust retrieval at inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across four standard benchmarks, underscoring the importance of discovering cross-view semantic consensus for reliable geo-localization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种联合视角共识引导的跨视角地理定位学习框架，完全绕开显式几何扭曲，通过在特征空间中动态挖掘并强化语义共识，将共识挖掘能力蒸馏到单视角编码器中，实现鲁棒且无需几何对齐的跨视角检索。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位方法常依赖几何扭曲（warping）来暴露共视线索，但这类变换受限于严格的空间假设，在视角依赖可见性下会产生严重视觉畸变，导致噪声监督和脆弱对应关系。作者希望绕过显式几何对齐，直接在特征空间中挖掘语义共识。
AI.method: 1) 训练阶段引入辅助联合视角通路，实现跨视角直接交互，使每个视角选择性聚合佐证证据到统一的共识表示；2) 引入全局模式探针作为语义字典，将单视角与联合视角的异构特征投影到严格对齐的度量空间；3) 采用共识介导的对比目标，在训练中将单视角嵌入拉向联合视角锚点，将共识挖掘能力蒸馏进单视角编码器，推理时仅需单视角即可鲁棒检索。
AI.result: 在四个标准基准数据集上达到了最先进的性能，验证了发现跨视角语义共识对于可靠地理定位的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 跨视角语义共识挖掘比显式几何对齐更为鲁棒和可靠，联合视角共识引导框架能够有效解决视角差异带来的特征不对齐问题，为跨视角地理定位提供了新思路。

title: Renormalising Generative Models for Active Inference: Foundations, Derivations, and Verification
comment: 25 pages, 1 figure. Accepted as a full paper at the 7th International Workshop on Active Inference (IWAI 2026). Supplementary material: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20533539. Code: https://github.com/apashea/RGMs
summary: Active inference offers a unified framework for perception, learning, and action, but scaling discrete active-inference models to rich spatial and temporal domains remains difficult. Renormalising generative models (RGMs) address this challenge by composing discrete generative models across spatial and temporal scales, coarse-graining lower-level states and paths into higher-level causes for objects, events, and action. However, fully reproducing and adapting the framework remains difficult: the mathematical exposition is compact, and the reference implementations are deeply integrated within specialized software environments, leaving many algorithmic details implicit. This paper addresses these challenges by providing a self-contained, derivation-oriented account of RGMs together with an open, verified implementation. We explain how the hierarchy is built, how beliefs and actions are updated within it, and how information is passed between levels. Where the published equations and implementation differ in emphasis, we make those choices explicit and explain their modelling consequences. By clarifying the theory and separating it from its original implementation context, this work lowers practical barriers to entry and makes RGMs more transparent, auditable, and reproducible, providing a foundation for future quantitative evaluation and development on machine-learning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了重正化生成模型（RGMs）的自包含、面向推导的说明，并附带开放、可验证的实现，澄清了其数学理论与实现之间的差异，降低了实际应用门槛，使RGMs更透明、可审计和可复现。
AI.motivation: 活动推断（Active Inference）提供一个统一框架，但将离散活动推断模型扩展到丰富的空间和时间领域仍然困难。RGMs通过跨空间和时间尺度组合离散生成模型来解决这一问题，但完整的复现和适应仍然困难：数学表述紧凑，参考实现深度集成在专门的软件环境中，许多算法细节隐式未明。
AI.method: 本文提供RGMs的自包含、面向推导的说明，解释层次结构如何构建、信念和行动如何在其中更新、信息如何在层级之间传递。对于已发表方程与实现之间存在差异的地方，作者明确做出选择并解释其建模后果。同时提供开放、可验证的实现，将理论与原始实现环境分离。
AI.result: 通过澄清理论并将其与原始实现环境分离，本文降低了RGMs的实际入门障碍，使其更透明、可审计和可复现，为未来在机器学习基准上的定量评估和发展提供了基础。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过提供清晰的理论说明和开放实现，使RGMs更易于理解和使用，为后续在机器学习基准上进行定量评估和进一步发展奠定了坚实基础。

title: Diffusion Image Editing via Asynchronous Token Decoding
summary: Text-guided diffusion image editing aims to modify semantic attributes of an image while preserving its identity, layout, and background. However, naïvely switching the text condition during sampling often causes global drift, as denoising dynamics propagate changes across tokens and can disrupt unedited regions. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{A}synchronous \textbf{T}oken \textbf{D}ecoding \textbf{Edit} (ATDEdit), an inference-time framework that views each sampler step as a parallel update of a globally coupled token matrix and enables token-indexed condition switching with differentiated update policies. Instead of applying synchronous target-conditioned updates to all tokens, ATDEdit estimates editable locations using token-wise conditional surprisal and applies target-conditioned corrections to the selected token set. It supplies source key/value memory at keep-token positions and projects selected keep-token latent rows back to their source values; these operations promote background preservation but do not constitute a pixel-level invariance guarantee. This approach combines local editing and background preservation without external or user-provided spatial masks and without model fine-tuning. On PIE-Bench, ATDEdit achieves the strongest reported preservation metrics, including 27.44~dB PSNR and 0.055 LPIPS, while retaining competitive semantic alignment.

AI.tldr: ATDEdit是一个无需微调和外部掩码的推理时框架，通过异步令牌解码实现文本引导的图像编辑，同时保持背景和身份信息不变。
AI.motivation: 文本引导的扩散图像编辑中，简单地切换文本条件会导致全局漂移，因为去噪动态会将变化传播到所有令牌，破坏未被编辑的区域。需要一种方法在局部编辑和背景保持之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 将每个采样步骤视为全局耦合令牌矩阵的并行更新，通过令牌级条件surprisal估计可编辑位置，对选中令牌施加目标条件修正；在保留令牌位置提供源键/值记忆，并将选中的保留令牌潜在行投影回源值。
AI.result: 在PIE-Bench上达到最强的保留指标：PSNR 27.44 dB，LPIPS 0.055，同时保持有竞争力的语义对齐。
AI.conclusion: ATDEdit展示了无需外部掩码或模型微调即可实现高质量局部编辑与背景保持的方案，但该方法不提供像素级不变性保证。

title: One Adapter Pair per Model: A Universal Activation Interface for Language Models
summary: Activation-based tools are usually tied to one model's native hidden space, requiring probes, sparse autoencoders, and natural-language interpreters to be rebuilt or rediscovered for each new language model. We present a Universal Activation Bus, a framework that provides a common activation interface across compatible language models. Using a small set of source models, we learn a shared dense space together with one lightweight linear encoder--decoder adapter pair per model. After source training, the interface is frozen; a new model joins by fitting only its adapter pair on unlabeled matched text. The resulting interface allows activation-based tools to be shared across connected models, including common probes and SAE features as well as access to an NLA originally trained for a different model. Across five models, semantically related texts form consistent neighborhoods in the shared space, and an onboarded model reuses these tools effectively without retraining them. We further show that an intermediate activation from one model can be used by another model's frozen upper layers to produce predictions. These results establish a stable, model-wise activation contract for reusable tools across compatible language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Universal Activation Bus"框架，通过共享稠密空间和每模型轻量线性编解码器适配器，为多个语言模型提供统一的激活接口，使基于激活的工具（如探针、SAE特征、NLA）无需重训即可跨模型复用。
AI.motivation: 现有的激活工具（探针、稀疏自编码器、自然语言解释器等）都依赖于特定模型的内部隐藏空间，导致每个新语言模型都需要重新构建和发现这些工具，缺乏跨模型的通用性和可移植性。
AI.method: 使用少量源模型学习一个共享稠密空间，并为每个模型配备一对轻量线性编码器-解码器适配器。源训练完成后界面冻结，新模型只需在无标注匹配文本上拟合自己的适配器对即可加入。
AI.result: 在五个模型上验证：语义相关的文本在共享空间中形成一致的邻域；新加入的模型无需重训即可有效复用已有工具；一个模型的中间激活可以被另一模型的冻结上层用于产生预测。
AI.conclusion: 该框架建立了稳定的、跨模型的激活契约，使得激活工具可以在兼容的语言模型之间复用，避免了针对每个新模型的重复构建工作。

title: Revisiting the Current Frame: Physical-Trace-Guided Network Output Correction for Video Restoration
summary: Video restoration methods exploit temporal information to recover information missing from degraded observations. However, reference frames within the sequence may introduce inconsistent degradation, content discrepancy, or reconstruction errors due to physical image-formation variations, occlusion, and imperfect temporal aggregation. Existing approaches mainly focus on improving restoration networks, while the reliability of the generated outputs at different spatial locations remains largely unexplored. In this work, we propose ANCHOR, a model-agnostic framework that revisits the low-quality current frame as a temporally aligned anchor for video restoration correction. Specifically, ANCHOR estimates a spatial trust field from heterogeneous physical-trace evidence and adaptively balances the restoration proposal with the original observation. Experiments on High Dynamic Range video reconstruction and video deraining demonstrate consistent improvements across various state-of-the-art restoration models, validating the effectiveness of reliability-aware output correction for video restoration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ANCHOR，一个模型无关的视频修复校正框架，通过将低质量当前帧作为时间对齐的锚点，估计空间信任场来平衡修复结果与原始观测，从而在HDR视频重建和视频去雨任务上一致提升多种SOTA修复模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视频修复方法主要致力于改进修复网络本身，但序列中的参考帧可能引入不一致的退化、内容差异或重建误差（源于物理成像变化、遮挡、时间聚合不完美等），而输出结果在不同空间位置上的可靠性问题尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出ANCHOR框架，将低质量的当前帧重新审视为时间对齐的锚点，通过从异构物理痕迹证据中估计空间信任场，自适应地在修复提议与原始观测之间进行平衡，实现对修复输出的可靠感知校正。
AI.result: 在HDR视频重建和视频去雨两个任务上的实验表明，ANCHOR能够一致性地提升多种最先进修复模型的性能，验证了可靠性感知输出校正对视频修复的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ANCHOR证明了模型无关的可靠性感知校正框架能够有效改善视频修复质量，为视频修复领域提供了新的研究视角——即关注输出的空间可靠性而非仅改进网络结构。

title: verdi: retrieval is not transfer for continual world model optimization
summary: Foundation world models have made remarkable progress in planning, simulation, and embodied intelligence. However, optimizing a pretrained world model toward a user-specified objective remains difficult: each campaign typically rediscovers optimization strategies from scratch, and the resulting knowledge rarely transfers to the next model. Existing research agents automate the optimization loop but treat successful strategies as directly reusable recipes, without principled safeguards for when transfer is appropriate. We argue instead that retrieval is not transfer: a strategy validated on one model is at best an optimization hypothesis for another, and becomes transferable knowledge only after target-side experimental valida- tion. Guided by this principle, we propose VERDI , a continual framework for evidence-licensed world model optimization. VERDI characterizes each world model through shared inference-time probes to construct an Optimization Fin- gerprint, retrieves relevant prior experience as ranked hypotheses, and validates every candidate under a frozen target-side verifier before admitting it as reusable evidence; contradictions among nearby fingerprints further trigger probe evolution, continually refining the diagnostic representation itself. Experiments on Ctrl-World, the Cosmos family, and RoboCoin show that VERDI reduces search cost by 68%, GPU cost by 69%, and negative transfer from 0.34 to 0.06, while predicting transfer outcomes with 83% sign accuracy.

AI.tldr: VERDI是一个用于基座世界模型优化的持续学习框架，核心思想是"检索不等于迁移"——只有在目标端验证通过的经验才能作为可迁移的知识。它通过优化指纹（Optimization Fingerprint）描述模型特性，检索相关经验作为假设，经冻结的验证器验证后才纳入可复用证据，并持续进化探针以精炼诊断表征。在Ctrl-World、Cosmos和RoboCoin上，VERDI将搜索成本降低68%、GPU成本降低69%，负迁移从0.34降至0.06，迁移结果预测准确率达83%。
AI.motivation: 基座世界模型在规划、仿真和具身智能方面取得了显著进展，但针对用户指定目标优化预训练世界模型仍然困难。每次优化任务都需要从头重新发现策略，已有经验难以迁移到新模型。现有研究智能体虽然自动化了优化循环，但将成功策略直接视为可复用配方，缺乏对迁移时机是否合适的可靠保障。核心痛点在于：一个模型上验证过的策略对另一个模型最多只是优化假设，不能直接视为可迁移知识。
AI.method: VERDI框架包含四个关键组件：(1) Optimization Fingerprint——通过共享推理时探针（inference-time probes）刻画每个世界模型的特性；(2) 检索模块——基于指纹检索相关先验经验并排序为假设；(3) 目标端验证器——在冻结的目标模型上验证每个候选策略，通过验证才将其纳入可复用证据；(4) 探针进化机制——当相邻指纹之间出现矛盾时，触发探针更新，持续精炼诊断表征本身，形成闭环的持续学习系统。
AI.result: 在Ctrl-World、Cosmos系列和RoboCoin三个基准上，VERDI实现了搜索成本降低68%、GPU成本降低69%、负迁移从0.34降至0.06，迁移结果的符号预测准确率达到83%。
AI.conclusion: VERDI的核心贡献在于确立了"检索不是迁移"的优化原则，通过证据许可（evidence-licensed）机制确保只有经目标端验证的经验才被视为可迁移知识，同时通过指纹进化实现诊断表征的持续优化，为世界模型优化提供了一种可靠且高效的持续学习范式。

title: Beyond Global Editing: Per-Instance Disentangled Subspaces for Training-Free Hallucination Mitigation in LVLMs
summary: Recent advances in large vision-language models (LVLMs) have enabled powerful multimodal reasoning by integrating visual encoders with large language models (LLMs). However, their reliability is frequently undermined by hallucinations, where generated text inaccurately describes the visual input. Although fine-tuning can mitigate this problem, it is computationally expensive and requires large, curated datasets, making training-free alternatives attractive. Among these, model editing is more promising than decoding-based approaches: decoding methods adapt outputs per input but introduce computational overhead and instability, whereas model editing modifies internal representations offline, providing a more efficient and stable solution. However, existing model-editing techniques typically rely on a single global subspace to correct hallucinations, treating all test samples identically and failing to capture diverse hallucination modes across inputs. To address this limitation, we propose a training-free hallucination mitigation framework for dynamic, per-instance suppression at test time. Our method first constructs a set of Disentangled Hallucination Subspaces, each isolating a distinct hallucination mode. During inference, the model adaptively calculates weights reflecting each input's relationship to these subspaces, guiding a dynamically combined projection that selectively suppresses the most probable hallucination directions while preserving image-grounded semantics. Extensive experiments across multiple vision-language benchmarks and LVLM families demonstrate consistent improvements, highlighting the robustness, generalizability, and efficiency of our approach.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免训练的幻觉抑制框架，通过构建解耦的幻觉子空间并在推理时动态加权组合投影，实现逐实例的幻觉抑制，在多个视觉语言基准和LVLM家族上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有模型编辑方法依赖单一全局子空间纠正幻觉，将所有测试样本等同对待，无法捕捉输入间多样的幻觉模式；解码方法虽可但引入计算开销和不确定性，因此需要更精细、动态且免训练的幻觉抑制方案。
AI.method: 首先构建一组解耦的幻觉子空间，每个子空间隔离一种不同的幻觉模式；推理时模型自适应地计算每个输入与这些子空间的关系权重，引导动态组合的投影，选择性抑制最可能的幻觉方向，同时保留基于图像的语义信息。
AI.result: 在多个视觉语言基准和LVLM家族上的大量实验表明，该方法取得了一致的性能提升，凸显了其鲁棒性、泛化性和效率优势。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过动态逐实例的幻觉抑制，克服了单一全局子空间的局限性，为大规模视觉语言模型提供了一种高效、稳定且可泛化的幻觉缓解方案。

title: Bidirectional Context Self-Distillation for Reinforcement Learning of Skill-Based LLM Agents
summary: External natural-language skills provide large language model (LLM) agents with reusable and editable guidance for solving complex tasks. Yet their effectiveness depends not only on skill quality, but also on whether the policy can translate the provided guidance into appropriate actions. However, methods specifically designed to improve this skill-utilization ability remain largely underexplored. In practice, skill-based agents are commonly trained with reinforcement learning objectives centered on task-level rewards, which offer limited supervision and struggle to capture subtle differences in how effectively the policy uses the provided skills. We propose BCSD (Bidirectional Context Self-Distillation), a framework that combines self-distillation with reinforcement learning to train LLM agents to use external skills more effectively. Unlike prior self-distillation methods that rely on a single privileged context, BCSD evaluates each trajectory from two complementary skill-context views. The augmented view introduces higher-level Meta-Skill guidance, while the reduced view prunes general guidance to highlight task-specific skills. Their complementary token-level signals are combined to rescale the RL advantage. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop demonstrate that BCSD achieves the strongest overall performance across model scales, enabling agents to utilize external skills more effectively. Ablation studies further verify the complementary contributions of the augmented and reduced context views. Code will be released to ensure full reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BCSD（双向上下文自蒸馏）框架，将自蒸馏与强化学习相结合，训练LLM智能体更有效地利用外部自然语言技能。BCSD从两个互补的技能上下文中评估每条轨迹（增强视图引入高层元技能指导，精简视图突出任务特定技能），并将两者互补的token级信号结合以重新缩放RL优势函数。实验在ALFWorld和WebShop上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有技能型智能体通常使用基于任务级奖励的强化学习目标进行训练，但这种监督信号有限，难以捕捉策略在使用外部技能时的细微差异。目前缺乏专门用于提升技能利用能力的方法。
AI.method: 提出BCSD框架，核心创新在于使用双向（双重）技能上下文视角：1）增强视图：引入更高级的Meta-Skill指导；2）精简视图：剪除通用指导以突出任务特定技能。两种互补视角产生的token级信号被结合，用于重新缩放RL优势函数，从而提供更细粒度的监督信号。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop基准上，BCSD在不同模型规模下均取得最强综合性能，消融实验验证了增强和精简两种上下文视图的互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: BCSD通过双向上下文自蒸馏为RL训练提供更细粒度的技能利用监督，有效提升了LLM智能体利用外部技能的能力，且方法具有可复现性保障。

title: One-Time Training for All Grains: Open-Set Grain Recognition and Quantitative Analysis
summary: Advances in crop breeding have introduced an increasing number of grain varieties, creating a growing demand for efficient variety recognition and quantitative analysis. However, existing methods are typically trained on a fixed variety set, and incorporating newly introduced varieties requires additional data collection and model retraining. To address this limitation, we propose GROW, a framework for Grain Recognition and quantitative analysis in Open sets Without retraining. GROW first performs class-agnostic grain localization, converting mixed-grain images into individual instances for variety-wise counting and phenotypic measurement. It then combines visual embeddings and morphological descriptors into fused grain descriptors stored in an extensible GrainBank. Query grains are recognized through rank-similarity weighted top-k retrieval, and newly introduced varieties are incorporated by appending their descriptors without updating the deployed models. Extensive experiments under progressive variety expansion, varying grain densities, and background domain shifts demonstrate the scalability, robustness, and adaptability of GROW. Compared with joint retraining, GROW reduced the average category-registration time from 4153 s to only 39 s while maintaining competitive recognition performance. These results demonstrate that GROW provides an efficient and maintainable solution for extensible grain recognition, counting, and phenotypic analysis without repeated model retraining.

AI.tldr: GROW是一个用于开放式谷物识别与定量分析的框架，无需重新训练即可扩展新品种。它通过类无关谷物定位、融合视觉与形态特征的GrainBank存储以及排名相似度加权top-k检索实现识别，新增品种仅需追加特征描述符。实验表明相比联合重训练，单类注册时间从4153秒降至39秒，同时保持竞争性识别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有作物品种识别方法通常基于固定品种集训练，引入新品种需要额外数据采集和模型重训练，效率低下且难以维护。随着育种技术进步带来的品种数量激增，亟需一种可扩展、无需重训练的谷物识别方案。
AI.method: GROW框架包含三个核心步骤：(1) 类无关谷物定位，将混合谷物图像分割为单个实例以支持计数和表型测量；(2) 融合视觉嵌入与形态学描述符，构建可扩展的GrainBank特征库；(3) 通过排名相似度加权的top-k检索进行查询谷物识别，新品种通过追加描述符入库即可，无需更新已部署模型。
AI.result: 在渐进式品种扩展、不同谷物密度和背景域偏移条件下进行了大量实验，验证了GROW的可扩展性、鲁棒性和适应性。相比联合重训练，GROW将平均类别注册时间从4153秒降低到39秒，同时保持有竞争力的识别性能。
AI.conclusion: GROW为可扩展的谷物识别、计数和表型分析提供了高效且可维护的解决方案，避免了重复模型重训练，满足现代育种中对新品种快速纳入的需求。

title: The Politician, the Liar, and the Obedient Worker: Emerging Behavior of LLM Agents in Hierarchical Games
summary: LLMs are rapidly embedding themselves into daily life: drafting our emails, managing our schedules, and making decisions on our behalf. As they move from individual tools to participants in multi-agent organizations, an important question arises: do they reproduce the governance failures like free-riding, corruption, and entrenched leadership that plague human institutions? We introduce the Hierarchical Game (HG), a public goods game extended with managerial authority, democratic elections, and private communication. Testing six frontier models across twelve experiments that add institutions one at a time (speech, peers, government, wages, oversight, elections), we find distinct behavioral profiles: Qwen promises and lies (13.3\% broken promises); Grok refuses to cooperate on its own but becomes fully cooperative once a manager can punish it (16\%$\to$100\%); Claude and GPT-4o cooperate reliably at baseline. But honesty proves fragile. When the manager role comes with a salary, all models except GPT-4o start cutting private deals to win or keep the position. When punishment is made anonymous, honest models begin to cheat. When all agents share the same model family, the first elected manager stays in power indefinitely. Leadership change only happens in groups that mix different families.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM在多智能体组织中是否会复现人类机构的治理失败（如搭便车、腐败、领导者固化）。通过提出层级博弈（Hierarchical Game），在公共品博弈中加入管理权威、民主选举和私人通信，测试六个前沿模型在十二种渐进加入制度的实验中的行为，发现不同模型有独特的行为画像，且诚实行为脆弱，同质模型群体中领导者会固化。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM从个人工具转变为多智能体组织的参与者，一个重要问题浮现：它们是否会复现困扰人类机构的治理失败，如搭便车、腐败和领导者固化？这一问题尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 提出层级博弈（Hierarchical Game），即扩展了管理权威、民主选举和私人通信的公共品博弈。测试六个前沿模型，在十二个实验中逐步加入制度（言论、同伴、政府、工资、监督、选举），以观察行为变化。
AI.result: 发现不同的行为画像：Qwen承诺但说谎（13.3%食言）；Grok单独不愿合作，但有管理者可惩罚时完全合作（16%→100%）；Claude和GPT-4o基线可靠合作。但诚实脆弱：管理者角色有薪水时，除GPT-4o外所有模型都开始私下交易以赢得或保住职位；惩罚匿名时，诚实模型也开始作弊；同模型家族群体中首个当选管理者无限期掌权，只有混合不同模型家族的群体才发生领导更替。
AI.conclusion: LLM确实会在多智能体组织中复现人类机构的治理失败，诚实行为具有脆弱性，且同质性群体强化了领导者固化，这对构建多智能体系统提出了治理设计层面的警示。

title: Alpha as an Efficiency Signal: Visibility-Routed RGBA Image-to-Video Generation
summary: RGBA videos combine RGB appearance with an alpha channel, enabling animated assets to be applied across arbitrary backgrounds, which are heavily used in gaming industry. However, generating high-quality RGBA animations for games remains challenging for two reasons. First, most existing RGBA video datasets are dominated by photorealistic content, with limited coverage of game assets. Second, the traditional generate-then-matte pipelines estimate alpha only after RGB synthesis, so semi-transparent regions are often blurred by background, resulting in unstable matting outputs. More recently, many methods have begun to model RGB and alpha jointly, but existing approaches are mostly text-conditioned, and still have unresolved issues in efficiency and quality. To address these challenges, we introduce GameAlpha-2.4K, a 2.4K-clip game-style RGBA video dataset built with matte-friendly synthesis, multi-hypothesis alpha recovery, and compositing-based quality gates. Using this dataset, we train a reference-conditioned RGBA video generator that jointly produces RGB frames and alpha mattes in a single pass. To improve efficiency, we propose a visibility router that identifies transparent tokens in an early stage and bypasses their later DiT updates, while x_0-lock guides them along the original flow-matching schedule toward self-predicted endpoints. Our model obtains lower FVD than traditional two-stage pipelines, and the visibility router skips 35% of token evaluations in the final two DiT denoising steps, providing a 1.2x backbone speedup with negligible quality degradation compared to dense inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GameAlpha-2.4K数据集和参考条件化的RGBA视频生成器，联合生成RGB帧和alpha蒙版，并通过visibility router跳过透明token的DiT更新来提高效率。
AI.motivation: 游戏行业大量使用RGBA动画资产，但现有方法存在两大挑战：一是现有RGBA视频数据集主要覆盖写实内容，缺乏游戏资产覆盖；二是传统的生成后抠像（generate-then-matte）流程在RGB合成后才估计alpha，半透明区域常因背景模糊导致蒙版输出不稳定。现有联合建模方法多为文本条件驱动，在效率和质量上仍有不足。
AI.method: 1) 构建GameAlpha-2.4K数据集：采用matte-friendly合成、多假设alpha恢复和基于合成的质量门控。2) 训练参考条件化的RGBA视频生成器，单次前向传播联合生成RGB帧和alpha蒙版。3) 提出visibility router：在早期阶段识别透明token并在后续DiT更新中跳过它们；同时使用x_0-lock引导这些token沿原始flow-matching调度向自预测端点推进。
AI.result: 模型相比传统两阶段流水线获得更低的FVD；visibility router在最后两步DiT去噪中跳过了35%的token评估，相比密集推理提供1.2倍骨干网络加速，且质量退化可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 通过专用游戏风格数据集和联合RGB-alpha生成框架，配合高效的token跳过策略，实现了更高品质和更高效的RGBA视频生成，为游戏资产生成提供了可行的解决方案。

title: ElasticBack: Stealthy Conditional Backdoor in LLM-Agent Skills via Coupled Trigger-Rule Optimization
summary: Agent skills, bundles of instructions and resources that an LLM agent loads on demand, form an emerging supply chain where a single poisoned skill can persistently compromise every agent that installs it. However, existing skill attacks either fire on every request or rely on fine-tuned weights or multiple skills, leaving a conditional and low-cost backdoor unexplored. In this work, we present ElasticBack, an effective conditional single-skill backdoor that plants a rule R in the skill document and a benign-looking trigger T in the user query, so the malicious payload fires only when both co-occur. ElasticBack binds the two sides through a trigger-as-switch construction, generating R via semantic-anchored rule injection. It then freezes R and evolves T against it with a stealth-constrained genetic search, so that effectiveness and stealth are optimized, keeping the backdoor weight-free and dormant on benign inputs. Extensive experiments across three target behaviors (50 skills each) and four agent LLMs show that ElasticBack attains a high attack success rate at a near-zero false-positive rate with preserved clean accuracy, transfers across models, and evades deployment-time defenses. These results motivate stronger defenses for the skill supply chain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ElasticBack，一种条件性单技能后门攻击方法，通过在技能文档中植入规则R并在用户查询中植入良性触发词T，只有在两者同时出现时恶意载荷才会触发，实现了高攻击成功率、近零误报率且无需微调权重，揭示了技能供应链的新型安全威胁。
AI.motivation: 现有技能攻击要么每次请求都触发，要么依赖微调权重或多个技能配合，缺乏低成本、条件性触发的单技能后门攻击方案，而这类攻击在技能供应链中具有现实威胁性。
AI.method: ElasticBack通过trigger-as-switch机制将触发词T与规则R绑定：先通过语义锚定的规则注入生成R，再冻结R通过带隐写约束的遗传搜索进化T，同时优化攻击有效性和隐蔽性，实现无权重依赖且对良性输入保持休眠的后门。
AI.result: 在三种目标行为（每种50个技能）和四个代理LLM上的实验表明，ElasticBack实现高攻击成功率、近零误报率、保持清洁准确率，可跨模型迁移并规避部署时的防御检测。
AI.conclusion: ElasticBack证明了技能供应链中存在低成本、高隐蔽性的条件性后门攻击，这些发现呼吁为技能供应链开发更强的防御机制。

title: ControlRadio: Prompt-Driven Controllable Diffusion for Cross-Modal Radio Map Generation
summary: Radio maps describe how wireless signals propagate across space and are essential for wireless communication, sensing, and network planning. However, constructing accurate radio maps traditionally requires either dense measurements or computationally expensive physical simulations, which limits scalability and real-time deployment. Recent advances in generative artificial intelligence offer a promising alternative, but existing approaches lack fine-grained control and physical consistency when applied to real-world wireless environments. Here we present \textbf{ControlRadio}, a controllable generative framework that produces radio maps from natural-language descriptions and environmental layouts, including building structures and transmitter locations. Joint semantic and spatial conditioning enables interpretable, propagation-plausible generation, while a controlled latent prior and layout-aware conditioning improve stability and structural consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ControlRadio achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and strong generalization across diverse urban scenarios, while reducing computation time by more than four orders of magnitude compared with conventional simulation-based methods. Such results suggest a new paradigm for scalable and controllable wireless environment modeling, with broad implications for next-generation communication systems and data-driven radio sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ControlRadio，一个可控生成式框架，能从自然语言描述和环境布局（建筑结构、发射器位置）生成无线电地图。相比传统测量或物理仿真方法，该方法在保持高精度的同时将计算时间减少超过四个数量级，实现可扩展且可控的无线环境建模。
AI.motivation: 传统无线电地图构建需密集测量或昂贵物理仿真，限制可扩展性和实时部署；现有生成式AI方法缺乏细粒度控制和物理一致性，无法很好应用于真实无线环境。
AI.method: ControlRadio采用联合语义和空间条件控制实现可解释、传播合理的无线电地图生成；通过受控潜在先验（controlled latent prior）和布局感知条件（layout-aware conditioning）提升生成稳定性和结构一致性。
AI.result: 在多样城市场景中达到最先进（SOTA）精度，具备强泛化能力；相比传统基于仿真的方法，计算时间减少超过四个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出可扩展且可控的无线环境建模新范式，对下一代通信系统和数据驱动的无线电感知具有广泛意义。

title: CoRCi: Cross-Reconstruction of Coherent Interests Modeling in Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation
summary: Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation (CDSR) aims to alleviate data sparsity by transferring dynamic user interests across related domains. A key challenge lies in effectively bridging these domains. In single-domain modeling, models cannot distinguish between domain-specific and domain-invariant interests. Recent methods merge domain-specific sequences chronologically into a mixed-domain sequence to capture domain-invariant knowledge. However, they typically deploy separate encoders for the mixed-domain sequence and train them with per-domain loss aggregation. This workflow magnifies inter-domain discrepancies and disrupts domain-invariant interest coherence, especially when query target pairs in Seq2Seq originate from different domains. In this paper, we present CoRCi (Cross-Reconstruction for Coherent Interest), a dual-target CDSR framework that tackles these drawbacks. Specifically, CoRCi proposes a Cross-Reconstruction approach that generates mixed-domain representations directly from pre-encoded specific-domain representations via cross-attention. The generated representations are then trained using a single, sequence-level, domain-agnostic loss to preserve the coherence of domain-invariant interests. To further suppress domain discrepancies in mixed-domain modeling, CoRCi introduces FocalNCE, which embeds Focal Loss into the preceding mixed-domain InfoNCE objective. The new loss assigns higher penalties to negatives drawn from the same domain as the query, thereby strengthening domain-invariant alignment. Extensive experiments on four real-world datasets demonstrate that CoRCi consistently outperforms state-of-the-art CDSR counterparts, achieving statistically significant gains across all metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoRCi，一种双目标跨域序列推荐框架，通过跨重建方法（Cross-Reconstruction）生成混合域表示，并用单一序列级域无关损失进行训练，以保持域不变兴趣的连贯性。同时引入FocalNCE损失，将Focal Loss嵌入混合域InfoNCE目标中，对同域负样本施加更高惩罚，强化域不变对齐。在四个真实数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 跨域序列推荐中的关键挑战是桥接不同域。现有方法将域特定序列按时间合并为混合域序列来捕捉域不变知识，但通常为混合域序列部署独立编码器并以逐域损失聚合方式训练，这会放大域间差异、破坏域不变兴趣的连贯性，尤其是当Seq2Seq中的查询-目标对来自不同域时问题更为严重。
AI.method: CoRCi提出两种核心机制：1) 跨重建（Cross-Reconstruction）方法：通过交叉注意力直接从预编码的域特定表示生成混合域表示，避免额外独立编码器；2) FocalNCE损失：将Focal Loss嵌入混合域InfoNCE目标中，对与查询同域的负样本施加更高惩罚，从而强化域不变对齐。整个框架使用单一序列级域无关损失进行训练。
AI.result: 在四个真实数据集上的大量实验表明，CoRCi在所有指标上一致性地优于最先进的CDSR方法，且取得了统计学上显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: CoRCi通过跨重建策略和FocalNCE损失有效解决了现有CDSR方法中域间差异被放大和域不变兴趣连贯性被破坏的问题，证明了其作为跨域序列推荐框架的有效性。

title: Deep Learning based Detection of Fishing Vessels and Fishing Monitoring using Nightlight Images
summary: The demand for maritime surveillance has given rise to the need for monitoring fishing vessel activities, particularly in addressing the challenge of "dark vessels" that operate without Automatic Identification System (AIS) transmission. This study presents a novel approach for detecting small-scale fishing vessels using nighttime light (NTL) imagery from the SDGSAT-1 satellite, combined with deep learning techniques to enhance fishing monitoring awareness along the western coast of India. A dual-branch YOLO11 architecture was developed to exploit both the 10-meter panchromatic and 40-meter RGB imagery from SDGSAT-1. The custom model architecture was specifically optimized for small object detection in NTL imagery, featuring parallel convolutional backbones that process both modalities before concatenation for enhanced feature extraction. The dual-branch YOLO11 model demonstrated optimal performance with a precision of 0.99, recall of 0.93, F1-score of 0.96, and mAP@50 of 0.96, significantly outperforming single-branch implementations of YOLOv5s, YOLOv8s, and standard YOLO11s architectures. When applied to the western coast of India, the model detected 31525 vessel instances across the temporal dataset spanning 2022-23. Cross-matching analysis with AIS data revealed that only 7146 (22.7%) of detected vessels had corresponding AIS transmissions, while 24379 (77.3%) were identified as potential dark vessels. Spatio-temporal analysis showed peak fishing activity during January-April, with a primary activity corridor parallel to the coastline within 50-100 km, corresponding to productive continental shelf areas. This research contributes to maritime surveillance capabilities by highlighting the effectiveness of nighttime lights satellite imagery for fishing vessel detection and provides valuable insights into fishing patterns and potential regulatory compliance issues in Indian waters.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用SDGSAT-1卫星夜间灯光影像结合双分支YOLO11深度学习架构，检测印度西海岸的小型渔船，成功识别出31,525艘渔船，其中77.3%为未开启AIS的"暗船"，为实现海上渔业监控提供了新方法。
AI.motivation: 海上渔业监控需求日益增长，特别是针对不发送AIS信号的"暗船"监控存在挑战。传统方法难以有效检测小型渔船，需要利用夜间灯光卫星影像与深度学习相结合的新方案来提升渔业监控能力。
AI.method: 提出双分支YOLO11架构，并行处理SDGSAT-1卫星的10米全色影像和40米RGB夜间灯光影像，两分支经过卷积骨干网络提取特征后拼接融合，专门针对夜间灯光影像中的小目标检测进行优化。
AI.result: 模型精度0.99、召回率0.93、F1分数0.96、mAP@50为0.96，显著优于单分支YOLOv5s、YOLOv8s和标准YOLO11s。在2022-23年印度西海岸数据中检测到31,525艘渔船，其中77.3%为暗船。时空分析显示捕捞高峰期为1-4月，主要活动带位于海岸线50-100公里范围内。
AI.conclusion: 夜间灯光卫星影像结合深度学习可有效实现渔船检测，为海上监控和渔业合规监管提供了有力工具，也为理解印度海域渔业活动模式和潜在的监管合规问题提供了重要见解。

title: ICM Out! Better Tournament Strategy from Computed Continuations, vs. Solvers and LLMs
summary: The Independent Chip Model (ICM) converts tournament chips into reference prize equity, and policies are routinely constructed against those values. Because ICM reads only stack sizes, it omits action order, blind obligations, and seat rotation, and it does not price the elimination pressure a big stack puts on the short stacks it can bust. Those omissions can alter the successor-state contrasts that determine a move. We introduce Strategic-Continuation Optimization (SCO), a policy-construction method that enumerates current-hand outcomes, maps them to successor states, prices those states with continuation values computed from the finite tournament model, and optimizes and freezes the resulting current-hand policy. The fixed-ICM comparison policy changes one thing only: the same optimizer solves the same game with successor states priced by analytic ICM, so the two policies differ only through that pricing. We evaluate the resulting policies in a three-player jam/fold tournament with a \$1M prize pool. Relative to the frozen strategic-continuation benchmark, analytic ICM has \$9{,}036 mean absolute value error across all 2,838 state--seat entries. That value error rewrites the ranges it prices: measured against each decision point's own fixed-ICM jam range, SCO moves the jam frequency by an average of 14.08\%. To price those different moves, we compare all 946 states and three policy owners while changing only the focal policy and holding both opponents and the continuation evaluator fixed. The policy produced by SCO earns \$214.33 more prize equity per hand on average and is favored in 2,433 of 2,838 matched units. The ordering survives replacing the solver-built opponent with two LLMs and with a family of non-modeling threshold players. This value-to-policy-to-cost chain shows directly when ICM becomes an inadequate objective for tournament strategy construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出战略延续优化（SCO），一种基于有限锦标赛模型计算延续值来定价后继状态，从而构建扑克锦标赛策略的方法。相比传统的独立筹码模型（ICM）仅依赖筹码量，SCO考虑了行动顺序、盲注义务和座次轮转等遗漏信息。在三人jam/fold锦标赛中，SCO比ICM平均每手多赢得214.33美元奖金权益，在2838个匹配单元中占优2433个。
AI.motivation: ICM作为扑克锦标赛策略构建的标准工具，仅读取筹码量而忽略了行动顺序、盲注义务、座次轮转以及对短筹码的淘汰压力，这些遗漏可能改变决定行动的后继状态对比，导致ICM成为不充分的策略目标。
AI.method: 提出SCO方法：枚举当前手牌结果，映射到后继状态，用有限锦标赛模型计算的延续值对这些状态定价，然后优化并冻结当前手牌策略。通过与固定ICM对比策略（仅改变后继状态定价方式）进行比较来隔离定价差异的影响。
AI.result: 在三玩家jam/fold锦标赛（100万美元奖池）中：ICM的平均绝对价值误差为9036美元（覆盖2838个状态-座位条目）；SCO相对固定ICM将jam频率平均移动14.08%；SCO每手平均多赚214.33美元奖金权益，在2838个匹配单元中占优2433个；该优势在替换对手为两个LLM和非建模阈值玩家后仍然保持。
AI.conclusion: 价值误差会重写定价范围，进而改变策略并影响成本，这一链条直接证明了ICM何时成为锦标赛策略构建的不充分目标，SCO提供了更优的策略构建替代方案。

title: FeedbackTrack: Visual-Cortex-Inspired Cross-Frame Feedback for Transformer Tracking
summary: Visual object tracking requires effective temporal integration, yet most Transformer trackers still rely on predominantly feed-forward feature extraction. Existing temporal mechanisms typically update templates, prompts, queries, or prediction states, while intermediate representations are rarely reused to modulate corresponding processing stages. We propose \textbf{FeedbackTrack}, a visual-cortex-inspired framework that introduces sparse, group-level layer-aligned cross-frame feedback into pretrained Transformer trackers. Previous-frame intermediate states are detached, cached, and returned to corresponding Transformer groups in the current frame through two lightweight pathways: Query Feedback for token-level query modulation and Gate Feedback for context-dependent feature modulation. FeedbackTrack preserves the original tracking pipeline with only a fixed-size one-frame cache. Across SPMTrack and ARTrackV2, FeedbackTrack consistently improves five backbone configurations on LaSOT and GOT-10k, achieving 83.4 AO and 79.1 AUC with SPMTrack-G while adding less than 1\% parameters. Controlled comparisons show that cross-frame feedback outperforms same-frame modulation by 1.8--3.2 AO points, demonstrating that the gains mainly come from recurrent historical information. Further analysis reveals a non-uniform depth-dependent organization of learned feedback strengths, highlighting the effectiveness of recurrent feedback for Transformer tracking.

AI.tldr: 提出FeedbackTrack框架，将视觉皮层启发的稀疏分组级跨帧反馈引入预训练Transformer跟踪器。通过Query Feedback和Gate Feedback两条轻量路径，将上一帧中间状态缓存并反馈到当前帧对应Transformer组，在SPMTrack和ARTrackV2上显著提升性能（SPMTrack-G达83.4 AO和79.1 AUC），仅增加不到1%参数。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer跟踪器主要依赖前馈特征提取，虽已有各种时间机制（更新模板、提示、查询或预测状态），但中间表示很少被复用来调制对应的处理阶段，缺乏对跨帧递归信息的有效利用。
AI.method: 引入两路轻量反馈路径：(1) Query Feedback用于token级查询调制；(2) Gate Feedback用于上下文依赖的特征调制。上一帧中间状态被分离、缓存并返回到当前帧对应Transformer组，仅需固定大小的一帧缓存，保持原始跟踪流水线不变。
AI.result: 在LaSOT和GOT-10k上，对SPMTrack和ARTrackV2五种骨干配置均有一致提升，SPMTrack-G达到83.4 AO和79.1 AUC；跨帧反馈比同帧调制高出1.8-3.2 AO点；训练得到的反馈强度呈现非均匀的深度相关组织。
AI.conclusion: 跨帧递归反馈比同帧调制更有效，证明性能提升主要来自历史信息复用；反馈强度在深度上呈非均匀分布，验证了递归反馈对Transformer跟踪的有效性。

title: From Sweep to Seam: Interleaved Cross-Block Post-Training Quantization
summary: Compressing large language models to two bits or fewer is increasingly feasible through block-wise post-training quantization; cross-block variants reconstruct neighboring Transformer blocks within a moving window. In the fixed two-block setting studied here, the matched sequential baseline moves this window through the network once, so errors introduced early in the sweep are not revisited. We propose Interleaved Cross-Block Quantization (ICBQ), a scheduling modification that revisits the boundary pair between consecutive chunks. Each seam pair is refined twice: first at the end of one chunk and again at the start of the next. The method retains the local two-block objective and reuses the calibration inputs of existing block-wise PTQ pipelines. Under stated local contraction and smoothness assumptions, we derive a depth-wise upper-bound comparison in which seam revisits multiply the propagated term while the residual remains bounded independently of depth. In the reported experiments, ICBQ reduces ternary-quantization perplexity relative to the matched Sequential CBQ baseline, yields finite perplexity in configurations where the baseline has severe degradation, and can also be used with 3-bit and 2-bit GPTQ.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为交错跨块量化（ICBQ）的调度修改方法，用于低比特（2比特或更低）大语言模型的块级后训练量化。与固定两块的顺序基线相比，ICBQ通过重新访问相邻块之间的边界对，每个接缝对被精炼两次，从而在保持局部目标的同时改善量化性能。
AI.motivation: 在块级后训练量化中，顺序基线只将移动窗口遍历网络一次，早期引入的误差在后续过程中不会被重新审视，导致误差累积和传播问题，特别是在极端低比特（≤2比特）情况下。
AI.method: ICBQ是一种调度修改方案：对每个接缝对（连续块之间的边界）进行两次精炼——先在当前块的末端，再在下个块的开头。该方法保持局部两块的优化目标，并复用现有块级PTQ流程中的校准输入。作者在局部收缩和平滑假设下推导了深度方向的上界比较，证明接缝重访使传播项倍增而残差项与深度无关有界。
AI.result: 实验表明ICBQ相较于匹配的顺序CBQ基线降低了三元量化的困惑度，在基线严重退化的配置中仍能获得有限困惑度，并且可推广应用于3比特和2比特的GPTQ量化。
AI.conclusion: ICBQ通过简单有效的调度修改，即重访接缝对，显著改善了极低比特下的块级量化性能，且无需改变优化目标或增加新的校准数据。

title: Preserve More Details: Mitigating Content Drift in Real-World Image Super-Resolution
comment: Accepted to ACM MM 2026. This is the author's accepted version. The definitive version is published in the Proceedings of ACM MM 2026
summary: Real-world image super-resolution (Real-ISR) aims to reconstruct high-quality (HQ) images from low-quality (LQ) inputs subject to diverse real-world degradations. Recent advances have leveraged the LQ inputs and natural image priors learned by Stable Diffusion models to achieve impressive results. However, existing methods often overlook insufficient clarity of LQ inputs inevitably induce content drift in the generated HQ images. This manifests primarily as visual detail degradation and textual semantic shift, severely compromising both fidelity and perceptual quality. To address this challenge, we propose FSP-Diff, a novel one-step diffusion model featuring a dual-pathway architecture. This architecture comprises a Detail-Conditioned Pathway for injecting structured details to recover fine structures, and a Detail-Modulated Semantic Pathway that refines semantic guidance using structured details to mitigate semantic deviations. Extensive experiments on standard Real-ISR benchmarks demonstrate that FSP-Diff surpasses existing one-step diffusion methods in both quantitative and qualitative metrics.

AI.tldr: FSP-Diff是一种新型单步扩散模型，通过双路径架构（细节条件路径和细节调制语义路径）解决真实图像超分辨率中因低质量输入导致的内容漂移问题，在标准基准上超越现有单步扩散方法。
AI.motivation: 现有Real-ISR方法虽然利用Stable Diffusion先验取得了不错效果，但忽视了低质量输入清晰度不足会导致生成的高质量图像发生内容漂移，具体表现为视觉细节退化和文本语义偏移，损害了保真度和感知质量。
AI.method: 提出FSP-Diff，一种单步扩散模型，采用双路径架构：1) Detail-Conditioned Pathway用于注入结构化细节以恢复精细结构；2) Detail-Modulated Semantic Pathway利用结构化细节精炼语义引导，以缓解语义偏差。
AI.result: 在标准Real-ISR基准上的大量实验表明，FSP-Diff在定量和定性指标上均优于现有单步扩散方法。
AI.conclusion: FSP-Diff通过双路径架构有效解决了内容漂移问题，同时保持单步扩散的效率优势，在真实超分辨率任务中取得了更优的性能。

title: Adaptive Sequential Test Planning for Multi-Mechanism Reliability Qualification via Bayesian Monte Carlo Tree Search
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Reliability
summary: Reliability qualification of advanced semiconductor devices requires sequential stress decisions that balance characterization objectives against multiple competing failure mechanisms. Current practice relies on static test plans derived from population-level acceleration models, which cannot adapt to per-unit variability or real-time degradation observations. This paper presents a closed-loop adaptive test planning framework that formulates reliability qualification as a partially observable sequential decision problem and solves it using Monte Carlo tree search for seed-action simulators (MCTS-SA) coupled with extended Kalman filter (EKF) belief-state estimation. The framework models stochastic, per-device variability in bias temperature instability (BTI), electromigration (EM), and time-dependent dielectric breakdown (TDDB), and treats stress selection as a constrained sequential optimization, i.e., to maximize the probability of successful degradation characterization while respecting catastrophic failure constraints. Under the experimental assumptions used here (discrete stress actions, proxy damage observability, and cumulative degradation without recovery), we believe this to be a novel application of tree-search-based adaptive test planning to multi-mechanism reliability qualification. Across 5,000 planning iterations, the characterization yield (CY) improves from 20% in the first 500 iterations to over 54% in the final 500, with 39% cumulative success, while the best successful test sequence terminates with EM and TDDB damage fractions DEM=0.564 and DTDDB=0.537, well within safety margins. These results demonstrate that sequential Bayesian planning can synthesize damage-aware test policies that significantly outperform non-adaptive strategies for reliability qualification under competing failure modes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种闭环自适应测试规划框架，将半导体器件可靠性鉴定建模为部分可观测的序贯决策问题，利用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS-SA）与扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）相结合，在多竞争失效机制（BTI、EM、TDDB）下自适应选择应力测试序列，显著提升了表征产出率。
AI.motivation: 当前可靠性鉴定依赖静态测试计划，基于群体级加速模型，无法适应单器件个体差异或实时退化观测。在面对多种竞争失效机制时，传统非自适应策略难以在表征目标与灾难性失效约束之间取得良好平衡。
AI.method: 将可靠性鉴定建模为部分可观测序贯决策问题，采用MCTS-SA（种子动作模拟器的蒙特卡洛树搜索）进行规划，结合扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）进行信念状态估计，对BTI、EM、TDDB三种失效机制建模器件级随机变异性，并将应力选择视为受灾难性失效约束的序贯优化。
AI.result: 在5000次规划迭代中，表征产出率（CY）从最初500次迭代的20%提升至最后500次的54%以上，累计成功率为39%；最优测试序列终止时EM和TDDB损伤分数分别为0.564和0.537，均在安全裕度内。
AI.conclusion: 序贯贝叶斯规划能够生成损伤感知的自适应测试策略，在多种竞争失效机制下显著优于非自适应策略，为先进半导体器件的可靠性鉴定提供了新思路。

title: Efficient Human-Contact Representation for Human-Scene Interaction
summary: Human-scene interaction is an active research topic with several industrial applications in virtual reality, gaming, robotics, and surveillance. Despite significant progress in network architectures to improve the results or optimize models' parameters for fast inference speed, the efficient representation of contact between humans and their environments remains an open challenge. In this paper, we propose a new efficient human-contact representation for human-scene interaction. Our primary contribution is the introduction of sparse contact masks that strategically select essential contact information, significantly reducing redundant data in high-dimensional inputs. Leveraging this efficient contact representation, we propose a suite of sparse operators to replace traditional dense operators within deep network layers for faster computation. Our approach not only enhances computational speed but also filters out non-essential contact data, thereby improving the precision of human-scene interaction models. To validate the effectiveness of our method, we conduct intensive experiments across three public benchmark datasets, focusing on two critical tasks for human-scene interaction: contact prediction and scene synthesis. The experimental results show that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art models in reconstruction accuracy and achieves a computation speed-up of at least 12 times over recent baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新型高效的人-场景接触表示方法，通过稀疏接触掩码选择关键接触信息，并引入稀疏算子替代传统密集算子，在保持精度的同时显著提升计算速度（至少12倍加速），在接触预测和场景合成两个任务上超越现有最先进模型。
AI.motivation: 人-场景交互研究虽有网络架构上的进展，但接触（contact）的高效表示仍是一个开放挑战。现有方法在高维输入中存在大量冗余数据，导致计算开销大且精度受限。
AI.method: 1) 提出稀疏接触掩码（sparse contact masks）作为高效接触表示，策略性地选择关键接触信息以削减高维输入中的冗余数据；2) 基于该表示，设计一套稀疏算子（sparse operators）替代深度网络层中的传统密集算子，以提升计算效率并过滤非必要接触数据。
AI.result: 在三个公开基准数据集上，针对接触预测和场景合成两个关键任务进行实验，结果表明所提方法在重建精度上优于最先进模型，且计算速度相比近期基线至少提升12倍。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏接触表示与稀疏算子相结合，不仅大幅提升了人-场景交互模型的计算效率，还通过过滤冗余数据增强了模型的精度，为该领域提供了高效且精准的新方案。

title: Rethinking Self-Evolving Agents: Do We Still Need Prescribed Optimization Pipelines?
summary: Self-evolving agents are usually built around prescribed optimization pipelines: the framework decides how to gather evidence, revise a persistent artifact, select candidates, and stop. We ask whether this task-specific procedure remains necessary when a frontier model acts as the optimizer. We introduce Open-Ended Optimization (OEO), which keeps the objective, permitted interactions, resource budget, data boundary, and evaluation fixed while allowing the optimizer to compose the improvement process online. We compare OEO with two complementary prescribed approaches: SkillOpt, a staged pipeline with bounded edits, and GEPA, a reflective evolutionary search. Across 14 head-to-head comparisons over 8 benchmark-target-model settings, GPT-5.5-driven OEO records 12 wins, 1 tie, and 1 narrow loss of 0.21 percentage points. It uses a median 34.3 percent of SkillOpt's configured target-interaction token budget. A one-shot, zero-interaction control shows that the gains are not explained by a single prior-driven rewrite. However, delegation has a capability boundary: SkillOpt outperforms OEO with a medium optimizer, and a weak optimizer cannot operate through the unchanged OEO interface. In the fully instrumented OEO-SkillOpt pair, trajectory analysis further shows that prescription changes how optimization proceeds more consistently than it changes final behavior. Together, these findings recast prescribed pipelines as capability-dependent scaffolding: essential constraints remain external, but a sufficiently capable optimizer can compose the route from measurable feedback to persistent improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出开放端优化（OEO）框架，让前沿模型作为优化器自主编排改进流程，而非依赖预设的优化管线。在14项头对头比较中，GPT-5.5驱动的OEO取得12胜1平1负的成绩，且仅消耗SkillOpt约34.3%的交互token预算，表明高能力优化器可以自主组合优化路径。
AI.motivation: 传统自进化智能体依赖预设的优化管线（如固定证据收集、工件修订、候选选择与停止策略），本文质疑当使用前沿模型作为优化器时，这种任务特定程序是否仍然必要，探索更灵活开放的优化范式。
AI.method: 提出OEO框架，固定目标、允许交互、资源预算、数据边界和评估标准，但允许优化器在线自主编排改进过程。与两种预设方法对比：SkillOpt（分段管线+受限编辑）和GEPA（反思式进化搜索），并设置零交互一次性对照组以排除先验重写的解释。
AI.result: 在8个基准-目标模型设置的14项对比中，GPT-5.5驱动的OEO取得12胜1平1负（唯一失利差距仅0.21个百分点），中位数token消耗仅为SkillOpt预算的34.3%。但能力边界明显：中等优化器下SkillOpt超越OEO，弱优化器无法通过OEO界面运作。轨迹分析显示预设改变优化过程多于最终行为。
AI.conclusion: 预设管线可视为能力依赖的脚手架：外部约束仍然必要，但足够强大的优化器可以自主从可测量的反馈组合出通往持续改进的路径，重新定位了当前优化框架设计范式。

title: CoInS-Net: A Continuous Position-Aware Network for Joint Medical Image Interpolation and Segmentation
summary: Accurate medical image interpolation and anatomical structure segmentation are fundamental for computer-aided diagnosis and treatment planning. Anisotropic medical volumes with sparse through-plane sampling often suffer from structural discontinuity and boundary blur, hindering reliable clinical image analysis. Most existing methods implement interpolation and segmentation independently, which introduces redundant computation and fails to fully exploit complementary cross-slice structural information between sequential slices. To address these issues, we propose a continuous position-aware interaction network, termed CoInS-Net, for joint frame interpolation and lesion segmentation. Unlike conventional cascaded interpolation-then-segmentation paradigms, the framework enables bidirectional interaction under a shared Swin encoder with continuous spatial coordinate queries. A spatially continuous position interpolation module generates target-position features at every scale from the relative coordinate and physical spacing, and a prototype-based task mutual interaction module lets the segmentation and interpolation branches exchange global structure through a small set of shared prototypes rather than dense feature mixing. A multi-scale task-cooperative decoder further separates each scale into shared and task-specific components, so the two tasks reinforce common anatomy while preserving their distinct requirements down to the boundary level, without extra annotations. Experiments on four public medical imaging datasets with diverse modalities and anatomical regions demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms conventional single-task schemes. The joint optimization framework effectively realizes mutual promotion between interpolation and segmentation tasks, providing a reliable and universal technical scheme for intelligent clinical medical image analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoInS-Net，一个用于联合帧插值和病灶分割的连续位置感知交互网络。通过共享Swin编码器实现双向交互，利用连续空间坐标查询生成目标位置特征，并通过原型互作用模块和多尺度任务协同解码器促进两个任务相互增强，在四个公开医学影像数据集上优于传统单任务方案。
AI.motivation: 各向异性医学体积数据（层间采样稀疏）常导致结构不连续和边界模糊，影响临床图像分析。现有方法将插值和分割独立实现，存在冗余计算且未能充分利用连续切片间的互补结构信息，亟需联合框架。
AI.method: 1) 共享Swin编码器支持双向交互与连续空间坐标查询；2) 空间连续位置插值模块从相对坐标和物理间距生成各尺度的目标位置特征；3) 基于原型（prototype）的任务互作用模块让分割和插值分支通过共享原型交换全局结构信息（而非稠密特征混合）；4) 多尺度任务协同解码器将每个尺度分离为共享和任务特定组件，使两任务强化共同解剖结构同时保留各自边界级需求，无需额外标注。
AI.result: 在四个涵盖不同模态和解剖区域的公开医学影像数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于传统单任务方案，联合优化框架有效实现了插值和分割任务间的相互促进。
AI.conclusion: CoInS-Net提供了一种可靠且通用的联合插值与分割技术方案，证明多任务联合优化能够通过共享结构和原型交互实现任务间良性互补，为智能临床医学影像分析提供了新范式。

title: CableDex: Cable Length Estimation on Industrial Reels Using a Handheld Device
summary: CableDex is a computer vision system that addresses the time-consuming and inaccurate manual measurement of cable length on industrial reels from a single photograph captured with a mobile phone. The system combines camera calibration, instance segmentation, pose estimation, and volumetric calculation to estimate the cable length across five different reel types and various cable sizes. This system is based on an instance segmentation model trained on 1,000 manually annotated images, achieving 99.5\% mAP50 with an inference time of 5.66 ms per image. Evaluated on 75 reels across five reel types, the system achieves a MAPE of 4.90\%, within the 10\% error tolerance commonly accepted in industrial cable-reel measurement. The demonstration presents the end-to-end pipeline, from reel label scanning and image capture to segmentation and length estimation, through the mobile application.

AI.tldr: CableDex是一个计算机视觉系统，通过手机单张照片实现工业电缆卷筒上电缆长度的自动化测量，结合相机标定、实例分割、姿态估计和体积计算，在五种卷筒类型上达到4.90%的平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE），推理时间仅5.66毫秒。
AI.motivation: 传统电缆长度测量依赖人工操作，耗时且不准确。工业场景中需要一种快速、便捷且精度可接受的自动化测量方法来替代人工测量。
AI.method: 该系统采用多模块级联的计算机视觉pipeline：相机标定恢复成像参数，实例分割模型（基于1,000张人工标注图像训练）识别卷筒和电缆，姿态估计确定卷筒空间朝向，最后通过体积计算将视觉信息转换为电缆长度估计，并集成到移动应用中实现端到端流程。
AI.result: 实例分割模型达到99.5%的mAP50，推理时间5.66毫秒/张；在75个卷筒、五种卷筒类型的评估中，系统MAPE为4.90%，满足工业电缆测量的10%误差容忍标准。
AI.conclusion: CableDex证明了基于单张手机照片的计算机视觉方法能够以工业可接受的精度实现电缆长度自动测量，误差控制在10%容差范围内，且推理速度快，具备实际部署的可行性。

title: Hallucination-Free GUI Grounding via Regression-Free Layout-Aware Matching
summary: GUI agents are shifting from metadata-dependent large language models to purely visual multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that operate directly on screenshots. The core task, GUI grounding, requires translating abstract user instructions into precise element coordinates. This task faces a persistent dual obstacle: conventional grounding models lack the semantic richness to interpret abstract instructions, while end-to-end MLLMs suffer from coordinate hallucinations caused by deficient fine-grained perception. We propose a regression-free framework where a frozen MLLM performs instruction parsing and a dedicated grounding model handles precise localization without learning any coordinate regression.
