A frozen MLLM first elaborates the abstract instruction into a structured visual description rich in layout cues. These descriptions are then fed to a novel Layout-Aware GUI Grounding Model, which performs regression-free localization by matching against layout-prior candidates, inherently suppressing hallucinations and avoiding expensive fine-tuning. The grounding model is trained with only Text/Icon binary labels, requiring no coordinate regression parameters. On ScreenSpot-Pro, our method achieves over 20% improvement in grounding accuracy over end-to-end systems; on Mind2Web, it raises success rate and element selection rate by more than 15%. These results demonstrate that decoupling instruction understanding from layout-aware localization effectively resolves the core challenges of GUI interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无回归的GUI grounding框架，将冻结的MLLM用于指令解析与布局感知的grounding模型结合，无需坐标回归参数，在ScreenSpot-Pro上提升20%以上精度，在Mind2Web上提升15%以上的成功率。
AI.motivation: GUI grounding面临双重障碍：传统grounding模型缺乏语义丰富性来理解抽象指令，而端到端MLLM因细粒度感知不足而产生坐标幻觉。现有方法难以同时解决语义理解和精确定位的问题。
AI.method: 提出回归无关框架：(1) 冻结的MLLM将抽象指令解析为富含布局线索的结构化视觉描述；(2) 新建的布局感知GUI grounding模型通过匹配布局先验候选进行无回归定位，不需要训练坐标回归参数，仅用Text/Icon二分类标签训练。
AI.result: 在ScreenSpot-Pro上，grounding精度比端到端系统提升超过20%；在Mind2Web上，成功率和元素选择率提升超过15%。
AI.conclusion: 将指令理解与布局感知定位解耦，能有效解决GUI交互的核心难题，既避免了坐标幻觉，又无需昂贵的微调。

title: Sign Language Recognition Using Original and Synthetic Depth Image Based Point Cloud Data Models
summary: Research regarding the sign language recognition mostly relies on RGB images, whileas sign language datasets that provide depth images are limited. Point clouds obtained from depth images can be used for sign language recognition with neural networks like PointNet. In recent years, various neural networks are used for generating realistic depth images from monocular RGB images. In this work, synthetic depth images were created from RGB images using Depth Anything V2 network. For this purpose, three sign language datasets (Real-time ASL Fingerspelling, KArSL, AUTSL) which contain both RGB and depth images were used. Classification accuracies of the point cloud data created from both original and synthetic depth images using various PointNet architectures were measured for sign language recognition. From the original and synthetic point clouds, frame based, Point Gesture Map and Long Short Term Memory data models were used for classification and their performances were compared. In the results, both original and synthetic based data achieved acceptable performance in most models. In general, original depth based point cloud models performed better than synthetic ones, however in some models synthetic depth based models performed better than the originals.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Depth Anything V2网络从RGB图像生成合成深度图像，并基于此创建点云数据用于手语识别。研究比较了原始深度与合成深度来源的点云在多种PointNet架构及数据模型（帧、点手势图、LSTM）下的分类性能，发现两者均表现可接受，原始深度总体略优，但部分模型中合成深度表现更佳。
AI.motivation: 现有手语识别研究主要依赖RGB图像，而提供深度图像的数据集有限。为缓解深度数据稀缺问题，探索利用神经网络从单目RGB图像生成合成深度图，以扩充可用于手语识别的深度数据资源。
AI.method: 使用Depth Anything V2网络从RGB图像生成合成深度图；在三个同时包含RGB和深度图像的手语数据集（Real-time ASL Fingerspelling、KArSL、AUTSL）上，将原始深度与合成深度分别转换为点云；采用多种PointNet架构进行分类，并通过帧（frame-based）、Point Gesture Map和LSTM三种数据模型进行建模与性能对比。
AI.result: 原始深度和合成深度生成的点云数据在大多数模型中均取得可接受的手语识别性能。总体上原始深度来源的点云模型表现优于合成深度，但在部分模型中合成深度来源的模型反而优于原始深度模型。
AI.conclusion: 合成深度图像可作为手语识别的可行数据来源，在一定程度上弥补真实深度数据的不足，但整体性能仍略逊于原始深度数据。未来有望通过改进深度生成或点云建模方式进一步提升合成数据的有效性。

title: Open Evaluation Agent: Efficient and Promptable Evaluation of Visual Generative Models
comment: Journal extension of our ACL 2025 paper (arXiv:2412.09645). 12 pages. Code: https://github.com/Vchitect/Evaluation-Agent
summary: Recent advances in visual generative models have enabled high-quality image and video generation, but evaluating these models often demands sampling hundreds or thousands of images or videos, which is computationally expensive. Existing evaluation methods also rely on rigid pipelines that overlook specific user needs and provide numerical results without clear explanations. Mimicking how humans quickly form impressions of a model's capabilities from only a few samples, we propose the Evaluation Agent framework, which employs human-like strategies for efficient, dynamic, multi-round evaluations, offering detailed, user-tailored analyses. Given a natural-language evaluation request, the agent decomposes it into sub-aspects, generates targeted prompts, samples images or videos from the evaluated model, invokes suitable evaluation tools, and iteratively updates its plan from the observed evidence, covering both predefined benchmark dimensions and open-ended user concerns. The framework is thus efficient, promptable, explainable, and scalable across models and tools. Experiments show that Evaluation Agent reduces evaluation time to 10% of traditional methods while delivering comparable results. We further introduce Open Evaluation Agent (Open-EA) by constructing EA-CoT-10K, a corpus of history-conditioned step-level instruction-tuning records derived from multi-round evaluation rollouts, and training EA-3B from Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct as a local planning backbone that preserves the structured reasoning, tool invocation, and summary protocol of the API-based agent while reducing dependence on proprietary backbones. Experiments validate the API-based agent on established T2I/T2V benchmarks and open-ended queries, and evaluate Open-EA on four in-domain and three out-of-domain T2V generator families, showing partial cross-family transfer of the learned policy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Evaluation Agent框架，通过模拟人类快速形成模型能力印象的方式，实现高效、动态、多轮次的生成模型评估。该框架能将自然语言评估需求分解为子方面，生成针对性提示词，采样图像/视频并调用评估工具，迭代更新评估计划。评估时间仅为传统方法的10%且结果相当。作者还引入Open-EA，通过构建EA-CoT-10K语料并训练EA-3B模型，减少了专有后端模型的依赖，验证了策略的部分跨模型族迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉生成模型评估方法计算成本高昂（需采样数百上千张图像/视频），且依赖僵化流程，忽视用户特定需求，只给出数值结果缺乏清晰解释。人类只需少量样本就能快速形成对模型能力的印象，作者受此启发，希望设计更高效、灵活、可解释且可扩展的评估框架。
AI.method: 1) 构建Evaluation Agent框架：接收自然语言评估请求后，将其分解为子方面，生成针对性提示词，采样待评估模型的图像/视频，调用合适的评估工具，并根据观测证据迭代更新评估计划。2) 覆盖预定义基准维度和开放式用户关注点。3) 引入Open-EA：构建EA-CoT-10K语料（由多轮评估rollouts生成的历史条件下步级指令微调记录），基于Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct训练EA-3B作为本地规划骨干，保留API-based agent的结构化推理、工具调用和总结协议。
AI.result: 实验表明Evaluation Agent将评估时间降至传统方法的10%，同时保持可比的结果质量。在已建立的T2I/T2V基准和开放式查询上验证了API-based agent的有效性。Open-EA在四个域内和三个域外T2V生成器族上进行了评估，显示出学习策略的部分跨族迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: Evaluation Agent框架提供了高效、可提示、可解释且可扩展的生成模型评估新范式，显著降低计算成本；Open-EA进一步实现了对专有后端的去依赖，虽然跨模型族迁移仍存在部分局限性，但验证了该思路的可行性，为未来的开放评估Agent发展奠定了基础。

title: One Model to Magnify Them All: Efficient Scale-Invariant Histopathology via Conditional Normalization and Continuous Magnification Training
summary: Whole slide images (WSIs) in digital histopathology are acquired at discrete magnification levels encoding complementary diagnostic information from global tissue architecture to fine-grained cellular morphology. Yet, deep learning models remain sensitive to scale variation. Existing magnification-invariant methods rely on multi-scale architectures at predefined discrete resolutions, while in clinical deployment the acquisition magnification varies continuously, rarely aligns with a model's fixed training resolution, and intermediate scales are common, so robust coverage otherwise demands a costly ensemble of magnification-specific models. We propose Conditional Layer Normalization (CLN), a lightweight mechanism that generates affine normalization parameters from input pixel size via a small MLP, integrated into standard CNN architectures for both WSI classification and segmentation. Trained on patches sampled continuously across a range of pixel sizes, the model decouples inference from scanner-dependent magnification and generalizes to arbitrary, previously unseen scales at test time. On the PANDA prostate cancer dataset, our approach on average matches or exceeds independently trained single-magnification models and ranks among the top three performers at every evaluated magnification, including those unseen during training. This collapses a five-model ensemble into a single network and reduces training, and inference cost roughly 4-5 times, while leaving the multiply-accumulate count unchanged. The code is available at: https://github.com/aflorkowska/OneModelToMagnifyThemAll.

AI.tldr: 本文提出条件层归一化（CLN）机制，通过小型MLP根据输入像素尺寸生成仿射归一化参数，集成到标准CNN架构中，使模型能够在连续变化的放大倍数下处理全切片图像（WSI），无需为每个倍数单独训练模型，显著降低训练和推理成本。
AI.motivation: 现有的放大倍数不变方法依赖预定义的离散分辨率多尺度架构，但在临床实际部署中，采集放大倍数连续变化，很少与模型固定训练分辨率对齐，中间尺度常见，鲁棒覆盖需要昂贵的多模型集成。
AI.method: 提出条件层归一化（CLN），通过小型MLP从输入像素尺寸生成仿射归一化参数，集成到标准CNN架构中；在连续像素尺寸范围内采样patch进行训练，使模型能够泛化到训练时未见过的任意尺度。
AI.result: 在PANDA前列腺癌数据集上，该方法平均匹配或超越独立训练的单放大倍数模型，在所有评估倍数（包括训练中未见过的倍数）中排名前三；将五模型集成压缩为单个网络，训练和推理成本降低约4-5倍，同时保持乘法累加操作数不变。
AI.conclusion: CLN提供了一种轻量级、高效的解决方案，实现了对任意连续放大倍数的鲁棒推断，消除了对多模型集成的依赖，为数字病理学的实际临床应用提供了更强的泛化能力。

title: Adaptive Semantic Capacity Allocation for Parallel Generative Recommendation
summary: Autoregressive semantic ID recommenders are constrained by expensive beam-search decoding, which limits the practical length of item identifiers. Parallel generation methods alleviate this bottleneck by predicting all semantic ID tokens simultaneously, enabling longer IDs. However, existing semantic ID methods still rely on manually predefined and homogeneous ID structures, where both the number of semantic slots and the codebook size of each slot are treated as fixed hyperparameters. This ignores the heterogeneous capacity demands of different semantic subspaces and may allocate prediction capacity to slots with limited utility. We show that uniformly expanding semantic slots can provide limited gains, indicating redundant capacity in homogeneous semantic IDs. We propose InforID, a lightweight adaptive semantic target construction framework for parallel generative recommendation. InforID allocates a fixed capacity budget across candidate semantic slots, thereby jointly determining the effective ID length and slot-specific codebook sizes. Experiments demonstrate improved recommendation accuracy under comparable capacity budgets while preserving one-step parallel prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InforID，一个轻量级自适应语义目标构建框架，用于并行生成式推荐。InforID在固定的容量预算下跨候选语义槽分配容量，联合确定有效的ID长度和每个槽的码本大小，克服了现有语义ID方法中同质化、手动预定义ID结构的局限。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归语义ID推荐器受限于昂贵的beam-search解码，而并行生成方法虽可预测更长的ID，但依赖手动预定义的同质化ID结构（语义槽数量和码本大小均为固定超参数），忽视了不同语义子空间对容量的异质需求，可能将预测能力分配到效用有限的槽上，造成容量冗余。
AI.method: 提出InforID框架，在固定的容量预算内，跨候选语义槽自适应分配容量，从而联合确定有效的ID长度和每个槽特定的码本大小，替代传统均匀扩展语义槽的方式。
AI.result: 实验表明，在相当容量预算下，InforID提升了推荐准确率，同时保持一步并行预测的优势。
AI.conclusion: 均匀扩展语义槽带来的收益有限，说明同质化语义ID中存在冗余容量；InforID通过自适应容量分配能更有效地利用预算，提升推荐效果。

title: MeanSR: Restoration Trajectory Learning for One-Step Perceptual Super-Resolution
summary: Diffusion-based super-resolution (SR) achieves strong perceptual quality but requires costly iterative denoising. Existing one-step distillation methods reduce inference time but depend on expensive pretrained teachers, whereas CTMSR avoids distillation through PF-ODE consistency training yet does not explicitly model the restoration dynamics from low-resolution (LR) inputs to high-resolution (HR) images. We propose MeanSR, a one-step perceptual SR method that learns an LR-conditioned average velocity field to directly capture the finite-time transition from degraded or noisy inputs to plausible HR outputs. We further reformulate distribution trajectory matching for average-velocity generation and introduce a Stage-Aware Temporal Sampling strategy to improve trajectory learning. Experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that MeanSR outperforms CTMSR on CLIPIQA, MUSIQ, and MANIQA while substantially reducing FLOPs and inference latency. MeanSR also reconstructs sharper structures and more realistic textures with fewer perceptual artifacts.

AI.tldr: 提出MeanSR，一种一步式感知超分辨率方法，通过学习LR条件平均速度场直接捕获从低分辨率到高分辨率的有限时间过渡，无需蒸馏预训练教师模型，在多个感知指标上优于CTMSR且计算开销更低。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散式超分辨率方法虽感知质量好但迭代去噪成本高；一步蒸馏方法依赖昂贵的预训练教师；CTMSR虽通过PF-ODE一致性训练避免蒸馏，但未显式建模从LR到HR的恢复动力学过程。
AI.method: 1) 学习LR条件平均速度场，直接捕获从退化/噪声输入到合理HR输出的有限时间过渡；2) 为平均速度生成重新制定分布轨迹匹配；3) 引入阶段感知时间采样策略提升轨迹学习效果。
AI.result: 在合成和真实世界基准上，MeanSR在CLIPIQA、MUSIQ和MANIQA指标上优于CTMSR，同时大幅减少FLOPs和推理延迟；重建出更锐利的结构和更逼真的纹理，伪影更少。
AI.conclusion: MeanSR通过LR条件平均速度场实现一步式高质量感知超分辨率，在不依赖蒸馏的前提下实现了更优的感知质量与更高的计算效率。

title: Model Discovery Agent: LLM-assisted Bayesian experiment design for data-efficient discovery of mechanistic world models
summary: Predicting the answer to interventional ``what if'' questions --- the outcome of an action never taken --- requires a \emph{mechanistic}, causal model, not a curve fit; and learning such a model requires \emph{experiments}, because passive data leaves its mechanisms unidentified. Experiments are expensive, so the central problem is \emph{data efficiency}. We present the Model Discovery Agent (MDA), which couples a large language model (LLM), used as a \emph{proposer} of candidate structures, with standard Bayesian machinery --- sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) for parameter and structure posteriors, simulation-based inference (SBI) for intractable likelihoods, and value-of-information (VoI) for experiment design --- to discover latent mechanistic world models from few interventions. MDA operates in the M-open setting: when the truth lies outside the current hypothesis class, a predictive check flags the inadequacy and the proposer expands the hypothesis space with a new model whose parameters are then identified by designed experiments. We show that \emph{discovery and design reinforce}: the design step identifies the mechanism the discovery step proposes, and the identified mechanism improves predictions, enabling further discoveries from the remaining unexplained residuals. On three different benchmarks --- covering physics (\DPbench, \citep{wiemann2026discoverphysics}), chemistry (\CHEMbench, \citep{kabra2026autoscilab}) and biology (\HHbench, a new partially observed single-neuron electrophysiology benchmark we create) --- we show that MDA sets a new SOTA in terms of data-efficient model learning and reliable interventional forecasting ability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Model Discovery Agent (MDA)，将大语言模型作为候选模型结构生成器，与贝叶斯推断（SMC用于参数和后验）、仿真推断（SBI处理不可处理的似然）及信息价值（VoI）实验设计相结合，从少量干预实验中自动发现潜在机制性世界模型。MDA在M-open设置下运作，当真实模型超出当前假设类时，通过预测检查标记不足并扩展假设空间。在物理、化学和生物三个基准上达到新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 预测"what if"干预问题需要机制性的因果模型而非曲线拟合，而学习此类模型需要实验（被动数据无法识别机制）。实验成本高昂，因此核心挑战是数据效率。
AI.method: MDA将LLM作为候选模型结构提议器，耦合SMC进行参数与结构的贝叶斯后验推断、SBI处理不可处理的似然函数、VoI指导实验设计。采用M-open设置：当真实模型在假设类之外时，通过预测检查触发模型空间扩展，形成"发现-设计"相互强化的闭环。
AI.result: 在三个基准（物理DPbench、化学CHEMbench、新建的生物HHbench单神经元电生理基准）上，MDA在数据高效模型学习和可靠的干预预测能力方面均达到新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 发现与设计相互增强：设计步骤识别发现步骤提出的机制，识别出的机制改善预测，进而从剩余残差中发现更多机制，形成正反馈循环。

title: Foundation Models are Implicit Deepfake Detectors
summary: Pretrained self-supervised representations have emerged as a core component of current deepfake detection methods, yet it remains unclear which of their properties make real and fake media distinguishable. In this work, we uncover a surprisingly consistent phenomenon: across multiple pretrained models, datasets, and both image and video domains, fake samples systematically produce lower-magnitude representations than their real counterparts. Motivated by this finding, we formulate deepfake detection as an anomaly detection problem and show that simple statistics of feature magnitude achieve competitive performance with far more sophisticated deepfake detection methods. We further investigate the origin of this effect and demonstrate that reduced feature magnitude is primarily associated with semantic shifts introduced by fake content, while low-level generative fingerprints play a comparatively smaller role. Finally, we show that this discriminative signal strengthens as the size of the underlying foundation model grows, suggesting that advances in representation learning naturally translate into stronger zero-shot deepfake detectors.

AI.tldr: 本文发现一个惊人且一致的现象：在多种预训练模型、数据集以及图像和视频领域，伪造样本系统性地产生比真实样本更低幅度的特征表示。基于此，作者将深度伪造检测建模为异常检测问题，仅用特征幅度的简单统计即可达到与复杂方法相当的性能。该效应主要源于伪造内容引入的语义偏移，且随着基础模型规模增大而增强。
AI.motivation: 预训练自监督表示已成为深度伪造检测的核心组件，但究竟是其哪种属性使得真实与伪造媒体可区分仍然不清晰。作者旨在揭示这一区分信号的本质来源，从而理解深度伪造检测的底层机制。
AI.method: 首先系统性地在多个预训练模型、数据集及图像/视频领域上验证伪造样本特征幅度更低的一致性现象；随后将深度伪造检测形式化为异常检测问题，使用特征幅度的简单统计量作为判别信号；最后通过消融实验区分语义偏移与低层生成指纹的贡献，并探究模型规模的影响。
AI.result: 1) 伪造样本的特征幅度系统性低于真实样本，该现象跨模型、跨数据集、跨模态一致成立。2) 仅基于特征幅度统计的简单方法即可达到与复杂深度伪造检测方法竞争的性能。3) 该效应主要源于伪造内容引入的语义偏移，而非低层生成指纹。4) 随着基础模型规模增大，该判别信号增强，表示学习的进步自然转化为更强的零样本深度伪造检测器。
AI.conclusion: 特征幅度是区分真实与伪造媒体的强有力且可解释的信号，其有效性随自监督模型规模增长而增强，为构建零样本深度伪造检测提供了简单而可扩展的范式。

title: Unveiling the Secret of AdaLN-Zero in Diffusion Transformer
comment: Accept by IEEE TPAMI 2026, camera-ready version
summary: Diffusion transformer (DiT), a rapidly emerging architecture for image generation, has gained much attention. However, despite ongoing efforts to improve its performance, the understanding of DiT remains superficial. In this work, we delve into and investigate a critical conditioning mechanism within DiT, adaLN-Zero, which achieves superior performance compared to adaLN. Our work studies three potential elements driving this performance, including an SE-like structure, zero-initialization, and a "gradual" update order, among which zero-initialization is proved to be the most influential. Building on this understanding, we propose an analysis-guided initialization strategy, termed adaLN-Gaussian, which serves both as an empirical validation of our analysis and as a practical initialization method that consistently improves optimization efficiency. On the other hand, inspired by the SE-like structure, we introduce an improved conditioning mechanism called SE-adaLN-Zero. Extensive experiments following DiT on four datasets, especially on ImageNet1K demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of adaLN-Gaussian and SE-adaLN-Zero. Beyond class-to-image generation, we also evaluate the generalization of the two improved methods on text-to-image generation.

AI.tldr: 本文深入研究了Diffusion Transformer (DiT)中的关键条件机制adaLN-Zero，通过分析其优于adaLN的三个潜在因素（SE-like结构、零初始化、"逐渐"更新顺序），证明零初始化是最关键的因素。基于此提出分析引导的初始化策略adaLN-Gaussian和新型条件机制SE-adaLN-Zero，在多个数据集（尤其ImageNet1K）和文生图任务上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 尽管Diffusion Transformer (DiT)在图像生成领域取得了显著进展并受到广泛关注，但目前对其内部工作机制的理解仍然很浅层，特别是对其核心条件机制adaLN-Zero为何能优于adaLN缺乏深入分析。
AI.method: 1) 系统研究adaLN-Zero性能优势的三个潜在因素：SE-like结构、零初始化、以及"逐渐"更新顺序；2) 通过归因分析确定零初始化最具影响力；3) 提出分析引导的初始化策略adaLN-Gaussian作为实证验证和实用初始化方法；4) 受SE-like结构启发，提出改进的条件机制SE-adaLN-Zero。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上（尤其是ImageNet1K）遵循DiT进行大量实验，验证了adaLN-Gaussian和SE-adaLN-Zero的有效性与泛化性，并在类条件图像生成之外进一步验证了两种方法在文生图任务上的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 零初始化是adaLN-Zero性能优势的最关键因素，基于分析提出的adaLN-Gaussian初始化策略和SE-adaLN-Zero条件机制能持续提升优化效率并在多种生成任务上泛化良好。

title: Second-Order Muon Done Right: A Principled Marriage of Spectral Geometry and Curvature
summary: Muon's polar update is exact for an unweighted spectral geometry. We introduce GO-MUON, which uses a matched data-dependent geometry and reuses it across several optimization steps. Conditioned on any positive-definite left and right maps, its raw update exactly solves the corresponding weighted spectral oracle; this statement is independent of how the maps are estimated or how recently they were refreshed. For softmax cross-entropy, we quantify when the observed-label backward factor approaches the model Fisher and generalized Gauss--Newton factor. We also show that four-step refresh nearly preserves the tracking delay of slowly changing geometry while increasing stationary factor noise, making lazy geometry a compute--statistics tradeoff rather than a denoising mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GO-MUON方法，利用匹配的数据依赖几何结构并在多个优化步骤中复用该几何。在正定左右映射条件下，其原始更新精确求解对应的加权谱预言机。论文还分析了softmax交叉熵下观测标签反向因子与模型Fisher/GNN因子的接近程度，并揭示了四步刷新几何在跟踪延迟与因子噪声之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: Muon的极更新在未加权谱几何下是精确的，但实际优化中几何结构需要估计和刷新。作者希望将Muon推广到加权数据依赖几何的情境，并深入理解几何刷新频率对优化性能的影响。
AI.method: 引入GO-MUON，使用匹配的数据依赖几何并在多个优化步骤间复用。作者从理论上证明，给定任意正定左右映射，GO-MUON的原始更新精确求解对应的加权谱预言机。此外，通过理论分析刻画softmax交叉熵下观测标签反向因子与模型Fisher和广义Gauss-Newton因子的关系，并分析四步刷新策略下几何跟踪延迟和因子噪声的权衡。
AI.result: 证明了GO-MUON在正定映射下更新是精确的，且该结论不依赖于映射的估计方式或刷新频率。量化了观测标签反向因子与Fisher/GNN因子的接近程度。证明了四步刷新几何几乎保持跟踪延迟但增加稳态因子噪声，表明惰性几何是一种计算-统计权衡而非降噪机制。
AI.conclusion: GO-MUON为加权谱几何下的优化提供了精确的理论保证，并澄清了几何复用（惰性更新）的本质：它是在计算开销与统计噪声之间进行权衡，而不是一种改善估计质量的去噪手段。

title: Sekai2: From World Exploration to Interactive World Modeling
comment: Sekai2 dataset technical report. Developed at Alaya Lab
summary: Video world models must capture how scenes evolve over time and across viewpoints. Training them for long-horizon generation and camera control therefore benefits from long videos paired with camera trajectories and temporally grounded semantics. Existing corpora rarely offer the three together: large-scale web video provides broad visual diversity but no trajectories or time-aligned text, while pose-annotated datasets are typically short-range or reconstruction-oriented. We introduce Sekai2, a multi-source real-world video dataset that carries the world-exploration footage of Sekai toward interactive world modeling. The release contains 128,892 clips totaling 2,826 hours from 10,428 source videos across 113 countries or regions, and is deliberately weighted toward sustained observation: under a common 120-second decomposition, 43,594 segments reach the full two minutes and account for 51.4% of all footage. Every clip includes a released camera trajectory and hierarchical annotations disentangling subject motion, environment dynamics, static scene content, and camera behavior, resulting in 649,597 temporally grounded segments. Crucially, we further introduce 982 panoramic sequences captured along non-linear trajectories with loops and revisits. These revisits provide repeated observations of the same locations across time and viewpoints, offering essential supervision for learning persistent scene representations, long-term spatial memory, and geometrically consistent world models. Corpus-scale analyses demonstrate complete pose-and-caption coverage, broad geographic and semantic diversity, varied camera trajectories, and highly non-redundant temporal descriptions. Together, these properties make Sekai2 a scalable resource for long-horizon video generation, camera-controllable synthesis, and interactive world-model pre-training.

AI.tldr: Sekai2是一个多源真实世界视频数据集，包含128,892个片段、2,826小时、覆盖113个国家/地区，每个片段都配有相机轨迹和分层语义标注，特别引入了982个全景序列（含回访），用于支持长时程视频生成、相机可控合成和交互式世界模型预训练。
AI.motivation: 现有视频语料难以同时提供长视频、相机轨迹和时间对齐语义三者：大规模网页视频虽有视觉多样性但缺轨迹和时间对齐文本，而姿态标注数据集通常短程或面向重建。这限制了长时程生成和相机控制的世界模型的训练。
AI.method: 从Sekai探索视频构建多源数据集，包含128,892个片段（2,826小时，10,428个源视频，113个国家/地区），每个片段附带发布的相机轨迹和分层标注（主体运动、环境动态、静态场景内容、相机行为），共649,597个时间对齐片段；特别引入982个沿非线性轨迹（含环回和回访）拍摄的全景序列，提供对同一地点跨时间和视角的重复观察。
AI.result: 数据集在120秒分解下，43,594个片段达到完整两分钟（占全部素材51.4%）；语料级分析证明完整的姿态-字幕覆盖、广泛的地理与语义多样性、多样的相机轨迹以及高度非冗余的时间描述。
AI.conclusion: Sekai2具备可扩展性，可作为长时程视频生成、相机可控合成和交互式世界模型预训练的关键资源，其回访序列为学习持久场景表征、长期空间记忆和几何一致的世界模型提供必要监督。

title: AirFlow: Context Preserving and Multi-Rate State Modeling for Air Quality Forecasting
summary: Accurate air quality forecasting is essential for public health and urban environmental management, but remains challenging because pollutant channels differ in periodicity and distribution drift, while their concentration trajectories contain both multi-scale dependencies and rapid changes. Recent methods have improved spatial dependency learning and meteorological covariate modeling. However, pollutant channels are still passed through the same normalization rule and temporal backbone, using a shared latent representation for channel-specific distributions and changes at different rates. To address this limitation, we propose AirFlow, a pollutant-aware dual-stream framework that operates on station multivariate observations without additional graph propagation or predefined signal decomposition. Specifically, AirFlow designs two novel blocks: (1) a statistic-guided normalization routing mechanism that selects a normalization path for each pollutant according to its 24-hour autocorrelation and distribution drift; and (2) a hierarchical dual-stream state model that combines multi-scale state space propagation with learnable response coefficients, where gated bidirectional cross-attention exchanges information and adaptively fuses the resulting representations. Experiments on real-world data from multiple cities show that AirFlow achieves the best performance in 34 of 36 metrics comparisons, with reductions of up to 11.11% root mean square error over the state-of-the-art baseline. AirFlow also requires only 0.0483M parameters and 0.0215G FLOPs, achieving high forecasting accuracy with low computational overhead.

AI.tldr: AirFlow是一个面向空气质量预测的污染物感知双流框架，通过统计引导的归一化路由机制和层级双流状态模型，解决不同污染物通道在周期性和分布漂移上的差异性，在36项指标对比中34项达到最优，RMSE最多降低11.11%，且仅需0.0483M参数和0.0215G FLOPs。
AI.motivation: 现有空气质量预测方法将不同污染物通道通过相同的归一化规则和时间骨干网络处理，使用共享的潜在表征来建模通道特定的分布和不同速率的变化，无法充分捕捉污染物之间的周期性和分布漂移差异，以及浓度轨迹中的多尺度依赖和快速变化。
AI.method: AirFlow包含两个核心模块：(1) 统计引导的归一化路由机制，根据污染物的24小时自相关和分布漂移为每种污染物选择归一化路径；(2) 层级双流状态模型，结合多尺度状态空间传播与可学习响应系数，通过门控双向交叉注意力进行信息交换和表示的自适应融合。
AI.result: 在多城市真实数据实验中，AirFlow在36项指标比较中34项达到最佳性能，相比最先进基线RMSE最多降低11.11%；同时仅需0.0483M参数和0.0215G FLOPs，以极低计算开销实现高预测精度。
AI.conclusion: AirFlow验证了污染物感知的通道差异化建模在空气质量预测中的有效性，在不依赖图传播或预定义信号分解的情况下，通过轻量级设计实现了高精度与低计算开销的兼顾，为城市空气质量精细化管理提供了可行方案。

title: A Content-Aware Pure Permutation with Intrinsic Avalanche Effect: Breaking the Diffusion-Permutation Dichotomy
summary:
Pixel permutation is a fundamental tool in image processing, image encryption, and data hiding (including watermarking and steganography) that rearranges pixels without changing their values. A common assumption in the literature is that permutation alone cannot create differential sensitivity; changing one pixel merely relocates that pixel in the output, producing no avalanche effect. This paper challenges this by introducing the Triangular Content-Aware Permutation (TCA) algorithm.
  The method extracts edge points using Canny and applies Delaunay Triangulation to edges and corners, creating a unique partition. Since triangulation is highly sensitive to image geometry, changing a single pixel alters the edge map, resulting in a completely different triangulation and global permutation pattern. Unlike classical dimension-based permutations and advanced content-aware methods (2025-2026), which lack differential sensitivity, TCA increases NPCR from near-zero to 97.10% solely through pixel relocation.
  Experiments on 50 images show that TCA, with an average of 14.81 iterations, achieves NPCR = 97.10% and UACI = 20.06%, proving pure permutation can create significant differential sensitivity. Conventional methods maintain near-zero NPCR. The iteration threshold varies from 6.4 to 30.7 based on content complexity. Low PSNR (11.93 dB) and near-zero correlation (~10^-3) confirm superior statistical performance. Although slower than classical methods due to triangulation, this is a deliberate trade-off for stronger security. Given the non-analytic, content-dependent nature of the pattern, TCA is ideal for reference-based encryption, fragile watermarking, and non-blind steganography.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三角内容感知置换（TCA）算法，通过Canny边缘检测和Delaunay三角剖分实现像素置换，挑战了"纯置换无法产生差分敏感性"的传统假设，将NPCR从近零提升到97.10%。
AI.motivation: 现有文献普遍认为纯像素置换无法产生差分敏感性（雪崩效应），因为置换只是重新定位像素而不改变其值。这一局限限制了置换在加密等安全敏感场景中的应用，作者希望突破这一传统认知。
AI.method: TCA算法首先使用Canny算子提取边缘点，然后对边缘点和角点应用Delaunay三角剖分，创建独特的图像分区。由于三角剖分对图像几何高度敏感，改变单个像素会改变边缘图，从而产生完全不同的三角剖分和全局置换模式。
AI.result: 在50张图像上实验，TCA平均14.81次迭代实现NPCR=97.10%和UACI=20.06%，而传统方法保持近零NPCR。迭代阈值根据内容复杂度在6.4到30.7之间变化。低PSNR（11.93dB）和近零相关性（~10^-3）证实了优异的统计性能，但速度因三角剖分而较慢。
AI.conclusion: TCA证明了纯置换可以产生显著的差分敏感性，打破了传统认知。该算法适用于基于参考的加密、脆弱水印和非盲隐写，这是以速度为代价换取更强安全性的有意权衡。

title: RecoverFly: A Failure-Aware Reinforcement Learning Post-Training Framework for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle vision-language navigation (UAV-VLN) requires agents to translate visual observations and language instructions into reliable flight actions in complex environments. Although recent end-to-end UAV vision-language-action (UAV-VLA) policies reduce reliance on separately designed perception, planning, and control modules, their behavior-cloning objectives provide limited corrective supervision for interactive closed-loop execution. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising solution, while its effectiveness is constrained by inefficient use of samples, long-tailed scene distributions, and policy distribution shift during optimization. To this end, we propose RecoverFly, a failure-aware RL post-training framework for end-to-end UAV-VLA policies. Specifically, RecoverFly adapts token-level RL for stable optimization of grammar-constrained autoregressive UAV actions, revisits unresolved failure cases to strengthen corrective learning and sample utilization, and combines a two-stage long-tail scene curriculum with reference-policy regularization to improve scene adaptation while preserving acquired capabilities. Experiments on the TravelUAV benchmark demonstrate that RecoverFly achieves the best performance on the seen, unseen-map, and unseen-object splits. Moreover, compared to the AerialVLA initialization, RecoverFly improves success rate by 3.12 to 8.37 percentage points under a total rollout budget of about 30\% of the training-set size, validating its effectiveness, robustness, and generalization capabilities.

AI.tldr: RecoverFly是一个面向端到端无人机视觉-语言-动作（UAV-VLA）策略的故障感知强化学习后训练框架，通过token级RL、失败案例重访和两阶段长尾场景课程来解决行为克隆监督不足、样本效率低和分布偏移等问题，在TravelUAV基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的端到端UAV-VLA策略主要依赖行为克隆目标，缺乏交互式闭环执行所需的修正监督；虽然RL是潜在解决方案，但面临样本利用效率低、长尾场景分布和策略分布偏移等挑战。
AI.method: RecoverFly包含三个关键技术：1）针对语法约束自回归无人机动作采用token级RL实现稳定优化；2）重新访问未解决的失败案例以强化修正学习和样本利用率；3）结合两阶段长尾场景课程与参考策略正则化，提升场景适应能力同时保留已获取能力。
AI.result: 在TravelUAV基准的seen、unseen-map和unseen-object三个数据划分上均取得最佳性能；相比AerialVLA初始化，在总rollout预算仅为训练集规模约30%的条件下，成功率提升3.12至8.37个百分点。
AI.conclusion: RecoverFly有效验证了故障感知RL后训练框架在提升UAV-VLN任务中端到端策略的有效性、鲁棒性和泛化能力，展现出在复杂环境下的实用价值。

title: FaLCon: Facet-Anchored Retrieval with Late Consensus for Sim2Real Text-Based Person Anomaly Search
comment: accepted to the ECCV 2026 AI City Challenge Workshop
summary: Text-based person anomaly search requires retrieving real-world pedestrian images from detailed natural-language descriptions using models trained primarily on synthetic data. This Sim2Real setting is particularly challenging because visually similar candidates may differ only in subtle actions, object interactions, or appearance attributes, while applying multimodal large language models to the entire gallery is computationally expensive. We propose an anchor-constrained coarse-to-fine retrieval framework that combines global semantic matching with fine-grained verification. First, each query is represented by its original caption, a structured concatenation, and several semantic facets. Heterogeneous vision-language retrievers are then integrated through robust per-query score calibration and soft claim-aware fusion. Full and concatenated captions serve as anchors to preserve candidate recall, whereas appearance, action, and object facets provide bounded corrective evidence. The resulting candidate pool is further refined by a discriminative Qwen3 reranker and two complementary semantic verification modules based on anomaly-aware cloze completion and multi-agent evidence reasoning. Finally, an uncertainty-gated consensus module adaptively reweights the three experts on ambiguous queries. Experiments on the PAB benchmark show that the proposed soft claim-aware retrieval achieves 86.44% mAP@10, substantially outperforming individual retrieval backbones. The complete framework further improves performance to 95.41% mAP@10, 94.44% R@1, and 99.09% R@5. These results demonstrate that preserving strong global retrieval while restricting expensive semantic reasoning to a small candidate pool is effective for fine-grained Sim2Real person anomaly search. Our code will be available on Github.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个锚点约束的粗到精检索框架，用于文本驱动的行人异常检索（Sim2Real场景）。框架结合全局语义匹配与细粒度验证，通过多视角查询表示、软声明感知融合、Qwen3重排序器及不确定性门控共识模块，在PAB基准上达到95.41% mAP@10、94.44% R@1和99.09% R@5。
AI.motivation: 文本行人异常检索面临两大挑战：一是合成数据训练（Sim2Real）导致视觉上相似候选仅在细微动作、交互或外观属性上有差异；二是直接在完整图库上应用多模态大语言模型计算开销过高。现有方法难以在保证检索效率的同时实现细粒度区分。
AI.method: 提出锚点约束的粗到精两阶段框架：(1) 粗检索阶段，每个查询由原始描述、结构化拼接及多个语义侧面表示，通过鲁棒按查询分数校准和软声明感知融合整合异构视觉语言检索器，完整和拼接描述作为锚点保留候选召回率，外观/动作/物体侧面提供纠正证据；(2) 细粒度验证阶段，使用判别性Qwen3重排序器及两个互补语义验证模块（异常感知完形填空和多智能体证据推理）；(3) 不确定性门控共识模块在模糊查询上自适应重新加权三个专家。
AI.result: 在PAB基准上，软声明感知检索达到86.44% mAP@10，显著优于单一检索骨干；完整框架达到95.41% mAP@10、94.44% R@1和99.09% R@5。
AI.conclusion: 保留强全局检索能力同时将昂贵的语义推理限制在小候选池中是处理细粒度Sim2Real行人异常检索的有效策略，验证了粗到精框架在该任务上的优越性。

title: CEAA: A Cognitive Embodied Agents Architecture for Interactive Computing Systems
summary: The development of embodied Intelligent Virtual Agents (IVAs) that have cognitive capabilities in real-time interactive virtual environments remains a challenge, even with today's advancements in technology. Existing architectures are often focused on either the implementation of low-level reactive control systems that are constrained by commercial game engines, or high-level representations of reasoning models that can be difficult to implement in virtual worlds. This paper builds on that notion and proposes a modular cognitive architecture for deploying embodied IVAs. This architecture builds on existing, pre-established frameworks such as the Sense-Think-Act paradigm and the Belief-Desire-Intention cognitive model, among others, and aims to provide a reusable implementation-oriented framework as a template for deploying IVA "brains" in interactive 3D computing systems. The proposed architecture contributes by providing a modular, implementation-oriented framework for the deployment of embodied, cognitive-capable IVAs and bridges the gap between high-level agent reasoning models with real-time embodied execution, for scalable, adaptive, and explainable agents in complex interactive virtual environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种模块化认知架构，用于在实时交互式三维虚拟环境中部署具身智能虚拟代理（IVA）。该架构基于Sense-Think-Act范式和BDI认知模型等已有框架，桥接高层推理模型与低层反应式控制之间的鸿沟，提供可复用、面向实现的模板，以实现可扩展、自适应且可解释的智能代理。
AI.motivation: 现有IVA架构存在两方面局限：一是偏向低层反应式控制系统，受限于商业游戏引擎；二是偏向高层推理模型表示，难以在虚拟世界中实际实现。两者之间存在明显鸿沟，缺乏一个既能体现认知能力又可落地实现的中间层架构。
AI.method: 提出一个模块化的认知架构，基于既有框架（Sense-Think-Act范式、Belief-Desire-Intention认知模型等）构建，提供一个可复用、面向实现的框架模板，用于在交互式3D计算系统中部署IVA"大脑"。
AI.result: 该架构贡献在于提供了模块化、面向实现的框架，弥合了高层代理推理模型与实时具身执行之间的差距，支持在复杂交互式虚拟环境中部署可扩展、自适应且可解释的智能代理。
AI.conclusion: 该架构填补了高性能推理模型与实际虚拟环境执行之间的空白，为在实时交互式三维环境中部署具备认知能力的具身智能代理提供了可落地的实现路径。

title: Agreement-Based Audio-Visual Segmentation:Champion Report for the MeViS-Audio Track in the 8th LSVOS Challenge
summary: The MeViS-Audio track asks a system to segment the objects described by a spoken motion expression throughout a video and to return empty masks when the described target is absent. We present a simple staged solution. Qwen3-ASR first converts speech into text. Several video mask tracks are then produced with complementary grounding and segmentation models. Instead of trusting a single prediction, we select the track that has the highest average mask agreement with the other candidates. A small set of explicit direction, count, and plural rules corrects queries that require more than ordinary single-object tracking. Finally, a video-level classifier combines visual, audio-visual, and within-video query scores to decide whether any target is present. The submitted system obtains 0.5952 J &F, 0.7931 no-target accuracy, 0.9205 target accuracy, and a final score of 0.769589. The challenge organizers notified our team that this result ranked first in the track.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于MeViS-Audio赛道（视频中口语运动表达所指目标分割）的分阶段解决方案，通过多候选掩码轨迹选择、显式语言规则修正以及视频级分类器判断目标是否存在，最终获得该赛道第一名（0.769589分）。
AI.motivation: MeViS-Audio赛道要求系统分割视频中由口语运动表达描述的目标，并在目标缺失时返回空掩码，这是一个具有挑战性的多模态任务。
AI.method: 该方法采用分阶段策略：(1) 使用Qwen3-ASR将语音转为文本；(2) 用互补的grounding和分割模型生成多个视频掩码轨迹；(3) 通过平均掩码一致性选择最佳轨迹；(4) 应用显式的方向、计数和复数规则修正查询；(5) 用视频级分类器结合视觉、音视频及视频内查询分数判断目标是否存在。
AI.result: 该系统获得0.5952 J&F、0.7931无目标准确率、0.9205目标准确率和0.769589的最终分数，在该赛道排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 通过多模型互补、掩码一致性投票选择、显式语言规则和后处理分类的组合策略，可以有效提升复杂视频口语表达分割任务的性能。

title: Beyond Uniform Restoration: Empowering All-in-One Restoration with Pixel-Level Multimodal Guidance
comment: Accepted by ACMMM2026 as Oral Paper
summary: All-in-one image restoration is a unified low-level vision task that aims to effectively recover high-quality images from inputs degraded by various types and levels of corruption using a single model. Recent works have achieved remarkable progress by learning degradation-adaptive prompts or network architectures. However, these methods typically apply a uniform restoration strategy across the entire image, neglecting the fact that different regions may suffer from distinct degradation types and varying degrees of severity. In contrast, we propose to perform restoration at the pixel level, thereby enabling more fine-grained and precise control over the restoration process. Specifically, we present MGN-AIR, a novel pixel-level restoration framework for all-in-one image restoration. Our approach first learns to estimate a pixel-level visual prompt. Then, it leverages both textual and visual prompts to provide global and local degradation cues, guiding the model on where to look and how to restore at each pixel. We conduct extensive experiments on multiple all-in-one image restoration benchmarks, covering a wide range of tasks including denoising, deraining, deblurring, dehazing, desnowing, and low-light enhancement. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed method consistently and significantly outperforms existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MGN-AIR，一个像素级全合一图像复原框架，通过学习像素级视觉提示并结合文本和视觉提示提供全局与局部退化线索，实现更细粒度的复原控制，在多个基准上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有全合一图像复原方法通常对整个图像采用统一的复原策略，忽略了图像中不同区域可能遭受不同类型的退化以及不同程度的严重性，缺乏像素级别的细粒度控制。
AI.method: 提出MGN-AIR像素级复原框架，首先学习估计像素级视觉提示，然后结合文本提示和视觉提示分别提供全局和局部退化线索，指导模型在每个像素位置进行针对性的复原。
AI.result: 在多个全合一图像复原基准上进行广泛实验，覆盖去噪、去雨、去模糊、去雾、去雪和低光照增强等任务，实验结果表明方法一致且显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 像素级复原策略能够实现更细粒度、更精确的复原控制，从而在多种退化类型和任务上取得更好的复原效果。

title: GeoRoute: Geometry-Aware Hybrid Inference for Traffic Future-Frame Prediction
comment: accepted to the ECCV 2026 AI City Challenge Workshop
summary: Long-horizon future-frame prediction is important for autonomous driving, traffic surveillance, and intelligent transportation systems, yet remains challenging due to temporal ghosting, geometry drift, and inconsistent object motion. Recent latent video diffusion models have achieved impressive visual quality, but directly applying them to structured traffic scenes often leads to unstable geometry and degraded temporal coherence over extended horizons. We present a training-free inference framework that stabilizes reliable static structure in pretrained video predictions through multi-frame temporal context and view-conditioned routing. For front-camera videos, our method refines generated futures with a multi-frame depth-layered renderer that projects static geometry from observed history frames while preserving dynamic regions from the generative base model. For heterogeneous traffic views, a frozen vision-language model infers a coarse camera group from the observed clip and selects a specialized motion-based predictor. The framework requires neither retraining nor fine-tuning of the underlying video model and can be applied directly to pretrained generators. We validate the proposed framework on the AI City Challenge Track 5 benchmark, where our final system achieves competitive performance among the top-ranked teams. These results demonstrate that geometry-aware inference-time refinement and view-conditioned hybrid inference can improve static-geometry stability and low-level structural fidelity without changing the original model architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个无需训练的推理框架，通过多帧时间上下文和视角条件路由来稳定预训练视频扩散模型在长时域交通场景预测中的静态几何结构，在AI City Challenge Track 5上取得有竞争力的成绩。
AI.motivation: 长时域未来帧预测对自动驾驶、交通监控等系统至关重要，但现有潜视频扩散模型直接应用于结构化交通场景时，会出现时间重影、几何漂移和物体运动不一致等问题，导致几何不稳定和时间连贯性退化。
AI.method: 提出一个无需训练/微调的推理框架，包含两部分：(1) 前摄像头视频通过多帧深度分层渲染器，从历史观测帧投影静态几何结构，同时保留生成基础模型的动态区域；(2) 异构交通视角通过冻结的视觉-语言模型推断粗粒度相机组类，并选择专门的基于运动的预测器。
AI.result: 在AI City Challenge Track 5基准上验证，最终系统在顶级团队中取得有竞争力的性能，证明了几何感知的推理时精修和视角条件混合推理无需改变模型架构即可提升静态几何稳定性和低层结构保真度。
AI.conclusion: 几何感知的推理时精修和视角条件混合推理能够在不改变原始模型架构的前提下，有效提升预训练视频生成模型在交通场景中的静态几何稳定性和结构保真度，为长时域预测提供了一种实用且高效的解决方案。

title: ArchAgent v2: A Case Study with the Data Prefetching Championship
summary:
Agentic artificial intelligence has shown great promise in automating algorithm design, but scaling similar techniques to computer microarchitecture discovery remains challenging due to vast search spaces, strict hardware budgets, and long simulation times. In this work, we present ArchAgent v2, a framework which scales automated microarchitecture search to multi-level data prefetching. While the original ArchAgent successfully discovered single-level cache replacement policies in competition settings, it does not scale to multi-level prefetching where the design space and degrees of freedom are larger. To overcome this, we introduce two new additions to ArchAgent: a cascaded evolutionary search that subdivides the design space by sequentially evolving and freezing prefetchers at individual cache levels, and a hardware-realizability feedback loop that embeds real-time size-estimation directly into the evolution process.
  Evaluated under identical rules of the 4th Data Prefetching Championship (DPC4), ArchAgent v2 automatically designs a three-level prefetcher that outperforms the winning hand-designed solution, further demonstrating automated agentic discovery as a useful tool for computer architects. Our discovered policy achieves a 3.8\% geometric mean IPC speedup over the baseline overall and a 0.3\% improvement over the prior champion, BertiGO. On low-bandwidth single-core configurations, our policy yields a 4.6\% performance speedup compared to only 2.6\% for BertiGO. However, multi-core evolution still remains a significant challenge due to simulation latency impeding evolution speed. Finally, our profiling of an ArchAgent evolution of over 12,000 candidate designs provides key insights into how automated evolutionary agents explore and synthesize complex microarchitectural logic.

AI.tldr: ArchAgent v2 是一个将自动化智能体搜索扩展到多级数据预取器设计的框架，通过级联进化搜索和硬件可实现性反馈循环，在DPC4竞赛规则下自动设计出超越人类冠军方案BertiGO的三级预取器，实现了3.8%的几何平均IPC加速。
AI.motivation: 智能体人工智能在自动化算法设计方面已展现出巨大潜力，但将其扩展到计算机微架构发现仍面临巨大挑战，因为搜索空间庞大、硬件预算严格且仿真时间长。原始的ArchAgent仅能发现单级缓存替换策略，无法扩展到多级预取设计，因为该设计空间和自由度更大。
AI.method: ArchAgent v2引入了两个关键新机制：(1) 级联进化搜索——通过按顺序进化和冻结各缓存级别的预取器，将设计空间细分；(2) 硬件可实现性反馈循环——将实时尺寸估计直接嵌入进化过程。评估遵循DPC4的完全相同规则。
AI.result: 自动设计的三级预取器在几何平均IPC上比基线提升3.8%，比之前的冠军BertiGO提升0.3%；在低带宽单核配置下实现4.6%的性能加速（BertiGO仅为2.6%）。多核进化仍因仿真延迟限制进化速度而存在挑战。
AI.conclusion: ArchAgent v2证明了自动化智能体发现可以作为计算机架构师的有用工具，超越了人类手工设计的最优方案。对超过12,000个候选设计的剖析为理解自动化进化智能体如何探索和综合复杂微架构逻辑提供了关键洞见。

title: SwissCrop25: A National Multi-Year Benchmark for Operational Crop Mapping
comment: Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop TerraBytes II. To appear in the workshop proceedings
summary: Operational crop mapping requires models that generalise across years, resolve fine-grained crop taxonomies, and distinguish cropland from surrounding landscapes. However, existing crop mapping datasets enable evaluation of these requirements only in isolation. We therefore introduce SwissCrop25, a national-scale crop mapping benchmark dataset spanning seven growing seasons (2019-2025). SwissCrop25 combines Sentinel-2 time series, daily temperature observations, a fine-grained 73 crop taxonomy including grassland management types, and 5 explicit non-crop land cover classes. To evaluate realistic deployment conditions, we define a leave-one-year-out protocol with joint cropland delineation and crop classification for benchmarking representative crop mapping architectures. Evaluating U-TAE (convolutional temporal-attention model), TSViT (transformer-based spatio-temporal model), and Galileo (EO foundation model) reveals differences between architectures hidden by conventional benchmarks. In this setting, domain-specific models outperform Galileo, with TSViT achieving the best overall performance and a 12 pp macro-mIoU advantage over U-TAE. SwissCrop25 also exposes substantial interannual distribution shifts and shows that incorporating temperature-derived phenological information improves robustness. Finally, in-season evaluation reveals a trade-off between models, with U-TAE performing better early in the season and TSViT gaining an advantage later through improved rare-class discrimination. SwissCrop25 provides a challenging testbed for evaluating crop mapping systems under realistic operational conditions and is publicly released at https://huggingface.co/datasets/EOA-team/SwissCrop25 .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SwissCrop25，一个覆盖瑞士全国、跨越2019-2025七个生长季的作物制图基准数据集，包含73种精细作物类别和5种非作物土地覆盖类别。通过留一年验证协议、联合农田划定与作物分类评估，发现领域专用模型（TSViT最优）超越基础模型Galileo，并揭示了跨年分布偏移、温度物候信息提升鲁棒性以及季内评估中不同模型的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有作物制图数据集只能孤立地评估泛化性、精细分类和农田-非农田区分这三个关键需求，无法在统一框架下检验模型在真实操作条件下的综合表现，因此需要一个能同时覆盖这些要求的国家级基准数据集。
AI.method: 构建SwissCrop25国家级基准数据集（Sentinel-2时间序列+每日温度观测，73类作物+5类非作物），设计留一年验证（leave-one-year-out）协议，联合评估农田划定与作物分类，对U-TAE、TSViT、Galileo三种代表性架构进行基准测试，并引入温度衍生物候信息与季内时序评估。
AI.result: TSViT取得最佳整体性能，比U-TAE高出12个百分点macro-mIoU优势；领域专用模型优于基础模型Galileo；数据集暴露了显著的跨年分布偏移；温度物候信息提升模型鲁棒性；季内评估显示U-TAE早期表现更好，TSViT后期通过稀有类别判别获得优势。
AI.conclusion: SwissCrop25为作物制图系统提供了在真实操作条件下评估的挑战性测试平台，揭示了不同架构在跨年泛化、精细分类和季内部署中的能力差异，为未来作物制图研究提供了公开基准。

title: SHE: Trajectory-driven Safety Harness Evolution for LLM Agents
summary: The safety of large language model (LLM) agents depends not only on model weights but also on the agent harness that manages context, memory, tools, permissions, and runtime control. Existing safety mechanisms often treat the harness as a fixed deployment artifact, limiting their ability to evolve with emerging risks. Moreover, coupled functions across harness components obscure safety responsibility attribution, making localized evolution difficult. We propose Safety Harness Evolution (SHE), a framework that learns evolving safe boundaries from rollout trajectories. SHE decomposes the harness into four artifacts with explicit safety responsibilities, including the System Prompt, Rule Bank, Safety Memory, and Tool Policy, defining clear functional boundaries for localized evolution. Based on this decomposition, SHE introduces an attribution-guided evolution loop that converts trajectory failures into structured diagnoses, learns artifact-specific boundary refinements, and selects evolved harnesses through safety-utility validation. Experiments on Agent-SafetyBench demonstrate that SHE effectively enhances safety through harness evolution, achieving a 3.1x ASR reduction compared with static SafeHarness, while also improving benign utility. The evolved harness further generalizes to unseen risks on the held-out AgentHarm benchmark and transfers across agent models without additional evolution.

AI.tldr: 提出Safety Harness Evolution (SHE)框架，通过将LLM Agent的harness分解为系统提示、规则库、安全记忆和工具策略四个具有明确安全职责的组件，并引入归因引导的演化循环，从rollout轨迹中学习演化的安全边界，显著降低攻击成功率(ASR降低3.1倍)，同时提升良性任务效用并具有良好的泛化性和跨模型迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM Agent安全机制将harness视为固定部署产物，难以随着新兴风险演化；且harness各组件功能耦合，导致安全责任难以归因，局部演化困难。需要一种能够从轨迹中学习并不断演化安全边界的框架。
AI.method: 1) 将harness分解为四个具有明确安全责任的组件：System Prompt、Rule Bank、Safety Memory和Tool Policy；2) 提出归因引导的演化循环，将轨迹失败转化为结构化诊断，学习组件特定的边界优化；3) 通过安全-效用验证选择演化的harness。
AI.result: 在Agent-SafetyBench上，SHE相比静态SafeHarness实现了3.1倍的ASR降低，同时提升良性效用；演化后的harness能泛化到AgentHarm基准上的未见风险，并能跨Agent模型迁移而无需额外演化。
AI.conclusion: SHE证明了通过harness演化而非固定部署，可以有效且可持续地提升LLM Agent的安全性，且演化结果具有良好的泛化性和可迁移性。

title: XFeat Revisited: Reproducibility and Evaluation of a Lightweight Image Matcher
comment: 21 pages, 6 figures. Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR); Reproducibility Certification
summary: We present a reproducibility study of XFeat, a lightweight local feature extractor and matcher designed to identify corresponding points across images efficiently on resource-constrained hardware. We re-implement the architecture based on the paper and supplementary material, re-evaluate the authors' released checkpoint alongside our re-implementation, and conduct additional architectural ablations to examine design choices that were not fully justified in the original work. This distinction between re-evaluation and reproduction is important, as the paper, supplement, and public code differ in several implementation details, including the backbone layout, fusion block, and training losses. Empirically, our reproduced models closely match and, in some cases, outperform the re-evaluated original checkpoint on MegaDepth-1500 and ScanNet-1500, supporting the main claim that XFeat provides a strong accuracy-efficiency trade-off for standard image-matching benchmarks. Our ablations provide a more nuanced view of two architectural arguments from the original paper. In particular, the parallel keypoint branch is important for semi-dense matching, but its benefit is less pronounced than originally claimed, while the evidence for the specific placement of the single skip-connection remains inconclusive. Finally, we reproduce the original downstream evaluations and find close agreement for homography estimation, while Aachen visual localization remains below the reported results, even for the released checkpoint, suggesting sensitivity to underspecified evaluation details. We then extend the analysis to zero-shot out-of-distribution and cross-modal matching across retinal, thermal-visible, and multimodal remote-sensing imagery, where XFeat remains effective in some settings but degrades sharply under severe modality shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文是对XFeat轻量级局部特征提取与匹配器的可复现性研究，重新实现了其架构并进行了消融实验，验证了其在标准基准上的准确性-效率权衡，同时揭示了原论文中若干未充分论证的设计选择与实际效果之间的差异。
AI.motivation: XFeat原论文、补充材料和公开代码存在多处实现细节差异（包括骨干网络布局、融合块和训练损失），且原论文中部分架构设计选择缺乏充分论证。作者希望通过系统的复现和消融研究，验证XFeat的核心主张并厘清各种设计决策的实际贡献。
AI.method: 作者重新实现了XFeat架构（基于论文和补充材料），对作者发布的官方检查点与自己的重实现进行重新评估对比，并进行了额外的架构消融实验，包括平行关键点分支和跳跃连接位置的验证。此外还扩展到零样本分布外和跨模态匹配场景的测试。
AI.result: 重实现模型在MegaDepth-1500和ScanNet-1500上与官方检查点匹配甚至超越；平行关键点分支对半稠密匹配重要但收益不如原论文声称的显著，跳跃连接位置证据不充分；单应性估计结果一致但Aachen视觉定位低于报告值；跨模态场景下XFeat在部分设置有效但在严重模态偏移下性能急剧下降。
AI.conclusion: XFeat在标准图像匹配基准上确实提供了良好的准确性-效率权衡（核心主张得到支持），但原论文中部分架构论证需要更谨慎的解读，且XFeat在剧烈模态偏移场景下的泛化能力存在明显局限。

title: DSLE: A Learning Environment for Dark Souls Boss Encounters
comment: AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Interactive Digital Entertainment, 2026
summary: We introduce the Dark Souls Learning Environment (DSLE), a containerized platform that presents all 22 boss encounters of Dark Souls: Remastered as game-playing agent benchmarks through a Gymnasium-style interface. DSLE combines real-time combat, high-dimensional visual input, and sparse terminal rewards, with each environment step being a real action executed against the running game. To support controlled comparison, we define DSLE-5, a representative five-boss subset, spanning a melee fight, a spatially constrained arena, an environmental-hazard fight, a multi-target fight, and a fast final-boss fight, that we recommend as the starting suite for agents built on DSLE. On DSLE-5 we evaluate a random policy, an expert system, an evolutionary baseline, and PPO and DQN agents trained from visual input. The expert system and the evolutionary baseline each defeat the Asylum Demon, the game's tutorial boss (63% and 43% peak win rates), but none of the five methods defeats the other four DSLE-5 bosses; PPO and DQN show no measurable learning (at most 0.33% win rate on the tutorial boss, 0% elsewhere) within a budget that already costs tens of wall-clock hours per run. A broader study running the evolutionary baseline across all 22 encounters under advantaged all level-50 stats yields wins on only a handful of additional early-game bosses and leaves the rest unwon. The failure cases range from sub-10-second deaths in cramped, multi-target encounters to minute-long stalemates that inflict almost no damage, and we report them through survival time and damage dealt rather than win rate alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Dark Souls Learning Environment (DSLE)，一个将《黑暗之魂：重制版》全部22个Boss战作为游戏智能体基准测试的容器化平台，并定义DSLE-5作为代表性五Boss子集。实验显示专家系统和进化基线的仅能击败教程Boss（最高63%和43%胜率），其他方法均无法击败其余Boss，PPO和DQN几乎无学习效果。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏AI基准（如Atari、StarCraft II）多偏向2D或即时战略，缺乏对实时动作、高维视觉输入与稀疏奖励相结合的3D动作游戏挑战。作者希望提供一个更贴近真实游戏复杂度的基准平台，以推动智能体在困难环境下学习能力的进步。
AI.method: 构建容器化的Dark Souls游戏环境，通过Gymnasium风格接口实现游戏交互；定义DSLE-5子集涵盖五种不同战斗类型；评估随机策略、专家系统、进化基线与从视觉输入训练的PPO和DQN智能体，并使用生存时间与伤害量补充胜率单一指标的不足。
AI.result: 专家系统和进化基线分别以63%和43%的峰值胜率击败教程Boss Asylum Demon，但五种方法均无法击败其余四个DSLE-5 Boss；PPO和DQN在教程Boss上最高仅0.33%胜率，其他Boss上为0%；在22个Boss全量实验中，进化基线仅在少数早期Boss上获胜。
AI.conclusion: DSLE揭示了现有强化学习方法在面对实时3D动作游戏时的严重局限性，证明该平台能有效区分方法能力差异。该基准可作为未来游戏AI研究的重要挑战性测试床。

title: A Height-Constrained 2-Point Minimal Solver for Pose Estimation from Active LED Markers with Event Cameras
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, accepted by IEEE/RSJ International Conference on INTELLIGENT ROBOTS & SYSTEMS (IROS) 2026
summary: In many autonomous applications requiring real-time localization, active marker-based systems are preferred due to their low latency and ease of deployment compared to computationally demanding feature-based methods. Event~\mbox{cameras} offer high temporal resolution and minimal delay and are commonly used with active LED markers for robust real-time localization. Existing methods typically rely on Perspective-n-Point (PnP) solvers for pose estimation. However, structured marker layouts can be challenging to deploy in space-constrained scenarios, while partial self-motion information (e.g., gravity direction and altitude) is readily available from onboard sensors. We derive a robust and accurate minimal solver that estimates camera pose from only two LED markers by incorporating known tilt angle and camera height measured by an onboard sensor, such as an IMU or an altimeter. The proposed formulation uniquely determines the camera pose through both a closed-form and a linear least-squares solution. We further analyze degenerate configurations and characterize the conditions under which height information does not contribute to rotation estimation. For evaluation, we developed an event-based active marker system to collect real-world data with ground truth from a motion capture system. Experiments on both synthetic and real data demonstrate improved accuracy over the state-of-the-art P2P solver and competitive performance relative to P3P.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种仅使用两个LED标记点，并结合机载传感器（IMU/高度计）提供的倾斜角和高度信息来估计相机位姿的最小解算器，通过闭式解和线性最小二乘解唯一确定相机位姿，在合成数据和真实事件相机数据上均优于现有P2P方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于事件相机和主动LED标记的定位方法通常依赖PnP解算器（如P3P），需要至少三个标记点；而结构化标记布局在空间受限场景中难以部署。同时，机载传感器（IMU、高度计）能提供部分自运动信息（如重力方向和高度），这些先验信息未被充分利用。因此作者希望仅用两个LED标记并结合机载传感器先验信息来完成位姿估计。
AI.method: 作者推导了一种最小解算器，通过已知倾斜角（来自IMU）和相机高度（来自高度计）约束，从仅两个LED标记点估计相机位姿。该公式通过闭式解和线性最小二乘解两种方式唯一确定相机姿态。此外，作者分析了退化配置，并刻画了高度信息对旋转估计无贡献的条件。
AI.result: 在合成数据和真实数据（使用事件相机主动标记系统，以运动捕捉系统作为真值）上，该方法相比最先进的P2P解算器精度更高，与P3P性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明利用机载传感器提供的先验信息（倾斜角和高度）可以用更少的标记点（仅两个）实现高精度实时位姿估计，在空间受限场景中具有实用价值，为事件相机主动标记定位提供了新的高效解决方案。

title: GENCO - A Unified Neural Solver Embedded in a Development Framework for Steady-State Grid Analysis
summary:
Foundation models are transforming business workflows and boosting productivity, yet they remain largely absent from engineering domains such as power system analysis, where strict physical consistency must be enforced.
  We present GENCO (GEometric Neural Corrective Optimizer), a unified neural solver for steady-state transmission grid analysis that handles power flow (PF), optimal power flow (OPF), and state estimation (SE) within a single architecture and shared network representation. To support advances in neural power system solvers, we introduce the open-source GridFM Development Framework, which standardizes synthetic data generation and training in a low-code environment. We also release large-scale datasets with millions of PF and OPF scenarios across diverse grid topologies to support reproducible benchmarking.
  We evaluate GENCO on the PFDelta and OPFData benchmarks against state-of-the-art neural solvers and classical solvers, including Newton-Raphson and IPOPT, as well as on real-world Hydro-Québec SCADA data. For large-scale PF, GENCO recovers the full AC operating state, including voltage magnitudes and reactive power that DC-PF cannot provide, while matching DC-PF-level active power-balance residuals. It achieves up to 30x speedups over Newton-Raphson at only 2x the runtime of DC-PF. For OPF, it achieves up to 85x speedups over IPOPT while improving feasibility, optimality, and runtime over DC-OPF. For SE, GENCO is more robust than classical weighted least squares to noisy measurements and network parameter errors, and always returns a high-quality estimate even when weighted least squares fails to converge.
  Together, the unified architecture and development framework provide a new approach to large-scale steady-state grid analysis, lowering the barrier to entry for power system engineers and marking a step toward Grid Foundation Models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GENCO，一个统一的神经求解器，可在一个架构中处理电力系统的潮流分析（PF）、最优潮流（OPF）和状态估计（SE）三个任务。同时发布GridFM开发框架和大规模数据集以支持可复现的基准测试。GENCO在IEEE基准和真实Hydro-Québec SCADA数据上，相比经典求解器（Newton-Raphson、IPOPT）实现高达30-85倍加速，同时保证物理一致性和可行性。
AI.motivation: 基础模型已广泛应用于各领域，但在电力系统分析等工程领域仍然缺失，主要挑战在于这些领域必须严格满足物理一致性约束。现有神经求解器通常针对单一任务设计，缺乏统一架构，且缺少标准化数据生成与训练框架，限制了该方向的发展。
AI.method: GENCO采用统一的几何神经校正优化器架构，通过共享网络表示同时处理PF、OPF和SE三个任务。此外，论文引入开源GridFM开发框架（低代码环境，标准化合成数据生成和训练），并发布覆盖多种电网拓扑的大规模数据集用于可复现基准测试。
AI.result: 在大规模PF任务中，GENCO可恢复完整AC运行状态（含DC-PF无法提供的电压幅值和无功功率），有功平衡残差与DC-PF相当；相比Newton-Raphson提速30倍，仅比DC-PF慢2倍。在OPF任务中，相比IPOPT提速85倍，同时改善可行性、最优性和运行时间。在SE任务中，对噪声测量和网络参数误差比加权最小二乘法更鲁棒，即使WLS不收敛时也能给出高质量估计。
AI.conclusion: GENCO的统一架构和GridFM开发框架为大规模稳态电网分析提供了新路径，降低了电力系统工程师的使用门槛，是迈向电网基础模型（Grid Foundation Models）的重要一步。

authors: Jose M. D. S. Rodrigues Neto
title: TriView-YOLO: Early Multi-View Fusion for Ground Penetrating Radar Cavity Detection in Soft, High-Water-Content Soils
summary: Automated detection of subsurface cavities from Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) is most difficult in soft, high-water-content ground, where conductive, water-saturated soil attenuates the signal and degrades cavity reflections, yet this is also the condition under which cavities most readily form. This paper proposes TriView-YOLO, a multi-view YOLOv12 detector for road cavity screening in such ground. Three co-registered views (longitudinal B-scan, horizontal C-scan, and cross-section B-scan) form a 9-channel input fused by a TripleInputConv layer that replaces the YOLOv12 stem; the rest of the network is unchanged, and bounding boxes are required on the longitudinal view only. Training used 1,600 expert-verified field samples, principally metropolitan road surveys of Bangkok, Thailand, acquired with a vehicle-mounted multichannel three-dimensional GPR mobile mapping system, with surveys over the firmer subgrades of Japan added to training and validation only. The test set comes exclusively from the Bangkok surveys, over soft marine clay with 80-140% water content and a water table at 1-2 m depth, a ground condition for which no dedicated deep learning cavity-detection evaluation has been reported. On this unaugmented, field-only test set, split randomly within surveys, the proposed model attains mAP50 of 0.558 +/- 0.028 over three seeds at 23.6 GFLOPs and 3.1 ms per image. Ablations show that removing the auxiliary views lowers mAP50 and recall, whereas public and synthetic training images, DINOv3 features, larger model scale, and COCO pretraining bring no gain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TriView-YOLO，一种多视角YOLOv12检测器，用于在软质高含水率地面中自动检测地下空洞。通过将纵向B-scan、水平C-scan和横截面B-scan三个共配准视图融合为9通道输入，在曼谷软海相黏土（含水率80-140%）条件下达到mAP50 0.558±0.028，为这一极具挑战性的地面条件提供了首个专用深度学习评估。
AI.motivation: 在软质高含水率地面中，GPR信号被导电的饱水土壤衰减，空洞反射退化，检测极为困难；然而这种条件恰恰是空洞最易形成的环境。此前缺乏针对此类地面条件的专用深度学习空洞检测评估。
AI.method: TriView-YOLO采用三视角方法：将纵向B-scan、水平C-scan和横截面B-scan三个共配准视图组成9通道输入，通过TripleInputConv层替换YOLOv12的stem，网络其余部分保持不变，仅需在纵向视图上标注边界框。训练使用1,600个专家验证的现场样本，主要来自曼谷道路调查。
AI.result: 在仅现场、未增强的测试集上（随机按调查拆分），模型在23.6 GFLOPs和每图3.1 ms下达到mAP50 0.558±0.028（三个种子）。消融实验表明，移除辅助视图会降低mAP50和召回率，而公开/合成训练图像、DINOv3特征、更大模型规模及COCO预训练均无增益。
AI.conclusion: 多视角融合对软质高含水率地面中的空洞检测有效，且该场景下的性能增益需依靠真实的现场数据而非合成数据或大规模预训练，提示该领域需要更多此类困难条件下的实测数据与方法优化。

title: Towards Expressive and Faithful Audio-to-Image Generation: A Unified Multimodal Dataset and Synthesis Framework
summary: As an important subfield of cross-modal generation, synthesizing static visual content in the form of images from audio, namely audio-to-image (A2I) generation, has attracted increasing research attention in recent years. Nevertheless, despite the remarkable visual quality of modern text-to-image (T2I) models, the performance of A2I remains fundamentally limited by traditional datasets, which often lack both high-fidelity images and precise cross-modal alignment. As a result, existing methods still struggle to achieve high-quality audio-to-image generation through finetuning strong T2I models, thereby constraining practical applications in this area. Motivated by this gap, we introduce A2I-Set, a unified, high-quality tri-modal dataset consisting of 323K paired audio, images, and detailed text captions, specifically designed for audio-visual research, including audio-conditioned image generation. Besides, we developed a new mixed-source test set for the A2I task through human supervision. We further propose an A2I model, AudioCanvas, fine-tuned on our A2I-Set. Experiments show that AudioCanvas achieves more visually expressive as well as cross-modal alignment results that generally outperforming existing approaches. Our dataset and source code are available at https://github.com/gdx012/A2I-Generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了A2I-Set，一个包含323K对音频、图像和详细文本描述的高质量三模态数据集，并基于此数据集微调T2I模型得到AudioCanvas，用于音频到图像（A2I）生成任务，实验表明其视觉表现和跨模态对齐效果优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 音频到图像（A2I）生成是跨模态生成的重要子领域，但现有数据集缺乏高保真图像和精确的跨模态对齐，导致通过微调强T2I模型仍难以实现高质量的A2I生成，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 1) 构建A2I-Set：包含323K对音频、图像和详细文本描述的三模态统一高质量数据集；2) 通过人工监督构建混合来源测试集；3) 提出AudioCanvas模型，在A2I-Set上微调强T2I模型以进行音频条件图像生成。
AI.result: 实验表明AudioCanvas在视觉表现力和跨模态对齐方面均优于现有方法，生成了更具视觉表现力且对齐度更高的A2I结果。
AI.conclusion: 高质量三模态数据集A2I-Set和基于其微调的AudioCanvas模型有效解决了A2I生成中数据和对齐的瓶颈，推动了该领域的发展，数据集和代码已开源。

title: DocPure: Prompt-Free Unified Document Restoration via Degradation-Aware Structure-Guided Wavelet Modulation
comment: 19 pages, 15 figures. Lingming Su and Wanglong Lu contributed equally to this work
summary:
High-quality document images are pivotal for information archiving and downstream automatic processing. However, they are frequently compromised by diverse degradations during uncontrolled acquisition and transmission. While unified document restoration techniques have been proposed to restore images from multiple degradations, they often struggle with training multiple degradation-specific models, reliance on manual task-specific prompts, or cross-task data pairing. To address these limitations, we propose DocPure, a prompt-free unified framework that achieves degradation-aware document restoration.
  We design a degradation-aware structure auto-encoder with degradation-informed routing regularization to predict clean structural priors from degraded inputs. The model is prompt-free at inference, and degradation labels are only used as auxiliary supervision for the routing regularization during training.
  Furthermore, we introduce a structure-guided wavelet interaction mechanism to bridge frequency-domain features and spatial semantics. Within the structure-guided wavelet interaction mechanism, a cross-frequency adaptive modulation utilizes low-frequency sub-bands to modulate high-frequency recovery, ensuring structural consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DocPure achieves strong performance compared with state-of-the-art methods across various tasks, including deblurring, denoising, compression artifact reduction, and deshadowing.

AI.tldr: DocPure是一个无需提示的统一文档图像恢复框架，通过退化感知结构自编码器和结构引导小波交互机制，在推理时无需任务特定提示即可同时处理去模糊、去噪、压缩伪影消除和去阴影等多种退化任务，并在多个任务上取得优于现有方法的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的文档图像恢复方法存在三大局限：一是需要为不同退化类型训练多个特定模型，效率低下；二是依赖人工设计的任务特定提示，使用不便；三是跨任务数据配对困难。作者希望提出一个无需人工提示、无需跨任务配对数据的统一恢复框架。
AI.method: DocPure包含两个核心组件：(1)退化感知结构自编码器，引入退化信息路由正则化，在训练时仅用退化标签作为辅助监督来学习从退化输入预测干净结构先验，推理时不需要退化标签；(2)结构引导小波交互机制，通过跨频自适应调制利用低频子带调制高频恢复，将频域特征与空间语义相融合，确保结构一致性。
AI.result: 在去模糊、去噪、压缩伪影消除和去阴影等多个文档恢复任务上，DocPure均取得了优于现有最先进方法的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: DocPure通过退化感知的路由正则化和结构引导的小波交互机制，实现了无需提示的统一文档图像恢复框架，在多个退化任务上展现出较强的泛化能力和恢复性能。

title: Towards Collaborative Joint Perception and Prediction: Framework, Baseline Evaluation, and Deployment Perspectives
comment: 28 pages, 4 figures, post-publication of conference paper, accepted at journal SN Computer Science
summary: Connected Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs) increasingly exploit Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication to exchange multi-source sensor information, enabling advanced Collaborative Perception (CP) capabilities. Extending beyond these capabilities, this work focuses on Collaborative Joint Perception and Prediction (Co-P&P), a paradigm that unifies CP with motion prediction to mitigate two persistent challenges: the accumulation of perception errors and visual occlusions. We present a conceptual framework for Collaborative Joint Perception and Prediction (Co-P&P) that improves motion prediction of surrounding road users, thereby enhancing situational awareness in complex and dynamic traffic environments. Building upon our preliminary study, this extended version compares the performance of different fusion strategies and establishes baseline performance for a modular design of perception and prediction. Experimental results show that prediction-level fusion leads to a decline in overall system performance compared to detection-level or tracking-level fusion. We further implement a minimal end-to-end Co-P&P prototype that couples collaborative point-cloud sharing via the RENO neural codec with joint detection-forecasting via FutureDet, showing that collaboration improves forecasting accuracy while neural compression preserves this benefit at roughly 34x lower communication bandwidth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并研究了协同联合感知与预测（Co-P&P）范式，该范式将协同感知与运动预测统一起来，以缓解感知误差累积和视觉遮挡问题。研究比较了不同融合策略（预测级、检测级、跟踪级），并在点云协同共享与联合检测-预测的端到端原型上验证了协同预测的优势。
AI.motivation: 传统的协同感知（CP）虽然通过V2X通信交换多源传感器信息提升了感知能力，但仍面临感知误差累积和视觉遮挡两大挑战，且缺乏将协同感知与运动预测统一考虑的研究。
AI.method: 提出Co-P&P概念框架，比较预测级、检测级和跟踪级三种融合策略的性能；实现最小端到端原型，将RENO神经编解码器的协同点云共享与FutureDet的联合检测-预测相结合。
AI.result: 预测级融合相比检测级或跟踪级融合会导致整体系统性能下降；端到端原型表明协同能提升预测精度，且神经压缩可在约34倍更低通信带宽下保持这一优势。
AI.conclusion: 协同联合感知与预测是提升复杂动态交通环境下态势感知的有效范式，选择合适的融合层级至关重要，且神经压缩技术可以在大幅降低带宽的同时保留协同预测的性能优势。

title: PressureMesh: 3D Human Mesh Estimation from Multi-Device Pressure Images
summary: Human pose monitoring is crucial in fields such as rehabilitation assessment and human-computer interaction. Due to its privacy-preserving nature, pressure-based human pose monitoring has become a primary approach for unobtrusive sensing. However, existing methods are generally limited to a single device, which restricts the effective monitoring range. To address this limitation, we propose MDP-Net, an end-to-end network capable of directly estimating human meshes from temporal pressure data across multiple devices. We introduce a multimodal fusion mechanism inspired by the Mixture of Experts (MoE) framework to achieve effective complementarity and enhancement of cross-device pressure information. To support the training and evaluation of MDP-Net, we constructed MDP, a high-quality multi-device temporal pressure dataset that includes various pose labels such as 2D/3D joints and human meshes. Experimental results demonstrate that MDP-Net achieves a joint position error of 12.6 cm on the MDP dataset. These results prove that fusing multi-device pressure information is an effective and promising new solution for daily human pose monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MDP-Net，一种端到端网络，能够从多设备时序压力数据直接估计人体网格，并构建了高质量多设备时序压力数据集MDP。实验表明在MDP数据集上关节位置误差为12.6厘米，证明融合多设备压力信息进行日常人体姿态监测是有效且有前景的新方案。
AI.motivation: 现有人体姿态监测方法大多局限于单一压力设备，导致有效监测范围受限。由于基于压力的监测具有隐私保护的天然优势，作者希望突破单一设备的限制，利用多设备压力数据融合来扩大监测范围并提升监测效果。
AI.method: 提出MDP-Net端到端网络，从多设备时序压力数据直接估计人体网格；引入基于混合专家（MoE）框架的多模态融合机制，实现跨设备压力信息的有效互补与增强；同时构建了包含2D/3D关节和人体网格等多种姿态标签的高质量多设备时序压力数据集MDP。
AI.result: MDP-Net在MDP数据集上实现了12.6厘米的关节位置误差，验证了多设备压力信息融合的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 融合多设备压力信息是日常人体姿态监测的一种有效且有前景的新解决方案，能够克服单一设备监测范围受限的问题。

title: From Semantic Grounding to Decision Optimization: A Unified Framework for Long-Horizon UAV Vision-Language Navigation
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26)
summary: UAV vision-language navigation (UAV-VLN) focuses on enabling an aerial agent to follow natural-language instructions in open 3D environments from egocentric visual observations. Current approaches suffer from three coupled issues: weak grounding of instruction-relevant landmarks in visual observations, insufficient exploitation of long-horizon history, and unstable decisions under local traps or repeated exploration. To address these issues, we propose a unified semantic-to-decision framework. First, we present an instruction-grounded semantic enhancement module that injects object-level semantics and relative spatial cues into the current observation state. Subsequently, we develop a relevance-aware dynamic temporal aggregation strategy that reweights the full history buffer while converting a few high-relevance frames into structured landmark prompts for the decoder. Finally, we devise a topology-aware decision method that combines local-optimum cognition with group-relative policy optimization under progress, goal, semantic, and path-compliance rewards. Experiments on the widely used AerialVLN and OpenFly benchmarks clearly demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的"语义到决策"框架来解决无人机视觉语言导航（UAV-VLN）中的三个耦合问题：指令相关地标在视觉观察中的弱定位、长时程历史信息利用不足，以及局部陷阱或重复探索下的决策不稳定。该框架包含指令接地语义增强模块、相关性动态时序聚合策略和拓扑感知决策方法，在AerialVLN和OpenFly基准上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 当前UAV-VLN方法存在三个相互耦合的问题：1）视觉观察中缺乏对指令相关地标的有效语义接地；2）对长时程导航历史信息利用不充分；3）在局部陷阱或重复探索场景下决策不稳定。这三个问题相互关联，需要统一解决。
AI.method: 提出统一语义到决策框架，包含三部分：1）指令接地语义增强模块：将物体级语义和相对空间线索注入当前观测状态；2）相关性感知动态时序聚合策略：对完整历史缓冲区重新加权，并将少量高相关帧转换为结构化地标提示供解码器使用；3）拓扑感知决策方法：结合局部最优认知与基于进度、目标、语义和路径符合度奖励的组相对策略优化。
AI.result: 在AerialVLN和OpenFly两个广泛使用的基准上进行了实验，方法达到最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过统一解决三个耦合问题，在无人机视觉语言导航任务上实现了SOTA性能，验证了"语义增强-时序聚合-拓扑决策"这一联合设计范式的有效性。

title: VideoVIBE: A Video-Grounded Diagnostic Benchmark for One-Shot Interactive Website Generation
summary: Natural-language-driven "vibe coding" enables the one-shot generation of visually rich and interactive web applications, yet reliable assessment of their quality has not kept pace. Existing evaluations often score isolated artifacts or final task outcomes, offering limited evidence about which failures occur and why. We introduce VideoVIBE, a video-grounded benchmark that transforms human-operated webpage recordings into fine-grained diagnostic tasks. It contains approximately 1.7K diagnostic Video QA instances derived from 6,338 verified failures across generated webpages, spanning semantic-logical, visual-motion, structural-temporal, and functional failures. Diagnoses are grounded primarily in recorded presentation and behavior, with webpage source code used as complementary context. We further propose V2Lens, a training-free, evidence-grounded multi-agent system that challenges and selectively refines initial video-based diagnoses through targeted visual and source-code verification. Across thirteen closed-source and open-weight Video MLLMs, Gemini-2.5-Flash is the strongest standalone model with a score of 64.54, while V2Lens reaches 71.72, an improvement of 7.18 points. Together, our results show that video-grounded evaluation can move beyond isolated artifacts and aggregate outcomes toward a behaviorally faithful and diagnostically informative account of generated application quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VideoVIBE，一个基于视频的诊断基准，将人类操作的网页录制视频转化为细粒度诊断任务，包含约1.7K个诊断性视频问答实例，覆盖6,338个已验证失败案例。同时提出V2Lens，一个无需训练、基于证据的多智能体系统，通过针对性视觉和源代码验证来挑战并选择性地优化初始视频诊断。实验表明Gemini-2.5-Flash为最强单模型（64.54分），V2Lens达到71.72分，提升了7.18分。
AI.motivation: 现有的自然语言驱动的"氛围编码"（vibe coding）可以一次性生成视觉丰富且交互式的网页应用，但对其质量的可靠评估未能同步发展。现有评估往往只对孤立的工件或最终任务结果进行评分，无法提供关于哪些失败发生以及为何发生的充分证据。
AI.method: 1) 构建VideoVIBE基准：将人类操作的网页录制视频转化为细粒度诊断任务，包含约1.7K个诊断性Video QA实例，来源于6,338个已验证的网页失败案例，覆盖语义逻辑、视觉运动、结构时间和功能四类失败。诊断主要基于录制的呈现和行为，源代码作为补充上下文。2) 提出V2Lens：一种无需训练、基于证据的多智能体系统，通过针对性的视觉和源代码验证来挑战并选择性地优化初始视频诊断结果。
AI.result: 在13个闭源和开源视频多模态大语言模型上评估，Gemini-2.5-Flash是最强的单模型，得分64.54；V2Lens达到71.72分，较最强单模型提升7.18分。
AI.conclusion: 基于视频的评估可以超越孤立的工件和聚合结果，提供行为上忠实且诊断信息丰富的生成应用质量评估方式。

title: MSP-Net: Manifold-Guided Spectral Prompt Network for Hyperspectral Object Tracking
summary: Hyperspectral object tracking leverages abundant spectral information to provide unique advantages for target discrimination in complex scenes. However, existing methods typically treat hyperspectral images as multi-channel extensions of RGB images, performing feature fusion in fixed band order. This approach leads to models dependent on specific sensor configurations while neglecting manifold relationships between bands, making generalization to heterogeneous sensors difficult. Moreover, the discriminative contribution of bands dynamically changes with target attributes and scene variations, further limiting the representational capacity of static fusion strategies. To address this, we propose the Manifold-Guided Spectral Prompt Network (MSP-Net). This network first reconstructs band relationships and forms adaptive spectral grouping through graph-driven manifold routing, then jointly integrates grouped spectral statistics with template appearance to construct target-related dynamic conditional prompts, enhancing target features while suppressing background interference. Furthermore, as tracking progresses, spectral conditions continuously evolve based on intermediate target representations, enabling target prompts to adapt in real-time to appearance and scene changes. Meanwhile, reliable historical states are used to constrain target localization and scale fluctuations, significantly improving temporal stability in cross-sensor tracking. Experiments on HOT2020 and HOT2023 demonstrate that MSP-Net achieves AUC and Precision exceeding 0.80 and 0.96, respectively, exhibiting exceptional robustness under heterogeneous sensors, target deformation, and complex background conditions. The code will be released at https://github.com/GGML668897/MSP-Net.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MSP-Net（流形引导光谱提示网络），用于高光谱目标跟踪。该网络通过图驱动的流形路由重建波段关系并形成自适应光谱分组，将分组光谱统计与模板外观联合构建动态条件提示，以增强目标特征并抑制背景干扰，在HOT2020和HOT2023上分别取得超过0.80的AUC和0.96的Precision。
AI.motivation: 现有高光谱跟踪方法将高光谱图像简单视为RGB图像的多通道扩展，在固定波段顺序下进行特征融合。这导致三个问题：1）模型依赖特定传感器配置，难以泛化到异构传感器；2）忽视了波段间的流形关系；3）静态融合策略无法适应波段判别贡献随目标属性和场景变化而动态改变的需求。
AI.method: MSP-Net包含三个核心组件：1）通过图驱动的流形路由重建波段关系并形成自适应光谱分组；2）将分组光谱统计与模板外观联合构建目标相关的动态条件提示，增强目标特征并抑制背景干扰；3）跟踪过程中根据中间目标表征持续更新光谱条件，并利用可靠历史状态约束目标定位和尺度波动以提升时间稳定性。
AI.result: 在HOT2020和HOT2023数据集上，MSP-Net的AUC和Precision分别超过0.80和0.96，在异构传感器、目标变形和复杂背景条件下表现出优异的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: MSP-Net通过流形引导的光谱分组和动态条件提示机制，有效解决了跨传感器高光谱跟踪中的泛化性和适应性难题，显著提升了跟踪精度和时域稳定性。

title: You Only Flow Once: Calibrated and Real-Time Radar Pose Estimation with Multi-Hypothesis Normalizing Flows
comment: Accepted at the Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027
summary: Sparse and noisy millimeter-wave radar point cloud observations often correspond to multiple plausible human poses, making deterministic pose estimation fundamentally ill-posed. Yet existing radar methods remain deterministic, collapsing this ambiguity into a single estimate. Diffusion-based alternatives can model multi-hypothesis distributions but require costly sequential denoising for each distribution sample and lack calibrated uncertainty. We propose Multi-Hypothesis Normalizing Flow Pose Generator (MH-NFPG), which models pose distributions from radar point clouds using a conditional normalizing flow. Specifically, we combine a spatiotemporal transformer backbone with a normalizing flow that transforms a Laplace base distribution into an expressive posterior, generated in parallel through a single forward pass. Leveraging this efficiency, we outperform diffusion-based alternatives in calibration across three radar benchmarks (MM-Fi, mmRadPose, mRI), improve pose accuracy on two, and match it on the third, while achieving over 20x faster inference for applications and reducing calibration error by up to 85%. We find that calibration degrades substantially for diffusion models, whereas our flow-based approach maintains reliable coverage, also in cross-environment settings. These results demonstrate normalizing flows as a practical alternative to diffusion models for real-time, uncertainty-aware radar pose estimation. Our code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出MH-NFPG，一种基于条件归一化流的雷达姿态估计方法。它通过单次前向并行生成多样姿态假设，相比扩散模型推理速度快20倍以上，校准误差降低85%，在三个雷达基准上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 毫米波雷达点云稀疏且含噪，同一观测可能对应多个合理的人体姿态，因此确定性姿态估计本质上是病态的。然而现有雷达方法仍是确定性的，将这种多义性坍缩为单一估计；扩散模型虽能建模多假设分布，但需要昂贵的顺序去噪且缺乏校准的不确定性。
AI.method: 将时空Transformer主干与归一化流结合，把Laplace基分布通过归一化流转换为表达性强的后验分布。所有分布样本通过单次前向传播并行生成，无需扩散模型那样昂贵的迭代去噪过程。
AI.result: 在三个雷达基准（MM-Fi、mmRadPose、mRI）上，校准性能优于扩散模型；在姿态精度上，两个数据集提升、一个持平；推理速度提升超过20倍；校准误差最多降低85%。扩散模型在多环境场景下校准显著退化，而流方法保持可靠覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 归一化流可作为扩散模型的实际替代方案，用于实时、不确定性感知的雷达姿态估计，同时兼顾多假设建模能力与推理效率。

title: GenTrack3: Hybrid Stochastic-Deterministic Online Multi-Object Tracking with Cluster-Aware Association
comment: The content of this paper was included in the full manuscript of GenTrack family which has been submitted to the journal for possible publication
summary: Multi-object tracking (MOT) involves maintaining consistent target identities as objects dynamically enter and leave a scene. Deterministic approaches, such as tracking-by-detection with data association, produce reproducible results and are computationally efficient, but they rely heavily on motion models and are sensitive to noisy detections that can lead to association errors. In contrast, stochastic methods explicitly model uncertainty and can better handle complex non-linear dynamics, albeit at the cost of increased computational complexity and variability arising from random sampling. This paper presents an online MOT framework that integrates deterministic and stochastic principles to achieve robust tracking under uncertainty. Furthermore, a novel track-to-detection matching approach is introduced to enhance scalability with increasing target numbers while supporting group tracking. The tracking inference mechanism employs a tracklet that includes identifiers, states, velocities, track penalties and track ages of targets, supporting a systematic tracking pipeline. Each target is associated with a stochastic particle set to compute the matching cost to detections. Reference implementations of the proposed approach and baseline trackers can be found on GitHub: https://github.com/SDU-VelKoTek/GenTrack3.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在线多目标跟踪（MOT）框架，将确定性方法（如按检测跟踪与数据关联）与随机方法（如粒子滤波）相结合，以实现不确定性下的鲁棒跟踪。同时引入了一种新颖的航迹-检测匹配方法，增强了随目标数量增加的可扩展性，并支持群体跟踪。系统使用包含标识、状态、速度、航迹惩罚和航迹年龄的航迹片段，每个目标关联一个随机粒子集来计算与检测的匹配代价。代码已在GitHub开源。
AI.motivation: 确定性跟踪方法虽然可重现且计算高效，但过度依赖运动模型且对噪声检测敏感；随机方法虽然能显式建模不确定性并处理复杂非线性动态，但计算复杂度高且结果存在随机采样带来的变异性。作者希望结合两者优势，在不确定条件下实现稳健的MOT，并解决目标数量增加时的可扩展性问题。
AI.method: 提出一个在线MOT框架，整合确定性跟踪与随机粒子滤波原则。核心包括：(1) 一种新颖的航迹-检测匹配方法，提升可扩展性并支持群体跟踪；(2) 基于航迹片段的跟踪推理机制，包含标识、状态、速度、航迹惩罚和航迹年龄等信息，形成系统化的跟踪流水线；(3) 每个目标关联随机粒子集，用于计算与检测的匹配代价。
AI.result: 论文提供了所提方法及基线跟踪器的参考实现，并开源在GitHub上（https://github.com/SDU-VelKoTek/GenTrack3），便于复现和对比验证。
AI.conclusion: 通过融合确定性与随机方法的优势，所提出的MOT框架能够在不确定性条件下实现稳健跟踪，同时通过新颖的匹配策略提升了可扩展性并支持群体跟踪场景。

title: TeaMatch: Teachable Cross-Modal Representation Learning for 2D-3D Matching
summary: Learning reliable correspondences between images and point clouds is fundamental for 2D-3D matching.
