Despite recent progress in detection-free methods, existing approaches primarily optimize matching within a single model and often struggle to maintain reliable correspondences under challenging conditions such as noisy inputs, low overlap, and ambiguous structures. In this work, we propose TeaMatch, a novel framework that introduces teachability as a criterion for cross-modal representation learning. We define teachability as the ability of a representation to be effectively recovered by weak learners under degraded inputs, reflecting its structural consistency and robustness. To this end, we construct a set of task-specific weak students that simulate common failure modes and train them to imitate the teacher on a training split while evaluating their recoverability on a disjoint meta split. The teacher is then optimized to improve the students' ability to recover reliable correspondences, guided by correspondence-level and geometry-aware constraints. Our framework can be seamlessly integrated into existing coarse-to-fine matching pipelines without additional inference cost. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TeaMatch improves matching robustness and achieves state-of-the-art performance on challenging 2D-3D matching benchmarks.

AI.tldr: TeaMatch是一个用于2D-3D匹配的框架，引入"可教性"（teachability）作为跨模态表示学习的标准，通过弱学生模型模拟常见失败模式并评估其可恢复性，从而优化教师模型以提升匹配鲁棒性，无需额外推理成本即可集成到现有coarse-to-fine匹配流程中。
AI.motivation: 现有检测无关（detection-free）的2D-3D匹配方法主要在单一模型内优化匹配，在噪声输入、低重叠和结构模糊等挑战性条件下难以保持可靠的对应关系。
AI.method: 提出TeaMatch框架：(1) 定义"可教性"为表示在退化输入下能被弱学习者有效恢复的能力；(2) 构建任务特定的弱学生模型来模拟常见失败模式；(3) 在训练集上训练学生模仿教师，在独立的元分割集上评估可恢复性；(4) 通过对应级别和几何感知约束优化教师模型以提升学生的恢复能力。
AI.result: TeaMatch在多个具有挑战性的2D-3D匹配基准上提升了匹配鲁棒性，达到最先进的性能，且无需增加推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 可教性是一种有效的跨模态表示学习准则，能显著提升2D-3D匹配在困难条件下的鲁棒性和可靠性。

title: Illusion or Integrity? Geometrical Consistency Metric for AIGC Video Quality Evaluation
summary: Recently, AI-driven video generation has attracted considerable attention. This surge increases the demand for reliable video quality assessment (VQA) metrics to evaluate AI-generated content (AIGC) videos and guide model optimization. Existing studies assess video quality through visual harmony, video-text consistency, and domain-specific alignment, yet lack quantitative metrics for measuring fidelity to physical laws. To address this limitation, we present a novel benchmark that evaluates the quality of AIGC videos based on their compliance with physical principles by quantitatively measuring geometric consistency across frames extracted from generated sequences. This serves as a proxy for estimating the extent to which generated videos conform to real-world physical rules. Specifically, GeoCon-Bench captures global motion through translation estimation, fits homography or fundamental matrix models using background correspondences, and reports complementary metrics, including inlier ratio and geometric error. We also release a dataset containing 20 scenes across six motion categories. Experiments on state-of-the-art AIGC models demonstrate the reliability of GeoCon-Bench as a video quality assessment metric.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeoCon-Bench，一个基于物理规律符合度来评估AI生成视频质量的基准，通过量化跨帧几何一致性来代理物理规则遵从程度。
AI.motivation: 现有AIGC视频质量评估方法主要关注视觉和谐度、视频-文本一致性和领域特定对齐，缺乏对物理规律符合度的定量度量指标。
AI.method: 通过全局运动估计（平移估计）捕获运动，利用背景对应点拟合单应性或基础矩阵模型，并报告内点比例和几何误差等互补指标作为质量评估依据。
AI.result: 发布了包含6类运动场景共20个场景的数据集，并在最先进的AIGC模型上实验验证了GeoCon-Bench作为视频质量评估指标的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: GeoCon-Bench通过几何一致性量化，为AIGC视频提供了一种新颖的、基于物理规律符合度的质量评估方法。

title: ResemBrick: Brick Reconstruction from Photographs with Perceptual Fidelity and Buildability
summary: Producing a hand-buildable, colored brick model of a 3D object from a few casual photographs is a clean testbed for a broader challenge: generating 3D content that meets hard physical-assembly constraints under a discrete, budget-limited voxel grid. On a coarse lattice, visual resemblance and structural stability pull against each other, yet prior brick pipelines address only one side and treat voxelization as fixed preprocessing rather than a variable to optimize. We present ResemBrick, which couples the two. Budgeted occupancy completion reframes discretization as allocation: given a target occupied-voxel count, a single resolution-conditioned network decides in one feed-forward pass which surface voxels to fill for best appearance, one weight set spanning 13 resolutions. Buildability by construction then combines support- and look-ahead-aware greedy placement with a deterministic, provably terminating repair that grounds every floating component. Under a matched budget, ResemBrick surpasses existing voxel selectors in perceptual fidelity while uniquely reaching zero floating and zero unstable bricks on unfiltered held-out objects; as a complete pipeline, it attains the best perceptual fidelity among prior brick-construction systems. Our results point to treating discretization and assembly as tightly coupled stages rather than independent ones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ResemBrick，一个将离散化（体素化）与组装（建造）耦合的彩色砖块模型生成流水线。它通过预算化占用补全网络在单次前馈中决定填充哪些表面体素以优化外观（一套权重覆盖13个分辨率），并通过支持性及前瞻性贪心放置与可证明终止的修复机制保证所有砖块零悬浮、零不稳定。在匹配预算下，ResemBrick在感知保真度上超越现有体素选择器，且作为完整流水线取得最佳感知保真度。
AI.motivation: 在粗网格上，视觉相似性与结构稳定性相互矛盾，而现有砖块流水线只解决其中一方面，并将体素化视为固定的预处理步骤而非可优化的变量。作者希望将离散化与组装作为紧密耦合的阶段共同优化，以生成同时满足硬性物理装配约束和视觉保真度的3D内容。
AI.method: 1) 预算化占用补全（Budgeted Occupancy Completion）：将离散化重新定义为分配问题，给定目标占用体素数，用单一分辨率条件网络在单次前馈中决定填充哪些表面体素以最大化外观保真度，一组权重覆盖13种分辨率。2) 可构建性保证：结合支持性-和前瞻性-贪心放置策略，以及确定性、可证明终止的修复机制，将每个悬浮组件接地，确保零悬浮和零不稳定砖块。
AI.result: 在匹配预算下，ResemBrick在感知保真度上超越现有体素选择器；在未过滤的保留对象上，独特地实现零浮动和零不稳定砖块；作为完整流水线，在所有先前的砖块构建系统中取得最佳感知保真度。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，应将离散化与装配视为紧密耦合的阶段而非独立的步骤，这一思路为在硬约束（预算、物理装配）下生成3D内容提供了新的方向。

title: Structure-Enhanced Features and Quality-Aware Dynamic Anchor Scoring for Robust Lane Detection
summary: Lane detection requires recovering thin, elongated, and frequently occluded lane structures under challenging driving conditions. While anchor-based detectors provide efficient candidate generation, their performance is limited by two coupled issues: backbone features often lose structural continuity along partially visible lanes, and classification confidence may decouple from line-level localization quality, allowing inaccurate anchors to persist before non-maximum suppression (NMS). We propose a structure-enhanced and quality-aware framework that improves lane representation and dynamic-anchor scoring while preserving the inference pipeline of the Anchor Decomposition Network (ADNet). Specifically, a Gated Horizontal-Vertical Token (GHVT) module enhances mid- and high-level backbone features via lightweight directional token interactions with a learnable residual gate. In parallel, Line-Quality-Aware Dynamic Anchor Scoring (LQAS) calibrates existing classification logits using quality supervision, hard-negative suppression, and pairwise ranking without adding inference branches. On the VIL-100 dataset, our method improves ADNet-R34 from 89.97 to 91.28 in F1 score at the 0.5 intersection-over-union threshold (F1@50), reducing both false positives and false negatives. Additional experiments on CULane and TuSimple datasets, extensive ablations, score-distribution diagnostics, and runtime analysis confirm complementary structural and ranking improvements with minimal computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个结构增强与质量感知的车道检测框架，在保持ADNet推理流程不变的前提下，通过GHVT模块增强骨干特征的结构连续性，并通过LQAS机制校准分类置信度与定位质量之间的耦合问题，在VIL-100、CULane和TuSimple数据集上均取得性能提升，且计算开销极小。
AI.motivation: 锚点式车道检测器存在两个耦合问题：1）骨干特征在部分遮挡或断续车道场景下缺乏结构连续性；2）分类置信度与车道线级别的定位质量脱钩，导致非极大值抑制前不准确的锚点得以保留。这两者共同限制了检测性能。
AI.method: 1）GHVT（门控水平-垂直令牌）模块：通过轻量级方向性令牌交互与可学习残差门增强中高层骨干特征的结构表达；2）LQAS（线质量感知动态锚点评分）：利用质量监督、难负样本抑制和成对排序校准现有分类logits，不增加推理分支；整体保持ADNet推理管线不变。
AI.result: 在VIL-100数据集上，ADNet-R34的F1@50从89.97提升至91.28，同时降低假阳性和假阴性；在CULane和TuSimple数据集上的实验、大量消融研究、分数分布诊断和运行时间分析均验证了结构与排序改进的互补性，且计算开销最小。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明通过结构增强（GHVT）与质量感知锚点评分（LQAS）的协同设计，可以在不改变推理架构的前提下显著提升锚点式车道检测器的性能，为细长、遮挡目标检测提供了有效思路。

title: Marrying Optimal Transport and ODEs for Unified Continuous-Time 4D Reconstruction and Tracking
summary: Existing unified 4D reconstruction and point tracking approaches typically rely on heuristic interpolations or just predict at integer timestamps, lacking kinematic coherence and failing to model dynamics at any arbitrary timestamp. In this paper, we propose Uni4R, a framework that unifies these tasks by learning continuous velocity fields through the synergy of Optimal Transport (OT) and Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE). Importantly, this continuous velocity field acts as a kinematic prior that mutually benefits both 4D reconstruction and point tracking. Specifically, we propose the Flow Matching Guided Decoder (FMGD). A global velocity branch first extracts anchor features that capture the global dynamic state of the sequence. Then, FMGD leverages Flow Matching (FM) theory to formulate a probability path defined by OT on the anchor feature manifold, instantiating it as FM-guided velocity features for velocity prediction. This establishes a robust kinematic inductive bias. Meanwhile, a point reconstruction branch provides geometric features. The local velocity prediction module then joint above features and time embeddings, to decode velocities at arbitrary timestamps. To overcome the absence of high-quality ground-truth velocities in fractional frames, we propose an integral-consistency training strategy. This strategy uses an ODE solver to integrate velocities to recover target pointmaps, enabling the model to be supervised end-to-end directly from integer timestamps. Experimental results demonstrate that Uni4R achieves SOTA performance in both 4D reconstruction and point tracking, and achieves SOTA in our new kinematics-aware benchmark at continuous time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Uni4R框架，通过最优传输（OT）和常微分方程（ODE）的协同来学习连续速度场，从而统一4D重建和点跟踪任务。该连续速度场作为运动学先验，使两个任务相互受益。实验表明Uni4R在4D重建、点跟踪以及新的运动学感知基准上均达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的统一4D重建和点跟踪方法通常依赖启发式插值或仅在整数时间戳进行预测，缺乏运动学连贯性，无法在任意时间戳建模动态。因此需要一种能够学习连续、运动学一致的动态建模方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出Flow Matching Guided Decoder (FMGD)：全局速度分支提取捕获序列全局动态状态的锚点特征；2) FMGD利用Flow Matching理论构建由OT定义的概率路径，实例化为FM引导的速度特征进行速度预测；3) 点重建分支提供几何特征，局部速度预测模块联合特征和时间嵌入，解码任意时间戳的速度；4) 提出积分一致性训练策略，用ODE求解器积分速度恢复目标点图，实现端到端监督。
AI.result: Uni4R在4D重建和点跟踪任务上均取得SOTA性能，并在新提出的运动学感知连续时间基准上也达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 通过将OT与ODE结合学习连续速度场，可以建立鲁棒的运动学归纳偏置，同时惠及4D重建和点跟踪，为任意时间戳的连续动态建模提供了有效方案。

title: LoRA-based Adaptation Alone Is Not Enough: Understanding the Limits of Foundation Models for Face Presentation Attack Detection
comment: accepted at ECCV 2026 Workshop on Foundation and Generative Models in Biometrics
summary: Face presentation attack detection (PAD) aims to reliably detect a wide range of presentation attacks. While PAD methods achieve strong performance within individual datasets, their performance degrades under cross-dataset evaluation. Variations in sensors or lighting conditions can reduce the effectiveness of detectors from near-perfect to nearly random. Foundation models (FMs) have emerged as a promising alternative because typical PAD datasets, such as the MCIO benchmarks (MSU-MFSD, CASIA-FASD, Replay-Attack, and OULU-NPU), are small relative to the scale used for web-based pretraining. However, existing PAD systems primarily focus on CLIP-based foundation models, while overlooking other FMs with different architectures and training procedures. This study addresses this question by systematically evaluating 32 FMs. Zero-shot prompting achieves performance near chance across model families and scales. The vision encoders, when low-rankadapted (LoRA) with fewer than 1% trainable weights, achieve below 2% intra-dataset ACER in most cases, while cross-dataset ACER is substantially higher. LoRA primarily refines the decision boundary within a dataset, suggesting that pretrained representations and the adaptation dataset play a larger role in cross-dataset generalization than the evaluated lightweight adaptation strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性评估了32种基础模型（FMs）在人脸呈现攻击检测（PAD）中的表现，发现零样本提示在所有模型族和尺度上性能接近随机，而低秩适配（LoRA）在数据集内表现优异但在跨数据集泛化上依然受限，表明预训练表示和适配数据集比轻量级适配策略对跨数据集泛化影响更大。
AI.motivation: 现有的PAD方法在跨数据集评估中性能严重退化（从近乎完美降至接近随机），而现有的基础模型PAD研究主要集中于CLIP模型，忽略了其他架构和训练流程的基础模型。因此需要系统性评估不同的基础模型在PAD任务中的表现。
AI.method: 对32个基础模型进行系统评估，涵盖不同架构和训练流程。使用零样本提示和低秩适配（LoRA）两种策略，在MCIO基准（MSU-MFSD、CASIA-FASD、Replay-Attack、OULU-NPU）上进行数据集内和跨数据集评估。
AI.result: 零样本提示在所有模型族和尺度上性能接近随机；视觉编码器通过LoRA适配（少于1%可训练权重）在大多数情况下实现低于2%的数据集内ACER，但跨数据集ACER显著更高。
AI.conclusion: LoRA主要是在数据集内优化决策边界，预训练表示和适配数据集对跨数据集泛化的作用大于轻量级适配策略本身。这表明基础模型在PAD跨数据集泛化方面仍面临挑战，需要更深入的适配策略或更好的预训练表示。

title: NeuroRefiner: Morphology-Aware Multi-Agent Refinement for 3D Fluorescence Microscopy Neuron Segmentation
summary: Accurate 3D neuron segmentation in fluorescence microscopy is critical for neuroscience. However, the sparse and elongated morphology of neurons poses significant challenges to existing segmentation methods. These methods struggle to preserve both local details and global topology, leading to fragmented results. To address this, we propose NeuroRefiner, a multi-agent system that formalizes the human expert workflow involving iterative global observation and local editing. Specifically, NeuroRefiner comprises three collaborative agents dedicated to diagnosing topological errors, generating correction instructions, and validating refinement quality. To facilitate agent instruction-guided segmentation refinement, we propose TopoRefineNet, a dedicated 3D U-Net-based tool that leverages cross-modality feature fusion to generate refined masks. Through multi-round agent reasoning and voxel-level editing, NeuroRefiner produces topologically more accurate segmentations with enhanced interpretability. Experiments on the BigNeuron, CWMBS, and ZBFWB datasets demonstrate that NeuroRefiner outperforms state-of-the-art methods, notably achieving a 3.02% improvement in F1 score on the challenging ZBFWB dataset.

AI.tldr: NeuroRefiner是一个基于多智能体的3D神经元分割精化系统，通过模拟人类专家的迭代观察与局部编辑流程，结合三个协作智能体（拓扑错误诊断、修正指令生成、质量验证）和基于3D U-Net的TopoRefineNet工具，实现了更准确的神经元分割，在BigNeuron、CWMBS和ZBFWB数据集上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 荧光显微镜下的3D神经元分割对神经科学至关重要，但神经元的稀疏细长形态给现有分割方法带来挑战，这些方法难以同时保持局部细节和全局拓扑，导致分割结果碎片化。
AI.method: 提出NeuroRefiner多智能体系统，包含三个协作智能体（诊断拓扑错误、生成修正指令、验证精化质量），并配备TopoRefineNet（基于3D U-Net的专用工具，利用跨模态特征融合生成精化掩膜），通过多轮智能体推理和体素级编辑来精化分割结果。
AI.result: 在BigNeuron、CWMBS和ZBFWB三个数据集上的实验表明，NeuroRefiner优于最先进方法，尤其在具有挑战性的ZBFWB数据集上F1分数提升了3.02%。
AI.conclusion: NeuroRefiner通过将人类专家工作流形式化为多智能体协作框架，能够生成拓扑更准确且可解释性更强的神经元分割结果。

title: DUET: A Diversity-Quality Duet of Distillation Experts for Two-Step Video Generation
summary: Diffusion models have enabled high-quality video generation in recent years, but the high cost of iterative sampling hinders their practical deployment. Few-step distillation alleviates this cost, yet exposes a quality--diversity trade-off between its two dominant paradigms: trajectory-level distillation (e.g., sCM) favors diversity, whereas distribution-level distillation (e.g., DMD) favors quality. Targeting extreme two-step video generation, we introduce DUET, which reconciles the two paradigms through a noise-level duet of experts: an sCM expert takes the high-noise step to lay out diverse structure, and a DMD expert takes the low-noise step to refine appearance detail. Since the two experts are trained independently with their native objectives, DUET sidesteps the optimization difficulties of loss-level combinations and delivers quality and diversity jointly rather than trading one for the other. We further identify the relay interface and the high-noise stage as the remaining bottlenecks, and address them with RL-guided expert adaptation, yielding DUET+. With the Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B backbone, DUET lifts the two-step quality of sCM close to the level of DMD while retaining nearly all of its structural diversity---about twice that of DMD---and DUET+ further improves overall quality while preserving this diversity advantage. Together, these results establish noise-level expert specialization as a simple, effective paradigm for reconciling diversity and quality in two-step video generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DUET框架，通过噪声级别的专家分工（高噪声步使用sCM专家保持多样性，低噪声步使用DMD专家提升质量）来协调两步视频生成中质量与多样性的权衡，并进一步通过RL引导的专家适配（DUET+）解决中继接口和高噪声阶段的瓶颈问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型虽能生成高质量视频，但迭代采样成本高昂。两步蒸馏虽降低开销，却在轨迹级蒸馏（sCM，重多样性）和分布级蒸馏（DMD，重质量）之间暴露出质量与多样性的权衡问题。现有方法难以同时兼顾两者。
AI.method: 提出DUET，在两步生成中按噪声级别分配专家：高噪声步骤由sCM专家负责（构筑多样化结构），低噪声步骤由DMD专家负责（精修外观细节）。两个专家独立训练，采用各自原生目标，避免损失级组合的优化难题。同时识别中继接口和高噪声阶段为瓶颈，引入RL引导的专家适配得到DUET+。
AI.result: 基于Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B骨干网络，DUET将两步生成质量从sCM提升至接近DMD水平，同时保留约DMD两倍的多样性；DUET+在保持多样性优势的同时进一步提升了整体质量。
AI.conclusion: 噪声级专家特化是调和两步视频生成中多样性与质量权衡的简单而有效的范式。

title: EgoHieraLoc: A Cortically Inspired Hierarchical Segmentation-Guided Framework for Egocentric Visual Query Localization
summary: Visual query localization (VQL) aims to retrieve and re-localize a queried object in egocentric videos, yet remains challenging when object boundaries are ambiguous and global context cannot effectively guide fine-grained localization. Human vision handles such ambiguity through a hierarchical process: it rapidly screens foreground candidates, selectively attends to the target despite distractors, refines perception via feedback between global context and local detail, and, when a single view is unreliable, integrates evidence across viewpoints according to its credibility. Inspired by these competencies, we propose \textbf{EgoHieraLoc}, a unified framework for VQL-2D and VQL-3D. A Discriminative Parsing Module first extracts foreground-aware query representations using segmentation priors; a Query-Aware Module then performs robust target localization through discriminative correlation filtering with deformable modeling; and a Regional Adaptation Module feeds multi-scale context back into local regions to recover precise object boundaries. To extend this perceptual hierarchy to 3D localization, we introduce Geometric-Semantic Joint Confidence (GSJC), which multiplicatively couples segmentation confidence with local depth consistency, multi-view back-projection consistency, and triangulation-baseline quality, so that a viewpoint contributes to the 3D estimate only when it is credible both semantically and geometrically. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on both VQL-2D and -3D benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EgoHieraLoc，一个统一的视觉查询定位框架，受人类分层视觉处理机制启发，同时解决VQL-2D和VQL-3D任务。通过判别式解析模块、查询感知模块和区域适应模块实现精细化的二维目标定位，并引入几何-语义联合置信度将定位扩展到三维。
AI.motivation: 视觉查询定位（VQL）在目标边界模糊、全局上下文无法有效引导细粒度定位时面临挑战。人类视觉通过分层处理机制（快速筛选候选、选择性注意、全局-局部反馈、多视角证据整合）来解决此类歧义，现有方法缺乏对这种层级化感知过程的建模。
AI.method: 提出EgoHieraLoc统一框架：(1) 判别式解析模块利用分割先验提取前景感知的查询表示；(2) 查询感知模块通过判别式相关滤波和可变形建模进行鲁棒目标定位；(3) 区域适应模块将多尺度上下文反馈到局部区域以恢复精确目标边界；(4) 对于3D定位，引入几何-语义联合置信度（GSJC），将分割置信度与局部深度一致性、多视角反投影一致性和三角化基线质量相乘耦合，确保视角在语义和几何上均可信时才参与3D估计。
AI.result: 实验表明EgoHieraLoc在VQL-2D和VQL-3D基准上均达到最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过模拟人类分层视觉处理能力并引入几何-语义联合置信度机制，EgoHieraLoc有效解决了细粒度目标定位中的边界模糊问题，并在二维和三维定位任务中均取得领先效果。

title: CIFA: Contextual-Intersectional Fairness Auditing for Hidden Subgroup Discovery in Face Analysis
summary: Fairness evaluation in computer vision commonly relies on aggregate accuracy and demographic subgroup analysis. However, visual models are also sensitive to contextual factors such as illumination, blur, image quality, facial accessories, and appearance attributes. These factors may interact with demographic characteristics, producing hidden subgroups in which performance degrades substantially despite strong aggregate accuracy and apparently acceptable demographic fairness. To address this, we propose the Contextual-Intersectional Fairness Auditing Framework (CIFA), a structured framework for identifying subgroup vulnerabilities arising from interactions between demographic and contextual attributes. CIFA performs demographic, contextual, and contextual-intersectional auditing, followed by worst-group discovery to identify and rank the most vulnerable attribute combinations. We evaluate CIFA on gender classification using ResNet-50 \cite{he2016deep} and ViT-B/16 \cite{dosovitskiy2020image} across FairFace \cite{Karkkainen2021}, CelebA \cite{Liu2015}, and UTKFace \cite{Zhang2017}. Our results show that aggregate accuracy and demographic-only evaluation can mask substantial contextual-intersectional disparities. We further assess several established mitigation strategies through an audit--mitigate--reaudit protocol and find that, although some worst-group disparities are reduced, no single strategy consistently eliminates them across datasets and architectures. These findings establish contextual-intersectional auditing as an important component of fairness evaluation and provide a reproducible framework for discovering, prioritizing, and reassessing hidden subgroup risks in face analysis systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出上下文-交叉公平性审计框架（CIFA），用于识别面部识别系统中由人口统计属性与上下文属性（如光照、模糊、图像质量等）交互作用产生的隐藏子群性能退化问题。实验表明，传统的聚合准确率和仅人口统计维度的公平性评估会掩盖显著的上下文交叉差异，且现有缓解策略无法一致地消除最差子群的性能差距。
AI.motivation: 计算机视觉中的公平性评估通常只关注聚合准确率和人口统计子群分析，但忽略了视觉模型对上下文因素（如光照、模糊、图像质量、面部配饰和外观属性）的敏感性。这些上下文因素可能与人口统计特征交互，形成隐藏子群，在这些子群中模型性能严重退化，尽管整体准确率和表面上的公平性表现良好。
AI.method: 提出CIFA框架，包含三个审计阶段：人口统计审计、上下文审计和上下文-交叉审计，随后进行最差子群发现以识别和排序最脆弱的属性组合。研究使用ResNet-50和ViT-B/16在FairFace、CelebA和UTKFace数据集上进行性别分类评估，并采用"审计-缓解-再审计"协议评估多种既有缓解策略。
AI.result: 研究结果表明聚合准确率和仅人口统计维度的评估会掩盖显著的上下文-交叉不公平差异。虽然部分缓解策略能减少最差子群的性能差距，但没有任何单一策略能在所有数据集和架构上一致地消除这些差异。
AI.conclusion: 上下文-交叉审计应作为公平性评估的重要组成部分，本文提供了一个可复现的框架，用于发现、优先级排序和重新评估面部分析系统中的隐藏子群风险。

title: MPISuperRes-PnP: A Super-Resolution Zero-Shot Plug-and-Play Reconstruction Algorithm for Magnetic Particle Imaging
summary: Magnetic Particle Imaging (MPI) is an emerging medical imaging modality. MPI is based on the non-linear response of magnetic nanoparticles to an applied magnetic field and avoids ionizing radiation. The measured signal is the voltage induced in receive coils by the particles' response. Reconstructing the particle concentration from the signal constitutes the imaging task. Even using state-of-the-art measurement-based reconstruction, the associated spatial grid is very coarse, hence super-resolution (SR) techniques are important. In this work, we propose an approach for SR in MPI inspired by energy minimization. Different methods have been proposed for SR in MPI, ranging from upscaling of the associated system matrix to interpolation of the reconstruction. Here we incorporate SR into the reconstruction task via an energy minimization formulation. Following the plug-and-play approach to energy minimization we derive a splitting scheme and a SR method for MPI where the arising Gaussian denoising task is treated with a pre-trained learned Gaussian denoiser in a zero-shot fashion. This way, we incorporate benefits of deep learning without training and avoid the need of training data. Further, we provide a quantitative and qualitative evaluation of the proposed method. Hyper-parameter are selected via an extended parameter search. The found parameters are applied for reconstruction on real data. We show the applicability of our method on synthetic and on real data (MPIData: EquilibriumModelWithAnisotropy and 2D-OpenMPI Data). The proposed method employs a deep-learning denoiser without training -- thus it does not require presently scarcely available MPI training data. The denoiser behaves conservatively, i.e., no hallucination artifacts were observed. The SR approach is generic such that it can be applied in future MPI contexts involving different regularizers or different imaging tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于能量最小化和即插即用（plug-and-play）框架的磁粒子成像（MPI）超分辨率方法。该方法将超分辨率整合到重建任务中，利用预训练的高斯去噪器以零样本方式处理去噪子问题，无需训练数据和额外训练过程，在合成数据和真实数据上均验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: MPI成像基于磁性纳米粒子的非线性响应，但即使使用最先进的基于测量的重建方法，其空间网格仍然非常粗糙，因此超分辨率技术至关重要。现有SR方法包括系统矩阵上采样和重建插值，但缺乏一种将SR自然融入重建任务并利用深度学习优势的通用方法，同时MPI训练数据稀缺，难以直接训练深度学习模型。
AI.method: 提出一个能量最小化框架，将超分辨率整合到MPI重建任务中。采用即插即用（plug-and-play）方法推导出分裂方案，其中高斯去噪子问题由预训练的学得高斯去噪器以零样本方式处理。该方法无需训练，避免了对训练数据的需求，并通过扩展参数搜索选择超参数。
AI.result: 在合成数据和真实数据（MPIData: EquilibriumModelWithAnisotropy和2D-OpenMPI Data）上验证了方法的适用性。去噪器行为保守，未观察到幻觉伪影，方法有效且通用。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种无需训练的深度去噪驱动的MPI超分辨率方法，避免了MPI训练数据稀缺的问题，且方法具有通用性，可应用于未来MPI场景中涉及不同正则化器或不同成像任务的情况。

title: Thinking With Tools, Not With Pixels: Tool Calls as Text Scaffolds for Visual Reasoning
summary: Tool-augmented vision-language models increasingly "think with images": they call crop, zoom, or code tools and reason over the returned pixels. However, recent work using blind tests, gain decompositions, and attention analyses has shown that returned images contribute little, raising the question: if pixels do not carry the gain, what does? We hypothesize that the load-bearing signal is the structured text emitted before any returned pixel arrives: tool name, coordinates, target description, and intent. This textual scaffold encodes where to look and what to find. We introduce TextCall (call-but-no-return) to test this: it keeps the scaffold but replaces returned images with the text placeholder [Image output skipped]. Three studies support the hypothesis. (i) Non-necessity of returned pixels: across LoRA, full fine-tuning, and RL, TextCall matches or exceeds full thinking-with-images; under RL it preserves tool use at the reported checkpoint, avoiding the failure mode where, under matched settings, seeing the returned image causes the model to stop calling tools and answer directly. (ii) Sufficiency of the scaffold: on matched training queries, scaffold-only input yields equivalent accuracy to returned-image input. (iii) Component specificity: decomposing the scaffold into reasoning text and spatial code shows both components contribute, with the dominant one varying by task. Together these results support the Tool-Call Scaffold Hypothesis: in current thinking-with-images distributions, the active signal is the structured text emitted at tool-call time; the returned image is a redundant carrier. TextCall preserves accuracy while reducing latency by 29-46% and eliminating tool-execution API calls. Our claims hold for current thinking-with-images benchmarks; constructing tasks where pixels are genuinely load-bearing remains an open direction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Tool-Call Scaffold假设：工具增强视觉语言模型中承载信号的不是返回的图像像素，而是工具调用时生成的文本脚手架（工具名、坐标、目标描述和意图）。作者引入TextCall方法（保留脚手架但用占位符替换返回图像），通过三项研究验证了该假设，并在保持精度的同时将延迟降低29-46%。
AI.motivation: 现有工具增强视觉语言模型（"thinking with images"）通过调用裁剪、缩放或代码工具并推理返回像素来工作，但近期研究表明返回图像对增益贡献甚微。这引发了一个关键问题：如果像素不承载增益，那什么才是真正起作用的信号？作者试图找到这个"隐藏的载体"。
AI.method: 作者提出TextCall（call-but-no-return）方法：保留工具调用时生成的文本脚手架，但将返回图像替换为文本占位符[Image output skipped]。设计三项研究验证：(i)非必要性测试——对比LoRA、全微调和RL下TextCall与完整"thinking with images"的性能；(ii)充分性测试——在匹配训练查询上对比仅脚手架输入与返回图像输入的准确性；(iii)成分特异性——将脚手架分解为推理文本和空间代码，分析各自贡献。
AI.result: 三项研究均支持假设：(i)TextCall在LoRA、全微调和RL下匹配或超越完整方法，且在RL下避免模型停止调用工具而直接回答的失败模式；(ii)仅脚手架输入与返回图像输入达到同等精度；(iii)推理文本和空间代码均有贡献，但主导成分因任务而异。TextCall保持精度同时将延迟降低29-46%，并消除了工具执行API调用。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持Tool-Call Scaffold假设：在当前thinking-with-images分布中，活跃信号是工具调用时发出的结构化文本，返回图像只是冗余载体。但该结论仅适用于当前基准，如何构建像素真正承载信息的任务仍是开放方向。

title: Diffuse the object, keep its label: curating detector training data from a few unlabeled photographs via VLM-built 3D vegetation scenes
comment: Accepted at the Curated Data for Efficient Learning (CDEL) Workshop @ ECCV 2026
summary: Labeled images of small objects hidden in vegetation are scarce, and detectors trained on them generalize poorly across sites. Rather than reusing labels collected at another site, we synthesize labeled training images from a handful of unlabeled photographs of the deployment site itself. A vision--language model generates a coarse 3D vegetation scene from one photograph; placing 3D object meshes in the scene yields bounding boxes, segmentation masks, and per-instance occlusion directly from the scene geometry, without manual annotation. A lightweight adapter fine-tuned on the photographs conditions a diffusion pass that re-textures the renders, and a graded mask-lock sets how much diffusion may touch the object itself. In our runs this grade was the most influential curation choice: lightly diffusing the object improves minority-class recall over fully protecting its pixels, while unrestricted diffusion dissolves it. Trained on these images, a standard detector matched or exceeded its counterpart trained on a larger labeled dataset of real images from a different site, consistently across seeds on a humanitarian-demining benchmark; the comparison is thus unsupervised site adaptation from a handful of photographs against conventional cross-site label reuse. In our ablations the gains were largely insensitive to the photograph and crop budgets, and in-domain accuracy did not predict cross-site performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需人工标注的跨站点目标检测方法：利用视觉-语言模型从少量部署站点照片生成粗略3D植被场景，将3D目标网格放入场景中直接获得标注，再通过扩散模型对渲染图重新贴图，最终训练得到在目标站点性能优于或等同于使用其他站点真实标注数据的标准检测器。
AI.motivation: 小目标隐藏在植被中的标注图像稀缺，且在不同地点训练的检测器泛化能力差；跨站点重复使用标签效果不佳。现有方法缺乏既无需人工标注又能在部署站点本地工作的训练数据来源。
AI.method: 1) 用视觉-语言模型从单张部署站点照片生成粗略3D植被场景；2) 在场景中放置3D目标网格，根据场景几何直接获得边界框、分割掩码和逐实例遮挡；3) 用照片微调的轻量适配器引导扩散模型对渲染结果重新贴图；4) 采用分级掩码锁定机制控制扩散对目标本身的修改程度。
AI.result: 在一个人道主义排雷基准上，用合成图像训练的标准检测器，其性能匹配或超过了在更大规模其他站点真实标注数据集上训练的检测器；轻度扩散目标区域能提升少数类召回率，而完全保护或完全放开扩散效果均较差；增益对照片数量与裁剪预算不敏感，且域内精度无法预测跨站点性能。
AI.conclusion: 从少量站点照片合成训练数据可作为跨站点标签复用的有效替代方案，实现无监督站点自适应；扩散的粒度控制（分级掩码锁定）是关键的调优选择，但总体方法对预算设置较为鲁棒。

title: LookAgain: Closed-Loop GUI Grounding with Visually Grounded Reflection
summary: Recent graphical user interface (GUI) grounders have significantly advanced single-shot accuracy on standard benchmarks, yet their performance degrades sharply on small targets, densely packed controls and out-of-distribution interfaces. We attribute this gap to a paradigmatic limitation shared by existing approaches: none of them treats a produced coordinate as a hypothesis to be reflected upon and revised under new visual evidence. This manifests as three coupled issues: 1) Lack of post-hoc reflection. The prediction is frozen at the moment of emission, leaving no internal mechanism to challenge or refine it. 2) Visual evidence decoupled from the prediction. The auxiliary visual evidence is gathered to support the upcoming coordinate rather than to scrutinise the one already committed to. 3) Refinement over views, not over predictions. The iterative zoom-in refines the inspected region instead of inheriting a previous coordinate as a spatial prior to be corrected. In this paper, we propose LookAgain, a closed-loop GUI grounder driven by post-prediction visual reflection. LookAgain reformulates grounding as a multi-turn predict-look-again-refine process with two primitives: "locate" posts a coordinate hypothesis, renders a marker on the image and appends a local patch of the predicted region. It anchors the next reasoning step to the previous prediction as a spatial prior; "confirm" accepts or reject the hypothesis and terminates the procedure. We train the LookAgain grounder with SFT on constructed reflective trajectories as a cold start, followed by GRPO with terminal grounding correctness as the sole reward. Extensive experiments show that LookAgain consistently improves performance on both refusal-aware and general GUI grounding benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art results. Comprehensive ablations further verify the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LookAgain，一种闭环GUI grounding框架，通过"预测-再看-修正"的多轮反思机制解决现有方法在小目标、密集控件和分布外界面上的性能退化问题，在多个基准上取得SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI grounder在标准基准上单次准确率很高，但在小目标、密集控件和分布外界面上性能严重退化。作者归因于现有方法的范式性局限：没有任何方法将产生的坐标视为需要被反思和修正的假设。具体表现为三个耦合问题：1)缺乏事后反思机制；2)视觉证据与预测脱节；3)迭代放大是在修正视图而非修正预测本身。
AI.method: LookAgain将GUI grounding重新定义为多轮"预测-再看-修正"闭环过程，包含两个原语："locate"提交坐标假设、在图像上渲染标记并附加预测区域的局部patch，将前一轮预测作为空间先验锚定下一轮推理；"confirm"接受或拒绝假设并终止流程。训练采用两阶段：先用SFT在构造的反思轨迹上进行冷启动，再用GRPO以终端grounding正确性作为唯一奖励进行强化学习。
AI.result: LookAgain在refusal-aware和通用GUI grounding基准上均取得一致性改进，达到SOTA结果；全面的消融实验验证了框架各组成部分的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将坐标视为可反思和修正的假设，通过闭环的多轮视觉反思过程，能够有效缓解现有GUI grounder在小目标、密集界面和分布外场景下的性能退化问题。

title: World Tokens: Enhancing Embodied Policies with Training-Time World Modeling
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are a widely adopted paradigm for embodied policies. They excel at efficient closed-loop control but do not explicitly model how physical scenes evolve as a task unfolds. Recently emerging world-action models (WAMs) leverage pretrained video world models to capture spatiotemporal evolution, yet retaining future generation or a large video backbone in the control loop substantially increases inference cost. We introduce World Tokens, an embodied policy architecture built around a World Adapter that bridges visual-language understanding, world-dynamics modeling, and action generation. It uses world modeling during training to enhance the action policy while preserving efficient deployment. Specifically, the World Adapter transforms VLM features into a fixed set of world tokens, which condition a jointly fine-tuned future-video denoiser and simultaneously serve as the action expert's sole visual-language context. This shared conditioning allows gradients from future-video denoising to directly shape the representation used for action prediction, while exclusive routing prevents the policy from bypassing that representation. At deployment, the world-model branch is removed, leaving only the VLM, World Adapter, and action expert, with no online video-model inference. With a 2B backbone and no embodied action pretraining, World Tokens is highly competitive on LIBERO, attains the best reported averages on SIMPLER, substantially improves real-world R1 Pro success over a matched action-only baseline, and generates each action chunk at VLA-level latency.

AI.tldr: World Tokens是一种具身策略架构，通过World Adapter在训练时利用世界模型增强动作策略，部署时移除世界模型分支，保持VLA级别的推理效率，在LIBERO、SIMPLER和真实机器人R1 Pro上均表现出色。
AI.motivation: VLA模型擅长闭环控制但不显式建模物理场景演化；而世界动作模型（WAMs）虽能捕捉时空演化，但保留未来生成或大型视频骨干会显著增加推理成本。作者希望兼顾世界动态建模能力与高效的部署效率。
AI.method: 引入World Adapter作为桥梁：将VLM特征转换为固定数量的world tokens，这些tokens同时作为未来视频去噪器的条件并作为动作专家的唯一视觉-语言上下文。通过共享条件化，未来视频去噪的梯度直接塑造用于动作预测的表征；通过独占路由防止策略绕开该表征。训练时包含世界模型分支，部署时移除该分支，仅保留VLM、World Adapter和动作专家。
AI.result: 在2B骨干且无具身动作预训练的情况下，World Tokens在LIBERO上极具竞争力，在SIMPLER上取得最佳平均结果，显著优于匹配的动作-only基线的真实世界R1 Pro成功率，且每个动作块生成延迟达到VLA级别。
AI.conclusion: World Tokens证明了通过训练时的世界建模蒸馏，可以在不牺牲推理效率的前提下提升具身策略的动作预测能力，实现了世界动态建模与高效部署的兼顾。

title: HandSplatter: Automated Digital Goniometry from Neural Rendering
comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 48th Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC 2026), Full Paper #1985
summary: Hand and finger disorders are leading contributors to musculoskeletal disability, creating a clinical need for precise methods to quantify joint motion. Range of motion (ROM) serves as the metric for diagnosis, rehabilitation monitoring, and evaluating surgical outcomes. Currently, the goniometer is the standard tool for assessing finger flexion and extension. However, manual goniometry is labor-intensive and suffers from inconsistent inter-rater reliability due to variations in examiner technique. While digital alternatives exist, current software-based approaches often lack the necessary accuracy for clinical usage. To address these limitations, we present a novel pipeline for 3-D hand joint location and pose estimation using neural rendering. Unlike previous methods, our approach combines 2-D feature extraction with view synthesis to significantly improve accuracy and clinical viability. Furthermore, we introduce a discrete density hill climbing algorithm that facilitates the meaningful correction of projected landmarks in 3-D space. This system overcomes the inefficiencies of manual measurement and the inaccuracies of existing software, providing a robust tool for objective functional assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于神经渲染的3D手部关节定位与姿态估计新流程，用于手指活动度（ROM）的客观量化评估，克服了传统量角器人工测量耗时且可靠性差、现有软件精度不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 手部与手指疾病是肌肉骨骼残疾的主要原因，需要精确量化关节运动的临床工具。当前金标准量角器人工测量劳动密集且因操作者技术差异导致评估者间信度不一致，而现有数字化软件方法缺乏临床所需的准确性。
AI.method: 提出一种结合2D特征提取与视图合成的神经渲染3D手部关节定位与姿态估计pipeline，并引入离散密度爬山算法，实现投影地标在3D空间中有意义的修正。
AI.result: 该系统克服了人工测量的低效率与现有软件的不准确性，显著提升临床可用性，为客观功能评估提供了稳健工具。
AI.conclusion: 该神经渲染方法相比此前方法能显著提升临床关节运动量化精度，为手部功能障碍的客观评估提供可行且可靠的替代方案。

title: Disentangling Co-Occurring Retinal Pathologies with Saliency-Guided Sparse Expert Routing
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing
summary: Retinal fundus images frequently exhibit multiple co-occurring pathologies, yet standard deep learning classifiers apply static, identical computation to every image regardless of the underlying disease distribution. We propose a novel architecture that resolves this via sparse conditional computation, pairing a Guided Context Gating (GCG) spatial attention front-end with a sparsely-routed Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) block operating over feature tokens. Crucially, this routing yields an interpretable, data-driven decomposition. Expert allocation is significantly disease-dependent (p < 0.001), with the healthy Normal state and morphologically distinct pathologies (e.g., ERM, AMD) isolating to dedicated experts. On a five-class, patient-disjoint 5-fold cross-validation benchmark, our model achieves 0.912 +/- 0.008 macro AUC and 0.653 +/- 0.014 macro F1. Furthermore, Grad-CAM++ and post-MoE t-SNE visualizations confirm that expert routing aligns with localized lesions and geometrically maps co-occurring cases between their constituent clusters, positioning sparse MoE as an interpretable approach to multi-disease retinal screening.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种稀疏条件计算架构用于视网膜眼底图像多病种分类，结合引导上下文门控（GCG）空间注意力前端与稀疏路由混合专家（MoE）块，在五类病人不相交五折交叉验证中达到0.912±0.008宏AUC和0.653±0.014宏F1，并通过可视化证明专家路由与病灶定位对齐，实现可解释的多病种视网膜筛查。
AI.motivation: 标准深度学习分类器对所有图像施加静态、相同的计算，忽视了视网膜眼底图像中多种病理共存的异质性，未能根据底层疾病分布自适应分配计算资源。
AI.method: 提出GCG空间注意力前端与稀疏路由MoE块结合的架构。GCG用于空间注意力引导，MoE块在特征token上执行稀疏条件计算，其路由机制产生可解释的数据驱动分解。
AI.result: 专家分配显著依赖疾病类型（p<0.001），正常状态与形态学上独特的病理（如ERM、AMD）被隔离到专用专家。模型在五类、病人不相交五折交叉验证中达到0.912±0.008宏AUC和0.653±0.014宏F1。Grad-CAM++和post-MoE t-SNE可视化证实专家路由与局部病灶对齐，并将共生病例几何映射到其组成簇之间。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏MoE被定位为一种可解释的多病种视网膜筛查方法，通过数据驱动的专家分配实现疾病依赖的适应性计算，同时保持可解释性。

title: C$^2$A: Coupling Spatial Evidence with Clinical Priors via Co-occurrence Aware Class Attention for Multi-Label Chest X-Ray Classification
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing
summary: Thoracic pathologies rarely occur in isolation, yet standard multi-label classifiers rely on shared global descriptors, discarding \emph{where} findings lie and \emph{how} they co-occur. We propose \textbf{C$\mathbf{^2}$A} (Co-occurrence Aware Class Attention), a classification head that explicitly couples spatial evidence with clinical priors. First, C$^2$A casts pooling as an expectation over learned per-class spatial attention maps, yielding localized descriptors for each disease. Second, it couples these descriptors via a learnable graph warm-started from empirical label co-occurrence. A single residual message-passing step shares evidence among related findings, proving to be a bounded perturbation of the identity where co-occurrence enters each logit through an explicit bilinear interaction. On CheXpert, C$^2$A achieves a superior $0.895$ macro-mean AUROC, outperforming advanced context-gating baselines. Crucially, gains concentrate on highly co-occurrent classes with ambiguous spatial evidence (rescuing Atelectasis by $+1.5$ over GCG), demonstrating the prior's regularizing effect with a negligible overhead of one linear projection and a $C\!\times\!C$ edge matrix.

AI.tldr: 本文提出C²A（Co-occurrence Aware Class Attention）分类头，通过将池化操作建模为对可学习逐类空间注意力图的期望，生成每个疾病的局部描述符；并利用从经验标签共现矩阵热启动的可学习图来耦合这些描述符，通过单次残差消息传递在相关发现间共享证据。在CheXpert上取得0.895的宏平均AUROC，超越先进基线，且增益集中在高度共现但空间证据模糊的类别上，额外开销极小。
AI.motivation: 胸部病理很少单独出现，但标准多标签分类器依赖共享的全局描述符，忽略了发现的位置信息及其共现模式，导致分类性能受限。
AI.method: 1) 将池化操作转化为对逐类空间注意力图的学习期望，为每种疾病生成局部描述符；2) 通过从经验标签共现矩阵热启动的可学习图耦合这些描述符；3) 执行单次残差消息传递共享证据，证明其为恒等映射的有界扰动，共现通过显式双线性交互进入每个logit。
AI.result: 在CheXpert数据集上达到0.895的宏平均AUROC，优于先进上下文门控基线；增益集中在高度共现且空间证据模糊的类别上（Atelectasis较GCG提升+1.5），仅需一个线性投影和C×C边矩阵的极小开销。
AI.conclusion: C²A验证了临床共现先验与空间注意力耦合的有效性，其正则化效应在空间证据模糊的高度共现类别上尤为突出，同时保持了极低的计算开销，为多标签胸部影像分类提供了一种高效且可解释的方案。

title: NTIRE 2026 Low-light Enhancement: Twilight Cowboy Challenge
summary: This paper presents a review of the NTIRE 2026 Low-light Enhancement: Twilight Cowboy Challenge. The objective of the competition was to merge a set of misaligned smartphone images in the raw domain, captured in low-light conditions, into a single, clean image. Introduced setup simultaneously addresses two problems of low-light photography: visual degradations such as high noise and mixed scene illuminants, and the geometric inconsistencies caused by hand movement during multi-frame capture. To advance research in low-light and nighttime computational photography, a challenging dataset was collected comprising 585 real-world scenes, spanning indoor low-light and outdoor nighttime conditions, for training and benchmarking participant solutions. The competition employed a three-stage evaluation protocol: automatic validation via the CodaBench platform in stages one and two, followed by blind assessment on a private test set for the final ranking. Ten teams surpassed the established baseline, achieving improvements of up to +6.49 dB in PSNR and +0.0101 in SSIM, thereby establishing new state-of-the-art performance for burst-based low-light image enhancement. These results demonstrate significant progress in handling real-world noise, motion, and illumination variability in the low-light setting. Comprehensive results, leaderboards, and additional information are publicly available at https://nightimaging.org.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了NTIRE 2026低光增强挑战赛（Twilight Cowboy），该竞赛要求参赛者在RAW域中融合一组错位的智能手机低光多帧图像，同时解决噪声、混合光源等视觉退化问题和手持拍摄导致的几何不一致问题。竞赛收集了585个真实场景数据集，采用三阶段评估协议，最终10支队伍超过基线，最高提升+6.49 dB PSNR和+0.0101 SSIM，刷新了基于突发序列的低光图像增强的最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 低光摄影同时面临两类挑战：一是高噪声和混合场景光源等视觉退化问题，二是多帧拍摄时手持移动造成的几何错位。现有方法通常分别处理这些问题，缺乏一个统一框架来同时解决二者。
AI.method: 竞赛在RAW域中要求参赛者将一组错位的智能手机低光多帧图像融合为一张干净图像。数据集包含585个真实场景（室内低光和室外夜间）。评估采用三阶段协议：前两阶段通过CodaBench平台自动验证，最终阶段在私有测试集上进行盲评。
AI.result: 10支参赛队伍超过预设基线，在PSNR上最高提升+6.49 dB，SSIM上最高提升+0.0101，建立了突发低光图像增强的新最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 该挑战赛结果表明，在统一框架下同时处理真实世界噪声、运动和光照变化是可行的，并且取得了显著进展。所有结果、排行榜和额外信息已公开发布。

title: ADOPD: Reference-Privileged On-Policy Distillation for MLLM-Based Industrial Anomaly Detection
summary: Industrial anomaly detection (IAD) requires identifying fine-grained deviations from normal visual patterns. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can improve recognition accuracy by comparing query images with references at inference time, but these benefits rely on additional retrieval and processing. We investigate whether the benefits of reference comparison can instead be internalized in the model parameters. Access to references during training allows a reference-aware teacher to supervise a query-only student. However, the teacher may favor plausible responses based on query cues or language priors rather than valid visual information. We propose ADOPD, a reference-privileged on-policy distillation framework. The teacher evaluates student-generated rollouts under matched and mismatched references. The matched-reference teacher-to-student log-ratio defines the token-level learning direction, specifying what the student should learn. The likelihood gap between the two reference views estimates reference-specific support and calibrates the sequence-level weight. ADOPD achieves 77.31% average accuracy on the MMAD benchmark under zero-shot inference, improving the Qwen3-VL-4B backbone by 6.14 points and outperforming its one-shot setting by 2.64 points. Experiments show that ADOPD learns a fine-grained anomaly inspection strategy from reference comparison. The project will be available at https://github.com/withTai/ADOPD.

AI.tldr: 提出ADOPD框架，通过参考特权在线策略蒸馏（reference-privileged on-policy distillation）将参考比较能力内化到模型参数中，使模型在零样本推理时无需额外检索和处理参考图像即可获得与参考比较相当甚至更好的异常检测性能，在MMAD基准上达到77.31%平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）通过推理时比较查询图像与参考图像可以提升工业异常检测（IAD）的识别精度，但这种优势依赖于额外的检索和处理开销。作者希望探索能否将参考比较带来的收益直接内化到模型参数中，从而在零样本推理时无需依赖参考图像即可获得同样的检测能力。
AI.method: 提出ADOPD（reference-privileged on-policy distillation）框架：(1) 训练时利用参考感知的教师模型监督仅查询输入的学生模型；(2) 教师模型评估学生生成的rollouts，分别在匹配与不匹配的参考条件下进行评价；(3) 匹配参考下教师到学生的对数概率比（log-ratio）定义token级别的学习方向；(4) 两种参考视角下的似然差距用于估计参考特定支持度（reference-specific support）并校准序列级别的权重。
AI.result: 在MMAD基准上零样本推理达到77.31%平均准确率，相比Qwen3-VL-4B骨干提升6.14个百分点，并超越其一次样本（one-shot）设置2.64个百分点。实验表明ADOPD成功学习到了从参考比较中提炼的细粒度异常检查策略。
AI.conclusion: ADOPD验证了参考比较能力可以通过蒸馏方式内化到模型参数中，使模型在零样本推理时无需额外的参考检索和处理就能获得优于一次样本设置的性能，为工业异常检测中高效推理提供了新的思路。

title: Modern Backbones Improve Multi-task DETR for Mammography Classification and Lesion Localization
comment: Medical Imaging with Deep Learning 2026 - Short Paper Track
summary: Joint exam-level prediction and candidate-region localization may improve the usefulness of AI support in mammography. We study this setting using a multi-task DETR framework, where shared representations support both image-level malignancy prediction and lesion localization, and evaluate its performance on OPTIMAM and a biopsy-confirmed SGM1k cohort. Across both datasets, modern backbones consistently outperformed older ResNet-style features, with ConvNeXtV2 and DINOv3 giving the strongest overall results, whereas MambaVision was less competitive. On OPTIMAM, ConvNeXtV2 achieved the best overall performance, reaching 97.96% AUC, 99.89% sensitivity, 25.08% mAP@.5, and 74.38% recall@.25. On SGM1k, DINOv3 gave the strongest overall results, with 90.97% AUC, 86.28% sensitivity, 82.00% specificity, 27.04% mAP@.5, and 77.32% recall@.25. These findings suggest that backbone quality is a critical factor in effective multi-task mammography, with ConvNeXtV2 emerging as a particularly strong and well-matched CNN backbone for mammography in this framework.

AI.tldr: 本文研究使用多任务DETR框架同时进行乳腺X光摄影的影像级恶性肿瘤预测和病灶区域定位。研究在OPTIMAM和SGM1k两个数据集上比较了多种骨干网络，发现ConvNeXtV2和DINOv3表现最佳，骨干网络质量是多任务乳腺影像分析的关键因素。
AI.motivation: 联合进行考试级预测和候选区域定位可能提升AI在乳腺X光摄影中的实用性，但现有研究对此联合设置探索不足，需要评估不同骨干网络在该多任务框架下的表现。
AI.method: 采用多任务DETR框架，共享表示同时支持影像级恶性预测和病灶定位。在OPTIMAM（活检确认的参考标准）和SGM1k数据集上评估多个现代骨干网络（ConvNeXtV2、DINOv3、MambaVision等），并与较旧的ResNet风格特征进行对比。
AI.result: 现代骨干网络在两个数据集上均优于旧式ResNet特征。OPTIMAM上ConvNeXtV2最佳（AUC 97.96%，敏感度99.89%，mAP@.5 25.08%，recall@.25 74.38%）；SGM1k上DINOv3最佳（AUC 90.97%，敏感度86.28%，特异度82.00%，mAP@.5 27.04%，recall@.25 77.32%）。MambaVision表现相对较弱。
AI.conclusion: 骨干网络质量是多任务乳腺X光摄影中的关键因素。ConvNeXtV2被证明是该框架下特别强大且与乳腺影像高度适配的CNN骨干网络。

title: MedPixel: A Unified Pixel-Language Model for Medical Reasoning and Segmentation
summary: Reliable medical image understanding requires models to connect clinical language and visual reasoning with pixel-level grounding. Yet medical vision-language models often lack precise localization, whereas medical segmenters typically rely on explicit target categories or precise spatial prompts. This divide is reinforced by a supervision mismatch: segmentation datasets provide precise masks but little language supervision, whereas medical vision-language data rarely pair language with dense spatial annotations. To address this gap, we present MedPixel, a unified medical pixel-language model built around a shared language--mask interface. To provide scalable supervision, we introduce MedPLG-440K, comprising approximately 440K pixel-language task samples constructed through a clinically motivated synthesis process without external LLM annotation. MedPixel is trained with joint multi-task supervised fine-tuning followed by Pixel-Level Preference Optimization, which uses ground-truth masks as offline verifiers to derive response preferences from mask quality. MedPixel supports a broad spectrum of tasks spanning explicit grounding, implicit reasoning, spatial interaction, grounded explanation, and medical VQA. Across this task spectrum, MedPixel achieves strong performance in both pixel-level prediction and response generation, together with effective zero-shot transfer to external grounding benchmarks and robustness to imperfect spatial prompts. Code and model checkpoints will be released at https://github.com/yhy-whu/Medpixel.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MedPixel，一个统一的医学像素-语言模型，通过共享的语言-掩码接口弥合医学视觉语言模型缺乏精确定位与医学分割模型依赖显式提示之间的鸿沟。作者构建了约440K像素-语言任务样本的MedPLG-440K数据集（无需外部LLM标注），并采用联合多任务监督微调加像素级偏好优化（以GT掩码作为离线验证器）进行训练，支持显式定位、隐式推理、空间交互、可解释分割和医学VQA等多种任务，实现像素级预测与响应生成的良好性能及零样本迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 医学视觉语言模型往往缺乏精确的像素级定位能力，而医学分割模型通常依赖显式的目标类别或精确的空间提示。这种割裂源于监督信号的不匹配：分割数据集提供精确掩码但语言监督极少，而医学视觉语言数据很少将语言与稠密空间标注配对。作者旨在弥合这一鸿沟，构建统一的像素-语言模型。
AI.method: 1) 提出MedPixel统一架构，围绕共享的语言-掩码接口设计；2) 构建MedPLG-440K数据集（约44万像素-语言任务样本），通过临床动机驱动的合成流程生成，无需外部LLM标注；3) 采用联合多任务监督微调（SFT）后接像素级偏好优化（Pixel-Level Preference Optimization），利用GT掩码作为离线验证器从掩码质量推导响应偏好。
AI.result: MedPixel在显式定位、隐式推理、空间交互、可解释分割和医学VQA等广泛任务谱系上均取得强性能，在像素级预测和响应生成两方面表现优异，同时展现出对外部定位基准的有效零样本迁移能力以及对不完美空间提示的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: MedPixel通过统一的语言-掩码接口和创新的数据合成与偏好优化策略，成功弥合了医学语言理解与像素级分割之间的鸿沟，为医学图像理解提供了一个可扩展的统一框架，代码和模型将开源。

title: From Diagnosis to Correction: Benchmarking and Improving Real-World Table Parsing
summary: Recent document parsers achieve table TEDS scores above 93 on OmniDocBench v1.6, yet community feedback and our audit reveal persistent failures on complex real-world tables. To quantify this gap, we introduce TableParseMap, a diagnostic benchmark of 916 real-world tables organized into five challenging scenarios and nine failure types. The strongest evaluated parser achieves only 85.03 TEDS, showing that aggregate benchmark scores conceal substantial weaknesses. Our analysis attributes these failures to three complementary limitations: large tables exceed the reliable processing scale of a single pass, weak or ambiguous visual cues hinder structure perception, and the reconstructed table may remain visually inconsistent with the image. We therefore propose DEC (Decompose--Enhance--Correct), a visual-consistency-guided agentic framework that improves frozen table parsers without retraining. DEC uses a general VLM as the controller: Decompose partitions large tables along structure-aware boundaries, Enhance exposes weak visual evidence and reparses transformed views, and Correct diagnoses and repairs residual errors. A Visual Consistency Gate (VC-Gate) selectively triggers intervention, while a Visual Consistency Ranker (VC-Ranker) verifies candidate updates and supports rollback without ground-truth HTML at inference time. We further derive a 1,977-table Consensus-Hard Set from 4,556 candidates through offline metrics and cross-model consensus. Across three frozen parsers, DEC improves TEDS by 1.57 points on average; on TableParseMap, gains reach 1.89 points overall, 2.62 on structural errors, and 5.66 on large tables.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TableParseMap基准（916张真实世界表格，5类场景，9种失败类型），揭示了最高性能解析器仅达85.03 TEDS的实际差距，并提出DEC框架（Decompose-Enhance-Correct），一个无需重训、利用通用VLM作为控制器的可视化一致性引导智能体框架，平均提升冻结解析器1.57个TEDS点。
AI.motivation: 现有文档解析器在OmniDocBench v1.6上TEDS>93，但社区反馈和审计显示在复杂真实世界表格上仍持续失败，聚合基准分数掩盖了重大缺陷，亟需量化和解决这一差距。
AI.method: 提出TableParseMap诊断基准（916张真实表格，5个挑战场景，9种失败类型）；提出DEC框架：Decompose沿结构感知边界分割大表格，Enhance暴露弱视觉证据并重新解析变换视图，Correct诊断和修复残留错误；VC-Gate选择性触发干预，VC-Ranker在无真值HTML下验证候选更新；从4,556个候选中通过离线指标和跨模型共识导出1,977表的Consensus-Hard Set。
AI.result: 最强解析器在TableParseMap上仅达85.03 TEDS；DEC在三个冻结解析器上平均提升1.57 TEDS；在TableParseMap上整体提升1.89，结构化错误上提升2.62，大表格上提升5.66。
AI.conclusion: 聚合基准分数会掩盖真实能力的不足；DEC通过可视化一致性引导的智能体框架，无需重训即可有效提升冻结解析器的鲁棒性，尤其在结构错误和大表格场景下效果显著。

title: Sci-VBench: Evaluating Knowledge- and Reasoning-Intensive Video Generation in Science Domains
summary: We introduce Sci-VBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating knowledge- and reasoning-intensive video generation across scientific domains. It contains 1,253 expert-annotated examples spanning 60 subjects across four core disciplines: Natural Science, Healthcare, Humanities & Social Sciences, and Engineering. Each example requires models to generate temporally rich videos that demand scientific reasoning and knowledge-grounded synthesis, going beyond surface-level visual plausibility. We further establish a rubric-based evaluation protocol. Our analysis shows that, under this protocol, both non-expert human evaluators and MLLM-as-Judge systems can achieve relatively high agreement with expert judgments, supporting reproducible evaluation at scale. We benchmark 16 frontier proprietary and open-source models and find that, while automatic perceptual-quality scores cluster tightly across systems, performance on Prompt Grounding and Scientific and Causal Correctness varies substantially, with a pronounced proprietary-open-source gap. These findings show that advances in visual realism have not yet translated into reliable modeling of scientific and causal dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Sci-VBench，一个面向科学领域的视频生成综合基准，涵盖1253个专家标注样本、60个主题、4大学科，并建立了基于评分标准的评估协议，对16个前沿模型进行了评测。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成基准主要评估表面视觉合理性，缺乏对科学推理和知识密集型视频生成的系统评估，无法判断模型是否真正理解科学和因果动态。
AI.method: 构建包含1253个专家标注样本的基准（覆盖自然科学、医疗健康、人文社科、工程四大学科），设计基于评分标准的评估协议，采用非专家人工评估者和MLLM-as-Judge进行可扩展评测。
AI.result: 非专家评估者和MLLM评估系统与专家判断具有较高一致性；16个模型在感知质量得分上高度聚集，但在提示词基础和科学因果正确性上差异显著，存在明显的专有-开源差距。
AI.conclusion: 视觉真实性的进步尚未转化为对科学和因果动力学的可靠建模，表明该领域需要更关注科学推理能力的提升。

title: Financial Numerical Prediction and Allocation as Token Generation
summary: Financial prediction typically relies on task-specific regression, ranking, or policy heads, separating the language model from the numerical object ultimately evaluated. We investigate whether a causal language model can instead represent forecasts and decisions directly through constrained token generation. FinATOM introduces a unified, head-free interface for three-step stock-return forecasting and dynamic five-ETF allocation. The forecasting model autoregressively emits volatility-standardized return tokens and is trained with ordinal and ranking supervision followed by a one-epoch token-level policy stage. The allocation model generates normalized long-only weights; supervised fine-tuning imitates a causal mean--variance anchor, and DAPO-augmented GRPO optimizes realized 21-day Sharpe subject to anchor consistency. In 2023--2025 ETF tests, the allocation policy improves pooled gross Sharpe from 1.428 to 1.529 and net Sharpe under a 5-bp transaction-cost model from 1.394 to 1.494. The multimodal allocation input attains the highest three-period mean Sharpe of 1.540, with its clearest advantage in 2025. On FinTexTS, the SFT and policy strategies achieve 73.52\%/2.68 and 73.72\%/2.69 cumulative-return/Sharpe, respectively. These results support the feasibility of direct language-model token generation for financial numerical prediction and decision-making, while motivating broader tests across assets, regimes, and random seeds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FinATOM，一个统一的免头部（head-free）因果语言模型接口，直接通过受限token生成实现三步骤股票收益预测和五ETF动态资产配置，无需任务特定的回归、排序或策略头。实验表明该方法在2023-2025年ETF测试中将混合总Sharpe从1.428提升至1.529，并验证了语言模型直接进行数值预测与决策的可行性。
AI.motivation: 传统金融预测方法将语言模型与最终评估的数值目标分离，依赖任务特定的回归、排序或策略头。作者质疑这种分离设计，希望探究因果语言模型能否通过受限token生成直接表示预测结果和决策，从而简化架构并提升表现。
AI.method: FinATOM包含两个核心组件：(1)预测模型：自回归地生成波动率标准化的收益token，采用序数（ordinal）和排序（ranking）监督训练，随后进行一个epoch的token级策略阶段；(2)配置模型：生成归一化的多头权重，通过有监督微调模仿因果均值-方差基准，并用DAPO增强的GRPO优化21天实现Sharpe，同时保持与基准的一致性。
AI.result: 在2023-2025年ETF测试中，配置策略将混合总Sharpe从1.428提升至1.529，5bp交易成本模型下的净Sharpe从1.394提升至1.494。多模态配置输入实现最高三期平均Sharpe 1.540，在2025年优势最明显。FinTexTS上SFT和策略分别达到73.52%/2.68与73.72%/2.69的累计收益/Sharpe。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持直接语言模型token生成用于金融数值预测和决策的可行性，同时指出需要在更多资产类别、市场状态和随机种子下进行更广泛的测试以进一步验证。

title: Space-Creating versus Dead Possession: An Off-Ball Possession-Quality Index for Broadcast Football
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures. Code and data pipeline: https://github.com/nowayfootball/junk-possession
summary: Ball possession is the most-cited and most-misleading number in football: 60% recycled in one's own half is not 60% spent pinning the opponent back. Existing event-based possession-value frameworks (expected threat, VAEP, on-ball value) price on-ball actions but ignore the off-ball question a sterile possession poses: did holding the ball create space, or was the circulation dead? We answer this in two layers. First, an event-side junk-possession index prices each possession sequence by its peak threat gain under an expected-threat grid and -- after reconstructing the live scoreline to exclude lead-protecting circulation -- flags low-threat sequences in tied-or-losing states. On the 2026 FIFA World Cup (103 matches, 206 team-matches) the flag correlates negatively with points (r=-0.37) and xG difference (r=-0.51, partly index-coupled). It is not a repackaging of on-ball value: with team offensive VAEP and field tilt held fixed, the junk flag stays strongly negatively associated with points (p<0.0001, also match-clustered) while VAEP is not significant -- in this same-match (descriptive) regression it adds information beyond this on-ball action-value model. Second, for a flagged window we resolve whether it was spatially dead or space-creating by projecting broadcast video to pitch coordinates and measuring a Space-Creation Index (SCI): a net pitch-control change capturing whether the possession seized space or pushed the opponent's block back. Across 31 of 35 flagged windows from nine World Cup matches (a purposive sample), 74% are spatially non-space-creating, 19% weak progression, and 6% space-creating windows the event flag alone would score as failure -- including a side with 73% of the ball that exited on penalties (two non-creating windows). The two layers separate space-creating-but-unconverted from sterile possession, a distinction event-only on-ball value cannot make.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个双层框架来区分足球中"死球控球"（junk possession）与"创造空间的有效控球"。第一层基于事件的垃圾控球指数（junk-possession index），利用预期威胁网格为每次控球序列定价，并重建实时比分以排除领先保护性传导，标记平局或落后状态下的低威胁序列。第二层通过广播视频投影到球场坐标，测量空间创造指数（SCI）判断被标记窗口是空间上死球还是创造空间。在2026年世界杯数据上，垃圾控球标志与积分显著负相关（r=-0.37），且即使控制VAEP和控球区域，该标志仍提供超越控球动作价值模型的增量信息。
AI.motivation: 现有的事件型控球价值框架（预期威胁、VAEP、控球价值）只对持球动作定价，忽略了无球问题——控球是否创造了空间，还是循环是无效的？作者希望通过区分"创造空间但未转化"与"无效控球"来弥补这一缺陷。
AI.method: 采用两层方法：(1) 事件侧：构建垃圾控球指数，通过预期威胁网格评估每个控球序列的峰值威胁增益，重建实时比分排除领先保护性传导，标记平局或落后状态的低威胁序列；(2) 空间侧：对标记窗口，将广播视频投影到球场坐标，计算空间创造指数（SCI），即净球场控制变化，判断控球是抢占空间还是被对手压迫回退。
AI.result: 2026年世界杯103场比赛（206个队-比赛）中，垃圾控球标志与积分负相关（r=-0.37），与xG差值负相关（r=-0.51）。控制VAEP和控球区域后，垃圾标志仍与积分显著负相关（p<0.0001）而VAEP不显著，提供增量信息。空间层面，31/35个标记窗口中有74%为非空间创造，19%为弱推进，6%为事件标志会误判为失败的空间创造窗口。包括一支控球率73%但在点球大战中出局的球队。
AI.conclusion: 该双层框架有效区分了"创造空间但未转化"与"无效控球"这两种情形，这是纯事件型控球价值模型无法做到的。垃圾控球指数不仅是对控球价值的重新包装，而是在控制控球动作价值后仍能提供显著的额外预测能力。

title: DistMoE: Private-data Rehearsal-free Routing in Mixture-of-Experts for Distributed Instruction Tuning
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong multimodal instruction-following ability, but adapting them to diverse visual-language domains typically assumes centralized data access and costly joint training. This is restrictive when data is distributed across private, domain-specific, or permission-limited clients. To this end, we propose DistMoE, a mixture-of-experts (MoE) approach for distributed visual instruction tuning. In each layer of the language decoder it augments the public feedforward network (FFN) with a client-specific private FFN expert, with the goal to acquire domain-specific knowledge. However, independent expert training causes the private FFNs to learn representation of different scale and magnitudes, making merging the experts difficult. To reduce client-specific drift, we introduce a public-anchored expert composition stage that updates only routers and lightweight private projection adapters on a mix of local client data and public data, via an isotropic regularization loss, therefore making it cross-client rehearsal-free composition. During inference, DistMoE performs modular routing over public and private experts, enabling token-wise domain composition without explicit domain labels. Experiments across diverse visual-language benchmarks show that DistMoE enables flexible expert reuse, effective domain adaptation, and competitive performance while preserving modular control over client-specific knowledge. Codes are available at https://github.com/mainaksingha01/DistMoE.

AI.tldr: DistMoE提出了一种基于混合专家（MoE）的分布式视觉指令调优方法，通过在公共FFN上附加客户端特定的私有FFN专家，并引入公共锚定的专家组合阶段（使用各向同性正则化损失）来解决专家合并中的漂移问题，实现无需跨客户端回放排练的模块化路由推理。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的视觉指令调优通常假设集中式数据访问和昂贵的联合训练，这限制了数据分布在私有、领域特定或权限受限客户端上的应用场景。
AI.method: DistMoE在语言解码器的每一层，用客户端特定的私有FFN专家增强公共FFN；引入公共锚定的专家组合阶段，仅更新路由器和轻量级私有投影适配器，结合各向同性正则化损失在本地客户端数据和公共数据的混合上进行训练；推理时通过模块化路由在公共和私有专家间进行token级领域组合。
AI.result: 在多样化的视觉-语言基准测试上，DistMoE实现了灵活的专家复用、有效的领域适应和有竞争力的性能，同时保持对客户端特定知识的模块化控制。
AI.conclusion: DistMoE证明了在分布式、隐私受限的视觉-语言领域适应中，通过公共锚定的专家组合实现无需显式领域标签的token级模块化路由是可行且有效的。

title: Beyond Hazard Resemblance: Contrastive Event Adjudication for Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection
summary: Video anomaly detection (VAD) aims to identify and temporally localize abnormal events in videos. Supervised methods learn anomaly decision boundaries from target-domain annotations but require substantial in-domain data. Existing training-free methods leverage the rich semantic knowledge and reasoning capabilities of pretrained models to interpret visual content, yet these capabilities do not directly define an anomaly decision criterion: richer anomaly descriptions better capture hazard resemblance without resolving abnormality. To this end, we propose Contrastive Event Adjudication for training-free Video Anomaly Detection (CEAVAD), which shifts the unit of inference from isolated anomaly concepts to falsifiable event hypotheses and establishes an inference-time explanatory boundary through the interaction between competing explanations and video evidence. Specifically, CEAVAD first uses public-safety knowledge to construct hazard-benign event contrasts, pairing each hazard mechanism with a generic normal account and a mechanism-specific benign counterpart. It then determines whether the target interval better supports a hazard explanation or its benign competitor, yielding a revisable contrastive boundary proposal for the target. Finally, CEAVAD adjudicates between the competing explanations to determine whether the hazard hypothesis survives the video evidence, supporting both temporally localized anomaly detection and evidence-grounded explanations. Experiments on three widely used VAD benchmarks demonstrate that CEAVAD achieves state-of-the-art performance under the training-free paradigm.

AI.tldr: CEAVAD 是一种无训练的视频异常检测方法，它通过将推理单元从孤立的异常概念转变为可证伪的事件假设，利用危害-良性事件对比和竞争性解释裁决，为视频异常检测建立推理时的解释性边界，在三个基准上取得了无训练范式下的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有训练免费方法虽利用预训练模型的语义知识和推理能力，但这些能力并不直接定义异常判定标准——更丰富的异常描述只是更好地捕捉了危险相似性，却无法解决"是否异常"的判定问题。监督方法需要大量域内标注，成本高昂。
AI.method: CEAVAD 将推理单元从孤立异常概念转为可证伪的事件假设。首先利用公共安全知识构建危害-良性事件对比（每个危害机制配对通用正常描述和机制特定的良性对应）；然后判断目标区间更支持危害解释还是良性竞争者，生成可修订的对比边界提案；最后在竞争性解释之间进行裁决，确定危害假设是否在视频证据下成立，同时支持时序定位和基于证据的解释。
AI.result: 在三个广泛使用的视频异常检测基准上，CEAVAD 在无训练范式下达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将异常判定从概念描述转变为可证伪的事件假设裁决，CEAVAD 成功弥合了预训练模型语义能力与异常判定标准之间的鸿沟，实现了无需训练数据的高性能视频异常检测，并能提供基于证据的可解释输出。

title: Learning How the World Evolves: Extrapolative Video World Models via Latent Dynamics Reasoning
summary: The world evolves following its dynamics, i.e., its laws of motion. However, leading video diffusion models largely fit the pixels without modeling how the pixels transit over time. Thus, they render visually plausible frames but may not accurately obey the laws. To capture the dynamics purely from pixels, we introduce Latent Dynamics Reasoning (LDR). LDR casts the latent transition as an explicit kinematic integration, where the lower-order dynamics are integrated numerically and the model regresses only the third- and higher-order residual that drives the rollout. For this integration to extrapolate better, LDR runs it on a structured latent rather than dense convolutional features. Following PhyWorld, we validate LDR on a controlled white-box physics benchmark spanning five tasks (uniform motion, parabola, collision, bouncing, looming), focusing on out-of-distribution scenarios that reveal whether a model has truly learned the underlying dynamics. LDR extrapolates the learned dynamics far better: the gap between its in- and out-of-distribution error is over 20$\times$ smaller than the video diffusion baseline's, under both single- and joint-task training at 256$^2$ resolution, while using 26$\times$ fewer parameters and running 143$\times$ faster. LDR can even generalize under severe shift: for example, trained only on red balls moving left-to-right, it correctly predicts the motion of a blue square moving right-to-left. To our knowledge, this is the first video world model that extrapolates learned dynamics beyond its training distribution. Project page: https://lat-dyn-reason.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出潜在动力学推理（LDR），将视频扩散模型从纯像素拟合提升为显式动力学建模，通过数值积分潜在状态并仅回归高阶残差来实现跨分布外推，在物理基准上以更少参数和更快速度实现了远优于基线的高阶外推能力，是首个能够将学到的动力学外推至训练分布之外的视频世界模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视频扩散模型主要拟合像素帧，并未显式建模像素随时间的转移规律，因此虽能生成视觉上合理的帧，却不一定符合真实的物理运动定律。作者希望纯粹从像素出发捕获世界的动力学规律，实现超越训练分布的真实外推。
AI.method: LDR将潜在状态转移显式建模为运动学积分：低阶动力学采用数值积分，模型仅回归第三阶及以上的残差来驱动滚动生成；为提升外推能力，积分在结构化潜在表示而非稠密卷积特征上进行；并在白盒物理基准上以单任务与多任务两种方式验证。
AI.result: 在均匀运动、抛物线、碰撞、反弹、逼近等五个物理任务上，LDR比视频扩散基线在分布内外误差差距上缩小超过20倍，参数少26倍，速度快143倍，且在严重分布偏移（如红球左向右训练、预测蓝方块右向左运动）下仍能正确泛化。
AI.conclusion: LDR表明显式结合物理动力学积分结构能够显著提升视频世界模型对底层运动规律的学习与外推能力，是首个在广泛场景中实现跨训练分布动力学外推的视频世界模型。

title: Perception Before Supervision: Self-Contained Visual Distillation from Counterfactual Blind Spots
summary: Self-improvement for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is typically driven by reward-based methods that provide only coarse scalar feedback. Distillation offers a richer alternative through dense token-level supervision, but in the visual domain it usually depends on privileged context constructed using external annotations and tools, or stronger models. We introduce \textbf{CVPD} (Contrastive Counterfactual Visual Process Distillation), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first fully self-contained framework for dense, on-policy, token-level visual self-distillation for MLLMs. CVPD identifies visual blind spots where zooming into a region changes and sharpens the model's answer distribution, while removing the same region leaves the full-image behavior largely unchanged. Such regions reveal perceptual information that the model can encode but fails to consistently utilize under full-image conditioning. We propose a three-gate Counterfactual Criterion that identifies these regions directly from the model's own responses and converts them into dense contrastive supervision for self-distillation. On Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, CVPD outperforms six self-evolving baselines across twelve benchmarks, including methods that rely on external GPT-4o supervision, without a single regression. It achieves gains of $+3.60$ on OCRBench, $+3.38$ on MMStar Fine-Grained Perception, and $+3.08$ on MMStar Logical Reasoning, while maintaining or improving performance on broader multimodal benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CVPD（对比反事实视觉过程蒸馏），这是首个完全自包含的MLLM密集、on-policy、token级视觉自蒸馏框架。CVPD通过识别模型的视觉盲区（放大区域改变答案分布，但移除该区域不影响整体行为），利用三闸反事实准则将这些区域转化为密集对比监督信号进行自蒸馏，在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上超越六种自进化基线（包括依赖外部GPT-4o监督的方法），且无任何回退。
AI.motivation: 现有的MLLM自改进方法主要依赖基于奖励的粗粒度标量反馈，而蒸馏方法虽能提供更丰富的token级密集监督，但在视觉领域通常依赖外部标注、工具或更强模型构建特权上下文。作者希望突破这一依赖，实现完全自包含的视觉自蒸馏。
AI.method: CVPD首先识别视觉盲区——这些区域在放大时会改变并锐化模型的答案分布，但移除后对全图行为影响不大，说明模型能编码这些感知信息但在全图条件下未能一致利用。随后提出三闸反事实准则，直接从模型自身响应中识别这些区域，并将其转化为密集对比监督信号用于自蒸馏。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上，CVPD在12个基准上超越6种自进化基线（包括依赖外部GPT-4o监督的方法），无单一回退。OCRBench提升+3.60，MMStar细粒度感知提升+3.38，MMStar逻辑推理提升+3.08，同时保持或提升更广泛的多模态基准性能。
AI.conclusion: CVPD证明了无需外部监督，仅通过模型自身响应即可实现有效的密集token级视觉自蒸馏，填补了完全自包含视觉自蒸馏框架的空白，为MLLM自改进提供了新的范式。
